source_en: @I've been a crossbow maker for so long, I've gotten weary of it. Hopefully, now that my apprentice has taken over the shop, I'll be able to spend more time as a bard.@
text_zh: @我製作十字弩的時間太長了，已經對它感到厭倦。幸運的是，既然我的學徒已經接管了店面，我將能夠花更多時間擔任吟遊詩人。@

source_en: @My shop still sells the finest crossbows in the land. I've done a lot over the years to refine the design, and I trained my apprentice well. I'm sure she'll carry on the tradition in fine fashion.@
text_zh: @我的商店仍然出售全國最精美的十字弩。多年來，我改進了很多設計，我也很好地培養了我的學徒。我相信她會以優雅的方式繼承這一傳統。@

source_en: @Yes, it's always been a hobby of mine. Have you heard the piece 'Stones' that I composed some years ago?@
text_zh: 「是的，這一直是我的愛好。你聽過我幾年前創作的那首《Stones》嗎？」

source_en: @Oh, you should get my wife Gwenno to teach it to you some time.@
text_zh: 「噢，你應該找時間讓我妻子 Gwenno 教你。」

source_en: @Though there is still need for the instruments of war, as I grow in years I would now take up those of peace.@
text_zh: 「雖然仍需要戰爭的工具，但隨著年歲漸長，我現在更想從事和平的工作。」

source_en: @If you want me to gather all our gold together so you can carry it, just say so. Or I can help you re-order the party.@
text_zh: 「如果你想讓我收集大家所有的黃金讓你攜帶，直接說一聲即可。或者我可以幫你們重新調整隊伍順序。」

source_en: Iolo gathers up everyone's gold and hands it to you.
text_zh: Iolo 收集了所有人的黃金並交給你。

source_en: @None of us are carrying any gold,
@Maybe you should ask me to join the party first.@
text_zh: 「也許你應該先邀請我加入隊伍。」

source_en: @She's had more time to develop her musical talents than I all these years. But after this quest I hope to join her in Minoc and enter the artisan's guild.@
text_zh: 「這些年來，她有比我更多時間來培養音樂才華。但這次任務之後，我希望去 Minoc 加入工匠公會。」

source_en: @Not as big as Britain, but it's a peaceful town.@
text_zh: @雖然不像 Britain 那麼大，但這裡是個和平的小鎮。@

source_en: @Avatar, thou knowest I do not condone cheating, however, it's much easier just to use the F2 Cheat menu in Exult...@
text_zh: @聖者，你知道我不贊同作弊，不過，在 Exult 中直接使用 F2 作弊選單會輕鬆得多...@

source_en: @There always seems to be a quest when you come to visit us, doesn't there? Some time you should just drop by for tea.@
text_zh: @每次你來我們這裡似乎都有任務，是不是？有空時應該只是來喝杯茶。@

source_en: @All right, make it Frasier's Folly, then.@
text_zh: @好吧，那就叫 Frasier's Folly 吧。@

source_en: @A drink worthy enough to greet an old friend.@
, do you need help with something? Or maybe you've got time for a story, eh?@
text_zh: , 你需要幫忙嗎？或者你有時間聽個故事，嗯？@

source_en: @You know. Where Mr. Nose hangs out.@
text_zh: @你知道的。Mr. Nose 常去的地方。@

source_en: @Remember, he doesn't like people to call him that...@
text_zh: @記住，他不喜歡人們那樣稱呼他...@

source_en: @They're pretty ugly looking, if you ask me...@
text_zh: @要是問我，它們看起來挺醜的...@

source_en: @His nibs, the king, told me I should stay with you constantly. I'll make an exception when you have to relieve yourself, of course.@
text_zh: @國王陛下告訴我，我應該一直陪在你身邊。當然，當你需要方便的時候我會例外。@

source_en: @My hut is in the Deep Forest, south of Yew. My horse Smith lives there.@
text_zh: @我的小屋在 Yew 南方的 Deep Forest。我的馬 Smith 住在那裡。@

source_en: @My favorite one is about the time I had to wake Dupre up for a tournament...@
text_zh: @我最喜歡的一個故事是關於那次我不得不叫醒 Dupre 參加錦標賽...@

source_en: Dupre cuts in. @Iolo! You promised NEVER to tell anyone about that!@
text_zh: Dupre 插嘴說。@Iolo！你答應過從來不告訴任何人那件事的！@

source_en: @Yes, you're right. I'm sorry.@ He whispers to you, @Ask me later when he's not around...@
text_zh: @是的，你是對的。對不起。@ 他小聲地對你說，@等他不在旁邊時再問我...@

source_en: @But maybe I shouldn't tell you about that. After all, I did promise...@
text_zh: @但也許我不該告訴你。畢竟，我答應過...@

source_en: . I'm ready to get back to adventuring.@
@You have enough travelling with you already. But if you ask one of them to leave first, I'd be happy to join you.@
text_zh: @你們已經有足夠的旅伴了。但如果你們讓其中一人先離開，我很樂意加入你們。@

source_en: @I've been with you since we saved you from those gargoyles, haven't I?@
text_zh: @自從我們從那些石像鬼手中救下你以來，我一直都陪著你，對吧？@

source_en: @Is it absolutely imperitive that I should leave you?@
text_zh: @我必須離開你們，這絕對必要嗎？@

source_en: @Alright then, if thou insists. Should I wait a little bit here or should I go home?@
text_zh: @好吧，如果你們堅持。我該在這裡等一下，還是回家？@

source_en: @Very well. I shall wait here until thou dost finish taking care of business...@
text_zh: @很好。我在此處等待，直到你忙完正事...@

source_en: I shall wait here for thee.
@Okay. I suppose I can go home and make sure Smith still has plenty of hay. My hut is just outside of Empath Abbey. Don't take too long, as I am disobeying direct orders from Lord British...@
text_zh: @好吧。我想我可以回家，確認 Smith 還有足夠的乾草。我的小屋就在 Empath Abbey 外面。別太久，因為我現在正違背 Lord British 的直接命令...@

source_en: Iolo turns to leave, looking somewhat dejected.
text_zh: Iolo 轉身離開，看起來有些沮喪。

source_en: @Well, I shall stay with you then.@
@I've still got to tell you that story about Dupre sometime...@
text_zh: @我還沒跟你講過關於 Dupre 的故事...@

source_en: @Iolo's the only name I remember having.@*
text_zh: @我只記得 Iolo 這個名字。@*
@-growl@ (注：此處保留語氣詞原文或譯為咆哮，但根據指令魔法咒語保持英文，非咒語則翻譯。Grrrrr 為擬聲詞，建議保留原文或譯為「嗚嗚」，考慮到遊戲語境，通常擬聲詞不強制翻譯，但若要自然繁體中文，可譯為「嗚嗚」。鑑於其他條目如 Woof 通常翻譯，這裡選擇翻譯)
@快把那漂亮的豆子影像放出來！@

source_en: @Though we have spent much time apart between your several visits to our realm, still I consider you one of my closest friends.@
text_zh: @雖然在你多次拜訪我們王國之間，我們分開了許久，但我仍視你為我最好的朋友之一。@

source_en: @I prefer the Deep Forest. Spiritwood isn't as dense, and it has those strange wisps everywhere.@
text_zh: @我比較喜歡 Deep Forest。Spiritwood 的樹木沒那麼茂密，而且到處都是那些奇怪的 wisps。@

source_en: @I know little of their nature. I believe there are some mages who have investigated them, however.@
text_zh: @我對它們的本性知之甚少。不過，我相信有些法師曾對它們進行過調查。@

source_en: @It is home to me. I love walking in the dark shadows of the trees, and studying the nature of the forest creatures.@
text_zh: @這裡是我的家。我喜愛在樹木的暗影中漫步，並研究林中生物的本性。@

source_en: You see a quiet man, who almost seems to be a creature of the forest.
text_zh: 你看到一名沉默的男子，他幾乎像是森林中的生物。

source_en: @A home needs not walls to make it so.@
@Those that dwell in the woods have lives of their own, more interesting to me than the ways of townfolk. There is much to be learned from the animals, if you will but listen.@
text_zh: @居住在森林中的生物擁有屬於自己的生活，這比城裡人的生活方式更令我感興趣。如果你肯聆聽，就能從動物身上學到很多東西。@

source_en: @Now Shamino's going on about talking to animals... The whole world's going batty!@
text_zh: @現在Shamino又在說和動物對話的事了...整個世界都瘋了吧！@

source_en: @When folk ask why I have no walls in my home, I ask where are the trees in theirs!@ He smiles.
text_zh: @當人們問起我為什麼的家裡沒有牆壁時，我就問他們的家裡在哪裡能找到樹木！@ 他微笑著。

source_en: @In many ways they are the lifesblood of the realm. Without trees, we could not long endure.@
text_zh: @在很多方面，它們是王國的命脈。沒有樹木，我們無法長久生存。@

source_en: @Perhaps one of the members of the council could tell you more.@
text_zh: @也許 councill 的其中一位成員能告訴你更多。@

source_en: @I feel that Lord British does not understand their true nature.@
text_zh: @我覺得 Lord British 並不理解它們真正的本性。@

source_en: @I know him better than you might think.@
text_zh: @我了解他，可能比你想像中的多。@

source_en: @I feel you need my guidance through the wild parts of Britannia. I'd best stay with you.@
text_zh: @我覺得你需要我在Britannia的荒野地區給予指導。我最好陪在你身邊。@

source_en: @If you insist...Shall I wait for you here, or go home?@
text_zh: @如果你堅持...我要是在這裡等你，還是先回家？@

source_en: , I shall wait here until thy return.@
@Perhaps I'll just wait for thee at the Blue Boar. I wouldn't want you to go through some unnecessary trouble finding me in the woods. Do thou return soon, who knows what the gargoyles will do next.@
text_zh: @也許我只需在 Blue Boar 那裡等你。我不希望你為了在森林裡找到我而費盡周折。請你盡快回來，誰知道石怪接下來會做些什麼。@

source_en: @I will head to the Blue Boar..@
, thou seemst to have enough companions as it is.@
text_zh: ，你似乎已經有足夠的同伴了。@

source_en: @I help my friends when they need it. The rest of my time I prefer to spend exploring the woods.@
text_zh: @朋友有難時我會出手相助。剩下的時間，我喜歡去森林裡探險。@

source_en: @Yes, you've gone on some really fine ones. When you're not around I have to settle for rescuing damsels, finding grails, and the like.@
text_zh: @是的，你去過一些很棒的地方。你不當值的時，我只能去救被擄走的女士、尋找聖杯之類的事了。@

source_en: @It could be worse. Some of them are pretty eager to show their gratitude, if you know what I mean...@
text_zh: @情況也可能更糟。有些女士很熱情地表達感謝，如果你懂我意思的話...@

source_en: @That's right. Lord British likes to keep grails around to use at his banquets, but he's always losing them.@
text_zh: @沒錯。Lord British喜歡在宴會上擺放聖杯，但他老是弄丟它們。@

source_en: @Wink wink, nudge nudge, say no more...@
You see a ruggedly handsome man, wearing a gleaming suit of armor.
text_zh: 你看到一位英武帥氣的男子，身穿閃亮的盔甲。

source_en: @He'll throw us a fine feast if you can deal with the gargoyle invasion somehow.@
text_zh: @如果你能 somehow 解決石像鬼的入侵，他會請我們吃一頓豐盛的宴席。@

source_en: @They may be the toughest threat we've ever faced.@
text_zh: @它們可能是我們面臨過最強的威脅。@

source_en: @Lord British gave me strict orders not to leave your side until this quest is complete. Besides, you know how I hate to miss a good quest.@
text_zh: @Lord British嚴令我在任務完成前不得離開你的身邊。況且，你知道我有多不喜歡錯過一個好任務。@

source_en: @Gladly, let's get back to our quest.@
text_zh: @很榮幸，讓我們回去繼續任務吧。@

source_en: @I'm afraid there is no room in thy party for me.@
text_zh: 恐怕你的隊伍裡沒有我的位置了。

source_en: @I've been with you since the start of this quest, haven't I?@
text_zh: 我不是一直從冒險開始就陪在你身邊嗎？
求你了，我們別再談鴨子了...

source_en: @If thou dost insist, I suppose I can step away for a while. But don't leave me in the lurch too long. Lord British will have mine head!@
text_zh: 如果你堅持的話，我想我可以離開一陣子。但別讓我落單太久。Lord British 會砍了我的頭的！

source_en: @Shall I wait here or leave for a while?@
text_zh: 我是留在此地，還是離開一陣子？

source_en: @I shall wait here then. Shouldn't be too long, right?@
text_zh: 那我便留在此地。應該不會太久的，對吧？

source_en: @I will wait for thee at the Blue Boar. Do hurry back, and we'll resume our quest.@
text_zh: 我會在 Blue Boar 等你。請盡快回來，我們繼續冒險。

source_en: @Yes, enough chit chat. Let's go find some action!@
text_zh: 是的，閒話就此打住。我們去找點刺激的事做吧！

source_en: @It's Dupre - sounds like dew pray, remember?@
text_zh: 那是 Dupre —— 聽起來像「dew pray」（祈雨），記得嗎？

source_en: @Why, questing, of course! We've been on many a quest together, you and I.@
text_zh: 當然是去冒險了！我們一起經歷過許多次冒險，你和我。

source_en: @Ask me to join and I will, gladly,
text_zh: 只要邀請我加入，我會很高興地答應，

source_en: @Avatar! 'Tis a great joy and relief to see thou hast returned to Britannia!@
text_zh: 聖者！很高興也很輕鬆，看見你回到了 Britannia！

source_en: She greets your other traveling companions. Everyone seems pleased to be reunited, albeit under tense circumstances.
text_zh: 她向你的其他旅伴問好。在緊張的情境下，大家似乎都很高興能重聚。

source_en: @Mayhap I can help thee in thy struggle against the gargoyles. Thou needst but ask and I will gladly join.@
text_zh: 也許我能幫助你對抗石像鬼。你只需開口，我會很高興地加入。
替換為 NPC 的道別語

source_en: ! Hast thou fared well in thy travels?@
text_zh: ! 願你在旅途中一切安好？@

source_en: @Joyous news! Thou must tell me of it sometime.@
text_zh: @這是令人喜悅的消息！你必須找時間告訴我詳情。@

source_en: @Mayhap I could help. Ask me to join thy band,
text_zh: @也許我幫忙。邀請我加入你的隊伍，

source_en: . Surely my help in thy previous quests was not so insignificant that thou hast forgotten it!@
text_zh: 。我在你之前的任務中所提供的幫助，應該不至於微不足道到讓你在這裡忘記吧！@

source_en: @Since thy last visit to Britannia, I have lived in Yew, blessing crops and tending to sick animals.@
text_zh: @自你上次造訪 Britannia 以來，我一直居住在 Yew，祝福作物並照料生病的動物。@

source_en: @Though I know 'tis unbecoming of a simple druid to do so, I miss the excitement of our quests together!@*
text_zh: @雖然我知道對一名普通的德魯伊來說這樣做並不妥當，但我還是懷念我們一同冒險時的 excitement！@*

source_en: , if thou had a use for my skills.@
@I've heard that Nicodemus the enchanter lives between two rivers.@
text_zh: @我聽說變術師 Nicodemus 住在兩條河流之間。@

source_en: @I know little of the gargoyles, Avatar, save what rumors I hear. But I know that the gargoyles are fierce fighters, and a great threat to the land!@
text_zh: @除了我聽到的傳聞外，我對石像鬼知之甚少，聖者。但我知道石像鬼是兇猛的戰士，對這片土地構成巨大威脅！@

source_en: @I look forward to the many adventures we will share.@
text_zh: @我期待我們將共同經歷的無數冒險。@

source_en: , thou seemst to have enough companions as it is. Mayhap if one of them left your band, thou might have more need of me.@
text_zh: ，你現在看來夥伴已經夠多了。也許如果你的隊伍中有一個人離開了，你就更需要我了。@

source_en: . Am I not already a member of thy band?@
text_zh: 。我現在不是已經是你隊伍的一員了嗎？@

source_en: @Dost thou want me to wait here or should I go home?@
text_zh: @你想讓我在這裡等，還是應該讓我去家？@

source_en: @Very well. I shall wait here until thou dost return.@
text_zh: @很好。我會在此等候，直到你回來為止。@

source_en: @I shall be waiting in Yew if thou needest my help later.@
text_zh: @如果你之後需要幫助，我會在水印城（Yew）等候你。@

source_en: @Thou mayst keep my supplies.@ She leaves everything he was carrying in a pile on the ground.
text_zh: @你可以保留我的補給品。@ 她將他身上攜帶的所有東西堆放在地上。

source_en: . I cannot leave thy party since I am not in it!@
text_zh: 。既然我不在你的隊伍中，我就不能離開！@

source_en: @Perhaps I could put my healing skills to use for thy quest. I can distribute our healing potions and bandages to sick or injured party members if thou dost need it.@
text_zh: @也許我可以運用我的治癒技能來幫助你的任務。如果你需要，我可以將我們的治癒藥水和繃帶分發給生病或受傷的隊員。@

source_en: @Farewell! Return when thou hast more news of thy quest!@
text_zh: @告別了！當你有了更多關於任務的消息時再來吧！@

source_en: @May the virtues guide us in our quest!@
@I fear I know little that would help in this situation,
text_zh: @恐怕我知道的對這種情況沒什麼幫助，

source_en: . Hast thou need of my services again?@
@Talking to a mouse?@ says Dupre. @Methinks you're starting to imagine things...@
text_zh: @在跟老鼠說話？@ Dupre 說道。@我想你開始幻覺了...@

source_en: @He used to read me bedtime stories every night.@
text_zh: @他過去每晚都會給我唸睡前故事。@

source_en: @He reads me bedtime stories every night.@
text_zh: @他每晚都會給我唸睡前故事。@

source_en: @He knows the one about Hubert the Lion by Heart!@
text_zh: @他把 Hubert the Lion 的故事背得滾瓜爛熟呢！@

source_en: @Yes, I can get in there to get the rune. Be back in a jiffy!@
text_zh: @是的，我可以進去拿符文。馬上回來！

source_en: @Give me some cheese and ask me again.@
@I can slip through openings that are too small for you to fit through!@
text_zh: @我能鑽進你進不去的狹小縫隙裡！

source_en: @I wish people would clean up under their beds and cabinets...@
text_zh: @我真希望人們會清理牀下和櫃子裡的灰塵...

source_en: @Dust mice are no friends of mine!@
@I can help you! Do you want me to come with you?@
text_zh: @我可以幫你！你想讓我跟你一起去嗎？@

source_en: @With that many people I'd get trampled!@
@Oh, does this mean you want me to go home now?@
text_zh: @噢，這意思是要我現在回家嗎？@

source_en: @All right. Now I can hear my bedtime stories again! I'll leave my stuff with you in case you need it.@
text_zh: @好吧。現在我又能聽睡前故事了！為了以防你之後需要，我把我的東西留給你保管。@

source_en: A cute little mouse. @Squeak, squeak, squeak!@
text_zh: 一隻可愛的小老鼠。@吱吱，吱吱，吱吱！@

source_en: @Travelling with you is fun! I hope we find some more cheese soon.@
text_zh: @跟你一起旅行真有趣！希望我們很快能找到更多奶酪。@
觸發了 Sherry 的接近事件

source_en: @Then I shall go wait at Serpent's Hold until you need me again.@
text_zh: @那我會去 Serpent's Hold 等待，直到你再次需要我為止。@

source_en: @I'd best leave you my equipment in case you need it on your quest.*@
text_zh: @為了以防你在任務中需要，我把我的裝備留給你。*

source_en: He leaves everything he was carrying in a pile on the ground.
text_zh: 他將身上攜帶的所有物品都堆在地上。

source_en: @Then let's be on about our mission!@
text_zh: @那我們就出發去執行任務吧！@
你看到一位英俊的戰士。*

source_en: . I hope you have returned to ask me to join you.@
text_zh: 。我希望你回來是希望我加入你。@

source_en: @It is I, Sentri.@ He pronounces his name 'Sahn-tray'.
@I have been waiting here for you. I heard you had returned, and knew you would come here eventually.@
text_zh: @我一直在此等待。我聽說你回來了，知道你會終於來到這裡。@

source_en: @Britannia needs your help now more than ever before. Many have set out to fight the gargoyles already.@
text_zh: @Britannia 現在比以往任何時候都需要你的幫助。許多人都已經出發去對抗石像鬼了。@

source_en: @Not just the town guards, but any able bodied men that could be spared from their work. The battle goes poorly. But now that you are here, there is hope. I stand ready to join you.@
text_zh: @不只是城鎮衛兵，還有任何能從工作中脫身的精壯男子。戰事不利。但既然你來了，就有希望了。我準備好加入你了。@

source_en: @Has the time come when your plans call for me to wait in reserve?@
text_zh: @現在是讓我留在後備的時候嗎？@

source_en: @So be it. Now that we are together, surely the realm will be saved.@
text_zh: @那就這麼定了。既然我們在一起，王國肯定能得救。@

source_en: @You have enough companions now. If you tell one of them to leave first, then I'll join you.@
text_zh: @你現在有足夠的同伴了。如果你讓其中一個先離開，我就會加入你。@

source_en: @I bow to your wisdom. If you have need of me later, you have but to ask.@
text_zh: @我順從你的智慧。如果你之後需要我，只需開口即可。@

source_en: @If you should pass this way again, I will be here. I await but the opportunity to join you.@
text_zh: @如果你再次路過這裡，我會在這裡。我等待加入你的機會。@

source_en: @Let's get our feet back on solid ground first, okay?@
@Should I wait here or go home?@
text_zh: @我應該在這裡等待還是回家？@

source_en: @Very well. I shall wait here until thou dost return.@*
text_zh: @很好。我會在此處等待，直到你回來。@*

source_en: @Aye, so the great Avatar deigns to return, does
text_zh: 啊，偉大的聖者竟然屈尊回來了，是

source_en: A sturdy woman with calloused hands and a loud manner.*
text_zh: 一位手腳粗繭、說話大聲的健壯女性。*

source_en: @'Tis well and good that ye have returned to our land, Avatar!@
text_zh: @你回來我們這片土地，真是太好了，聖者！@

source_en: @Well met, Avatar. An' what can I be doin' for ye this
. I be named Julia, same as the last time we met!@
text_zh: 。我名為 Julia，就跟我們上次見面時一樣！@

source_en: @Instruments I make, the finest in the land.@*
text_zh: @我製造樂器，是全國最精細的。@*

source_en: @For now, though, I'm followin' ye, and glad to do it!@
text_zh: @不過，現在我願意跟著你，為此感到高興！@

source_en: @Not to be immodest, but I'm respected by all the Guild!@*
text_zh: @別說我自大，公會所有人都很尊敬我！@*

source_en: @Ach, but give it all up I would for a life of adventure like your own...@
text_zh: @唉，為了像你這樣冒險的生活，我願意放棄一切...@

source_en: @If ye would like to be a member too, go talk to Selganor.@
text_zh: @如果你想成為成員，去跟 Selganor 談談吧。@

source_en: @Aye, I'd join you if ye wish.@
text_zh: @是的，如果你希望，我會加入你們。@

source_en: @Sent you to me they did? Aye, I can believe that.@*
text_zh: @是他們把我送到你這裡的嗎？哼，我倒是很相信這句話。@*

source_en: @Now the panpipes are a tricky instrument. You gotta have the finest wood.@*
text_zh: @現在，排簫是一種難以製作的樂器。你需要最好的木材。@*

source_en: @If you want to learn how to make pipes, you'll need to bring a yew board.@*
text_zh: @如果你想學做簫，你就得帶一塊櫸木板來。@*

source_en: @Do ye have a fine yew board for me today?@
text_zh: @你今天有塊上好的櫸木板帶給我嗎？@

source_en: @Ach, aye, and good wood it is, too. A fine set of pipes this will make!@*
text_zh: @啊，是啊，這木材真好。這能做出很棒的一套簫！@*

source_en: Julia sets the wood down on a bench and starts carving. As you watch, the rough board slowly turns into smooth wood rods.*
text_zh: Julia 把木材放在長凳上，開始雕刻。看著粗糙的木板慢慢變成光滑的木棒。*

source_en: Then she hollows out each rod and pegs them all together. Lastly, she notches each tube and cuts them all to the proper lengths.*
text_zh: 然後她將每根木棒掏空，並用木釘將它們組裝起來。最後，她在每根管子開孔，並將它們全部切成合適的長度。*

source_en: , a set of panpipes fit for any bard in the land!@*
text_zh: ，一套適合國內任何吟遊詩人的排簫！@*

source_en: She hands you the finished pipes.
@Well where is it? I canna see any board on ye!@
text_zh: @呃，那木板在哪裡？我看不到你身上有任何木板啊！@

source_en: @No? What are ye, daft? I canna be makin' pipes without wood!@*
text_zh: @沒有？你是瘋了嗎？沒有木材我怎麼做簫！@*

source_en: @Go to Yew where they grow the best wood in Britannia. Buy a freshly-cut yew log and take it to a sawmill.@*
text_zh: @去 Yew 那裡，那裡有 Britannia 最好的木材。買一根新切的櫸木原木，然後拿去鋸木廠。@*

source_en: @Have 'em cut it into a board, and bring it back here. Then I'll show ye how panpipes are made!@
text_zh: @讓他們把它鋸成木板，然後帶回來這裡。然後我會教你排簫是怎麼做的！@

source_en: @I'm already in your band! Though now I'm not so sure I want to be led by a crazy person...@
text_zh: @我已經在你們的隊伍裡了！不過現在我不太確定我還想被一個瘋子領導...@

source_en: @Aye, and be dumped off in the middle of nowhere again?@*
text_zh: @是啊，然後又被遺棄在荒郊野外？@*

source_en: @Not likely! Find some other sap to do your bidding!@
text_zh: @不太可能！去找個其他的笨蛋來聽你的指揮吧！@

source_en: @Ach, I can tell that you say that to everyone ye meet. Ask me again when you haven't as many companions.@
text_zh: @啊，我看得出你對遇到的每個人都這麼說。等你身邊沒有那麼多同伴的時候再問我吧。@

source_en: @Ach, I get it. You're makin' a wee joke!@
text_zh: 啊，我明白了。你是在開個小玩笑！

source_en: @What? Oh, I suppose a craftsman isn't warrior enough to suit
text_zh: 什麼？噢，我想工匠可能不夠戰士氣，不符合

source_en: @Well, that's fine and dandy with me!@*
text_zh: 好吧，這對我來說是再簡單不過的事了！*

source_en: @A good day and a good bye to the lot of ye! I'm tired of carrying all this junk anyway!@
text_zh: 祝大家一天愉快，再見！反正我受夠了搬運這些垃圾！

source_en: @Leave! Nay, 'tis my house. You do the leavin'!@
text_zh: 離開？不，這是我的房子。你才該離開！

source_en: @Aye, and wha' can ye be askin' of me?@*
@Aye, enough chatting. On with our quest!@
text_zh: 好吧，閒聊夠了。繼續我們的任務！

source_en: @Ach, aye! I wouldna want to hinder
@May fortune follow ye on thy way!@
@Sure an' I don't think I can be helpin' ya with this!@
You see the humble peasant Katrina.*
text_zh: 你看到了謙卑的農民 Katrina。*

source_en: ! I had heard that thou hadst returned to our land, but I dared not believe it! Hast thou returned to save our land from the gargoyles?@
text_zh: ！我聽說你已返回我們的土地，但我不敢置信！你回來拯救我們免受石像鬼的侵害了嗎？
那麼我們肯定已經獲救了！

source_en: @Then perhaps the crisis is not so severe as rumors say. If there is aught a humble peasant might do to aid thy quest,
text_zh: 那麼也許危機沒有傳言的那麼嚴重。如果有一個謙卑的農民能做的來幫助你的任務，

source_en: ! I hope thou hast fared well in thy travels?@
@The land rejoices when all is well with the Avatar.@
text_zh: 當聖者一切安好時，大地便歡欣鼓舞。

source_en: @If there is aught a humble peasant can do to help, I am yours to command.@
text_zh: 如果一個謙卑的農民能做點什麼來幫忙，我聽候差遣。

source_en: , as I was the last time we met.@
text_zh: 正如我們上次見面時一樣。

source_en: . Where once I grazed sheep, now I till the land. All work is the same to a peasant,
text_zh: 。從前我牧羊，如今我耕田。對農夫來說，所有的工作都是一樣的，

source_en: . We all do what is expected of us.@
@If thou wouldst have me join thy quest, thou needst but ask.@
text_zh: 若你想讓我加入你的探險，只需開口便好。

source_en: @Since thou dost think it wise, I wilt join. I hope I can aid thy quest.@
text_zh: 既然你認為這很明智，我願加入。希望能對你的探險有所助益。

source_en: Glad to adventure with thee again!
text_zh: 很高興能再次與你一起探險！

source_en: @I hesitate to deny any request thou might have.@
text_zh: 我不敢拒絕你可能會有的任何請求。

source_en: @But thou seemst to have enough companions as it is. Mayhap if one of them left your band, thou might have more need of me..@
text_zh: 不過你似乎已經有足夠的同伴了。或許如果有其中一人離開你的隊伍，你可能更需要我..

source_en: . Am I not already a member of thy band?@
text_zh: 。我現在不是已經是你隊伍的一員了嗎？@

source_en: @Should I wait here thee here, or go home to New Magincia?@
text_zh: 我應該在這裡等你，還是回 New Magincia 的家？

source_en: , I shall wait here until thy return.@

text_zh: 我只是一個簡單的農夫，

source_en: @Very well, I shall wait here for you to return.@
text_zh: 好吧，我會在這裡等你回來。

source_en: . I'll leave my equipment with thee.@
She sets down everything she was carrying before walking off.
text_zh: 她放下身上所有攜帶的物品，然後離開了。

source_en: @The gargoyles are a grave threat to the land,
text_zh: 石像鬼對大地構成嚴重的威脅，

source_en: . Many brave soldiers have died defending us from the invaders!@
text_zh: 。許多英勇的士兵都死於抵禦入侵者！。

source_en: , but I cannot answer thy question. 'Twould be vain of me to answer truthfully, and 'twould be worse to lie.@
text_zh: ，但我無法回答你的問題。如果我誠實回答，便是妄自菲薄；若撒謊，後果更糟。

source_en: @I doubt I could help in this situation.@
text_zh: 我懷疑我在此情境下能幫上忙。

source_en: @May we live up to the trust placed in us.@
the hopes of all the land.@
. Wilt thou allow me to follow you again?@*
@Command me to join and I will,
text_zh: 你命令我加入，我就會加入，

source_en: A troubadour with a drum. His tailored suit is travel-worn but bright.
text_zh: 一位帶著鼓的行吟詩人。他的定制西裝雖因旅途而陳舊，但仍顯眼。

source_en: @Why, hello there, my friend. You've grown a bit since we met last. I'm afraid I can't recall your name, you'll have to forgive me.@
text_zh: 哎呀，你好啊，朋友。自上次見面以來，你長大了些。我恐怕記不起你的名字了，請原諒我。

source_en: @It has been a while, Master Iolo.@
@My name is Sionnach.@ He pronounces it 'ShaNOK'.
text_zh: 我的名字是 Sionnach。他發音為 'ShaNOK'。

source_en: @Would you like me to play for you?@
The drum is wide and flat. Sionnach holds it by the strings on the back of it. Then, he taps it in intricate patterns using both ends of the dowel held loosely in his other hand.*
text_zh: 鼓身寬闊平坦。Sionnach 抓住鼓背面的琴弦。接著，他用另一隻手鬆鬆握住的木棍兩端，敲打出複雜的節奏。*

source_en: It sounds thus: 'RUM-TE-TUM, RUM-TE-TUM, TUMBLETY-TUM-TE-TUM!' The beat is invigorating  and exciting.
text_zh: 聽起來是這樣：'咚-塔-咚，咚-塔-咚，咚塔-塔-咚-塔-咚！' 節奏令人振奮且激昂。

source_en: @'Twas long ago... Back when men forced sorcerous secrets from demons...@*
text_zh: @那已是很久以前的事了... 那是人類強迫惡魔吐露魔法祕密的時候...@*

source_en: @Back when women wove moonbeams into cloth of indescribably fine texture...@*
text_zh: @那是女性將月光織成無可言喻的精緻布料的時候...@*

source_en: @Long ago, Lord Fennian devised a language of raps and knocks on the great drums used by his armies. Each drum was made of the entire skin of a bull, stretched taut by a dozen cords.@
text_zh: @很久以前，Lord Fennian 為他的軍隊所使用的巨大戰鼓設計了一套由輕叩和重擊組成的語言。每面鼓都由整張牛皮製成，並由十二根繩索繃緊。@

source_en: @It's true. I read that in a book I found at the Lycaeum.@
text_zh: @這是真的。我從在 Lycaeum 找到的一本書上讀到的。@

source_en: @I also read a number of maritime histories. They record the facts behind the many songs of different ships.@
text_zh: @我還讀過許多航海史。它們記載了許多關於不同船隻的傳說背後的事實。@

source_en: @The sea is not always a gentle, generous friend. Storms have brought down many a haughty vessel; the evil Empire, the Dutchman, the Virtuous...Have you heard of the Virtuous?@
text_zh: @大海並非總是溫柔慷慨的朋友。風暴曾擊沉許多傲氣的船隻；那邪惡的 Empire、那 Dutchman、那 Virtuous...你聽過 Virtuous 嗎？@

source_en: @I don't know where she rests. Ask other bards.@
text_zh: @我不知道她安息在哪裡。去問其他遊吟詩人吧。@

source_en: @A southerner from Serpent's Hold  Once slew a pirate crew of eight. Young Keegan was this warrior bold, And thus he claimed the 'Bitter Kate.'@*
text_zh:
@來自 Serpent's Hold 的南方人，
曾擊殺八人的海盜團。
年輕的 Keegan 是位勇敢的戰士，
因此他獲得了 'Bitter Kate'。@*

source_en: @Excuse me, ma'am. We are, um, indisposed.@
@He broke a bottle 'cross her bow And 'Virtuous' became her name. For many years she served him well; Good Captain Keegan rose to fame.@
text_zh:
@他打破瓶頸撞向船頭，
於是 'Virtuous' 成了她的名字。
多年裡她為他效力良多；
偉大的 Keegan 船長聲名遠揚。@

source_en: @The Barston Bay came north to fight, The Jolly Roger on her mast. To cold Loch Lake she sailed that night. To sink Keegan's ship with cannon blast.@*
text_zh:
@Barston Bay 北上決戰，
桅杆上懸掛著 Jolly Roger。
那一夜她駛向冰冷的 Loch Lake，
企圖用炮火擊沉 Keegan 的船。@*

source_en: @Ah, the old Bitter Kate, she's mended her ways, And as the Virtuous, ended her days.@*
text_zh:
@啊，老 Bitter Kate，她改過自新，
作為 Virtuous，結束了她的生涯。@*

source_en: @Captain Keegan, he sleeps the endless sleep.. While on Loch Lake's shore the Virtuous lays.@
text_zh:
@Keegan 船長，他沉睡在永恆的夢鄉..
而 Virtuous 就停在 Loch Lake 的 shore 上。@

source_en: @There's probably great treasure on her, and on the Virtuous, too.@
text_zh: 她的船以及《Virtuous》號上，很可能藏有豐厚的財寶。

source_en: @Pardon me, sir, but I hate to keep my dear one waiting. You understand, of course.@
text_zh: 抱歉，先生，我捨不得讓愛人久等。你當然會理解。

source_en: He returns his attentions to Sylaina.
text_zh: 他重新將注意力轉回 Sylaina 身上。
對 Sionnach 觸發了接近事件

source_en: A voluptuous woman dressed in dark blue velvet over white cloth.
text_zh: 一位豐腴的女子，身穿深藍色緞面，下襯白色布料。

source_en: @Hello there, stranger. Can I help you?@
@When I need some money for food and such, I work as a seamstress. Most of the time, however, I live off the seashore.@
text_zh: 當我需要錢買食物或其他東西時，我就做裁縫。不過大多數時候，我靠海邊生活。

source_en: @I'm a widow now. I live in a cottage on the beach.@
text_zh: 我現在是 widow 了。我住在海邊的小屋裡。

source_en: @Yes. I used to make such fine clothes for my Nathaniel...@
text_zh: 是的。我曾為我的 Nathaniel 做過許多精美的衣服...

source_en: @There's always a bit of fish or gull's eggs to eat, with lobster once in a while. I'm as carefree as a gypsy.@
text_zh: 總能吃到些魚或海鷗蛋，偶爾還有龍蝦。我就像吉普賽人一樣無憂無慮。

source_en: Sylaina isn't facing Sionnach, making them face each other
text_zh: Sylaina 沒有面向 Sionnach，使她們面對面

source_en: @Though he was not a bad husband, I'll always remember him as something of a scoundrel.@
text_zh: 雖然他不算個壞丈夫，但我總會記得他有點兒像個無賴。

source_en: She smiles and her lovely eyes sparkle with memories. @They say he went down in a storm. He was a pirate.@
text_zh: 她微笑著，美麗的眼睛裡閃爍著回憶的光芒。他們說他是在風暴中沉船的。他是一名海盜。

source_en: They travel the road between Britain and Trinsic. Normally I like them. They're a merry lot. But one time a group of gypsies stole my prized locket!@
text_zh: 他們行走在 Britain 和 Trinsic 之間的道路上。我通常喜歡他們，他們是一幫快活的人。但有一次，一羣吉普賽人偷走了我珍愛的鎖！

source_en: @My husband left me a gold locket wrapped in a piece of an old ship's chart. Maybe that's what you seek.@*
text_zh: 我丈夫留給我一個金掛鏈，裡面包著一張舊海圖的一部分。也許那就是你在找的東西。*

source_en: @I don't have the locket or the map anymore. The gypsies came by one day and stole them.@
text_zh: 我不再有那個掛鏈或地圖了。有一天吉普賽人來訪，把它們偷走了。

source_en: @My husband left me a little money, to support myself for a time, but I still like to sew fine clothing. There are few things as relaxing as embroidering and sitting by the ocean, listening to the surf.@
text_zh: 我丈夫留給我一些錢，讓我過一段日子，但我還是喜歡縫製精美的衣服。沒有什麼比繡花和坐在海邊聽海浪聲更讓人放鬆的了。

source_en: @Yes--some gypsies are trustworthy, but others are scoundrels!@
text_zh: 是啊——有些吉普賽人值得信賴，但有些則是無賴！

source_en: @Is that... you found my locket! I thought I'd never see it again since the gypsies took it!@
text_zh: 那是...你找到我的掛鏈了！我以為再也見不到它了，因為吉普賽人把它拿走了！

source_en: She gives you a hug. @I am forever grateful!@
text_zh: 她擁抱了你。我永遠感激！

source_en: @I don't have much to give you, but I just caught some fresh fish and will cook for you at least!@
text_zh: 我沒有太多東西可以給你，但我剛抓了一些新鮮的魚，至少會為你做一頓飯！

source_en: She brings out some fish and cooks it, and gives each of you a plate. @It's not much, but at least you won't be hungry!@
text_zh: 她帶出一些魚並煮好，每人給了一盤。雖然不多，但你們至少不會餓著！

source_en: @My husband left me a gold locket. It contained a piece of an old ship's chart. He said that chart would make me rich.@*
text_zh: 我丈夫留給我一個金掛鏈。裡面有一張舊海圖的一部分。他說那張海圖會讓我變得富有。*

source_en: @I didn't really care about the chart. But the locket...That locket was all I had to remember Nathaniel by.@
text_zh: 其實我不太在意那張海圖。但是那個掛鏈...那是我僅存的、用來紀念 Nathaniel 的東西了。

source_en: She sighs and looks away for a moment.
text_zh: 她嘆了一口氣，暫時別開了目光。

source_en: @I am very happy you found my locket, it's the only thing left I have to remember Nathaniel by.@
text_zh: 很高興你找到了我的掛鏈，那是我僅存的、用來紀念 Nathaniel 的東西了。

source_en: @Have you nothing better to do?@ she asks pointedly. @Please excuse us.@
text_zh: 「你還有別的事情要做嗎？」她尖銳地問道。「請原諒我們。」
針對 Sylania 的接近事件被觸發

source_en: @Aye, maybe there'd 'ave been extra for shovel and such in my pay, if the old skinflint had ever remembered to pay me!@
text_zh: 是的，如果那個老摳門鬼記得付我工資的話，我工資裡可能會有買鏟子之類的額外補貼！

source_en: @I'd have been glad to get a new shovel! Believe me, I knows how to pick out a good one, too. But how'm I supposed to pay for it, you just ask him that!@
text_zh: 我很樂意買一把新鏟子！相信我，我知道怎麼挑一把好的。但是讓我怎麼付錢呢，你去問問他！

source_en: Mole listens, a bit impatiently. @He gave me a shovel, all right - cheapest shovel I ever saw in all my years in the business!@
text_zh: Mole 聽著，有點不耐煩。他給我一把鏟子，沒錯——是我這些年來見過最便宜的鏟子！

source_en: @Tell 'im it broke the third day I tried usin' it.@
text_zh: 告訴他，我用了第三天就斷了。

source_en: You see a coarse looking individual, digging in the dirt with his bare hands.
text_zh: 你看到一個粗鄙的人，赤著手在泥土裡挖掘。

source_en: @Hello. If I be speaking with ye, I'd best not be digging at the same time.@
text_zh: 你好。如果我要和你說話，最好別同時在挖土。

source_en: @I dig graves for me master, Glen.@
Digging's been in me family for generations.@
text_zh: 挖掘這門手藝在我家已經傳了好几代了。

source_en: @If you take away enough dirt, a grave's what's left. After they has a funeral, I puts all the dirt back again.@
text_zh: 只要你挖掉足夠的土，就剩下一座墳墓了。等葬禮結束後，我再把土填回去。

source_en: @He's a strange one... Nobody knows what he keeps in that back room of 'is.@
text_zh: 他是個怪人...沒人知道他在後面的房間裡藏了什麼。

source_en: @I'll not speak with 'im, the way he treats me. But if you sees him, tell him I could dig these graves better if I had a shovel!@
text_zh: 以他對待我的方式，我不願跟他說話。但如果你見到他，告訴他如果有把鏟子，我能挖得更好！

source_en: @Funerals aren't me trade. I know plenty about dirt, though.@
text_zh: 葬禮不是我的本行。不過，我對土很在行。

source_en: Now, now. You can't be bringing bodies out here without reservations.@
text_zh: 慢著，慢著。沒預約，你不能把屍體帶到這裡來。

source_en: @I knows all the different kinds of dirt by heart.@
text_zh: 我熟記各種不同的土質。

source_en: @Oh, ye've brought a shovel with ye! Is it for me?
text_zh: 噢，你帶著鏟子來了！是給我的嗎？

source_en: @Thank ye very much! And 'tis not even my birthday!@
text_zh: 多謝你！這還不是我的生日呢！

source_en: @Let me tell you this - keep an eye on old  Glen. They say not all of the bodies end up where they're supposed to...@
text_zh: 讓我告訴你我件事——留意一下老Glen。據說並不是所有的屍體都去了該去的地方...

source_en: @You know, 'e was supposed to have paid me for a new shovel, and then you wouldn't have 'ad to go to so much trouble.@
text_zh: 你知道嗎，他本來該付錢讓我買把新鏟子的，那樣你就不用費這麼大勁了。
真遺憾。我真的很需要一把。
這是我這門手藝的工具。

source_en: @Me father said a good shovel is more important than a good wife.@
text_zh: 我父親說，一把好鏟子比一個好妻子更重要。

source_en: @That's what you look for after you've got a good shovel.@
text_zh: @那就看看你能用一把好鏟子挖到什麼吧。@

source_en: @Oh, going away, are ye? Let me know when ye return so I'll know 'tis time to speak with ye again.@ He returns to his digging.
text_zh: @喔，你要走了嗎？回來時告訴我，這樣我才知道該再跟你說話了。@ 他繼續挖土。

source_en: Go see me master Glen about having a funeral first.@
text_zh: 去找我的主人Glen，先安排葬禮吧。@

source_en: @Old penny pincher says he's going to pay me? I'll believe it when I have the coins in me hand.@
text_zh: @那個吝嗇鬼說他會付我錢？除非錢到了我手裡，否則我才不信。@

source_en: @For such a heroic client, I have something special to offer. It's a new process I've invented called 'cremation.'@*
text_zh: @對於如此英勇的客戶，我有個特別服務要推薦。這是我發明的一項新工藝，叫做「火化」。@*

source_en: @For a mere fifteen gold, the remains of the dearly departed are purified with flame. Would you like me to do this for you?@*
text_zh: @只要十五金幣，逝者遺體將以火焰淨化。您需要我為您辦理嗎？@*
目的地格倫位置1 可到達

source_en: Glen is moving to the path.
Glen is NOT moving to the path.
text_zh: Glen 不會移動到小路上。

source_en: @You're a bit short on gold.@ he says, dissapointedly.
text_zh: @你的金子不夠多。@ 他失望地說。

source_en: @Bring them back to my shop so we can safely cremate the body..@
text_zh: @把它帶回我的商店，這樣我們才能安全地火化遺體..@

source_en: Glen is too far away from creamatorium
@Ohhh! Silly me, spending so much time with my clients.@ He gestures at the corpses. @I forget little details like paying Mole...I'll have to take care of it right away!@
text_zh: @哎呀！真是愚鈍，把這麼多時間花在客戶身上。@ 他指了指遺體。 @我忘記了一些小事，比如付給 Mole 的錢...我得馬上處理！@

source_en: @You deserve a reward for helping me straighten this out. That mage over on the table was found just outside of town. He was carrying a couple of enchanted items and some money when the gargoyles got him. Nobody has been able to find any relatives of his, so you might as well take it all.@
text_zh: @你幫我理清了這件事，值得獲得獎勵。桌上那位法師是在城外不遠處被發現的。他被石像鬼襲擊時，身上帶著幾件附魔物品和一些金錢。沒人能找到他的親屬，所以你可以把這些都拿走。@

source_en: @That addle-brained, lower class, miserable excuse for a common laborer...I agreed to give him an equipment allowance with his pay. No doubt it's all been squandered at some tavern, along with the rest of his pay. See what he has to say about that!!@
text_zh: @那個頭腦簡單、下等人、可憐的普通勞工...我答應隨薪水給他一份裝備補貼。毫無疑問，他一定把它和剩下的薪水一起花在哪家 tavern 了。去看看他怎麼說！！@

source_en: @So, his shovel broke? That's no excuse. Tell him he should have bought another one and kept working.@
text_zh: @所以，他的鏟子斷了？這不是藉口。告訴他他應該再買一把並繼續工作。@

source_en: You pass along Mole's message. @Needs a shovel, does he? Tell him to use the one I gave him when I hired him! No doubt he's forgotten he has it by now, or lost it somewhere...@
text_zh: 你轉達了 Mole 的信息。 @需要一把鏟子，是吧？告訴他使用我僱他時給他的那把！無疑他現在已經忘記他有這把鏟子了，或者把它丟在某處...@

source_en: GLEN is not in a script
You see a quiet, pale, almost motionless gentleman.
text_zh: 你看到一位安靜、蒼白、幾乎不動的先生。

source_en: @Good evening.@ he says, in a voice that sends shivers down your spine. @It is evening, I hope. That's my favorite time.@
text_zh: 「晚安。」他說，聲音讓你脊背發涼。「我希望能是晚上。那是我最喜歡的時候。」

source_en: @I am Glen D'Arc, of the Trinsic D'Arcs.@
text_zh: 「我是葛倫·達克，來自Trinsic的達克家族。」 Glen

source_en: @I prepare the bodies of the departed for their eternal rest. It's very relaxing work. At least it would be, if I didn't have to put up with that incompetent gravedigger.@
text_zh: 「我為逝者準備長眠。這是一份非常放鬆的工作。至少本來會很放鬆，如果不是因為我得忍受那個無能的 gravedigger 的話。」

source_en: His eyes gleam fiendishly when he notices the body you're carrying.*
text_zh: 當他注意到你身上背的屍體時，他的眼睛閃爍著邪惡的光芒。*

source_en: I had to move away... Too sunny.@
text_zh: 我不得不搬離那裡... 陽光太強了。@

source_en: @I much prefer moonlight. It's more natural and healthy.@
text_zh: @我更喜歡月光。它更自然，也更有益健康。@

source_en: @Yes, those who cannot afford resurrection know the cool comfort of good, honest soil.@ He sighs longingly. @How I envy them, for only the dead know true peace..@
text_zh: @是的，那些負擔不起復活費用的窮人，知道良好、誠實的泥土帶來的涼爽與舒適。@ 他懷念地嘆了一口氣。 @我多麼羨慕他們，因爲只有死者才知道真正的安寧..@

source_en: @For most clients, I prefer to use Frigid Solvol. It's the finest enbalming fluid on the market.@
text_zh: 對大多數客戶，我較喜歡使用 Frigid Solvol。它是市面上最優質的防腐液。

source_en: @It gives the departed a nice, healthy glow...@
text_zh: 它會讓逝者擁有一個美麗、健康的容光...

source_en: He smiles. @I see you're not much of a believer in death. But next time you're dead you should try staying that way. You might like it...@
text_zh: 他微笑著。我看你對死亡沒什麼信仰。但下次你死了，應該試試保持那樣。你或許會喜歡...

source_en: @Mole was supposed to have two more graves finished yesterday. I can't stand to talk to him any more - if you see him, tell him I need those graves dug immediately!@
text_zh: Mole 原本應該昨天完成另外兩個墓穴。我再也受不了跟他說話了——如果你見到他，告訴他我急需要那些墓穴挖好！

source_en: @Goodbye for now - I'm sure I'll see you again. Every body ends up here sooner or later...@
text_zh: 暫時別了——我肯定還會見到你的。每個身體遲早都會來到這裡...

source_en: @Ah, you've brought me a client. Tell the truth, doesn't your friend look more peaceful this way?@*
text_zh: 啊，你給我帶來了一位客戶。老實說，你的朋友這樣看起來不是更安詳嗎？*

source_en: You see an enormous woman, both in size and personality.
text_zh: 你看到一個龐大的女人，不僅身材高大，個性也強勢。

source_en: !@ she screams as she strides over to you with beer mugs in her hands.
text_zh: ！@她雙手拿著啤酒杯，大步朝你走過來並大喊。

source_en: @Welcome to the Slaughtered Lamb. What can I get you?@
text_zh: @歡迎來到屠殺的羔羊。需要來點什麼？@

source_en: @I'm very pleased to meet you,@ she purrs.
text_zh: @我很高興認識你，@她輕聲說道。

source_en: @Honey, I've had many jobs in my time. But runnin' this pub is the best, 'cause I get to meet the strongest men.*@
text_zh: @親愛的，我這輩子做過很多工作。但經營這家酒館是最棒的，因為我能認識最強的漢子。*@

source_en: @I sell ale, mead, wine, and rations.@
text_zh: @我賣啤酒、麥酒、葡萄酒和口糧。@

source_en: @Yes. Them's who I beat at arm wrestling call me Miss Barlap, though. Out of respect.@ She laughs.
text_zh: @是的。那些在掰手腕上輸給我的男人，都尊稱我為 Barlap 小姐。那是出於尊敬。@她笑了。

source_en: @Look around. Here you'll find the men whose lives have lead them to many dangerous places.@
text_zh: @四處看看。你會在這裡發現那些生命引領他們抵達許多危險之地的男人。@

source_en: Someone in a dark corner shouts @Like this pub!@ and all the patrons laugh.
text_zh: 有人在昏暗的角落喊道 @就像這家酒吧！@，所有客人都笑了起來。

source_en: @Honey, I've not heard those names spoken since the former Mayor would come in for a drink, rest his soul.@
text_zh: @親愛的，自從前任市長進來喝一杯、安息他靈魂的時候之後，我就沒再聽過這些名字被提及了。@

source_en: @The story that the former Mayor told me was that they were to be transported here in secret to be put in solitary confinement.@
text_zh: @前任市長告訴我的故事是，他們被祕密運送到這裡，然後被關進 solitary confinement（單獨禁閉室）。@

source_en: @Only they never made it here. They overpowered the guards and killed the poor souls, and ran off into the night.@
text_zh: @只是他們從來沒能抵達這裡。他們制服了衛兵，殺了那些可憐的靈魂，然後趁夜逃走了。@

source_en: @The mayor asked me to keep an ear out for any talk amongst the menfolk about the two, and I just love chattin' up the men!@
text_zh: @市長讓我留心地人們對那兩人的談論，而我就是喜歡和男人們聊天！@

source_en: @I meet all kinds of men here, but one in particular during that time would stop in every few weeks or so for drinks and supplies.@
text_zh: @我在這裡見過各種各樣的男人，但特別有一個人，在那段時期每幾週就會進來一次，買些酒和物資。@

source_en: She sighs dreamily. @He sure knew how to sweet talk a woman! Of course he told me I was the prettiest thing he'd seen since his departed wife, Lucy.@
text_zh: 她夢幻般地嘆了口氣。 @他真懂得怎麼甜言蜜語哄女人！當然，他告訴我我是他自從失戀的妻子 Lucy 之後見過的最美的存在。@

source_en: @...or maybe he just wanted the free drinks!@ she laughs.
text_zh: @...或者也許他只是想要免費的酒！@ 她笑著說。

source_en: @Just like a man though, he offered to come back to take me to his home and then I never heard from him again. He said he lived alone as a hermit somewhere in the eastern edge of the Deep Forest.@
text_zh: @不過像個男人一樣，他提出回來帶我去他家，然後我就再沒收到他的消息。他說他獨自住在 Deep Forest（深邃森林）東端某個地方的隱士。@

source_en: @You haven't any room in your pack.@
@I didn't say anything to the mayor though, he couldn't have been Drudgeworth or Saduj, he said his name was Chuck.@
text_zh: @我沒有跟市長說過什麼，他不可能就是 Drudgeworth 或 Saduj，他說他叫 Chuck。@

source_en: She looks you up and down and then feels your arm. @Care for a match?@
text_zh: 她把你上上下下打量了一番，然後摸了摸你的手臂。@想來一場嗎？@

source_en: @Yer on!@ She grabs your arm and the contest begins!*
text_zh: @來啊！@ 她抓住你的手臂，比賽開始了。*

source_en: @Now don't feel bad, sugar, lots of folks lose to Andrea!@ She laughs heartily.
text_zh: @別灰心嘛，甜心，很多人輸給 Andrea 呢！@ 她開懷大笑。

source_en: Thou needest to work on your biceps, Avatar.
text_zh: 聖者，你需要練練你的二頭肌。
好吧，也許改天再說，甜心...

source_en: @Alright, alright, I admit it - ya won fair an' square. No need to gloat about it...@
text_zh: 好吧，好吧，我承認——你是公公平正贏的。別那麼得意...

source_en: @That old witch? She may not have hit the bottle, but I believe a few have hit her.@*
text_zh: 那老巫婆？她可能沒喝醉，但我相信有人揍過她。*
周圍的顧客忍不住笑了起來。

source_en: @Now there's a man.@ She looks into a beer mug and fixes her hair. @I wish he'd come into town more often.@
text_zh: @真不錯的一個男人。@ 她盯著啤酒杯看，整理了一下頭髮。 @我希望他常來鎮上。@

source_en: @I've never seen any creature that could scare me. I say if they want trouble, come in this pub!@
text_zh: @從沒見過任何能嚇到我的生物。我說，如果牠們想找麻煩，就進這家酒吧吧！@

source_en: The men around her let out a cheer and she turns, acknowledging them with a bow.
text_zh: 她周圍的男士們發出歡呼聲，她轉身向他們鞠躬致意。

source_en: @A little girlie-man. But he does make some fine clothes.@
text_zh: @有點娘娘腔的小子。不過他做的衣服挺精緻的。@

source_en: @He's never been in here. Can't imagine why--it seems like his kind of establishment.@
text_zh: @他從來沒進來過。想不出為什麼——這裡看起來像是他喜歡的那種地方。@

source_en: @Come back when my shop is open.@*
@So long. Come back when you're thirsty. And if you see that cutie Utomo, tell him Andrea says hi...@
text_zh: @再見。渴了再來。如果你看到那個帥哥 Utomo，告訴他 Andrea 問候他...@
@歡迎來到 British 城堡，聖者！@

source_en: @I'm the curator of the royal museum of oddities.@
@That was before Lord British appointed me to my current position.@
text_zh: @那是在 Lord British任命我為現職之前。@

source_en: @A true gentleman if ever I saw one.@
text_zh: @我見過的最真誠的紳士，莫過於他了。@

source_en: @It's just one of the projects Lord British has funded to provide a better life for his people.@
text_zh: @這是Lord British資助的項目之一，旨在為他的子民提供更好的生活。@

source_en: @I can tell you more about any of the exhibits you're interested in.@
text_zh: @我可以為您介紹任何您感興趣的展品。@

source_en: @He also established the conservatory that shares the building with the museum. The roads that span the realm are his doing as well.@
text_zh: @他也建立了與博物館共建築的音樂廳。橫跨王國的道路也是他修建的。@

source_en: @Sometimes I can hear their music drifting through the walls...@
text_zh: @有時我能聽到他們的音樂透過牆壁傳出來...@

source_en: @Usually that noisy, crackling field drowns it out, though.@
text_zh: @不過，通常那噼啪作響的能量場會將聲音蓋過。@

source_en: @Travel is much easier these days, that's for sure.@
text_zh: @如今旅行變得容易多了，這點是確定的。@

source_en: @We have the monolith, the energy field, the perpetual motion machine, the bones of Zog, the mystery fountain, and the dragon's head, wings, and egg.@
text_zh: @我們有巨石碑、能量場、永動機、Zog的骨骼、神祕噴泉，以及龍的頭顱、翅膀和龍蛋。@

source_en: @We are also getting other historic artifacts from Britannia's history to put on display - the Virtue stones!@
text_zh: @我們還從Britannia的歷史中收集了其他文物來展示——美德之石！@

source_en: You see a slender woman wearing a leather glove on her left hand.
text_zh: 你看見一位身材苗條的女子，左手上戴著一隻皮革手套。

source_en: @I can't tell you much about that. Lord British donated it to the museum, but I can't get him to talk about it.@
text_zh: @我對那件事不太瞭解。Lord British把它捐贈給博物館，但我無法讓他透露更多細節。@

source_en: @From what little he's said, I think it's an artifact from his home world.@
text_zh: @根據他透露的少許資訊，我猜那是來自他家鄉世界的文物。@

source_en: @The field is generated by a curious spell. By some process not yet understood, it converts magical energy into electrical energy, producing a continuous discharge. If we understood this process better, it would probably lead to all sorts of useful applications.@
text_zh: @這個能量場是由一個神奇的咒語生成的。通過某種尚未理解的過程，它將魔法能量轉化為電能，產生連續的放電。如果我們能更好地理解這個過程，很可能會帶來各種有用的應用。@

source_en: @It came to our attention that an antiquities dealer in Moonglow was selling them from his collection.@
text_zh: @我們注意到，Moonglow的古董經銷商正在出售他收藏中的這些物品。@

source_en: @Mandrake the bard came to us and offered to be the middleman for the trade, so we commissioned him to make the purchase.@
text_zh: @Mandrake這位吟遊詩人找上門來，願意擔任交易的仲介，於是我們委託他進行採購。@

source_en: @He should be returning soon. Hopefully, he hasn't been attacked by gargoyles...@
text_zh: @他應該很快就會回來。希望他沒有被石像鬼襲擊...@

source_en: @If thou dost see him during thy travels, tell him we are eagerly awating the stones for the exhibit.@
text_zh: @如果你在旅途中見到他，請轉告我們正焦急地等待著展覽所需的石頭。@

source_en: @That's a very curious device. The motion of each gear turns another, until eventually the movement is propagated back to the same gear again. There's one thing I can't figure out. We've made plans of the device, and I can't see how they started it moving in the first place. None of the gears would turn unless all the others were already going. What's worse, the motions serve to hold the machine together. If the gears were still, the whole thing would fall apart! How it was built is quite a mystery.@
text_zh: @這是一件非常奇怪的裝置。每個齒輪的轉動都會帶動另一個，最終動量會傳遞回原本的齒輪。有一件事我一直想不通。我們繪製了裝置的圖紙，但我看不出它是如何開始運轉的。除非所有其他齒輪已經在轉動，否則沒有任何齒輪能轉動。更糟糕的是，這些運動有助於將機器結合在一起。如果齒輪停止不動，整個裝置就會散架！它是如何建造而成的，至今仍是個謎。@

source_en: @This skeleton seems to be about ten times older than any other ever found in Britannia. Surely it has much to tell us about our origins, if we only knew what it meant!@
text_zh: @這具骨骸看起來比Britannia發現的任何其他骨骸都要古老十倍。如果能明白它的含義，它肯定能告訴我們許多關於我們起源的事情。@

source_en: @My name is Kytyn.@ She smiles. @Perhaps that explains why I like birds.@
text_zh: @我的名字叫Kytyn。@她微微一笑。@也許這解釋了我為什麼喜歡鳥類。@

source_en: @Someone named 'Gertan' donated all those parts. I think he said something about a dragon named 'Freitag'.@
text_zh: @一位名叫「Gertan」的人捐贈了所有這些部件。我想他說過什麼關於名為「Freitag」的巨龍。@

source_en: @Somebody found a huge boulder with a jet of water spraying out of it. We had it magically teleported here, buried with its surface flush with the ground, and then we built this building on top of it.@
text_zh: @有人發現了一塊巨大的岩石，上面有一道噴射而出的水柱。我們用魔法將其傳送到這裡，讓其表面與地面齊平地埋入地下，然後在上面建造了這座建築。@

source_en: @Of course we left a hole in the floor for the water to spray through. I often drink from it when I'm thirsty. The water is quite good, but there's something strange about it. It vanishes somehow before it hits the ground...@
text_zh: @當然，我們在地面上留了一個洞，讓水能噴射出來。口渴時我常常從那裡喝水。水質不錯，但有些奇怪。水在接觸地面之前不知怎的就消失了...@

source_en: @If you want to ask Gertan, I think he's in Cove.@
text_zh: @如果你想知道Gertan的看法，我想他在Cove。@

source_en: @Let me know if you are interested later..@
text_zh: @如果你以後有興趣，隨時告訴我。..@

source_en: @There is a great deal of knowledge available there for the serious scholar.@
text_zh: @那裡為嚴謹的學者提供了大量知識。@

source_en: @She favors you with a deep, throaty purr that sounds just like a cat.@
text_zh: @她發出深沉而喉音十足的呼嚕聲，聽起來就像是一隻貓。@

source_en: @Be sure to have a look at our paintings while you're here. And come again soon...We're expecting some unicorn horns, and a Klein bottle from Trinsic.@
text_zh: @在這期間務必看看我們的畫作。還要盡快再來...我們預計會收到一些獨角獸角，以及來自 Trinsic 的一個 Klein bottle。@

source_en: You see a tall, stern woman, with graying red hair and a perpetual scowl.
text_zh: 你看到一位身材高挑、神情嚴肅的女性，頭髮是帶灰的紅色，臉上永遠掛著一絲不悅。

source_en: @Welcome, worthy Avatar, to the Hall of Justice. How may we assist thee in thy quest?@
text_zh: @歡迎，值得欽佩的聖者，來到Hall of Justice。我們能在你的旅途中提供什麼協助？@

source_en: @Welcome again, worthy Avatar, to my hall.@
text_zh: @再次歡迎，值得欽佩的聖者，來到我的大廳。@

source_en: @I am Lenora, Lady Mayor of Yew.@
text_zh: 我是 Lenora，Yew 的女市長。

source_en: @It is my honor to preside over this town and its courts. We also provide the finest wood in the realm.@
text_zh: 能主持此鎮及其法庭，是我的榮幸。我們也提供這片土地上最優質的木材。

source_en: @Go ask Ben the logger. Head west from here into the forest until you can go no further. Then look for a way through the trees to the north.@
text_zh: 去問問伐木工 Ben 吧。從這裡往西進入森林，直到無法再前進為止。然後尋找穿過樹林往北的路。

source_en: @In Yew we take pride in our system of justice.@
text_zh: 在 Yew，我們為我們的正義制度感到自豪。

source_en: @Now that Rinaldo is back, he will be assuming his duties of presiding over the courts.@
text_zh: 既然 Rinaldo 回來，他將開始履行主持法庭的職責。

source_en: @Indeed, the Rune of Justice itself was sent here for safekeeping.@
text_zh: 事實上，正義之符文本身就被送到這裡妥善保管。

source_en: @A thief stole the rune from the grave of our most respected resident, the former Lord Mayor. Even though the thief was caught, we have not yet found the rune.@
text_zh: 一個小賊從我們最受尊敬的居民、前市長的墓中偷走了符文。雖然小賊被抓住了，但我們尚未找到符文。

source_en: @The thief is in the jail, awaiting the carriage of justice.@
text_zh: 那個小賊現在在監獄裡，等待正義的制裁。

source_en: @'Tis most strange, Avatar, that thou knowest not the Mantra of Justice. How can that be?@
text_zh: 真是奇怪，聖者，你竟然不知道正義的真言。這是怎麼回事？
嗯...嗯，無所謂，」她懷疑地說道。

source_en: @I suppose 'twould be improper to deny anything the Avatar requires. The Mantra of Justice is 'beh'.@
text_zh: 我想，拒絕聖者提出的任何要求是不合適的。正義的真言是 'beh'。

source_en: @Hmpf! Well, mayhap 'twould be best for you to seek such wisdom elsewhere!*@
text_zh: 哼！好吧，也許你最好去別處尋求這種智慧！*

source_en: @Thou may return when thou seest fit to answer my question!@
text_zh: 當你認為合適回答我的問題時，你再回來吧！

source_en: @A letter of permission? Dost thou truly need to speak with that reprehensible thief?@
text_zh: @一封許可信？你真的需要與那個令人憎惡的小偷說話嗎？@

source_en: @Very well then.@ Putting quill to parchment, she drafts a quick letter. @The jailer will now let you in, or verily shall he answer to me!@
text_zh: @很好。@ 她將羽毛筆擱在羊皮紙上，快速寫了一封信。@監獄長現在會讓你進去，否則他就得向我問罪！@

source_en: @Ask again when you have room to carry the letter@
text_zh: @等你能裝得下信件的時候再來問吧@

source_en: @Then why dost thou waste my time with frivolous requests?! Begone, Avatar, and return when thou hast more serious business on thy mind!@
text_zh: @那你為何用這些輕浮的要求浪費我的時間？！滾吧，聖者，等你有更嚴肅的事務時再來吧！@

source_en: @I already gave thee the letter, Avatar.@
@What, free the thief in return for the rune? Never! To do so would betray everything the rune itself stands for! Better to leave it lost.@
text_zh: @什麼？為了符文而釋放那個小偷？絕對不行！那樣做會背叛符文本身所代表的一切！寧願讓它遺失。@

source_en: @What? What stories has that thief been telling you? He has no family--he's just a drifter! Don't be taken in by his lies.@
text_zh: @什麼？那個小偷跟你說了什麼故事？他沒有家人——他不過是個流浪漢！別被他謊言矇蔽了。@

source_en: @Nicodemus the enchanter lives near here. His house lies between two rivers.@
text_zh: @尼可德穆斯（Nicodemus）這位咒術師就住在附近。他的房子位於兩條河之間。@

source_en: @What do you know of them? They were responsible for the murder of a few guards during their transport.@
text_zh: @你對他們知道多少？他們在押送期間殺死了几名衛兵。@

source_en: @Well, Avatar. I graciously grant thee another interview. I certainly hope thou wilt be more respectful this time.@
text_zh: @好吧，聖者。我大方地再給你一次面試機會。我強烈希望你這次會更有禮貌。@

source_en: @It happened during the former Lord Mayor's tenure while I was just a clerk. What he knew about the case most likely died with him.@
text_zh: @發生在前市長任內，當時我只是一名書吏。他對案件的瞭解很可能已隨他而去。@

source_en: @It's possible he might have talked to the barmaid about it as he enjoyed a good drink in the evenings, but he never discussed it with me.@
text_zh: @有可能他在晚上享用美酒時曾與酒吧女侍談起這件事，但他從未與我討論過。@

source_en: You inform Lenora of the events in Skara Brae surrounding Quenton's murder and the seance, in which Quenton indicated Michael was the culprit.
text_zh: 你向Lenora匯報斯卡拉布萊（Skara Brae）發生的事件，包括昆頓（Quenton）被殺以及降靈會，昆頓在降靈會中指責邁克爾（Michael）是兇手。

source_en: @Yes, I'm aware of the unfortunate death in Skara Brae, but people die all the time to gargoyle attacks these days.@
text_zh: @是的，我知道Skara Brae的不幸死亡事件，但這些天人們時常死於巖怪（gargoyle）的襲擊。@

source_en: @What wouldst thou have me do? Drop everything and send our already overstretched guards to arrest someone, based on a ghost's testimony?@
text_zh: @你想讓我做什麼？放下所有事情，派我們已經超負荷的衛兵去逮捕某人，僅僅基於一個鬼魂的證詞嗎？@

source_en: @It sounds more credible that it was the doings of those vile gargoyles. Please run along and trouble me not with this nonsense...@
text_zh: @聽起來更像是那些可惡巖怪（gargoyle）的所作所為。請走吧，別用這些胡說八道來煩我了...@

source_en: @Come back tomorrow when I'm working and we'll discuss this matter.@
text_zh: @明天我上班時再來，我們再討論這件事。@

source_en: @As I have said, all further discussion on this matter should be with Rinaldo.@
text_zh: @正如我所說，關於此事的進一步討論應與里納爾多（Rinaldo）進行。@

source_en: @Hmpf! Well, mayhap 'twould be best for you to seek such wisdom elsewhere!@
text_zh: @哼！好吧，也許你最好在別處尋求這種智慧！

source_en: @May you find that which thou deservest on thy quest.@
text_zh: @願你在旅程中找到你配得的東西。@

source_en: He tosses you some keys, then turns his back on you.
text_zh: 他扔給你一些鑰匙，然後轉身背對你。

source_en: @Okay. Never had nobody sound so interested in jest hearing about the jail before.@
text_zh: @好吧。從來沒聽過有人對牢房這麼感興趣的。@

source_en: @Much obliged,@ the taciturn jailer says as he takes the key.
text_zh: 沉默寡言的典獄長說道：「多謝，」同時接過鑰匙。

source_en: @Well, that does me no good. Need it here.@
text_zh: @這對我沒什麼用。我需要它在這裡。@

source_en: Without another word, the jailer returns to his carving.
text_zh: 典獄長沒再說一句話，便繼續回去刻木頭了。

source_en: @Well, bring it back to me when you are.@ Without another word, the jailer returns to his carving.
text_zh: @好了，等你辦完了就拿回來給我。@ 典獄長沒再說一句話，便繼續回去刻木頭了。

source_en: @Say, you looking to get the keys to my jail cells?@
An old man, tall and thin. He spends all his time whittling.*
text_zh: 一個老頭子，高而瘦。他花所有時間在刻木頭。*

source_en: . What can I do for you?@
@I mind the jail. Got a prisoner in solitary right now.@
text_zh: @我管牢房。現在有個囚犯被關在 solitary。@

source_en: @Got four of the cleanest cells you could ask fer.@
text_zh: @我有四間你能想象的最乾淨的牢房。@

source_en: @Feller broke into the grave of His Lordship, the late Mayor.@
text_zh: @Feller 闖入了前任市長大人——祂之尊貴——的墓。@

source_en: @You'll need my key to get in there.@
text_zh: 你需要我的鑰匙才能進去。
他被關在單獨監禁，就在那邊。

source_en: @Yup, I could give you the key.... But not without Her Ladyship's permission.@
text_zh: 嗯，我可以給你鑰匙....但沒有夫人 ladyship 的許可不行。

source_en: @You got a letter of permission from Her Ladyship?@
text_zh: 你有夫人 ladyship 寫的許可信嗎？

source_en: @Okay, here's the key. Give it back when you're done.@
text_zh: 好的，這是鑰匙。用完請還給我。

source_en: @Ask again when you have room to carry the key@
text_zh: 等你有空位拿鑰匙時再來問

source_en: @Gotta have a letter if you want to see the thief.@
@Well, gotta have a letter if you want to see the thief.@
@Well, ya know, I shouldn't do this. But Her Ladyship is a little too strict about who she puts in here.@*
text_zh: 嗯，你知道，我不該這樣做。但夫人 ladyship 對誰能被關在這裡有點太嚴格了。*

source_en: He thinks for a moment. @Nope. Sorry, not interested.@
text_zh: 他想了片刻。沒門。對不起，不感興趣。

source_en: @Pity. Never been offered a bribe before.@
text_zh: 可惜了。從來沒有人賄賂過我。

source_en: @'Taint my place to talk about that. You should go see Her Ladyship, the Mayor.@
text_zh: 這不是我能說的事。你應該去看看夫人 ladyship，也就是市長。

source_en: @Drudgeworth and Saduj?@ He thinks a moment.  @Doesn't ring a bell. We got lotsa prisoners 'round here these days.@
text_zh: @Drudgeworth and Saduj？@ 他想了一下。@聽沒聽說過。這些天我們這兒關押了許多囚犯。@

source_en: You hand him the leaflet. @Hmm, come to think of it.. this all sounds familiar now. I was a younger lad just starting out here as the jailer. Them prisoners never made it here.@
text_zh: 你給他傳單。嗯，這麼一想..這些聽起來很耳熟。我還是個年輕小伙子，剛在這裡當獄卒。那些囚犯從未到過這裡。

source_en: @They somehow escaped the transport cart and murdered the guards.@
text_zh: 他們不知怎麼從押運車上逃脫，並殺死了護衛。

source_en: @Seems like they found the abandoned cart and the guards some ways down the road from the Abbey. The former mayor led the investigation, but the two were never found.@
text_zh: 看來他們在修道院沿路不遠處發現了廢棄的車子和護衛。前市長主導了調查，但那兩人從未找到。

source_en: @They musta made their escape in the Deep Forest. Probably long gone now as that was years ago.@
text_zh: 他們一定是在Deep Forest中逃脫的。現在多半早不在了，那可是多年以前的事。

source_en: @Maybe Her Ladyship could tell ya more.@
text_zh: 也許夫人 ladyship 能告訴妳更多。

source_en: The jailer nods and says g'
@So I make up fer it by being a little careless with the keys, if you take my meaning.@*
text_zh: 所以我用對鑰匙稍微粗心一點來補償，如果你懂我的意思。*
DEATH 事件被呼叫於 Pridgarm

source_en: @Good!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the
text_zh: 很好！ 接受你的金子後，他交出

source_en: A huge, dark-skined man with a close-set face.*
text_zh: 一個身材高大、皮膚黝黑、五官緊湊的男人。*

source_en: @Ombogo dono,@ he grunts at you from behind a large forge.@
text_zh: 他從巨大的鍛爐後方向你低吼："Ombogo dono。"

source_en: @Utomo remember you, how you not remember Utomo? Utomo, from island.@
text_zh: Utomo 記得你，你為什麼不記得 Utomo？Utomo，來自島嶼。

source_en: @Utomo make good weapons. Make one for you if you like.@
text_zh: Utomo 打造優質武器。如果你願意，我可以為你打造一把。
那意思是"我不認識的人"。

source_en: @Utomo mean 'island' in my language. I also from island. Bring magic fan from island. This town new home for Utomo now.@
text_zh: 在我的語言中，Utomo 的意思是"島嶼"。我也來自島嶼。我從島嶼帶來了魔法扇子。這個小鎮現在是 Utomo 的新家。

source_en: @Learn to make as boy. I live on island then.@
text_zh: 小時候就學會做了。我後來住在島上。

source_en: @Lady on island make magic fans. They make big wind, blow ships all around.@
text_zh: 島上的一位女士會做魔法扇子。風吹得很大，把船吹得到處亂走。

source_en: @I come here from many days away. My home burned by evil man.@
text_zh: 我走了好長的路才來到這裡。我的家被壞人燒毀了。

source_en: @I not sure where. Got ride on big ship.@
text_zh: 我不確定在哪裡。我是搭一艘大船來的。

source_en: @He say to me, 'You man, you leave home and kill good people with me.' I ran from him.@
text_zh: 他跟我說：『傢伙，跟我一起離開家，去殺好人。』我跑掉了。

source_en: @I stow away when night come. After long time we land and I jump off.@
text_zh: 天黑時我偷渡上去。過了好久我們才上岸，我跳下來。

source_en: @Like people in town. Like Lord British.@
@Utomo go and drink at her home. She try kiss Utomo. Utomo say, 'I no want you' but she kiss anyway. Utomo not go back there.@
text_zh: Utomo 去她家喝酒。她試圖親吻 Utomo。Utomo 說：『我不想要你』，但她還是親了。Utomo 沒有再回去那裡。

source_en: @Utomo have girl back home. She not thin like Andrea. Someday Utomo go back and get her. Someday.@ He plays the poker over the hot coals and looks absently into the fire.
text_zh: Utomo 在老家有個姑娘。她不像 Andrea 那樣瘦。哪天 Utomo 會回去接她。總有那天的。他把撲克牌在熱煤上烤，漫不經心地望著火堆。

source_en: @Her name Yuna. She good tree climber. I not see her for long time.@
text_zh: 她叫 Yuna。她很會爬樹。我好久沒見她了。

source_en: @In my land it mean 'You have good meal in sun.' It is goodbye in my land.@
text_zh: 在我的土地，這意味著『你在太陽下享用美餐』。那是我們的道別語。

source_en: @You come to shop when it open.@*
@I have many things here. You want arms or armor.@
text_zh: 這裡有很多東西。你要武器還是防具。

source_en: @All right, I give up. The rune is 'idden under a potted plant at the Slaughtered Lamb. Now go away and leave me alone.@
text_zh: 「好吧，我認輸了。符文藏在『屠殺的羔羊』酒館的一盆植物下面。現在請走開，別煩我了。」

source_en: A short, heavyset man dressed in rags.*
text_zh: 一個矮小、體態肥胖的男人，身穿破爛衣物。*

source_en: @Who's there?@ the thief calls insolently. The thief's tone becomes more respectful as he recognizes you.*
text_zh: 「誰在那裡？」小偷無禮地喊道。當他認出你時，他的語氣變得恭敬起來。*

source_en: @'Strewth, it's the Avatar! You've got to get me out of 'ere,
text_zh: 「天哪，是聖者！你得幫我把我從這裡弄出去，

source_en: ! Am I glad to see thee! You're me last light in a world of darkness.@
text_zh: ！很高興見到您！您是黑暗世界裡我最後的希望。」

source_en: @I'm but a poor farmer, forced into crime by the harshness of these times. There weren't no other way to feed me family, Avatar!@
text_zh: 「我只是一個窮苦的農民，被這嚴苛的時勢逼得走上犯罪之路。沒有其他辦法能餵飽我的家人了，聖者大人！」

source_en: Tears fill the man's eyes. @My poor children've got no one to take care of them now. I only stole to feed them, and that's the truth.@
text_zh: 淚水充滿了男人的眼眶。「我的可憐孩子們現在沒有人照顧了。我偷東西只是為了餵飽他們，這是事實。」

source_en: @True? Of course it's true! Even a thief like me wouldn't lie to the Avatar.@
text_zh: 「真實？當然是真的！即使是像我這樣的小偷，也不會對聖者說謊。」

source_en: @All right, I admit it. I 'aven't got any kids. But that stupid cow they got runnin' this place won't listen to reason--a little give-and-take, know what I mean?@*
text_zh: @好吧，我承認了。我確實沒有孩子。但那頭管理這地方的愚蠢母牛根本聽不進講道理的話——說點互相譲步之類的，懂我的意思嗎？@*

source_en: @I tell you what. If I tell you where the rune is, will you take it away? I don't want these pompous blighters to 'ave it. Okay?@.
text_zh: @我告訴你吧。如果我告訴你符文的在哪，你會把它拿走嗎？我不想讓那些自以為是的混蛋擁有它。好嗎？@.

source_en: @All right, I'll take your word for it. Go to the Slaughtered Lamb; I 'id the rune under a potted plant there. And spit on Her Ladyship for me!@
text_zh: @好吧，我聽你的話。去「被屠殺的羔羊」；我在那裡的盆栽植物下藏了符文。另外，幫我對她大人撒泡尿！

source_en: @Then the gargoyles can take the lot of you! You'll never get nothin' out of me!@
text_zh: @讓那些石像鬼把你這夥人全部帶走吧！你永遠別想從我這裡問出什麼！

source_en: @I'll tell you where the rune is if you'll let me go. I've got me kids to think of.@
text_zh: @如果你放我走，我就告訴你符文在哪裡。我得照顧我的孩子。@

source_en: @I admit I robbed that grave. But it were only because 'is Lordship wouldn't be needin' that stuff no more. I 'ad me kids to feed, didn't I?@
text_zh: @我承認我盜了那個墳墓。但那是因為他大人已經不再需要那些東西了。我得餓著肚子養活我的孩子，是吧？@

source_en: @You mean it, Avatar? Are they gonna let me go 'ome?@
text_zh: @你是認真的嗎，聖者？他們真的會讓我回家嗎？@

source_en: His face lights up. @I knew I could count on you, Avatar! And I'll keep my end of the bargain. I 'id the rune under a potted plant in the Slaughtered Lamb inn.@
text_zh: 他的臉亮了起來。@我就知道可以靠你，聖者！我會信守承諾的。我把符文藏在「被屠殺的羔羊」旅館的一盆植物下面。@

source_en: As you leave, Iolo whispers to you. @Maybe it was necessary, Avatar, but lying makes me uneasy. Even to someone like him.@
text_zh: 當你離開時，Iolo 小聲對你說。@也許這是有必要的，聖者，但說謊讓我不安。即使是對那樣的人。@

source_en: His face falls. @Then I ain't sayin' nothin'. I've got me kids to think of, I do.@
text_zh: 他的臉色垮了。@那我就什麼都不說了。我得照顧我的孩子，我確實得。@

source_en: @Please, Avatar! Tell them to let me go 'ome! Tell them about me poor fatherless kids! They'll listen to you!@
text_zh: @求求你，聖者！告訴他們讓我回家！告訴他們關於我那些可憐的沒有父親的孩子！他們會聽你的！@

source_en: @I ain't talkin' to you, you're just like all the rest! I'll never crack, no matter 'ow many times you come back!@
text_zh: @我才不跟你說話，你們跟其他人一樣！不管你們回來多少次，我都堅貞不屈！

source_en: @I heard rumors that you were in town!@
Iolo greets his former apprentice warmly. @How goes business, Gwenneth?@
text_zh: Iolo 熱情地接待他從前的學徒。@生意怎麼樣，Gwenneth？@

source_en: @Very well, very well indeed. Sir Geoffrey himself just placed quite a large order! Much demand for bows these days, what with the gargoyles!@
text_zh: @很好，非常好。Sir Geoffrey 親自下了一個大訂單！現在對弓的需求量很大，都是因為那些石怪！@

source_en: Turning to you, Gwenneth says, @And what can I do for Iolo's friend this fine
text_zh: 轉過身對著你，Gwenneth 說，@今天這麼好，我能為 Iolo 的朋友做點什麼，

source_en: @I recongize thee! Thou art Iolo's friend,
text_zh: @我認識你！你是 Iolo 的朋友，

source_en: @What can I do for thee this fine
text_zh: 在這個美好的日子，我能為你做什麼？

source_en: @Hello again. What can I do for thee this fine
text_zh: 再次見面了。在這個美好的日子，我能為你做什麼？

source_en: @What a strange question. I'm Gwenneth, of course.@
text_zh: 多麼奇怪的問題。我當然是Gwenneth。

source_en: @Just ask Iolo! But dost thou not know Iolo? Well, I am his former apprentice, Gwenneth.@
text_zh: 去問Iolo吧！難道你不認識Iolo嗎？好吧，我是他從前的學徒，Gwenneth。

source_en: @Once was I Iolo's apprentice, but then he decided to retire. Now 'tis my shop, and I craft the bows sold here! 'Course, 'tis still called Iolo's Bows, out of respect for the master.@
text_zh: @我曾是 Iolo 的學徒，但後來他決定退休了。現在這是我經營的店鋪，這裡賣的弓都是我製作的！當然，為了尊敬師父，店名還是叫 Iolo's Bows。@
聽到這裡，Iolo謙虛地紅了臉。

source_en: @She smiles. I would not wish to speak of Iolo amongst his friends. I might embarass him!@
text_zh: 她笑了。我不希望在Iolo的朋友們面前談論他。那樣我會讓他難堪的！

source_en: @Nay, I really would not wish to speak of my master behind his back.@
text_zh: 不，我實在不希望在師父背後說他的壞話。

source_en: @I hear from the soldiers that the gargoyles are fierce opponents. Some gargoyles move like the wind itself, and can strike you like lightning bolts! The gargoyles also have a strange and terrible weapon.@
text_zh: 我從士兵們那裡聽說，石像鬼是兇猛的對手。有些石像鬼快如疾風，能像閃電一樣攻擊你！石像鬼還有一種奇怪而可怕的武器。

source_en: @'Tis called a boomerang, and it is a most bizarre ranged weapon. It flies out to strike its target, then returns to the hand that threw it! Against such magic the soldiers chose to arm themselves with good, stout Britannian bows!@
text_zh: 那叫迴力鏢，是一種非常古怪的遠程武器。它飛出去擊中目標，然後返回到投擲者手中！面對這種魔法，士兵們選擇配備結實好用的布里塔尼亞長弓！

source_en: @Aye, usually do I carry those in stock. But there has been a shortage of late, because of the gargoyle war. Go see Lynn the Fletcher, over to the north.@
text_zh: 嗯，我通常都會備有這些貨。但最近因為石像鬼戰爭，物資短缺。去北邊找製箭師Lynn看看吧。 Fletcher

source_en: @Lynn is a fine fletcher, and usually keeps me supplied with arrows and bolts. I've none left in stock, though, since the soldiers bought them all.@
text_zh: Lynn是一位出色的製箭師，通常都會供應給我箭矢和弩箭。不過，現在我貨架上已經沒有存貨了，因為士兵們買光了所有東西。

source_en: @You don't have room to carry it.@
text_zh: 你的隨身空間不夠，無法攜帶它。

source_en: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough gold.@
@Ah, I see thou art a discerning buyer. The triple crossbow is a marvel to behold. This enchanted weapon fires three bolts at once!@
text_zh: “啊，我看你是個有眼光的買家。這把三連弩值得一看。這件附魔武器能同時射出三支弩箭！”

source_en: @Normally I would not offer it for sale. But, because thy cause is so important, I will allow thee-- and thee only!-- to buy it. But, I fear I must charge 400 gold for it. Dost thou wish to buy this weapon?@
text_zh: “通常我是不會出售它的。但因為你的事關重大，我允許你——只有你——購買它。不過，恐怕我得收 400 金幣。你想買這件武器嗎？”

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, Gwenneth hands over the triple crossbow.
text_zh: “太好了！”收到你的金幣後，Gwenneth 把三連弩遞了過來。

source_en: @It will be here, waiting for thee, if thou hast a need for it.@
text_zh: “如果你需要它，它會一直在這兒等著你。”

source_en: @I fear I had but one triple crossbow for sale. Come back in six months and I may have another.@
text_zh: “恐怕我只有一把三連弩出售。六個月後再來，我或許會再有一把。”

source_en: You see a petite woman with flowing brown hair.*
text_zh: 你看到一位身材嬌小、留著飄逸棕髮的女子。*

source_en: @Anything else I can do for thee?@
text_zh: 還有其他我能為你做的嗎？

source_en: @Please come back when my shop is open.@
text_zh: 請等我店鋪開門時再來。

source_en: @Farewell, all of you. Iolo, I'll see thee again soon with thy share of this month's profits!@
text_zh: 再見，各位。Iolo，我很快就會再見到你，並給你這個月的利潤分成！

source_en: Dupre puts his hand on your shoulder and whispers, @Matt here had a most unfortunate accident as a child, and it left him deaf and dumb. I'd suggest you ask his wife instead,
text_zh: Dupre 把手放在你的肩上，低聲說：「Matt 小時候發生了不幸的意外，導致他失聰且啞口。我建議你問問他的妻子，

source_en: @Wouldst thou like ale, mead, wine, mutton, or perhaps a cake?@
text_zh: @你想來點麥酒、蜜酒、葡萄酒、羊肉，或者來塊蛋糕？@

source_en: @You don't have room to carry it.@
text_zh: 你的隨身空間不夠，無法攜帶它。

source_en: You see a gaunt fellow, with eyes that take in everything and reveal nothing. When you address him, the man replies with gestures that appear to be some kind of sign language.
text_zh: 你看到一個瘦削的人，他的雙眼觀遍了萬物，卻不透露任何訊息。當你向他搭話時，那人以看似某種手勢語言的方式回應。

source_en: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough gold.@
@That'll be 4 gold for the mutton. Is that alright?@
text_zh: @羊肉是 4 個黃金幣。這樣可以嗎？@

source_en: @Anything else I can do for thee?@
text_zh: 還有其他我能為你做的嗎？

source_en: @Very well. What else dost thou wish to speak about?@
When he sees that you can't understand him, he shrugs his shoulders and returns to his duties.
text_zh: 當他發現你無法理解他時，他聳了聳肩，然後回到他的工作中。

source_en: @Then here you are.@ She hands you the rune. @I wish you the best of luck on your quest.@
text_zh: @這裡，給你。@ 她將符文遞給你。@祝你旅途平安。@

source_en: @Oh, you're carrying too much right now. You'd better come back for it later.@
text_zh: @噢，你現在攜帶的東西太多了。你最好稍後再回來拿。@

source_en: @Well, if you get their permission later, let me know.@
text_zh: @嗯，如果你後來得到他們的允許，請告訴我。@

source_en: She curtsies gracefully. @Ariana is my name.@
text_zh: 她優雅地行了個屈膝禮。@我叫Ariana。@

source_en: @I'm learning to be a bard. I like to play the harpsichord best.@
text_zh: @我正在學習成為吟遊詩人。我最喜歡彈彈琴。@

source_en: @I want to be a bard when I grow up. They have more fun than anybody!@
text_zh: @我長大後想當吟遊詩人。他們比誰都過得開心！@

source_en: @I've been studying to be a bard since I was this many.@ She holds up three fingers.*
text_zh: @我從這麼高的時候就開始學習當吟遊詩人了。@ 她舉起三根手指。*

source_en: @I'd like to play something for you, but I'm not good enough yet.@
text_zh: @我很想為你演奏，但我還不夠好。@

source_en: She looks away for a moment, then turns back to you, blushing slightly. @Will you come back to hear my music when I am older, if you can?@
text_zh: 她暫時別過臉去，然後轉過身來，臉微紅。@如果我長大後，你能回來聽我唱歌嗎？@

source_en: The little girl's face breaks out into a smile bright enough to light up the whole room. @Really? I would like that very much.@
text_zh: 小女孩臉上綻放出足以照亮整個房間的笑容。@真的嗎？我非常喜歡。@

source_en: The little girl sniffles, seeming suddenly on the verge of tears. @I'm sorry,@ she says, @I shouldn't have asked.@ She turns her back, as if ashamed to face you.
text_zh: 小女孩抽噎著，似乎突然快要流淚了。@對不起，@ 她說，@我不該這麼問的。@ 她轉過身去，彷彿羞於面對你。

source_en: @I can't remember it now... And Kenneth just taught it to me last week... Wait, I know! It's 'mo!' Or maybe it was 'om'... Or 'mu,' or 'um'... It was something like that.@
text_zh: @我現在記不起來了... Kenneth上週才剛教我... 等等，我想起來了！是 'mo!' 或者是 'om'... 又或者是 'mu,' 或 'um'... 大概是那麼回事。@

source_en: You see a cute little girl with short hair.
text_zh: 你看到一個短髮的可愛小女孩。

source_en: @They taught me all about compassion. They say it's very important for bards.@
text_zh: @他們教了我許多關於慈悲的事。他們說這對吟遊詩人來說非常重要。@

source_en: @I have the Rune of Compassion. Isn't it pretty?@ She reaches into her pocket and takes it out to show you. @Do you need it for something?@
text_zh: @我有慈悲符文。它是不是很美麗？@ 她伸手從口袋裡取出它展示給你。@你需要它做什麼嗎？@

source_en: @I'm not supposed to let anyone else have it. But if you truly need it... I don't know what I should do. I know! My parents run the Blue Boar Tavern. Go ask them if you can borrow the rune. If they say 'tis okay, I'll give it to you.@
text_zh: @我不該讓其他人擁有它。但如果你真的需要它...我不知道該怎麼辦。我知道了！我父母經營Blue Boar Tavern。去問問他們能否借用符文。如果他們說可以，我就給你了。@

source_en: @I'd best hold onto it then. I was told to look after it carefully.@
text_zh: @那我最好先收起來。我被指示要小心保管它。@

source_en: @I already gave it to you, silly. I hope you can figure out how to use it.@
text_zh: @我已經給你了，傻瓜。希望你能想出來怎麼使用它。@

source_en: @My parents told me never to talk to strangers. What's your name?@
text_zh: @我父母告訴我絕對不要和陌生人說話。你叫什麼名字？@

source_en: @Ok, now I can talk to you!@
@Hi! Did you get permission from my parents to borrow the rune?@
text_zh: @嗨！你獲得我父母同意借用符文了嗎？@

source_en: @Okay just let me know when you're ready to check out.@
text_zh: @好的，等你準備退房時告訴我就行。@

source_en: A well-dressed man with a very even temper.*
text_zh: 一位穿著得體、性情平和的男子。*

source_en: , and welcome to the Wayfarer's Inn!@
, and welcome back to the Wayfarer's Inn!@
@I am Peyton, and this is my place.@ He gestures with his hands.
text_zh: @我是Peyton，這裡是我的地方。@ 他揮了揮手。

source_en: @I can offer you a room for the evening.@
text_zh: @我可以為您提供今晚的客房。@

source_en: gold per person for bed and breakfast. Interested?@
text_zh: 每人含早餐的住宿費。有興趣嗎？@

source_en: @Here's your key. You'll be staying in the room straight ahead. Checkout time is 9am and breakfast will be served. Enjoy your stay!@
text_zh: @這是您的鑰匙。您的房間就在前方直行處。退房時間是早上 9 點，屆時會提供早餐。祝您居住愉快！@

source_en: @You don't have enough gold for that. I'm sorry, cash in advance. That's our policy.@
text_zh: @您的金幣不足以支付此費用。抱歉，我們規定需先付清現金。這是我們的規章。@

source_en: @Well, perhaps next time you're in town.@
, are you ready to check out?@
Peyton serves you a large breakfast and you hand him the key.
text_zh: Peyton為您提供豐盛的早餐，您將鑰匙交還給他。

source_en: @Well, where is the key? Perhaps you left it in your room. Come back when you're ready to check out.@
text_zh: @嗯，鑰匙在哪裡？也許您忘在房間裡了。準備好退房時再來吧。@

source_en: @But she'sa be making thee too heavy,
@Achanged your aminda, eh? What'sa you wanta nexta?@
text_zh: @你改變主意了？接下來你想買什麼？@

source_en: @Hey, at'sa good!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the
text_zh: @嘿，這很好！@ 收下您的金幣後，他將
你看到一位黝黑的鐵匠。

source_en: @Whassamattayu, you blind or somethin'? I makea de swords and stuff, what's it alook like I'ma doin' here?@
text_zh: @幹嘛這樣看人，你瞎了嗎還是怎麼的？我這是打造劍啊之類的東西，看我這在幹什麼？@

source_en: @You gotta somethin' to sell oda somethin' you wanna buy?@
text_zh: @你有東西要賣，還是想買些什麼？@

source_en: @You come to my shopa when shesa open!@
@Goodbyea to you. Come abacka soon, ah?@
@But she'sa costing too much for you,
text_zh: 但她對你的收費太貴了，

source_en: @Fine, I shall wait here then if I must. Don't leave me here too long.@
text_zh: 好吧，如果我必須的話，我就在這裡等你。別讓我在這裡等太久。

source_en: @Fine. I'll be with my fellow gypsies if you change your mind.@
text_zh: 好吧。如果你改變主意，你會在我那些吉普賽同伴那裡找到我。

source_en: @I suppose you'll be wanting to keep all this equipment.*@
text_zh: 我想你應該想保留這批裝備。*

source_en: He leaves everything he was carrying in a pile on the ground.
text_zh: 他將身上攜帶的所有物品都堆在地上。

source_en: @Oh, pardon my mistake. It's just that we gypsies often have trouble finding acceptance among the gorgios.@*
text_zh: 噢，抱歉失禮了。只是我們吉普賽人常常難以被那些外人所接受。*

source_en: @I'm very grateful that you've given me the chance to come along on your quest.@
text_zh: 非常感謝你給了我跟隨你踏上冒險之旅的機會。

source_en: @Our dog did his best trick for you. You should show him some appreciation.@
text_zh: 我們的狗為了你使盡了渾身解數。你應該對它表示一些賞識。

source_en: @I am a juggler. But I would fain join thee and go adventuring.@
text_zh: 我是一名雜技表演者。但我很渴望加入你們，一起去冒險。

source_en: @I charge five gold for juggling. Would you like to see some?@
text_zh: 看我的雜技表演收費五金幣。你想看嗎？

source_en: The gypsy juggler takes three wands out of his knapsack and sets their ends afire. Tossing them into the air, he begins juggling.
text_zh: 吉普賽雜技演員從背包裡取出三根棍子，將末端點燃。他把它們拋向空中，開始表演雜技。
一個身材瘦小的吉普賽少年。*

source_en: The pattern is elaborate, almost hypnotic as the tips of the wands describe great flaming arcs and spirals through the air. At regular intervals he tosses one around behind his back. Yet somehow it always finds its way back into the pattern with the other two, without missing a beat.
text_zh: 圖案極為複雜，幾乎令人如癡如醉，隨著魔杖尖端在空中描繪出巨大的火焰弧線與螺旋。他每隔一段時間就會將其中一根拋到背後。然而不知為何，它總能與另外兩根配合，在節奏上絲毫未亂地重新回歸軌道。

source_en: At last he catches all three of the wands in one hand, waves them with a great flourish, and bows deeply before you. As he extinguishes the wands, he says @I hope you enjoyed the show.@
text_zh: 終於，他用一隻手接住了所有三根魔杖，以華麗的手勢揮舞著，然後在你面前深深鞠躬。當他熄滅魔杖時，他說 @我希望你享受這場表演。@

source_en: @I knew it! You don't really want to have a gypsy around.@*
text_zh: @我就知道！你其實並不歡迎吉普賽人在身邊。@*

source_en: @My advice will cost you a gold coin. What do you say?@
text_zh: @我的建議要收取一枚金幣。你說如何？@

source_en: Almost due east of Iolo's hut there lives a powerful enchanter...@
text_zh: 在 Iolo's hut的正東方，住著一位強大的幻術師...

source_en: @Do you want me to come with you?@
@I look forward to the many adventures we will share.@
text_zh: @我期待我們將共同經歷的無數冒險。@

source_en: @I believe thou hast enough travellers for one group.@
text_zh: @我相信你的隊友已經足夠多了。@

source_en: @Okay. Let me know if you need my help later.@
text_zh: @好的。以後如果你需要我的幫助，請告訴我。@

source_en: @Here's a little tune to lighten your step on the road ahead.@
text_zh: @這裡有一首小曲，希望能讓你在前路的步伐輕快些。@

source_en: @'Said the youthful earl to the gypsy girl, As the moon was casting its silver shine: 'Dear little lady, my gypsy lady, Let me kiss those sweet lips of thine'.@
text_zh: @年輕的伯爵對吉普賽女孩說，當月光灑下銀色的輝芒：『親愛的小姐，我的吉普賽女郎，讓我一吻你那甜蜜的唇。』@

source_en: @You wish me to leave you now, right?@
@Should I wait here? Or do you want me to go home..?@
text_zh: @我該在這裡等你嗎？還是你想讓我回家..？@

source_en: ; come listen to me. I've plenty of time to sing unto thee.@
text_zh: ；來聽我唱幾句。我有的是時間為你高歌。

source_en: ; I hope thy quest is going well.@
@Lazeena they call me, Lazeena the Dove. From Cove I did come, 'tis a town full of love.@
text_zh: @人們叫我 Lazeena，白鴿 Lazeena。我來自 Cove，那是一座充滿愛意的城鎮。@

source_en: @'Tis the aim of my life to sing like a bird. Wouldst thou like to hear the news I've heard?@
text_zh: @我終生的志向便是像鳥兒一樣歌唱。你願意聽聽我所聽聞的消息嗎？@

source_en: @Then tell me what would please thee more: a song of the sea or a rhyme of the shore?@
text_zh: @那麼告訴我，你更喜歡什麼：一首海之歌，還是一首岸之韻？@

source_en: She sings. @South of Loch Lake and north of the bay, the beautiful Shrine of Compassion doth lay.@
text_zh: 她唱道。@在loch湖之南，灣灣之北，美麗的Shrine of Compassion靜靜佇立。@

source_en: @My Artagel set out to chant there one day. But still he has not returned...@
text_zh: @我的Artagel有一天出發去那裡吟誦。但他至今仍未回來...@

source_en: @Was he taken by giants or headless so foul, that nary a man could contend with the smell.@
text_zh: @他是被巨魔抓走了，還是被那些頭都沒長齊的醜惡東西抓走了？那些東西臭得讓沒有一個男人能與之抗衡。@

source_en: @He should have come here weeks ago now. But still he has not returned.@
text_zh: @現在應該是他來到這裡的幾週前了。但他至今仍未回來。@

source_en: She sings. @The Dutchman was a giant ship with masts from the largest trees. The pride of the people she was hailed, the ruler of all the sea.@
text_zh: 她唱道。@Dutchman 是一艘巨輪，桅杆取自最大的樹木。她是人民的驕傲，被譽為海洋的統治者。@

source_en: @She sailed out of port one fine spring day, and headed for distant shores. But a britney caught her by surprise, 'twas flung against her core.@
text_zh: @她在一個晴朗的春日駛出港口，航向遠方的 shores。但一場突襲令她措手不及，她被猛烈地撞擊了核心。@

source_en: @The match began the grim men fought, to gather in her sails. But thunderous was the crack and lo, the mighty vessel reeled.@
text_zh: @比賽開始，嚴肅的男人們奮力收攏風帆。但一聲如雷的裂響，看哪，那艘巨大的船艦開始搖晃。@

source_en: @When gentle winds danced 'cross the surf, again the followed morn.@
text_zh: @當溫柔的風在浪尖起舞，再次迎來了翌日。@

source_en: @'twas nothing left of Dutchy's hull but remnants of her born. And now the tale has nothing left, but a gravesight on the floor.@
text_zh: @Dutchy的船殼只剩下殘骸，這是她誕生時的遺跡。現在故事也已沒有結局，只剩下地板上的墓冢。@

source_en: You see a sad lady with hair down to her ankles. A soft jingling accompanies her silent walk. Rather than talking, she sings in a voice like wind through reeds.
text_zh: 你看到一位悲傷的女士，長髮垂至腳踝。她靜靜走動時，伴隨著柔和的金屬聲響。她沒有說話，而是用如風穿蘆葦般的聲音歌唱。

source_en: @On the Fens o' the Dead she came to rest, ne'er to sail no more.@
text_zh: @她停泊在亡者沼澤，再無航行之日。@

source_en: @To be of more help, I wish I knew just what this little bird could do.@
text_zh: @為了提供更多幫助，我真希望知道這隻小鳥能做些什麼。@

source_en: @I must stay here in Cove whilst my Artagel recovers from his wounds.@
text_zh: @我必須留在Cove，直到我的Artagel從傷口中康復。@

source_en: @Sometimes I sing him songs to help ease his pain. I believe he's on his way to a recovery. I can't thank thee enough!@
text_zh: @有時我會為他唱歌，以緩解他的痛苦。我相信他正在康復。我不知如何感謝你！@

source_en: At this, Lazeena's demeanor changes and she speaks to you normally.
text_zh: 此時，Lazeena的態度改變了，她正常地對你說話。

source_en: @Could it be? Hast thou news of him?@
text_zh: @會不會是這樣？你有他的消息嗎？@

source_en: You tell Lazeena of the gargoyle assault on the Shrine of Compassion and that Artagel is alive in Cove, barely.
text_zh: 你告訴Lazeena關於石像鬼襲擊Shrine of Compassion的事，以及Artagel在Cove奄奄一息地活著。

source_en: @My poor Artagel! I can't bear that he is suffering alone, without me by his side.@
text_zh: @我那可憐的Artagel！我不能忍受他獨自受苦，而沒有我在身邊。@

source_en: @Before the gargoyles attacked, I was spending time here in Britain to sing and learn more about the bardic arts. He was supposed to meet me here weeks ago, but he never arrived...@
text_zh: @在石像鬼襲擊之前，我來到這裡的Britain唱歌，並學習更多的詩人藝術。他本該幾週前來這裡與我會合，但他從未到來...@

source_en: @I must go to him immediately, is it safe to travel now?@
text_zh: @我必須立即去他身邊，現在旅行安全嗎？@

source_en: @Thank the virtues! I must be on my way to Cove to be with my love. I hope I'm no too late...@
text_zh: @感謝美德！我必須前往Cove與我的愛人團聚。希望我不會來得太晚...@

source_en: @Please then, thou must do something. I can't let him die...@
text_zh: @那麼請務必做點什麼。我不能讓他死...@

source_en: @My name is Fyodor. What is thy name?@
text_zh: @我叫 Fyodor。請問閣下尊姓大名？@

source_en: @I make cloth upon my loom. Perhaps you'd like to buy some.@
text_zh: @我在織布機上織布。也許您想買些？@

source_en: @I work on a large new loom. The plans for it were found in one of Lord British's old books.@
text_zh: @我正在製作一台大型的新織布機。它的圖樣是出自 Lord British 的一本舊書。@

source_en: @I push the pedals with my feet--like this. Then I pull these levers. The pattern depends on which combinations of levers and pedals I move. My father's loom was not so complicated as mine. This design came from one of Lord British's old books.@
text_zh: @我用腳踩踏板——就像這樣。然後拉動這些槓桿。花紋取決於我如何組合移動槓桿和踏板。我父親的織布機沒我的這麼複雜。這個設計出自 Lord British 的一本舊書。@

source_en: @Come back when I'm at my loom, I'll deal with thee then.@
text_zh: @請在我織布時再來，到時候我再接待您。@

source_en: @It'll cost you 20 gold for the cloth. Interested?@
@Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the cloth.
text_zh: @太好了!@ 他收下你的金子後，把布料交給了你。

source_en: @It'll cost you 5 gold for the thread. Interested?@
@Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the thread.
text_zh: @太好了！@ 收下你的黃金後，他把線遞給了給你。
