source_en: @You'll find none better. What can I do for you?@
text_zh: @你再找不到比我更好的人了。我有什麼可以幫你的嗎？@

source_en: ! Come back when I'm at my loom, I'll deal with thee then.@
text_zh: ! 等我坐在織布機前再來吧，到時我再跟你談。@

source_en: @He turns to you and says @Will you take 8 gold for that wool?@
text_zh: @他轉過身來對你說 @你願意出 8 枚黃金買這批羊毛嗎？@

source_en: @Done!@ He hands you 8 gold pieces and takes the wool.@
text_zh: @成交！@ 他把 8 枚金幣給你，收下了羊毛。@

source_en: @Lord British treasures antiques. There is one book for which he hath offered a reward: 'The Wizard of Oz.'@
text_zh: @Lord British非常珍視古董。有一本書，他為此提供了賞金：《綠野仙蹤》。@

source_en: @By Master L. Frank Baum, I believe. It concerns a girl adventurer, a strange land, and a clever balloonist.@
text_zh: @我想作者是 L. Frank Baum。書中講述了一位女冒險家、一個奇異的國度，以及一位聰明的飛行員。@

source_en: A man in a multicolored jacket. His fingers are long and graceful.*
text_zh: 一名身穿多彩夾克的男子。他的手指細長而優雅。*

source_en: @Are they not made of silk, in the form of a great bag?@
text_zh: @它們不是由絲綢製成的巨大袋子嗎？@

source_en: @'Tis a wondrous strong stuff, silk, and very light. I regret that I am not skillful enough to weave silk.@
text_zh: @絲綢是一種強韌而輕盈的奇妙材料。我很遺憾自己技藝不夠精湛，無法織造絲綢。@

source_en: @In New Magincia, however, lives the silk-weaver Charlotte.@
text_zh: @然而，在新瑪基亞城（New Magincia），住著一位名叫夏洛特（Charlotte）的絲織工。@

source_en: @She is the only person I know of who can weave silk.@
text_zh: @她是我所知唯一能織造絲綢的人。@

source_en: @May our paths cross again some day!@

text_zh: 天哪..我的魯特琴裡有蜘蛛！

source_en: @I would play for thee, but I'm worried about my lute.@
text_zh: 我想為你演奏，但我很擔心我的魯特琴。

source_en: @Every time I pick up my lute, spiders crawl out of it. There must be hundreds of them nesting in there!@
text_zh: 每次我拿起魯特琴，蜘蛛就會爬出來。裡面一定有好幾百隻在築巢！
只是你的想像力太豐富了，親愛的。

source_en: @I hate spiders! They're creepy, ugly, disgusting things! Why won't they leave me alone?@
text_zh: 我討厭蜘蛛！它們令人毛骨悚然、醜陋、噁心！為什麼它們不肯離開我？

source_en: Iolo says to her, @Now, now, my dear. Have you forgotten about the gloves I gave you?@
text_zh: Iolo 對她說：「好了好了，親愛的。你忘了我送給你的手套嗎？」

source_en: @Oh, yes. Perhaps if I wore those I could play...@
text_zh: 噢，是的。也許如果我戴上它們，我就能彈了...

source_en: @Iolo gave them to me for my birthday.@
text_zh: Iolo 是送給我當生日禮物的。

source_en: @Yes, I know of the Rune and Mantra of Compassion.@
text_zh: 是的，我知道慈悲符文和真言。

source_en: @'Twas given to our most promising student, young Ariana.@
text_zh: 它是頒發給我們最有潛力的學生，年輕的 Ariana 的。

source_en: @The Mantra of Compassion is 'mu.' Is that a spider on your shoulder? No, 'tis just a trick of the light.@
text_zh: 慈悲的真言是「mu」。你肩膀上有隻蜘蛛嗎？不，那只是光影的錯覺。

source_en: @She's very talented. She'll go far, if the spiders don't get her...@
text_zh: 她很有天賦。如果蜘蛛沒傷害到她的話，她會很有前途...

source_en: @Fare thee well, and watch thy step! The spiders are lurking everywhere.@
text_zh: 再見了，小心你的腳步！蜘蛛到處都在窺伺。

source_en: You see a nervous young bard.
text_zh: 你看到一位緊張不安的年輕吟遊詩人。

source_en: @According to the numbers on the hourglass, you see.@
text_zh: @根據沙漏上的數字，正如你所見。@

source_en: @Well, I usually know what time it is up here in my head somehow. But just in case, I start this hourglass at sunup, turning it over every nine hours.@
text_zh: @嗯，我通常總能憑頭腦裡的直覺知道現在是什麼時候。但萬一搞錯了，我就會在日出時啟動這個沙漏，並每九小時翻轉一次。@

source_en: @It is especially important for those with shops. They know when to open for business, eat lunch, close, and that sort of thing.@
text_zh: @這對那些經營商店的人特別重要。他們需要知道何時開張做生意、吃午餐、打烊，以及其他類似的事情。@

source_en: A man wearing a long grey cloak. He wears gloves with the fingers cut off, and carries a large hourglass with him.
text_zh: 一個穿著長灰斗篷的男人。他戴著指尖剪去的皮手套，隨身帶著一個大沙漏。

source_en: @Another of Lord British's innovations, this bell thing.@
text_zh: @這是 Lord British的另一項發明，也就是這個鐘。@

source_en: @Hmmm. I guess that you don't keep a regular schedule, being the Avatar and all. Probably out till all hours, collecting runes and such.@
text_zh: @嗯。我想你不會遵守固定的作息，畢竟你是聖者之類的身份。大概常常忙到深夜，收集符文之類吧。@

source_en: @You look much taller in person. Woodroffe's painting does not do you justice.@
text_zh: @你本人看起來比畫中更高大。Woodroffe 的畫並沒有顯出你的真容。@

source_en: @Heh, heh. I know little of that. I'm just the bell-ringer.@
text_zh: @嘿嘿。我對那些知之甚少。我只不過是個敲鐘的人。@

source_en: @Magical little things. There's a symbol on one side, and a letter on the other.@
text_zh: @奇妙的小玩意兒。一面是符號，另一面是字母。@

source_en: @Probably spell something out if you put 'em all on a necklace. But that hasn't been done for a long time.@
text_zh: @如果把它們串成一條項鏈，大概能拼出某種意義。但這已經很久沒有人做過了。@

source_en: @After the Codex of Ultimate Wisdom was brought back from the underworld, Lord British gave the runes to the lords of the eight cities.@
text_zh: @在《終極智慧法典》從冥界奪回後，Lord British將符文分給了八座城市的城主。@

source_en: @Lord British appointed lords to rule the eight cities.@
text_zh: @Lord British指派城主來治理八座城市。@

source_en: @Let's see now.@ He counts them off on his fingers. @Minoc, Trinsic, Jhelom, Yew, Skara Brae, Britain, Moonglow...@
text_zh: @讓我看看。@ 他掰著手指頭數道：@Minoc、Trinsic、Jhelom、Yew、Skara Brae、Britain、Moonglow...@。

source_en: @...Ah yes, and New Magincia. I hear each of the lords knows a mantra.@
text_zh: @...啊對了，還有New Magincia。我聽說每位領主都知道一句咒語。@。

source_en: @Haven't the foggiest what those are for. Something to do with the shrines, I think.@
text_zh: @我一點都不知道那是幹什麼用的。我想是有關神龕的。@。

source_en: @Always wanted to visit them. Never had the time.@
text_zh: @我一直想去那兒看看。但從沒時間去。@。

source_en: @Every hour of the day, I ring the bell a number of times.@
text_zh: @每天每小時，我都按規定次數敲鐘。@。

source_en: @Yes, I recognize you from your portrait...My mother used to tell me stories about you when I was a girl.@
text_zh: @是的，我看你的畫像認出了你...我小時候，我媽媽常給我講關於你的故事。@。

source_en: @You probably wouldn't remember her, but she was at the big celebration right after you recovered the Codex.@
text_zh: @你大概不認識她，但她就在你取回《法典》後的那場盛大慶典上。@。

source_en: @Anyway... I just wanted to tell you that I always wanted to grow up to be just like you...@
text_zh: @反正...我只是想告訴你，我從小就夢想長大後能像妳一樣...@。

source_en: @Anyway... I just wanted to tell you that I always hoped someday I'd meet a man like you...@
text_zh: @反正...我只是想告訴你，我一直希望能遇見像您這樣的男士...@。

source_en: @Oh, you've come back to visit me again!@
@But I wish I had been named after you.@
text_zh: @但我希望能以您的名字來命名我。@。

source_en: @Don't you think that would be a good name for an Avatar's wife?@
text_zh: @您覺得這作為聖者妻子的名字，是不是很好聽？@。

source_en: @By royal decree, I am the only one allowed to mint the official coinage of the realm. Copper pence, silver pieces, and gold crowns - they're all made right here.@
text_zh: @奉王室詔令，我是唯一有權鑄造本國官方貨幣的人。銅便士、銀幣和金幣——它們全都是在這裡製作的。@

source_en: @My father ran the mint before me. But I get lonely here sometimes...@
text_zh: @我父親在我之前經營這個造幣廠。但我有時在這裡會感到孤單...@

source_en: @It's so nice of you to come by and talk to me. Kytyn will never believe it when I tell her I got to meet the Avatar in person!@
text_zh: @你能來找我聊天真是太好了。Kytyn 肯定不會相信我竟然親眼見到了聖者！@

source_en: @Here, let me show you.@ She takes out a sample of each coin for you to look at.  @The pence has an ankh on one side, and crossed swords on the other.@
text_zh: @來，讓我拿給你看看。@ 她拿出一種每種貨幣的樣品讓你觀看。 @便士的一面是安卡符號，另一面是交叉的劍。@

source_en: @The silver piece has Lord British's face on the front, and a serpent on the back. And the gold crown is a familiar sight, with a crown and the symbol of the Codex.@
text_zh: @銀幣正面是 Lord British 的臉，背面是一條蛇。而金幣則很眼熟，上面有皇冠和法典的符號。@

source_en: All three of them look newly minted - they're very shiny.
text_zh: 這三枚錢幣看起來都是剛鑄造的——它們非常閃亮。

source_en: @Of course, I'm sure you only carry gold crowns with you, being as important as you are.@ She reaches over and squeezes your shoulder affectionately.
text_zh: @當然，我相信你只攜帶金幣，因為你如此重要。@ 她伸過手來親暱地擠了擠你的肩膀。

source_en: @She's a good friend of mine. She runs the museum.@
text_zh: @她是我的好朋友。她經營博物館。@

source_en: @You must be the bravest man I've ever met. I can't believe it's really you!@
text_zh: @你一定是我見過最勇敢的人。我簡直不敢相信真的是你！@

source_en: @I get most of my gold from people who bring in nuggets or gold bars to exchange them for coins. Do you have any gold nuggets or bars you'd like to trade in for crowns?@
text_zh: @我的大部分黃金來自那些帶來金塊或金條兌換成錢幣的人。你有帶金塊或金條想換成金幣嗎？@

source_en: @Normally there's a ten percent tax on the exchange. But since you're the Avatar, I'll give you a full hundred crowns for every gold bars you have, and ten crowns for every gold nugget.@
text_zh: @通常兌換時會收取百分之十的稅。但既然你是聖者，我會給你在每一根金條換一百個金幣，每一塊金礦換十個金幣。@

source_en: You see a sharply dressed, very voluptuous woman.
text_zh: 你看到一個穿著考究、身材非常豐滿的女人。

source_en: She exchanges all of your gold nuggets and gold bars for
text_zh: 她把所有的金塊和金條兌換成

source_en: She exchanges all of your gold nuggets for
text_zh: 她把所有的金塊兌換成

source_en: She exchanges all of your gold bars for
text_zh: 她把所有的金條兌換成

source_en: @You must be mistaken. But let me know if you come across any gold nuggets later.@
text_zh: @你一定是記錯了。不過如果你之後找到金礦，記得告訴我。@

source_en: @Well, if you do later, you know where to find me.@
text_zh: @嗯，如果你之後有的話，你知道該去哪找我。@

source_en: @My mother told me all about it.@
@You should visit there sometime. But please stay and talk to me a bit longer first...@
text_zh: @你有空應該去那裡看看。不過請先留下來跟我多聊幾句...@

source_en: You notice she was staring at you with a dreamy look in her eyes.
text_zh: 你注意到她正用夢囈的眼神注視著你。

source_en: @Oh, I'm sorry, I wasn't listening. I was just thinking how nice it must be to be as beautiful as you.@
text_zh: @噢，對不起，我沒在聽。我只是在想，像你這麼美的人一定很幸福吧。@

source_en: @Oh, I'm sorry, I wasn't listening. I was just noticing how strong and handsome you are...@ She looks away and sighs.
text_zh: @噢，對不起，我沒在聽。我只是注意到你長得強壯又帥氣...@ 她別過臉，嘆了口氣。

source_en: @Hello. My name's Terri - I run the mint. Say, aren't you the Avatar?@
text_zh: @你好。我叫Terri - 我管理造幣廠。對了，你是聖者嗎？@

source_en: @I know you're very busy, saving Britannia and all that, but I hope you'll come and visit me again...@
text_zh: @我知道你很忙，要拯救Britannia諸事纏身，但我希望你有空能再來找我...@

source_en: @It really was delightful talking to you.@
@And maybe if you have time for it, I could show you more than a few silly coins!@
text_zh: @也許如果你有時間，我可以給你看的不只是些許硬幣！@

source_en: As you turn to leave, she pinches you.
text_zh: 當你轉身離開時，她捏了你一下。

source_en: I think she likes you, Avatar..
Lynn takes your money and hands over the
text_zh: 林恩收下你的錢，把 Lynn
遞給了你。@感謝你的惠顧。@

source_en: You see a tall, willowy woman with long blond hair.
text_zh: 你看到一位高挑纖細的女子，留著一頭金色長髮。

source_en: @How can I help thee this fine
@I'm Lynn. Thou needn't tell me thy name,
text_zh: @我是Lynn。你不必告訴我你的名字，

source_en: . The Avatar is famous throughout the land!@
@I am a fletcher. I make bolts and bolts for the armies of Lord British himself!@
text_zh: @我是一名弓箭手。我為Lord British本人的軍隊製作箭支和箭矢！@

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open!@
text_zh: @我營業時間時歡迎來到我的商店！@

source_en: @I have all I need, and have no reason to purchase anything more. But I appreciate thy offer.@
text_zh: @我所需要的都有了，也沒有理由再購買更多。但我感謝你的好意。@

source_en: @I sell them only by the dozen. How many dozens?@
@Farewell! I hope I've aided thy quest!@
text_zh: @告別了！希望我能幫助你的旅程！@

source_en: @Thou hast not enough gold for that many!@
@Is there aught else thou would buy?@
text_zh: @還有其他你要購買的東西嗎？@
對 Wilbur 調用了接近事件

source_en: You see a thin, dark-haired man with a nervous smile.
text_zh: 你看到一位身材瘦削、黑髮的男子，面帶緊張的微笑。

source_en: ! What can I do for you this fine
text_zh: ！今天這麼好，我能為你做什麼？

source_en: @I work here at the stables, taking care of the horses. You can buy one if you'd like.@
text_zh: @我在這裡的馬廄工作，照顧馬匹。如果你願意的話，可以買一匹。@

source_en: @Aye, if you wish to buy one, just say the word.@
text_zh: @是的，如果你願意買，開口就行。@

source_en: @My price is a hundred gold pieces for the deed to a horse carriage, no less. Interested?@
text_zh: @我的要價是一百枚黃金，換取馬車的使用權，低於這個數不賣。有興趣嗎？@

source_en: @Good!@ Wilbur takes your gold, and hands over the deed to a fine horse-drawn carriage.@
text_zh: @很好！@Wilbur收下你的黃金，交給你一張優質馬車的憑證。@

source_en: @But thou canst not carry the deed!@
@I'm afraid you bought my last one already.@
text_zh: @恐怕你已經買走我最後一匹了。@

source_en: @A talking horse? Ridiculous! Who told you that?@ He seems more nervous than before.
text_zh: @會說話的馬？荒唐！是誰告訴你的？@他看起來比之前更緊張了。

source_en: . Perhaps thou canst prevail where others could not. I sent a party of ten to recapture the Shrine of Compassion from the gargoyles. Alas, they failed dismally.@
text_zh: . 也許你能夠做到他人所無法做到的事。我派了十個人去奪回被石像鬼佔領的憐憫神殿。不幸的是，他們徹底失敗了。@@ Shrine of Compassion

source_en: @The survivors are recuperating in the town of Cove. Thou wouldst do well to speak with them first. Mayhap they learned something which might aid thee.@
text_zh: @倖存者們正在 Cove 鎮休養。你最好先去找他們談談。也許他們得知了一些對你有用的情報。@

source_en: @I must confess I fear the worst. The gargoyles are such powerful foes, and they are spreading so fast...@
text_zh: @我必須承認，我最擔心的是最壞的情況。石像鬼是強勁的敵人，而且它們擴散得很快...@@

source_en: @Perhaps the end of the realm is nigh. Good luck, and my prayers go with thee.@
text_zh: @也許王國的終結已迫在眉睫。祝你好運，我的祈禱與你同在。@@

source_en: @Who knows what acts of villainy the gargoyles are comitting even as we speak? I hope you've had a chance to visit Cove and speak with Gertan.@
text_zh: @誰知道石像鬼此刻又作了什麼惡事？我希望你有機會去過 Cove 並與 Gertan 談過話。@

source_en: , Avatar. How may I be of assistance?@
text_zh: ，聖者。我可以為您提供什麼幫助？

source_en: @I am Sir Geoffrey, Captain of the Guard. For many years I have served Lord British and Britannia.@
text_zh: @我是 Sir Geoffrey，衛隊隊長。多年來，我效忠 Lord British 與 Britannia。@

source_en: @My charge is the defense of Britannia and her people. In times past I led our forces against pirates and bandits... now the gargoyles test our strength.@
text_zh: @我的職責是守護Britannia及其子民。過去，我率領軍隊對抗海盜與強盜...如今，石像鬼考驗著我們的實力。@

source_en: @The battle is far from over, Avatar, but thy victory at Compassion has given us hope.@
text_zh: @戰爭遠未結束，聖者，但你在慈悲之地的勝利給了我們希望。@

source_en: @The people of Cove suffered greatly when the Shrine of Compassion fell. It is a wonder the gargoyles didn't raze Cove itself.@
text_zh: @當Shrine of Compassion失守時，Cove 的人民受盡苦難。石像鬼沒有夷平 Cove 本身，真是奇事。@

source_en: @Now that the shrine is freed, their spirits are lifted. Thy deeds shall be sung there for years to come.@
text_zh: @如今聖地已獲解放，人們的精神振奮了。今後數年，那裡將傳頌你的功績。@

source_en: @Each shrine is sacred to Britannia. The gargoyles strike at them not only for power, but to wound the very soul of our land.@
text_zh: @每一座聖地對Britannia而言都是神聖的。石像鬼襲擊它們，不僅為了權力，更是要傷害我們土地的靈魂。@

source_en: @We must not rest until every shrine is free, and the Codex preserved.@
text_zh: @在每一座聖地都獲得解放、法典得以保存之前，我們不能停歇。@

source_en: You see a tall, handsome man.
text_zh: 你看到一位高帥的男子。

source_en: @Seek out Gertan in Cove. He fought bravely when the shrine was lost and yet survived. He may hold wisdom that will aid thee in battles to come.@
text_zh: @去 Cove 找Gertan。當聖地失守時，他英勇作戰並倖存下來。他或許擁有智慧，能幫助你在未來的戰鬥中。@

source_en: @Aye... I have received troubling reports. A guard named Myron deserted his comrades during the battle for the Shrine of Sacrifice.@
text_zh: @是的...我收到了令人擔憂的報告。一名叫 Myron 的衛兵在爭奪 Shrine of Sacrifice 的戰鬥中背叛了戰友。@

source_en: @By rights, such cowardice should be met with justice. Yet... if thou hast found him, Avatar, then I place the matter in thy hands.@
text_zh: @按理說，這種怯懦應受到懲罰。但是...如果你找到了他，聖者，那麼我將此事交由你處理。@

source_en: @If thou findest some spark of redemption in him, and say he should be spared, I shall honor thy word. But if not... the law must be served.@
text_zh: 若你能在他身上看到一絲贖罪的火花，並認為他應該被赦免，我將尊重你的話。但若不然...法律必須被執行。

source_en: @Thou hadst best speak to Lord British before aught else.@
text_zh: 你最好先去拜見 Lord British。

source_en: @Very well. I see thou dost temper justice with Compassion.@
text_zh: 很好。我看你確實以慈悲來調和正義。

source_en: @I shall grant Myron a pardon, written and sealed with mine own hand. Give it to him, and he will be free from fear of pursuit.@
text_zh: 我將頒發一份赦免 Myron 的書面令狀，並親手蓋印。將它交給他，他便不再懼怕追緝了。

source_en: You inform Geoffrey of Myron's whereabouts. @So be it. Thou hast chosen to bring him to justice. I shall send men to take him into custody at once.@
text_zh: 你告知 Geoffrey Myron 的下落。既如此。你選擇讓他接受法律的制裁。我將立即派人去逮捕他。

source_en: @Mayhap his example shall remind others of the price of cowardice. Still, I sorrow that a son of Britannia should fall so low.@
text_zh: 或許他的例子能提醒他人怯懦的代價。然而，我悲痛看到一名Britannia的子民墮落至此。
願你的勇氣永不衰退，聖者。

source_en: You see a rough and tumble man with wild, unkempt hair.
text_zh: 你看到一個粗魯好鬥的男人，頭髮狂野且不整齊。
是啊，而且你是個出色的

source_en: @'Tis good to see thee, friend!@ he says, grabbing your arm. What d'ya need?@
text_zh: 很高興見到你，朋友！他抓著你的手臂說道。你需要什麼？

source_en: @If you want to buy horseshoes or cannonballs, just ask.@
text_zh: 如果你想買馬蹄鐵或 cannonballs，儘管問。

source_en: @Can ya not tell by my hair?@
text_zh: 從我的頭髮看不出來嗎？

source_en: @Aye, it saves their feet from stones and such.@
text_zh: 對，這樣可以保護馬蹄不踩到石頭之類的東西。

source_en: @It'll cost you 2 gold for the horseshoes. Interested?@
text_zh: 馬蹄鐵要兩枚黃金。有意嗎？

source_en: @Good, good!@ After accepting your gold, Rufus hands over the horseshoes.
text_zh: 很好，很好！魯夫斯收下你的黃金後，把馬蹄鐵遞了給你。 Rufus
你不會找到比這更強的。

source_en: @Come back when my shop is open if you want some.@
text_zh: 如果你想買，等我的店門營業時再來。

source_en: @It'll cost you 20 gold per cannon ball. Interested?@
text_zh: 每顆砲彈要二十枚黃金。有意嗎？

source_en: @How many cannonballs do you want to buy?@
@Good, good!@ After accepting your gold, Rufus hands over the cannonballs.@
text_zh: 很好，很好！魯夫斯收下你的黃金後，把砲彈遞了給你。 Rufus

source_en: @Remember to shoe yer steed often. Bye.@
text_zh: 記得常給你的愛馬裝蹄鐵。再見。

source_en: @I'm busy just now. Why don't ya come t'my smithy tomorrow and we'll talk then.@
text_zh: 我現在正忙著。為什麼不明天來我的鐵匠鋪，到時我們再談呢？

source_en: @I'm busy just now. Why don't ya come t'my smithy later today and we'll talk then.@
text_zh: 我現在正忙著。為什麼不稍後來我的鐵匠鋪，到時我們再談呢？

source_en: @Very well. What else dost thou wish to speak about?@
, but I've just an hour to myself today. I'll gladly talk with thee later.@
text_zh: ，但今天我只有一個小時的空閒時間。我很樂意稍後與你談話。”

source_en: @Wouldst thou like ale, mead, wine, mutton, or perhaps a cake@
text_zh: “你想來啤酒、麥酒、葡萄酒、羊肉，也許還有一塊蛋糕嗎？”

source_en: You see a buxom woman who looks hard working, yet contented.*
text_zh: 你看到一位豐滿的婦女，看起來辛勤工作，卻感到滿足。*

source_en: , and welcome to the Blue Boar Tavern. Art thou here for business or pleasure?@
text_zh: ，歡迎來到Blue Boar Tavern。你是來辦事還是來享樂？”

source_en: @I run this tavern to support my family. The hours are long, but my husband offers what help he can.@
text_zh: 我經營這間 tavern 是為了撫養家人。時間很長，但我的丈夫也盡力幫了許多忙。

source_en: @We make enough to pay for my daughter's schooling, so 'tis all worthwhile.@
text_zh: 我們賺夠了女兒的學費，所以一切都值得。

source_en: @'Tis good to talk with thee again. Things have been slow around here since the gypsies left. Good! Perhaps thou might stay and talk with me a while, before I'm back about my work.@
text_zh: 很高興再次與你交談。自從吉普賽人離開後，這裡的生意一直不太好。很好！也許你可以留下來陪我聊一會兒，在我回去忙工作之前。

source_en: @They pass by Britain occasionally. I believe they travel on the King's Way.@
text_zh: 他們偶爾會經過 Britain。我想他們是沿著 King's Way 旅行的。

source_en: @The King's Way is the oldest road in Britain.@
text_zh: King's Way 是 Britain 最古老的道路。

source_en: @My husband Matt, and my daughter Ariana.@
text_zh: 我的丈夫 Matt，以及我的女兒 Ariana。

source_en: @He had an accident as a child which left him deaf and dumb, but I love him all the same. I only wish he could hear our daughter play, just once. But 'twill ne'er come to pass. He lives in a world of eternal silence.@
text_zh: 他童年時遭遇意外，導致聾啞，但我依然愛他。我多希望他能聽一次女兒演奏音樂。但這件事永遠不會發生。他生活在一個永恆寂靜的世界裡。

source_en: @Ariana is the light of my life. Seems she had scarce learned to walk when she first showed a gift for music. She studies now with the bards at the Conservatory.@
text_zh: @Ariana 是我生命中的光芒。似乎她剛學會走路，就展現出音樂的天賦。現在她正跟著 Conservatory 的吟遊詩人學習。@

source_en: Her face brightens suddenly. @You have the look of one who practices the art of magic. Perhaps thou couldst find some spell that might restore my husband's hearing! I know 'tis a lot to ask, but wilt thou try?@
text_zh: 她的臉突然亮了起來。@你看起來是位習練魔法藝術的人。或許你能找到某種法術，來恢復我丈夫的聽力！我知道這要求很多，但你願意試試嗎？@

source_en: Her look of hope changes to one of sorrow as she looks down at the floor to hide her embarrassment. @I'm sorry to have bothered thee,@ she says. @I'm sure thou hast more important things to do.@
text_zh: 她眼中的希望轉為哀傷，低頭看著地板以掩飾尷尬。@對不起打擾了，@ 她說道，@我相信你肯定有更重要的事情要做。@

source_en: @Bless their hearts for teaching her well. She'll be no tavern wench when she grows older.@*
text_zh: @感謝上天將她教得好。她長大後絕不會成為酒館裡的花魁。@*

source_en: @I'm sorry, but you don't have enough gold.@
@Perhaps she'll even be court musician to Lord British some day...@
text_zh: @也許有一天她甚至會成為 Lord British 的宮廷音樂家...@

source_en: @Thou shouldst ask my daughter of that. Methinks the bards have taught her of it.@
text_zh: @你應該去問問我女兒關於這件事。我想吟遊詩人已經教過她了。@

source_en: @Ah, twas the proudest moment of my life when they awarded my dear little Ariana the Rune of Compassion. They said she was the most promising student they'd ever had at the Conservatory. I'm sure she would show thee the rune, if thou wouldst care to see it.@
text_zh: @啊，當他們授予我親愛的 Ariana 慈悲之靈符時，那是我人生中最驕傲的時刻。他們說她是 Conservatory 以來最有前途的學生。我相信如果你願意，她會給你看看那塊靈符。@

source_en: @Thou dost wish to borrow the Rune of Compassion from my daughter?@ She pauses a while in thought.*
text_zh: @你想向我女兒借用慈悲之靈符嗎？@ 她停下腳步沉思了一會兒。*

source_en: @Very well--thou dost have an honest face. I grant thee my permission.@
text_zh: @好吧——你長著一張誠實的臉。我授予你許可。@

source_en: @I already gave thee my permission to borrow the rune! Do thou be careful not to lose the stone or let any harm befall it. Ariana would never forgive herself.@
text_zh: @我已經允許你借用那塊靈符了！請務必小心，不要弄丟石塊或讓它受到任何損壞。Ariana 永遠不會原諒自己的。@

source_en: @You haven't any room in your pack.@
@Well, 'tis time I was back about my work. Dishes to wash, food to cook, drinks to serve... I thank thee for stopping by to brighten my day with thy conversation. Do thou come again.@
text_zh: @好吧，我該回去工作了。洗盤子、做飯、倒酒... 感謝你來這裡用談話讓我的一天變得開心。歡迎再來。@

source_en: @Anything else I can do for thee?@
text_zh: 還有其他我能為你做的嗎？

source_en: Efram frowns at you. @Hrmmph. That was a fair price. Well...@
text_zh: Efram 皺眉看著你。@哼。那個價格很公道。好吧...@

source_en: You see a grunting and grumbling man with a large stomach.
text_zh: 你看見一個大肚子、咕噥聲不斷的男人。

source_en: @Hrmmph. Hello.@ His breathing is quite heavy.
text_zh: @嗯。你好。@ 他的呼吸相當沉重。

source_en: @Hrmmph, well. Haven't we...never mind. Hrmmph. What do you need?@
@I sell torches, oil, gems, backpacks, bags, shovels, and powder kegs.@
text_zh: @我賣火把、油、寶石、背囊、袋子、鏟子，還有火藥桶。@

source_en: @Are you interested in buying provisions today?@
text_zh: @你今天有興趣買點補給品嗎？@

source_en: @Very well. What else dost thou wish to speak about?@
@Come back to my shop when it's open.@
Efram looks at you. @That costs more than you have.@
text_zh: Efram 看著你。@那比你擁有的還多。@

source_en: Efram looks at you. @You haven't any room in your pack.@
text_zh: Efram 看著你。@你的背包沒有空間了。@

source_en: @My wife and I teach young bards the arts of composition, performance, and improvisation. We also give concerts on occasion.@
text_zh: @我和我妻子教導年輕吟遊詩人作曲、演奏和即興的藝術。我們偶爾也會舉辦音樂會。@

source_en: @Kenneth plays a delightful little melody for you.@
text_zh: @Kenneth 為你演奏了一首悅耳的小旋律。@

source_en: @I asked you not to wear it out! It's the only name I've got.@
text_zh: @我告訴過你別磨損它！這是我的唯一名字。@

source_en: @Her name is Nan. Whatever you do, don't say anything to her about spiders...@
text_zh: @她的名字是 Nan。無論如何，別跟她提起蜘蛛...@

source_en: @Bards must be well versed in such matters.@
text_zh: @吟遊詩人必須熟練這些知識。@

source_en: @She has quite an imagination. Sometimes she lets it carry her away.@
text_zh: @她的想像力很豐富。有時讓她隨心所欲。@

source_en: @Usually it doesn't give her any trouble.@
text_zh: @通常不會給她帶來任何麻煩。@

source_en: @Yes, I know of the Rune and Mantra of Compassion.@
text_zh: 是的，我知道慈悲符文和真言。

source_en: @Ariana has the rune, and they could hardly have found a sweeter child to give it to.@
text_zh: @Ariana 持有符咒，他們幾乎找不到比她更甜美的孩子來擁有它了。@

source_en: @I've been trying to work the Mantra of Compassion into a song - but I don't know what 'mu' means.@
text_zh: @我一直試圖將慈悲咒語編成一首歌——但我不知道「mu」是什麼意思。@

source_en: @Tell me, what does it mean? Hmmmm... No, I don't think that's it.@
text_zh: @告訴我，那代表什麼？嗯...不，我不覺得是那個。@

source_en: @Once in a great while a student comes along with such a gift for learning that one need but offer a little guidance and step back to watch them learn.@
text_zh: @偶爾才會出現一位天資聰穎的學生，只需稍加引導，退後一步看著他們學習即可。@

source_en: You see a lively bard with laughter in his eyes.
text_zh: 你看到一位活潑的吟遊詩人，眼中充滿笑意。

source_en: @To have such students is the most rewarding part of a teacher's job, and Ariana is one such.@
text_zh: @擁有這樣的學生是教師工作中最令人滿足的部分，Ariana 正是其中之一。@

source_en: ! I am Sir Kenneth, and I'd gladly play a song for thee.@
text_zh: ! 我是 Sir Kenneth，我很樂意為你彈奏一曲。@

source_en: @Kenneth's my name - don't wear it out.@
text_zh: @我叫 Kenneth，別把這名字用濫了。@

source_en: . He is Arty the Mute, a local shipwright and an honored citizen.@
text_zh: . 他是 Arty the Mute，當地的一名造船師，也是備受尊重的公民。@

source_en: The man looks at you, puzzled. Then he raises his tankard and goes back to drinking.
text_zh: 那人困惑地看著你。然後他舉起酒罐，繼續喝酒。

source_en: He smiles and points to the workbench. On the bench, you see the tools of a shipwright.
text_zh: 他微笑並指向工作台。在工作台上，你看到了造船師的工具。

source_en: The man looks at you, puzzled. He shakes his head and spreads his hands as if to say @sorry.@
text_zh: 那人困惑地看著你。他搖搖頭並攤開雙手，似乎想說 @抱歉。@

source_en: The man smiles and points to the deed to a shipm and to a sextant.
text_zh: 那人微笑並指向一艘船的船契和一台六分儀。

source_en: Arty shows you a ship deed. Written on it is the price, 400 gold. Do you want to buy the deed?
text_zh: Arty 向你展示了一份船契。上面寫著價格，400 金幣。你想購買這份船契嗎？

source_en: After accepting the gold, Arty smiles and hands you the deed. He seems pleased.
text_zh: 收下金子後，Arty 微笑著將船契交給你。他看來很高興。

source_en: You don't have enough room to carry the deed
text_zh: 你沒有足夠的空間來攜帶地契

source_en: You don't have enough gold for that.

text_zh: 一個沉默但性情良好的男人。

source_en: Arty shows you a sextant. Written on a piece of paper is the price, 20 gold. Do you want to buy the deed?
text_zh: Arty 向你展示了一個六分儀。紙條上寫著價格，20 金子。你想買地契嗎？

source_en: After accepting the gold, Arty smiles and hands you the sextant. He seems pleased.
text_zh: 收下金子後，Arty 笑了笑，把六分儀遞給你。他看起來很高興。

source_en: You don't have enough room to carry the sextant
text_zh: 你沒有足夠的空間來攜帶六分儀

source_en: Arty waves as you leave, then returns to his ale.
text_zh: Arty 在你離開時揮手，然後繼續喝他的麥酒。

source_en: Arty waves as you leave, then returns to what he was doing.
text_zh: Arty 在你離開時揮手，然後繼續做他剛才做的事。

source_en: He looks up from his tankard of ale, sees you and smiles.
text_zh: 他從麥酒杯上抬起頭，看見你後笑了笑。

source_en: He grins widely and waves at you.
He points to his mouth and shakes his head.
text_zh: 他指了指自己的嘴，搖了搖頭。

source_en: @Bread, cakes, pies, pastries... They all have their roots here.@
text_zh: @麵包、蛋糕、派、糕點...它們都源於此。@

source_en: @Woman does not live on meat alone.@
@I was born to work the earth. It was either this, or be a gravedigger...@
text_zh: @我生來就是耕種土地的。不然的話，就得去當個挖墓的...@

source_en: @Yes, men need to eat too, I suppose.@
@Cows and sheep are much more trouble to raise than wheat.@
text_zh: @養牛和羊比種小麥麻煩多了。@

source_en: @They have their place. But not on my farm.@
text_zh: @牠們有牠們的用處。但不在我的農場上。@

source_en: @May the sun shine on you, and the rain bring you nourishment.@

text_zh: 一位外表粗獷的女農夫。*

source_en: @I raise crops. If you'd like to buy some grain, just say the word.@
text_zh: @我種植作物。如果你想買些穀物，儘管開口。@

source_en: @It'll cost you 2 gold for a sack of grain. Interested?@
text_zh: @一袋穀物要2金幣。你有興趣嗎？@

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open!@
text_zh: @我營業時間時歡迎來到我的商店！@

source_en: @I attempt to heal, cure, or if needed, resurrect the fallen.@
text_zh: @我致力於治療、痊癒，或在必要時復活垂死者。@

source_en: @If you're carrying a body put it down, otherwise I see no one in need of resurrecting.@
text_zh: 如果你正背着尸體，請把它放下，否則我看這里沒有需要復生的人。

source_en: A rotund man in monk's robes.
text_zh: 一個穿着修士袍的矮胖男人。

source_en: . What can I do for thee today?@
@I am Tiberius, healer for this town.@
text_zh: 我是提比略，這座城鎮的醫師。 Tiberius

source_en: @It is my responsibility to care for the sick and injured.@
text_zh: 照顧傷病者是我的責任。

source_en: @But I can spare you a moment,
text_zh: 但我可以抽一點時間給你，

source_en: @I am Tholden von Bazillius, Chancellor to Lord British. In my younger days, I was known as 'The Werecat of the Wine Cellar'...@
text_zh: 我是索爾登·馮·巴齊利烏斯，英國國王的 Chancellor。在我年輕的時候，我被稱作“酒窖里的野貓”...。 Lord British Bazillius Tholden

source_en: @All the little details of governing, all the paperwork falls on my shoulders.@*
text_zh: 所有治理的細枝末節，所有的文書工作都壓在我的肩膀上。*

source_en: @Someone must do it, and yet I miss the days when I was a carefree adventurer.@
text_zh: 總得有人去做，但我還是很懷念當初我是個無憂無慮的冒險者的日子。

source_en: @Now where did I put mine pen?@
text_zh: 現在我那支鋼筆放到哪兒去了？

source_en: @The rune and mantra of Compassion are in the keeping of the bards at the Conservatory. I entrusted them with the rune due to their compassionate nature.@*
text_zh: 仁慈的符文和咒語由音樂學院的說唱歌手保管。我之所以將符文托付給他們，是因爲他們具有仁慈的本性。*

source_en: @As for the other runes - they are no longer together, as they were when the Codex was recovered. Since then, they have become scattered throughout the land. Each was sent to a town near its shrine. If thou dost ask the lords of each of these towns, they should be able to tell thee more.@*
text_zh: @至於其他符文，它們已不像《法典》被找回時那樣聚在一起了。從那以後，它們便散落各地。每片符文都被送往靠近其神廟的小鎮。若你向這些小鎮的城主詢問，他們應該能提供更多資訊。@*

source_en: @The towns are Moonglow, Jhelom, Yew, Minoc, Trinsic, Skara Brae, and New Magincia.@
text_zh: @這些小鎮分別是 Moonglow、Jhelom、Yew、Minoc、Trinsic、Skara Brae 和 New Magincia。@

source_en: @'Tis the greatest treasure in all the realm.@
@I could tell you stories... But there's no time for that now.@
text_zh: @我可以給你講講故事...但現在沒時間了。@

source_en: Tholden bows deeply. @I hope I have been of assistance, Avatar.@
text_zh: Tholden 深深地鞠了一躬。@希望我對您有所幫助，聖者。@

source_en: A preoccupied man holding a ledger under one arm.*
text_zh: 一個專心忙碌的男人，臂下夾著一本帳簿。*

source_en: @Records to keep, festivals to plan, I'm so busy...@
text_zh: @要記錄的檔案，要策劃的節日，我忙不過來...@

source_en: @Either you're a gorgio or my name's not Zoltan!@
text_zh: @你要是個 Gorgio（指不懂行的人），我就不是 Zoltan 了！@

source_en: @There are no women like gypsy women!@
text_zh: @沒有哪種女人比吉普賽女人更迷人！@

source_en: Karina produces a fiddle from somewhere and begins to play a tune at a very high tempo.*
text_zh: Karina 從某個地方拿出一把小提琴，開始以極快的節奏演奏旋律。*

source_en: Zoltan dances a wild dance for you, leaping and capering about frantically. His chest glistens with sweat as he walks up to you expectantly.*
text_zh: Zoltan 為你跳了一支狂亂的舞，瘋狂地跳躍、扭動。他走過來期待地看着你，胸脯上閃著汗水的光芒。*

source_en: @Hah! I should know better than to expect a gorgio to appreciate a fine gypsy dance.@*
text_zh: @哈哈！我就不該期待一個 Gorgio 能欣賞精美的吉普賽舞蹈。@*

source_en: @Farewell! My fellow gypsies and I will dance to your health and good fortune!@
text_zh: @再見！我和我的吉普賽同伴們將為您的健康與幸運跳舞慶祝！

source_en: Do you give him any money?

text_zh: Zoltan 把錢放進口袋。@謝謝。@

source_en: @You don't have that much. I should know better than to expect a gorgio to appreciate a fine gypsy dance.@*
text_zh: @你沒帶這麼多錢。我就不該期待一個 Gorgio 能欣賞精美的吉普賽舞蹈。@*

source_en: Proudly, he turns his back on you.
@So be it. Leave me before I place a gypsy curse on you!@
text_zh: @就讓它如此吧。在我對你施下吉普賽咒語之前，滾出去！@

source_en: A lively soul of a gypsy, with a bit of a wild look to him.*
text_zh: 一個生動的吉普賽靈魂，眼神裡帶著幾分野性。*

source_en: @Huzzah! I am Zoltan, king of the gypsies!@
@Huzzah! I am still Zoltan, king of the gypsies!@
@As I said, I am Zoltan, king of the gypsies!@
@I have no lands nor castles, as most rulers do. Nay, for I am the king of the open road.@
text_zh: @我不像大多數統治者那樣擁有領地和城堡。不，因為我是自由大道之王。@

source_en: @He licks his lips and smiles. A duck? No, haven't seen any around here.@
text_zh: @他舔了舔嘴唇並微笑著。鴨子？不，我在這裡沒見過。@

source_en: @You cannot tie a gypsy down to a single place. We are free spirits, and must roam like the wind throughout the land.@
text_zh: @你無法將吉普賽人束縛在一地。我們是自由的靈魂，必須像風一樣在這片土地上漫遊。@

source_en: @Anyone who would mistreat a dog has no business with Zoltan.@
text_zh: @任何虐待狗的人都沒有資格見Zoltan。@

source_en: @The roads wander everywhere, just like a gypsy!@
text_zh: @道路遍佈各地，就像吉普賽人一樣！@

source_en: @The four winds - they are gypsies too!@
text_zh: @四風兄弟——他們也是吉普賽人！@

source_en: @As a gypsy's body wanders, so does his mind. Just now I am thinking of what you might buy from me today.@
text_zh: @吉普賽人的身體四處漂泊，心思亦然。此刻我正想著你今天會向我買些什麼。@

source_en: @Aye, my spirit is free, but my advice is not.@
text_zh: @是的，我的靈魂是自由的，但我的建議並非免費。@

source_en: @Ask my people for advice, or what they have to sell. Gypsies see and hear much, and occasionally happen across items of interest...@
text_zh: @向我的族人尋求建議，或看看他們有哪些賣品。吉普賽人見多識廣，偶爾還會碰到些有趣的東西...@

source_en: @Tell you what. Since I'm in a good mood, I'll only charge you two gold coins. Is it a deal?@
text_zh: @告訴你吧。既然我心情不錯，就只收你兩枚金幣。成交嗎？@

source_en: @I'll tell you this: Powder kegs are useful for persuading uncooperative doors to open.@
text_zh: @我告訴你這個：火藥包對於勸服那些不願打開的門很有用。@

source_en: @Come back when you're not so down on your luck.@
text_zh: @等你時運不濟的情況改善後再來吧。@

source_en: @I'd be glad to help you out. But 'tis a hard life, sometimes, being a gypsy.@*
text_zh: @我很樂意幫你。但過吉普賽人的日子，有時確實很苦。@*

source_en: @You'd be willing to pay ten gold for the information, would you?@
text_zh: @你願意花十枚金幣來換取這些情報，是吧？@

source_en: @Some gorgio called 'Captain Johne' brought us the silver tablet and paid us to take it to the Lycaeum.@*
text_zh: @有個叫「Captain Johne」的傢伙把這塊銀質牌匾交給我們，出錢讓我們把它送到 Lycaeum。@*

source_en: @While we were on the way there, we were ambushed by Captain Hawkins and his crew. The tablet was broken in two during the scuffle. The pirates got away with the bigger half.@*
text_zh: @就在我們前往那裡的路上，被 Captain Hawkins 和他的船隊伏擊了。打鬥中牌匾被劈成兩半。海盜搶走了較大的一半。@*

source_en: @Hah! You again! You are no friend to Zoltan.@*
text_zh: @哈！又是你！你可不是 Zoltan 的朋友。@*

source_en: @Hawkins took my finest earring as well - I spit on his mother's grave!@*
text_zh: @Hawkins 還順手牽羊拿走了我最珍貴的耳環——我把他老娘的墳頭都吐了！@*

source_en: @Most likely they went to Buccaneer's Den with their loot. We took the corner of the tablet that they missed to the Lycaeum and sold it to Mariah.@
text_zh: @他們大概帶著贓物去了 Buccaneer's Den。我們把他們沒搶走的那角牌匾送到了 Lycaeum，賣給了 Mariah。@

source_en: @Come back when you have the money.@
@Let me know if you change your mind.@
text_zh: @如果你改變主意，告訴我就行。@

source_en: @A silver hoop, thick and gleaming like moonlight on a still lake.@*
text_zh: @一個銀色的圓環，厚實明亮，宛如平靜湖面上的月光。@*

source_en: @It had a tiny emerald set in it, green as the forest.@*
text_zh: @上面鑲著一顆小小的翠綠寶石，綠得像森林一樣。@*

source_en: @Was my pride, that earring. Wore it since I was a child, gifted by my dear Mamma before she danced off to the stars.@
text_zh: @那是我的驕傲，那隻耳環。我從小就戴著它，那是我親愛的媽媽在她飛向羣星之前送給我的禮物。@

source_en: @You found it? By the fires of my ancestors, I thought it lost forever!@*
text_zh: @你找到了？借我祖先之火，我還以為它永遠丟了！@*

source_en: @I hope you spat upon his grave as you pried it from his cold, dead fingers!@*
text_zh: @我希望你把他那冰涼僵硬的指頭掰開時，對著他的墓穴啐了一口！@*

source_en: @I dance for you, and how do you repay me?@
text_zh: @我為你跳舞，你卻如此報答我？@

source_en: @For returning this treasure, you deserve something in kind.@*
text_zh: @為了回贈這份寶物，你值得得到同等價值的回報。@*

source_en: He reaches into a pouch tied to his sash and pulls out a small, ancient-looking key.*
text_zh: 他伸手探入綁在腰帶上的錢袋，掏出一把看起來很古老的小鑰匙。*

source_en: @I found this old skeleton key inside a hollow tree some moons ago. It opens chests and doors not meant for gorgio hands.@*
text_zh: @幾個月前，我在一個空心的樹幹裡發現了這把舊鑰匙。它能開啟那些不該由哥吉歐人動用的寶箱和門。@*

source_en: @Take it with my blessing. May it serve you well.@
text_zh: @帶著我的祝福收下它吧。願它對你有所助益。@

source_en: @He's the lowest scum I ever met.@
text_zh: @他是我見過的最卑劣的蟊賊。@

source_en: @It's no place for an honest soul like you.@*
text_zh: @那裡不是你這種正派靈魂該去的地方。@*

source_en: @But if you're determined to go, I hear it's on an island due east of Paws.@
text_zh: @但如果你執意要去，據我所知，它就在Paws正東方的一座島上。@

source_en: @We pass Paws often in our travels. Taynith likes to go drinking there.@
text_zh: @我們旅行時常經過Paws。Taynith喜歡在那裡喝酒。@

source_en: @It's on the same island as Moonglow.@
@It's on the same island as the Lycaeum.@
@She knows how to be generous to poor wandering gypsies. You should follow her example!@
text_zh: @她懂得如何對窮困的流浪吉普賽人慷慨大方。你也應該向她學習！

source_en: @Perhaps a few coins might ease the sting of your insult.@
text_zh: @也許幾枚硬幣能緩解你侮辱帶來的痛楚。@

source_en: @Captain Johne? I talked to him when he gave us the silver tablet for Mariah.@*
text_zh: @Captain Johne？Mariah給他銀錠時，我和他談過話。@*

source_en: @He's madder than a gremlin! Claims as he's been living with the gargoyles.@*
text_zh: @他比精靈還瘋！聲稱他一直在和石像鬼住在一起。@*

source_en: @He talks as if there's nothing evil about them. He said the tablet had something to do with translating.@
text_zh: @他說起來好像它們沒什麼邪惡之處似的。他說那塊銀錠與翻譯有關。@

source_en: @My name is Karina.@ she says, looking shyly at the ground. @Do you think it's a pretty name?@
text_zh: @我叫 Karina。@她羞澀地看著地面說。@你覺得這是個好聽的名字嗎？@

source_en: @Father says I'm supposed to dance for gorgios.@
text_zh: @爸爸說我該為哥吉歐人跳舞。@

source_en: @I have to ask you for a gold piece for my advice. Is that okay?@
text_zh: @我得向你收一枚金幣作為諮詢費。這樣可以嗎？@

source_en: @Ask our dog, Kador, to do some tricks for you. He knows lots of them!@
text_zh: 讓我們的狗 Kador 為你表演些把戲吧。他會很多呢！

source_en: @I'm sorry. I'm not supposed to help you unless you pay.@
text_zh: 我很抱歉。除非你付錢，否則我不該幫你。

source_en: @He is Zoltan, king of the gypsies!@
text_zh: 他是 Zoltan，吉普賽人的國王！

source_en: @Oh, I just couldn't, not in front of so many people.@
text_zh: 哦，我做不到，尤其是在這麼多人面前。

source_en: @That's what we call anyone who isn't a gypsy.@
text_zh: 那就是我們對所有非吉普賽人的稱呼。

source_en: @It's a nice life, but it gets lonely. I miss my sister.@
text_zh: 這種生活很好，但很寂寞。我想念我的姐姐。

source_en: @Her name is Penumbra. Have you any news of her?@
text_zh: 她名叫 Penumbra。你有她的消息嗎？

source_en: @Oh! I'm so glad to hear she's okay!@ She throws her arms around you and kisses you on the cheek.@
text_zh: 哦！很高興聽到她沒事！她張開雙臂擁抱你，親了親你的臉頰。

source_en: @If you do, please come tell me. I miss her so much...@
text_zh: 如果你找到了，請告訴我。我很想念她...

source_en: @I have nothing to sell you. Talk to my father.@
text_zh: 我沒什麼東西賣給你。跟我父親談談吧。

source_en: @How could you be so mean to Kador! You go and apologize to my poor little dog this instant!@
text_zh: 你怎麼可以對 Kador 這麼壞！你現在立刻去向我那可愛的小狗道歉！

source_en: @Well... Do you promise not to make fun of me?@
text_zh: 呃...你保證不會取笑我嗎？

source_en: Suddenly she starts dancing a dance of haunting beauty, to the sound of music that seems to emanate from nowhere.*
text_zh: 突然間，她開始跳起舞來，舞姿美得令人著迷，伴隨著不知從何處傳來的音樂聲。*

source_en: It's one of the most wondrous sights you've ever seen.*
text_zh: 這是你見過最奇異的景象之一。*

source_en: After a timeless time, the music ceases, and she turns and runs away.
text_zh: 過了漫長的時光，音樂停止了，她轉身跑開了。
牠是一隻多麼可愛的小狗啊...

source_en: @Good bye, and sweet dreams to you.@
text_zh: 再見，祝你有個甜美的好夢。

source_en: A gypsy girl poised on the verge of womanhood.*
text_zh: 一位即將成為成熟女性的吉普賽女孩。*

source_en: @Hey hey hey! Welcome to the finest sewers in Britannia.@
text_zh: @嘿，嘿，嘿！歡迎來到Britannia最棒的下水道。@

source_en: @My name's Daros, old duck.@ He shakes your hand.
text_zh: @我名叫 Daros，親愛的。@ 他握了握你的手。

source_en: @Well, ducky, I keep the sewers running the way they should. When work is slow, sometimes I play a joke or two on my friends to keep things lively.@ He winks at you.
text_zh: @嗯，親愛的，我負責讓下水道按正常方式運作。當工作清閒時，我偶爾會跟朋友開一兩個玩笑，以維持氣氛活躍。@ 他朝你眨了眨眼。

source_en: @Even though we don't know each other that well, I'd like to think of you as my friend already.@
text_zh: @儘管我們並不怎麼熟，但我想已經把你當做朋友了。@

source_en: @Britain is the biggest city in the world, and all those people use a lot of water. All the runoff drains down here. It's not a bad place to work, really, except for the rats.@
text_zh: @Britain 是世界上最繁忙的城市，所有這些人都使用了大量的水。所有的排水最終都流到了這裡。這其實並不是一個糟糕的工作地點，真的，除了那些老鼠。@

source_en: @Oh you know, ducks, the usual kinds.@ He nudges you in the ribs.
text_zh: @噢，你知道的，親愛的，就是那些常見的那種。@ 他碰了碰你的肋骨。

source_en: @Go back up and have a look! I'm sure it's still there.@ He grins, obviously delighted with his own sense of humor.@
text_zh: @回去上面看看！我敢肯定它還在那裡。@ 他露出笑容，顯然對自己的幽默感感到滿足。@

source_en: @I wouldn't go swimming around here, ducks.@
text_zh: @我不建議你在水裡游泳，親愛的。@

source_en: @They're pretty big, ducky, but not to worry. They usually won't eat you until after they've killed you first.@
text_zh: @它們挺大的，親愛的，別擔心。它們通常不會先把你吃掉的，它們會先把你殺了才吃。@

source_en: @Of course, if you have a set of panpipes, I hear you can just pipe them away...@
text_zh: @當然，如果你有一支排簫，我聽說可以吹奏著把老鼠趕走...@

source_en: @I don't have a set myself. I usually just run away.@
text_zh: @我沒有自己的排簫。我通常只是跑開。@

source_en: @See you around, old duck.@ He gives you a hearty slap on the back as you leave, which almost knocks one of the straps on your pack loose.
text_zh: @回見了，老鴨。@ 當你離開時，他重重地拍了一下你的後背，差點讓你背上的背帶鬆脫。

source_en: A skinny, awkward looking man, wearing boots that come up past his knees.
text_zh: 一個瘦小、看起來彆扭的男人，穿著高過膝蓋的靴子。

source_en: @Hey hey hey! Welcome to the finest sewers in Britannia. You look like you need a nickname, so I'll call you 'ducks.'@
text_zh: @嘿！嘿！嘿！歡迎來到Britannia最棒的下水道。我看你需要一個綽號，那我就叫你「鴨子」吧。@

source_en: @I tend Lord British's orchard. Of course, this time of year there's not much to do, so I take a lot of naps.@
text_zh: @我打理 Lord British 的果園。當然，現在這個季節也沒什麼事做，所以我睡了很多午覺。@

source_en: @Well, I have better dreams at night anyway.@
@Long live the king! I was just a homeless orphan when he gave me this job.@
text_zh: @國王萬歲！我本來只是個無家可歸的孤兒，是他給我這份工作的。@

source_en: @To snooze, perchance to dream... O Morpheus, I long for a taste of thy sweet oblivion!@
text_zh: @睡覺吧，也許會夢見...噢Morpheus，我渴望品嚐你甜美的忘卻！@

source_en: @To provide fresh fruit for Lord British's banquets.@
text_zh: @為 Lord British 的盛宴提供新鮮水果。@

source_en: @My parents were killed in an earthquake. But now I have a place to live, and a job to put food on the table.@
text_zh: @我的父母在地震中喪生了。但現在我有地方住，也有工作維持生計。@

source_en: @Sleep is the finest medicine, for in our dreams lie the answers to all the problems of the waking world.@
text_zh: @睡眠是最好的良藥，因為在我們的夢中，藏著醒時世界所有問題的答案。@

source_en: @Morpheus is the King of Slumberland! I think the moon is one of his daughters.@
text_zh: @Morpheus是Slumberland的國王！我想月亮是他的女兒之一。@

source_en: @The earthquakes seem to have stopped, thank goodness. We haven't had one in well over a year now.@
text_zh: @地震似乎停止了，感謝上蒼。我們已經一年多了沒經歷過地震了。@

source_en: @I dream of castles of ice, rivers that run backwards, fairy princesses and cloud dragons. Once I dreamed that my orchard grew and grew, until I felt like a tiny bug amongst the giant plants. Sometimes everything is upside-down, or made of chocolate. I've dreamed many a strange dream, but my favorite one is.....@
text_zh: @我夢見冰之城堡，倒流的河流，精靈公主和雲龍。有一次我夢見我的果園不斷生長，直到我覺得自己像是一隻小蟲，穿梭在巨大的植物之間。有時一切是顛倒的，或是由巧克力做成的。我做過許多奇怪的夢，但我最喜歡的一個是.....@

source_en: She falls asleep before finishing her sentence.
text_zh: 她在說完這句話之前睡着了。
一位看起來睡眼惺忪的年輕女子。*

source_en: @Day brings questions, night brings answers. Thusly does the duality of the universe find expression in our lives.@
text_zh: @白天帶來問題，夜晚帶來答案。如此，宇宙的二元性就在我們的生活裡體現出來了。@

source_en: @Colors never seem as vivid when I'm awake.@
text_zh: @醒著的時候，顏色從來沒那麼鮮明過。@

source_en: @When the sun's blazing eye winks shut, and Morpheus rules the heavens.@
text_zh: @當太陽那熾熱的眼睛閉上，Morpheus統治著天空時。@

source_en: @It lies halfway between our fears and our desires.@
text_zh: @它位於我們的恐懼與渴望之間。@

source_en: @She is the sweet harbinger of the night!@
@What color is seven? How many is green? Could horses speak, if they wished to? These things concern me...@
text_zh: @七是什麼顏色？綠色是多少？如果馬兒願意，它們能說話嗎？這些事讓我在意...@

source_en: She yawns as you approach. @Oh, hello there. I must have been daydreaming.@
text_zh: 當你靠近時她打了個哈欠。 @哦，你好。我剛才一定是在發呆。@

source_en: @Concerned? She should be committed! We have better things to do than listen to this loon.@
text_zh: @擔心？她應該被送進瘋人院！我們還有更好的事要做，而不是聽這個瘋子胡說。@

source_en: @Fear and desire... What would either be without the other?@
text_zh: @恐懼與渴望...若沒有對方，它們又算什麼？@

source_en: She seems to have dozed off before she even heard you say goodbye.
text_zh: 她似乎在聽見你道別之前就睡著了。

source_en: @From the day I first saw your portrait, I knew you must be the most beautiful woman in all Britannia.@
text_zh: @從我第一眼看到你的畫像，我就知道你是整個Britannia最美麗的女人。@

source_en: @You're the greatest hero in all the land.@
text_zh: @你是這片土地上最偉大的英雄。@

source_en: Avatar, 'tis an unexpected pleasure to see you again!@
text_zh: 聖者，沒想到又見到你了！@

source_en: @Maldric, I am. Once Maldric the boar hunter, now Maldric the cook.@
text_zh: @Maldric，就是我。曾是獵野豬的 Maldric，如今是廚師 Maldric。@

source_en: @Aye, I used to live in the forest and hunt wild boars.@*
text_zh: @是啊，我以前住在森林裡，打獵野豬。@*

source_en: But one day I presented a roast boar as a gift to his majesty, and he liked it so much he hired me as his cook.@
text_zh: 但有一天，我獻上一道烤野豬作為禮物給陛下，他非常喜歡，便僱用我當廚師。@

source_en: @Those were good times. But I'm happy here.@
text_zh: @那是一段美好的時光。但我很高興在這裡。@

source_en: @I cook for all those who live in the castle, and for any guests who dine with Lord British as well.@*
text_zh: @我為城堡裡的所有人烹飪，也為與Lord British進餐的賓客準備餐點。@*

source_en: @'Tis sastisfying work, yet at times I wish I could travel with one such as you...@
text_zh: @這是一份令人滿意的差事，但有時我希望自己能像你這樣去旅行...@
是的，正是英格蘭爵士本人。 Lord British

source_en: @The secret is in the spices. It's an old family recipe.@
text_zh: 祕密在於香料。這是一份古老的家族食譜。

source_en: @I'll never tell. Though for one so sweet, I must say I'm tempted.@
text_zh: 我永遠不會說出來。不過，對於這麼甜美的人，我必須承認我有些心動了。

source_en: A bare chested, muscular man, his body gleaming with sweat.
text_zh: 一個赤裸上身、肌肉發達的男人，他身上閃著汗水的亮光。

source_en: @I like having a job where I can make people happy.@
text_zh: 我喜歡這份能讓人開心的工作。

source_en: @A fancier home than any of my family ever lived in. Yet I still miss my simple hut in the forest.@*
text_zh: 這是一棟比我家任何人住過的房子都要豪華的住所。然而，我依然思念我在森林裡那間簡單的小屋。*

source_en: @I wish it were still there, so I could invite you to come spend an evening by the fireplace with me...@
text_zh: 我希望能還在，這樣我就可以邀請你來和我一起在壁爐旁度過一個夜晚了...
英格蘭爵士有很多朋友。 Lord British

source_en: @I shouldn't even speak of such things.@*
text_zh: 我不應該談論這些事情。*

source_en: @After all, you are the Avatar, and I but a lowly cook. Please forgive me.@
text_zh: 畢竟，你是聖者，而我僅是一名卑微的廚師。請原諒我。

source_en: @There's fire enough in my kitchen, but 'tis no place for romance. I shouldn't even speak of such things.@*
text_zh: 我的廚房裡有足夠的火焰，但那裡不是談情說愛的地方。我不應該談論這些事情。*

source_en: @He's a good man. Likes plenty of pepper in his stew.@
text_zh: 他是個好男人。喜歡在他的燉湯裡放很多胡椒。

source_en: @Spice puts some variety in life, is what I always say.@
text_zh: 香料為生活增添了變化，這是我一直說的話。

source_en: @You're a pretty spicy little number yourself!@
text_zh: 你自己也挺火辣辣的嘛！

source_en: @I've heard about all of your adventures. I wish I were a warrior too, and not just a cook!@
text_zh: 我聽說了你們所有的冒險經歷。我希望我也是一名戰士，而不僅僅是一名廚師！

source_en: @See you later. And next time you dine with his majesty, I'll cook you something special.@
text_zh: 回頭見。下次陛下請你用餐時，我會為你做些特別的東西。

source_en: He pulls a napkin from his belt and mops at his brow. @Now, what were you saying?@*
text_zh: 他從腰間抽出一塊餐巾，擦著額頭。現在，你剛才說什麼來著？*

source_en: He seems about to say more, with a hopeful look in his eyes. But then he turns away without speaking.
text_zh: 他似乎還想說更多，眼中流露出希望的神情。但隨後他轉身離去，一言不發。

source_en: @Wait a minute,@ he interrupts, @I recognize you...You're the Avatar! I've always wanted to meet you.@
text_zh: @等一下,@ 他打斷道，@我認得你...你是聖者！我一直都想見你一面。@

source_en: @Ha! You must be afraid of what your mother might think.@
text_zh: @哈！你一定是怕你母親知道了會怎麼想吧。@

source_en: @If we can find someplace private, I'll gladly show you how I got my nickname...@
text_zh: @如果我們能找到個隱蔽的地方，我很樂意向你展示我是怎麼得到這個綽號的...@

source_en: @Hmm, sounds like I've piqued your interest...@
, are you trying to insinuate something?@ She breaks into a fit of giggles.
text_zh: , 你是在影射什麼嗎？@ 她 burst 出一陣嬌笑。

source_en: @Again, so soon? Nay, come back later, when I've had a little time to rest.@
text_zh: @又來，這麼急？不，過陣子再來吧，等我休整一下。@

source_en: @I don't get many lady customers... but why not? You're sure this is what you want? I've a cot in my wagon... 15 gold's the price--and I don't haggle! Interested,
text_zh: @我不常接待女性顧客... 但為什麼不行呢？你確定這是你想要的嗎？我馬車裡有一張行軍牀... 價格是15個金幣--而且我不講價！有興趣嗎，

source_en: @I've a cot in my wagon... 15 gold's the price--and I don't haggle! Interested,
text_zh: @我馬車裡有一張行軍牀... 價格是15個金幣--而且我不講價！有興趣嗎，

source_en: @I don't think we have time for this...@
A voice in the back of your head asks, @Do you really have time for this?@
text_zh: 腦海深處有個聲音問道：「你真的有時間做這個嗎？」

source_en: @Come on, honey. Cross my palm with 15 gold and I'll show you a good time. Okay?@
text_zh: 「快點，親愛的。把手伸到我掌心上面，放上 15 個金幣，我保證讓你玩得開心。好嗎？」

source_en: @Hey, I don't give credit! No pay, no play, capish?@
text_zh: 「嘿，我不掛帳！不付錢就不給玩，懂嗎？」

source_en: @Fine! Come back when you get permission from your mother!@
text_zh: 「好吧！等你拿到你母親的允許再回來吧！」

source_en: @Let's get a bit closer to the wagon before we discuss these things, okay?@
text_zh: 「我們離馬車近一點再談這些事，好嗎？」

source_en: @We don't have... Oh, wait, there was something!@
text_zh: 「我們沒有了...噢，等等，好像還有東西！」

source_en: @Arturos, he, uh, found a map last time we were up at Empath Abbey.@
text_zh: 「Arturos，他、他上次我們去Empath Abbey時找到了一張地圖。」

source_en: @I don't care much for them. They're all too stuck up.@
text_zh: 「我不太喜歡她們。她們都太擺架子了。」

source_en: @Andreas has a silver tablet you could ask him about.@*
text_zh: @Andreas 有一塊銀色板，你可以問問他。@*

source_en: @But I have something much sweeter for sale...@
text_zh: 「不過我有個更甜蜜的東西要賣...」

source_en: @He could show you a real good time, honey!@
text_zh: 「他一定讓你玩得開心，親愛的！」

source_en: @He's in the same line of work as I am--but I think I'm more your type!@
text_zh: 「他是跟我同一行的——但我覺得我更符合你的口味！」

source_en: @If you've got the money, I've got the time!@

text_zh: 「這是個累人的差事，你知道的。」

source_en: @See you around... And if you meet anyone tall, dark and handsome, send 'em my way!@
text_zh: 「再會...如果你遇到高挑、英俊的男士，請介紹給我！」

source_en: @If you ever decide you need a break from adventuring, come find me again.@
text_zh: 「如果你決定需要從冒險中放鬆一下，再來找我。」

source_en: A gypsy wench with a voluptuous figure.
text_zh: 一位身形豐滿的吉普賽女子。

source_en: @Well, hello handsome! Looking for a little...relaxation?@
@I do not know the specifics, but she studied legends of strange people appearing through moongates, or disappearing through them altogther.@
text_zh: @我不太清楚細節，但她研究過關於怪異人物透過月亮門出現，或透過它們消失的傳說。@

source_en: @Somehow she was able to discern exactly when a moongate would appear and that it would lead us to this land.@
text_zh: @不知怎的，她能夠準確判斷月亮門何時會出現，以及它會將我們帶到這片土地。@

source_en: @Why I came here? Let's just say mine homeland cares not for the true meaning of justice.@
text_zh: @我為什麼來到這裡？就說我的家鄉不關切正義的真實意義吧。@

source_en: @My knowledge of magic is very miniscule. She just told me to trust her intiutions, that we would be going to a far better place than our own homeland.@
text_zh: @我的魔法知識非常有限。她只是告訴我信任她的直覺，我們會去一個比家鄉好得多的地方。@

source_en: @We do not have a system of virtues like here in Britannia. My interest in law led me to Yew, the city of Justice. This was some time after Blackthorn's reign. My sister stayed briefly, but left for an unknown destination.@
text_zh: @我們這裡不像Britannia那樣擁有美德體系。我對法律的興趣將我引向了正義之城Yew。那是在Blackthorn統治時期之後的事了。我的姐姐短暫停留後，便離開去往了一個未知的目的地。@

source_en: @Thy legendary Quest was very inspiring. Justice is a virtue that I strive to uphold.@
text_zh: @您傳奇的冒險經歷非常令人鼓舞。正義是我不斷努力維護的美德。@

source_en: @I spent years studying Britannian law. Quite interesting stuff.@
text_zh: @我花了很多年研習不列顛尼亞的法律。相當有趣的內容。@

source_en: @Her quest for knowledge has lead her to many different lands, and quite possibly different planes of existence. She promised she would return to Britannia eventually.@
text_zh: @她對知識的探索將她帶到了許多不同的土地，甚至可能是不同的存在平面。她承諾終究會返回Britannia。@

source_en: @She had mentioned wanting to move to Skara Brae when she returns. 'Tis the City of Spirituality of course.@
text_zh: @她曾提到想返回後搬去Skara Brae。那可是精神之城啊。@

source_en: @Thou hast successfully completed the investigation already. Good work.@
text_zh: @你已經成功完成了調查。幹得不錯。@

source_en: @While I do not doubt the Avatar's integrity, relying on the testimony of a spirit could set a horrible precedent. There is nothing on the books that would make it proper evidence.@
text_zh: @我並不懷疑聖者的正直，但依賴靈體的證詞可能會樹立一個可怕的先例。書面法規中沒有任何規定使其成為合法的證據。@

source_en: @Start at the scene of the crime. Talk to all the townsfolk again. Were there witnesses? If so, ask them.@
text_zh: @從犯罪現場開始調查。再和所有的鎮民談談。有目擊者嗎？如果有，請詢問他們。@

source_en: @A credible witness willing to testify would be beneficial to our case. Leave no stone unturned.@
text_zh: @有一位願意作證的可信目擊者將有助於我們的事實。務必詳查。@

source_en: @Report back here with me if thou dost need more assitance, or if you have evidence we can act upon. Make haste!@
text_zh: @如果你需要更多幫助，或者找到了我們可以採取行動的證據，請回來向我匯報。快點！@

source_en: @Thou hast found some evidence? Let me see it.@
text_zh: @你找到了一些證據嗎？讓我看看。@

source_en: You show Rinaldo the scroll you found, and inform him that Michael has fled on his ship.
text_zh: 你向 Rinaldo 展示你找到的卷軸，並告訴他 Michael 已經乘船逃跑了。

source_en: @So, Quenton owed him a debt. Seems as though Michael murdered him when he didn't pay.@
text_zh: @原來，Quenton 欠他一筆債。看起來 Michael 是在對方不還錢時殺了他的。@

source_en: @Well, where is it? Where is thine evidence?@
text_zh: @好吧，它在哪裡？你的證據在哪裡？@

source_en: You inform Rinaldo that Michael had fled on a ship and Marney was saved.
text_zh: 你告知 Rinaldo，Michael 已乘船逃離，而 Marney 獲救了。

source_en: You inform Rinaldo that Michael had fled on a ship with Marney.
text_zh: 你告知 Rinaldo，Michael 帶著 Marney 乘船逃離了。

source_en: @Indeed... he could be anywhere by now. Avatar, please speak with this fellow here, Renthar, immediately.@
text_zh: @確實如此...他現在可能在任何地方。聖者，請立刻與在場的這位仁兄，Renthar，談談。@

source_en: @Before you came in, he was revealing some information on a pirate crew that may be interesting to you.@
text_zh: @你進來之前，他正在透露一些關於海盜船隊的資訊，這或許會讓你感興趣。@

source_en: @Michael has a connection to them! Talk to him, and find out where Michael might be hiding. I'm afraid due to the lack of manpower with the gargoyle war, it is up to thee to bring him to Justice!@
text_zh: @Michael 與他們有關聯！去找他談談，查出他可能藏身之處。我擔心由於石像鬼戰爭導致人手不足，只能由你帶他歸案了！@

source_en: @Do what thou must, but bring him in alive, so that he faces a proper trial.@
text_zh: @盡你所能，但要將他生擒，讓他接受公正的審判。@

source_en: @Make haste and good fortune to thee!@
Rinaldo listens as you inform him that Stivius witnessed the murder, but made the gargoyle story up to save himself from Michael.
text_zh: Rinaldo 聆聽你告知，Stivius 目睹了謀殺案，但為了逃避 Michael，他編造了石像鬼的故事。

source_en: @I see. I will see to it that he testifies against Michael and his safety will be guaranteed. Excellent work.@
text_zh: @我明白了。我會確保他指證 Michael，並保證他的安全。幹得好。@

source_en: @Greetings, milady Lenora. Didst I overhear of a murder in Skara Brae?@
text_zh: @你好，Lenora 夫人。我剛才聽到 Skara Brae 發生了一起謀殺案？@

source_en: Lenora, looking flustered, says @Then we shall arrest Michael, if that wouldst make thee happy. Tis enough evidence for me, Rinaldo. Mine intuitions have not failed me yet. The cells are full of prisoners who deserved their sentences...@
text_zh: Lenora 顯得有些慌張，說道：@那我們就逮捕 Michael，如果這樣能讓你高興的話。對我來說，Rinaldo，證據已經足夠了。我的直覺從未有過失誤。牢房裡塞滿了罪有應得的囚犯...@

source_en: @I shall relieve you from the duties of judicial matters so you can concentrate on governing the city. Thank thee for filling in during my absense.@
text_zh: @我將解除你司法方面的職責，讓你能專心治理城市。感謝你在我缺席期間的代為處理。@

source_en: Lenora, looking both irate and insulted at the same time, resigns herself to authority.
text_zh: Lenora 既氣憤又覺得受辱，最終還是屈服於權威。

source_en: @Very well, milord.@ she sighs. @Avatar, thou shouldst consult with Rinaldo concerning this matter. Good luck.@
text_zh: 「很好，大人。」她嘆了口氣。「聖者，這件事你應該去諮詢 Rinaldo。祝你好運。」

source_en: She glances at Rinaldo and then goes about her duties, quietly fuming to herself.
text_zh: 她看了一眼 Rinaldo，然後開始處理自己的職務，心裡暗暗發怒。

source_en: @If you will excuse me Avatar, Renthar is discussing an important matter with me. Please come back later.@
text_zh: 「聖者，請原諒，Renthar 正在和我商量一件重要的事。請稍後再來。」

source_en: @I thank thee for helping bring a murderer to justice, noble Avatar. With the gargoyles running roughshod across Britannia, manpower has been quite scarce in dealing with such crimes.@
text_zh: 「感謝高貴的聖者幫我將兇手繩之以法。隨著石像在 Britannia 為非作歹，處理這類犯罪的人力一直相當緊張。」

source_en: @Renthar was able to make Michael reveal the location of Marney and he is en route to the location. He promised to return her to Skara Brae, let us hope he is not too late.@
text_zh: 「Renthar 成功讓 Michael 透露了 Marney 的下落，他正趕往該地點。他答應會把她帶回 Skara Brae，希望還來得及。」

source_en: @This situation is being taken care of, Rinaldo. There is no need for thy concern.@
text_zh: 「這件事正在處理中，Rinaldo。無需你擔心。」
「收下這份報酬，以謝你的辛苦。」

source_en: He hands you a pouch of 100 gold coins.
text_zh: 他遞給你一袋 100 金幣。

source_en: @Thou art truly a shining example of the virtue of Justice.@
text_zh: 「你確實是正義美德的閃耀典範。」

source_en: @Ask again when you have room to carry thy reward.@
text_zh: 「等你的包裏有空間裝下獎勵時，再回來領取。」

source_en: He hands you a pouch of 200 gold coins.
@Thou art truly a shining example of the virtue of Justice, noble Avatar.@
text_zh: 汝實乃公正德行之光輝典範，高貴的聖者。

source_en: You see a nobleman in judge's robes.
text_zh: 你看到一位身穿法官袍的貴族。

source_en: @Avatar, 'tis an honor to meet thee.@ He shakes your hand.@
text_zh: @聖者，與汝相見是榮幸。@他握了握你的手。@

source_en: @I am Rinaldo, and I strive to uphold the virtue of Justice.@
text_zh: 我是Rinaldo，我致力於維護公正德行。

source_en: @I was appointed a judge of the High Court of Yew, by Lord British. In my absense, Lenora took care of my duties.@
text_zh: 我受Lord British之命，被任命為Yew High Court的法官。在我缺席期間，Lenora代為履行了我的職責。 High Court

source_en: @I was away for a while on a sabbatical, scouring books in the Lycaeum for any information regarding moongates and their functions.@
text_zh: 我休假了一段時間，在Lycaeum遍覽書籍，尋找關於月門及其功能的任何資訊。

source_en: @Lenora was gracious enough to temporarily take over my duties overseeing the High Court of Yew.@
text_zh: Lenora寬厚地暫時接替了我監督Yew High Court的職責。 High Court

source_en: Lenora looks over and scowls, then goes back to what she was doing.
text_zh: Lenora瞥了一眼，皺了皺眉，然後繼續做她剛才在做的事。

source_en: Rinaldo looks at you and grins slightly
He whispers: @Between you and I, her idea of justice was a bit too heavy handed and apparently based on her emotions...usually anger!@
text_zh: 他低聲說道：「說起來，她對公正的理解似乎有點過於強硬，而且顯然基於她的情緒...通常是憤怒！」

source_en: @Lest ye not forget that Lord British himself appointed me to properly administrate Justice, after it had been twisted during his absense for so long.@
text_zh: 莫要忘記，正是Lord British本人任命我來正確行使公正，因為在他缺席的漫長歲月中，公正曾遭到扭曲。

source_en: @Such a noble and just ruler. The former lord mayor of Yew recommended me to him for this position. I hope my service doth make him proud, and I strive to dispense justice fairly and according to the law.@
text_zh: 如此高貴且公正的統治者。Yew的前任市長向我推薦了他擔任此職位。我希望我的服務能讓他感到自豪，我致力於依法公平地執行公正。

source_en: @Such a shame. My thoughts go out to the young woman left behind without her father. I am glad thou hast brought the murderer to justice.@
text_zh: 真是遺憾。我的思緒牽掛著那位失去父親的女子。我很感謝汝將兇手繩之以法。

source_en: @I hope thou weren't offended by mine interjection. I strive for Justice, even for those who may seem like scoundrels. From what I understand about thy last visit here, justice was grossly misapplied...@
text_zh: 我希望汝不至於因我的插話而感到不快。我追求公正，即使是對那些看似無賴的人也是如此。根據我對汝上次到此的瞭解，公正曾被嚴重濫用...

source_en: @Let us have a thorough investigation into this matter so we can properly prosecute the murderer by the books.@
text_zh: 讓我們對此事件進行徹底調查，以便我們能依法正確起訴兇手。

source_en: @Yes, very interesting topic. Much like thyself, I come from another land.@
text_zh: 是的，非常有趣的話題。與汝一樣，我也來自另一個地方。

source_en: @Yes, far away. I like Britannia much better. In fact, I hope to see my sister here again one day as well. I was hoping that I might be able to find something on moongate appearances and how often inter-wordly gates appear. I didn't find much of use though.@
text_zh: 是的，很遠。我比較喜歡Britannia。事實上，我希望有一天能在這里再次見到我的姐姐。我希望能找到一些關於月門出現以及跨世界門出現頻率的資訊。雖然沒找到什麼有用的。

source_en: @She's powerful in the art of magic. It was her who found a way for us to come here, via the moongates.@
text_zh: 她精通魔法。就是她找到了讓我們通過月門來到這裡的方法。
@歡迎來到 British 城堡，聖者！@
我是庫倫，庫倫麵包師。 Cullen

source_en: @I'd have thought that'd be obvious! I'm a baker!@ As he laughs heartily, more clouds of flour rise off his clothing.*
text_zh: 我以為這很明顯！我是麵包師！*他大笑著，衣服上揚起更多麵粉雲霧。

source_en: @You can buy bakery goods from me or perhaps you have some flour to sell, eh?@
text_zh: 你可以向我購買烘焙食品，或者也許你有麵粉要賣？

source_en: @I bake goods for Lord British himself!@ the man says proudly. @If you'd like to buy some, just say the word!@
text_zh: 我為英吉利領主親自烘焙食品！這人驕傲地說。如果你想買一些，只要說一聲！ Lord British

source_en: @Come to my shop when it's open!@
text_zh: 開門的時候來我的商店吧！

source_en: @Will you take 5 gold for that sack of flour?@
text_zh: 那袋麵粉收你5個金幣，好嗎？

source_en: @Done!@ He hands you 5 gold pieces and takes the sack of flour.@
text_zh: 成交！他遞給你5個金幣並收下那袋麵粉。

source_en: @Changed your mind, eh?@ he folds his arms. @Well, what else will it be then?@
text_zh: 改變主意了？他抱起雙臂。那麼，還要買點別的嗎？

source_en: @I'm sorry, but you don't have enough gold.@

text_zh: , 但你不會找到比這更好的了！

source_en: gold each. How many do you want,
@Whoa! Don't buy out my entire stock!@
text_zh: @哇！別把我所有的貨都買光了！

source_en: gold each. How many _do you want,
text_zh: 金幣每份。你真的要買幾份，
@啊，這是我的專長！那些售價是

source_en: You see a short, dark man, covered in white flour.
text_zh: 你看到一個矮小、黝黑的男人，身上沾滿了白色麵粉。

source_en: !@ As he shakes your hand enthusiastically, clouds of flour fly off his clothes.
text_zh: ！@ 他熱情地握住你的手，麵粉塵從他的衣服上飛濺出來。

source_en: @Come back whena you have the money.@
@But ifa some maniac with an axe catches you in a dark alley somewhere, don'ta blame me for not warning you.@
text_zh: 但如果哪個瘋子拿著斧子在陰暗的巷弄裡截住你，可別怪我之前沒提醒你。

source_en: @I'ma called Arturos. That meansa either 'foolish monkey' or 'he who sells cheese', depending on howa you translate it.@
text_zh: 我叫阿托羅斯（Arturos）。這名字的意思要嘛是「笨猴子」，要嘛是「賣起司的人」，得看你怎麼翻譯。

source_en: @That'sa nice and friendly. I like you too.@ He comes over and gives you a big hug.
text_zh: 真親切友善。我也喜歡你。他走過來，給你一個大大的擁抱。

source_en: @You knowa about that eh? It was delicious!@ He licks his lips and grins.
text_zh: 你知道啊？真美味！他舔了舔嘴唇，咧嘴一笑。

source_en: @He's a whadda you call, an impostor. You shouldn'ta listen to him.@
text_zh: 他是個冒牌貨，你該叫他什麼來著。別聽他的。

source_en: @The silver tablet? I don't know anything about that.@*
text_zh: 銀色石板？我對此一無所知。*

source_en: @But hey, maybe there's something in the cards about it, ah?@
text_zh: 不過嘿，或許在牌運裡有些關於這事的線索，嗯？

source_en: Shamino whispers to you, @Best check your coinpouch. I think I saw something when that gypsy hugged you.@
text_zh: 沙米諾（Shamino）對你低語，「最好檢查一下你的錢袋。我剛才看那個吉普賽人擁抱你時，好像有什麼動作。」

source_en: @Ima the king of all the gypsies. Of course, thatsa what you call more of an 'honorary' title, so I tell fortunes on the side.@
text_zh: 我是所有吉普賽人的國王。當然，這算是個「榮譽」頭銜，所以我順便幫人看相。

source_en: @Yeah, I used to have a map like that. Can't remember what I did with it, though...@
text_zh: 是啊，我以前有張這樣的地圖。不過我忘記把它弄到哪裡去了...

source_en: @Map. Hmm, map... Oh yeah, thata old thing. Sure, I got that, but she'sa not very interesting.@*
text_zh: 地圖。嗯，地圖...噢對了，那老東西。我有這張地圖，但這東西一點也不有趣。*

source_en: @Oh! Well, sure you do, she's a very important map!@*
text_zh: 噢！當然，這是一張非常重要的地圖！*

source_en: He leads you away from the rest of the group. @Don't want no spyin' ears, ah?@
text_zh: 他把你帶離了其他人。不想要長著耳朵的間諜，嗯？

source_en: @Yeah, this map, she'sa leading to the treasure of - oh, who was it, Yellowbeard or somebody.@*
text_zh: 是啊，這張地圖，它通往下黃鬍子或誰誰的寶藏地。 Yellowbeard*

source_en: @Well, I forget, but the point is it leads to a big, huge treasure! So if you want this map you're agonna have to pay - 100 gold! Okay?@
text_zh: 嗯，我忘了，但重點是它通往一大筆、巨大的寶藏！所以如果你想要這張地圖，你就得付——100 金幣！好嗎？

source_en: @Okay, here's the map, and may fortune bring you lotsa gold!@
text_zh: 好，這是地圖，願命運帶給你滿滿的金幣！

source_en: @Yeah, well, you've got a lot to carry right now. I do you a favor and just hold on to the map for you until you got room for it. I do you another favor and hold on to the money, too.@
text_zh: 是啊，現在你得搬運很多東西。我幫個忙，先幫你收著這張地圖，直到你有地方放為止。我再幫個忙，錢也先幫我收著。

source_en: @Hey, what are you, a deadbeat? Come back when you can afford the map!@
text_zh: 嘿，你個窮光蛋！等你買得起這張地圖時再回來吧！

source_en: @Well, I hate to see anybody pass up good fortune, so I tell you what I do. I sell you this map, this key to infinite wealth, for just 75 gold. Okay?@
text_zh: 好吧，我不喜歡看到任何人錯過好運，所以我這麼做。我把這張地圖、這把通往無限財富的鑰匙，以 75 金幣賣給你。好嗎？

source_en: A colorfully clad, bemused looking gypsy.*
text_zh: 一位穿著色彩繽紛、面帶會心微笑的吉普賽人。*

source_en: @What, are you nuts? But okay, how'sabout just 50 gold?@
text_zh: @什麼，你瘋了？好吧，那 50 黃金怎麼樣？@

source_en: @Thank you! You have asaved me from amaking a big mistake! You're right, I better hold on to this valuable map myself. No way is it worth less than 100 gold.@
text_zh: @謝謝你！你幫我避免犯了一個大錯！你說得對，我最好自己保留這張寶貴的地圖。它的價值絕對不止 100 黃金。@

source_en: @Nah, I didn't think so. What for would anybody want to buy it, ah?@
text_zh: @哼，我本以為什麼。誰會想要買它呢，啊？@

source_en: @You cana just call me 'Uncle Arthur' if you like.@
@I gota this fine set of fortune telling cards. These werea hand painted by Musgrave himself.@*
text_zh: @我有一組精美的占卜卡牌。這些是 Musgrave 親自手繪的。@*

source_en: @For justa five gold, maybe I can help you finda this silver tablet. And I'll tell you the rest of your future as well. What a bargain! Whadda you say?@
text_zh: @只要 5 黃金，也許我能幫你找到這塊銀板。我還會告訴你其餘的未來。多划算！你說呢？@

source_en: @I'll tella you your future. Whadda you say?@
text_zh: @我會告訴你未來的命運。你說呢？@

source_en: If you were looking to geta your fortune told, you came to the right place.@*
text_zh: 如果你想算算命，你來對地方了。@*

source_en: He takes out a deck of cards, shuffles it, and has you pick one.*
text_zh: 他拿出一副卡牌，洗牌，並讓你抽取一張。*

source_en: @Okay, thisa card, she'sa the Tower. That means you'rea going to go into a real big building soon, like maybe a castle.@*
text_zh: @好吧，這張牌，是‘高塔’。這意味著你很快就會進入一座大型建築，比如一座城堡。@*

source_en: @Pretty good, huh? Maybe you want a better card, though. Do you want to pick again?@
text_zh: @還不錯，是吧？也許你想要一張更好的牌。你想再抽一次嗎？@

source_en: You pick another card. @This here isa the Wheel of Fortune.@*
text_zh: 你抽取另一張牌。@這張是‘命運之輪’。@*

source_en: @Wheels, they go 'round and 'round, so that means you'rea gonna have some good luck, and some bad luck.@*
text_zh: @輪子轉啊轉，所以這意味著你會有一些好運，也有一些厄運。@*

source_en: @That doesn't tell you so much. Try for another card?@
text_zh: @這沒什麼預言意義。要再試一張牌嗎？@

source_en: @Oh, hey, you picked the Lovers this time.@
@ I thinka maybe you should go talk to Andreas, you know what I mean?@
text_zh: 「我想也許你該去和 Andreas 談談，你知道我的意思吧？」

source_en: @ I thinka maybe you should go talk to Wanda, you know what I mean?@
text_zh: 「我想也許你該去和 Wanda 談談，你知道我的意思吧？」

source_en: @That'sa pretty good card. How about another one?@
text_zh: 「這張牌還挺不錯的。還要再來一張嗎？」

source_en: @This here's Temperance. Thata means that you shouldn't lose your temper. I cana find you a better card than that, here, wait a minute.@*
text_zh: 「這是節制。這意味著你不應該失去耐心。我能找到一張比這更好的牌給你，來，等一下。*」

source_en: He picks out a card. @This is Justice, that'sa one of what they call the 'court cards.' Let me try again.@ He picks another.*
text_zh: 他挑出一張牌。「這是正義，那是他們所謂的『侍從牌』之一。讓我再試一次。」他選了另一張。*

source_en: @Okay, this isa better. This is the Hierophant. That'sa like an elephant, but taller and without the trunk.@*
text_zh: 「好了，這好多了。這是教皇。這就像大象，但更高，而且沒有長鼻子。*」

source_en: @That means you'rea gonna see one of them someday. Pretty interesting, huh? Another card?@
text_zh: 「這意味著你將來某一天會看到其中之一。還挺有趣的，對吧？再來一張？」

source_en: @Uh-oh, you justa drew the Death card. That means eithera you're going to kill somebody soon, ora somebody's gonna kill you.@*
text_zh: 「哎呀，你剛纔抽到了死亡牌。這意味著不是你要殺了某人，就是某人要殺你。*」

source_en: @I can never geta that part straight. One more card?@
text_zh: 「我永遠搞不清楚那一部分。還要再來一張嗎？」

source_en: @Allaright, now we're talking. You pickeda the Crow card. That'sa telling you adventuring isa for the birds.@*
text_zh: 「好吧，現在說得通了。你選了『烏鴉』牌。這是在告訴你冒險是鳥做的事。*」

source_en: @You should open a little shop somewhere and settle down, you know?@
text_zh: 「你應該在某個地方開間小商店，安定下來，你知道吧？」

source_en: @The cards didn't say nothin' about the silver tablet. Guess that means you're not gonna find it.@*
text_zh: @卡上沒寫關於銀色石板的事。看來你不會找到它了。@*

source_en: extra cards at 5 gold apiece. That makes
text_zh: 張額外的卡，每張 5 金幣。總共

source_en: @Since you don'ta have that much, I'll just settle for what you've got.@
text_zh: @既然你沒有那麼多錢，我就先收下你身上所有的錢了。@

source_en: @It was a pleasure doinga business with you.@
@Ah, I see you couldn't stay away... I have that effect on women..@
text_zh: @啊，我看你還是沒能拒絕...我有這種對女性的魔力..@

source_en: . Came for some more of our gypsy hospitality, I see!@
text_zh: 。看來你是來體驗我們吉普賽人的熱情款待的！@

source_en: @I am Andreas, prince of the gypsies.@
@I live the carefree life of a gypsy, traveling hither and yon.@
text_zh: @我過著吉普賽人無憂無慮的生活，到處旅行。@

source_en: @Naturally, when so lovely a lady as yourself comes along, I offer, shall we say, my services.@
text_zh: @當然，當像您這樣美麗的女士出現時，我會提供，也就是說，我的服務。@

source_en: @When the opportunity arises, I do what I can to brighten the lives of the ladies.@
text_zh: @當機會來臨時，我會盡我所能讓女士們的生活中增添光彩。@

source_en: @Of course, you'd probably be more interested in my sister Wanda, right?@
text_zh: @當然，你大概更對我的妹妹Wanda感興趣，對吧？@

source_en: @Can't say I blame you. In fact, if she wasn't my sister...@
text_zh: @我不怪你。事實上，如果她不是我的妹妹...@

source_en: @Hmm, wouldn't have figured you for the type...@
text_zh: @嗯，我沒想到你會是這種類型的人...@

source_en: @Wouldn't you like to be a gypsy too?@
@A fine thing to dream of! But one such as you could never be a gypsy.@
text_zh: @夢想得很美！但像你這樣的人，永遠無法成為吉普賽人。@

source_en: @You have the carefree spirit, but alas, one must be born a gypsy.@
text_zh: @你擁有一份灑脫的精神，但很可惜，吉普賽人的身份是天生的。@

source_en: @We all have our talents. I myself happen to have two.@*
text_zh: @我們每個人都有才藝。我剛好就有兩樣。@*

source_en: @I'd be glad to show you sometime!@
text_zh: @我很樂意在合適的時候展示給你看！@

source_en: @What, you mean swordplay? Just ask, and I'll give thee a lesson you won't forget!@
text_zh: @什麼，你是說劍術嗎？只要開口，我就能給你一節讓你難忘的課！@

source_en: @She practices the world's oldest profession. I, of course, have perfected it, and thus need no practice.@
text_zh: @她從事的是世上最古老的行業。而我，當然已經把它完美掌握了，所以不需要練習。@

source_en: @He's my dad - the king of the gypsies!@
text_zh: @他是我父親——吉普賽人的國王！@

source_en: @A map? Aye, Arturos has some scrap like that. I know nothing more of it.@
text_zh: @地圖？是的，Arturos 有那類破爛東西。我對它並不清楚。@

source_en: @Would you like to spar a bit?@
Pulling a couple of sticks from his belt, the gypsy hands you one. You fight with them as if they were swords for a while.*
text_zh: 這個吉普賽人從腰帶上抽出兩根棍子，把其中一根遞給你。你拿著它們像劍一樣打鬥了一會兒。*

source_en: After you're finished, he comes over and puts his arm around your shoulder as he gives you a few pointers on fencing style.*
text_zh: 結束後，他走過來把手搭在你的肩膀上，給你了幾點擊劍姿勢的建議。*

source_en: You're not sure, but you think perhaps you felt a slight tug at the pouch you keep your coins in.
text_zh: 你不太確定，但覺得放在錢包裡的金幣似乎輕輕動了一下。
一位英俊、瀟灑的吉普賽男人。*

source_en: @Ah yes, you've heard of the silver tablet!@*
@I haven't got it myself, but I can tell you where it is for a price... Shall we say 7 gold pieces?@
text_zh: @我手上沒有，但我可以收費告訴你它在哪...就說 7 個金幣唄？@

source_en: @I overheard a bard in a tavern say that it was somewhere on the Isle of the Avatar. Perhaps Arturos could tell you precisely.@
text_zh: @我聽 tavern 裡的一位吟遊詩人說，它在Isle of the Avatar上的某個地方。或許 Arturos 能告訴你確切的位置。@

source_en: @Come back when you have the money.@
@Oho, so that's what you're after, you naughty
text_zh: @哦，原來你是想找這種樂趣啊，調皮的

source_en: @For a mere 10 gold pieces, I'll transport you to the heights of ecstasy. Will it be yea or nay?@
text_zh: @只要 10 枚金幣，我就能帶你登上極樂的高峯。是還是不是？@

source_en: @Hey, foxy! I bet you'd like me to unsheathe my weapon so you can have a look....@
text_zh: @嘿，調皮鬼！我敢打賭你很想看我把武器拔出來讓你看個夠....@

source_en: @Well... Normally I'm more of a ladies' man. But I guess your money is as good as anyone else's. It'll cost you 10 gold, okay?@
text_zh: @嗯...通常我比較喜歡跟女士們打交道。不過我想你的錢跟別人的錢一樣好使。10 枚金幣，好嗎？@

source_en: @A voice in the back of your head asks, @Do you really have time for this?@
text_zh: @你腦海深處有一個聲音問你，@你真的有空做這種事嗎？@

source_en: , I really doubt we have time for this...@
text_zh: ，我真的懷疑我們有沒有時間做這個...@

source_en: @Hey, you don't have the money! I don't take charity cases.@
text_zh: @嘿，你身上連錢都沒有！我不做慈善。@

source_en: @As you like. But take my advice--you should live a little now. That way, you'll have something to remember when you're old and gray...@
text_zh: @隨你喜歡。但聽我一句勸——你應該趁現在好好享受一下生活。這樣，等你老了、頭髮白了……還有東西可以回憶...@

source_en: @My mind is willing, but the flesh is weak...Come back later, when I've had some time to rest.@
text_zh: @我的心願是願意，但我的肉體很疲憊...改天再來吧，等我休息好了。@

source_en: @Let's get a bit closer to my wagon before we discuss such matters, okay?@
text_zh: @讓我們先靠近我的馬車，再談這些事，好嗎？@

source_en: @I hope we get better acquainted when next we meet.@*
text_zh: @希望下次我們見面時能更熟絡一些。@*

source_en: @I like your clothes, but I think you'd look better without them...@
text_zh: @我喜歡你的衣服，但我想你脫掉它們會更好看...@

source_en: @Hey there! Welcome to our humble caravan! You look like a bold warrior - would you like to spar a bit for practice?@
text_zh: @嘿，你好！歡迎來到我們謙卑的商隊！你看起來像個勇敢的戰士——你想不想切磋一番，練練手？@

source_en: @Oh, I thank thee, Avatar! Perhaps as a reward I could tell thee some more jokes!@
text_zh: @哦，謝謝你，聖者！或許作為回報，我可以再講幾個笑話給你聽！@
@你的感激之情就足夠了，我想...@

source_en: He whispers to you. @I'd rather face Blackthorn's torture chamber than have to listen to more of Chuckles' jokes!@
text_zh: 他低聲對你說。@我寧願去面對 Blackthorn 的刑訊室，也不想再聽 Chuckles 的笑話了！@

source_en: @Frankly, if telling him yes gets him out of our hair, that's good enough for me.@
text_zh: @說實話，如果答應他能讓他別纏著我們，那對我來說就夠好了。@

source_en: Chuckles throws himself at your feet. I beseech thee, what shall I do to convince you to not ruin mine life!?@
text_zh: Chuckles 撲倒在你的腳邊。我懇求你，我要做什麼才能說服你不要毀掉我的人生！?@

source_en: @Be waiting at the Blue Boar tavern after midnight by the mirror and we shall discuss the details...@
text_zh: @午夜過後，請在 Blue Boar 小酒館的鏡子旁等候，我們再談細節...@

source_en: @Tis a strange request but I'll be there, I promise thee!@ Chuckles walks off nervously.
text_zh: @這是一個奇怪的請求，但我保證會去！@ Chuckles 緊張地走開了。

source_en: @Avatar, thou surely couldn't be considering that spirit's offer??@
text_zh: @聖者，你不會真的在考慮那個鬼魂的提議吧？？@

source_en: @I question your methods on this but I hope thou hast some sort of lesson in mind and not going along with Drudgeworth's plot..@
text_zh: @我對你在此事的處理方式存疑，但我希望你有某種教訓放在心上，而不是順從 Drudgeworth 的陰謀..@

source_en: @While running Chuckles through is something many of us have entertained the thought of because of his terrible jokes, you can't be serious.@
text_zh: @雖然我們中很多人因為 Chuckles 那可怕的笑話而曾想過刺穿他，但你別開玩笑了。@

source_en: @When I am guaranteed eternal torment of Chuckles' soul, then I shall reward ye handsomely! Bring his ashes back to my hut and I will bequeath thee a great treasure..@
text_zh: @當我確保 Chuckles 的靈魂將受到永恆的折磨時，我必將重重報賞你！把他的骨灰帶回我的小屋，我會遺留給你一大筆寶藏..@

source_en: @Thou shouldst never trust the word of a pirate, an undead one at that!@
text_zh: @你絕不該相信海盜的話，更別說是不死的海盜了！@

source_en: @I did my best, did I amuse you? If not, I hope I did confuse you.@
text_zh: @我盡力了，對吧？逗樂你了嗎？如果沒有，我希望至少讓你感到困惑了。@

source_en: @You did? Then I'll tell you another one!@
@Riddle me this: Do you know what the goose said to the avatar?@
text_zh: @猜猜看：你知道那隻鵝對聖者說了什麼嗎？@

source_en: @No, no, no, that's not how it works! You're supposed to say you don't, so I can tell you! Let's try it again@
text_zh: @不不不，不是這樣玩的！你應該說不知道，這樣我才能告訴你！我們再來一次。@

source_en: @What did you think of that one?@
@Hee hee, ho ho, to spread good cheer I go! Come talk to me again and I'll give you another show!@
text_zh: @嘿嘿，吼吼，我去散播快樂了！再來找我聊天，我會再給你表演一次！@

source_en: @Come back for some more great jokes!@
@Really? I'll just have to try harder, then!@
text_zh: @真的嗎？那我只能再努力一點了！
@為什麼 Dupre 像個馬蹄鐵？@

source_en: @It's because they both have the letter 'r' in them!@
@I think we should run you through for that terrible joke!@
text_zh: @我想我們應該因為那個可怕的笑話刺穿你！

source_en: Can we run him through yet, Avatar?
text_zh: 我們現在可以刺穿他嗎，聖者？

source_en: @I am here as thou has requested, in front of the mirror. For a second, looking into it I could have sworn I saw...nevermind...couldn't be...@
text_zh: @我應你所請，來到了鏡子前。有一瞬間，望著鏡中，我彷彿看見了...算了...不可能...@

source_en: @So what would you have me do? Avatar, I beg thee... I'll do anything... just please keep mine secret!@
text_zh: @那你想讓我做什麼？聖者，我求你了...我什麼都肯做...只求你保守我的祕密！

source_en: You clutch Drudgeworth's cutlass and it's almost as if all of his rage overtakes you, clouding your own thoughts as you approach Chuckles.
text_zh: 你緊握住 Drudgeworth 的彎刀，彷彿他所有的怒氣都吞噬了你，當你接近 Chuckles 時，你的思緒也變得模糊不清。

source_en: @Drudgeworth sends his regards...@, you calmly speak as you plunge the cutlass into Chuckles' belly. His eyes are sheer terror as he coughs up blood and collapses before you.
text_zh: 「@Drudgeworth 向你致意...@」，你平靜地說道，同時將彎刀刺入 Chuckles 的腹部。他的眼中滿是恐懼，咳出鮮血，倒在你面前。
Chuckles 的劇本被調用了，對嗎？

source_en: @I don't want to talk to thee anymore, tattle-tale! Go away!@
text_zh: 「@我不想再跟你說話了，長舌婦！走開！@」

source_en: @Ho eyo he hum! Care for a joke?@
text_zh: 「@吼 咿歐 嘿 哼！想聽個笑話嗎？@」

source_en: @Avatar, thou hast returned for mine jokes!@
text_zh: 「@聖者，你回來了，就為了我的笑話！@」

source_en: A carefree fellow in a ludicrous costume.
text_zh: 一個穿著滑稽服裝的隨性傢伙。

source_en: @Ho eyo he hum, I've got a clue! It's important, and just for you!@
text_zh: 「@吼 咿歐 嘿 哼，我有一個線索！這很重要，而且是專門為你的！@」

source_en: @Why, I'm Chuckles the jester, of course! You've heard of me haven't you? Sure you have!@
text_zh: 哼，我是小丑Chuckles，當然啦！你聽過我的名字吧？肯定聽過！

source_en: @You've heard a word? Why that's absurd!@
text_zh: 你只聽過一個詞？這太荒謬了！

source_en: @To jape, to jeer, to prance, to frolic! To keep this place unmelancholic!@
text_zh: 開玩笑，嘲笑，跳躍嬉戲！讓這個地方遠離憂鬱！

source_en: @I practice tomfoolery for Lord British - or anyone else who passes too close.@
text_zh: 我為Lord British演滑稽戲——或者給任何靠得太近的人演。

source_en: @And prance! To dance a Corybantic dance!@
text_zh: 還有跳躍！跳庫里班提克舞！
@我像個酒鬼一樣東倒西歪地走來走去！@

source_en: @'Cause Dick and Harry both called in sick.@
text_zh: @因為 Dick 和 Harry 都請病假了。@

source_en: @Call him Mr. Nose... But don't tell him I said so!@
text_zh: @叫他 Mr. Nose...但別告訴他我這麼說！@

source_en: @Shhh! Don't let him know I told you!@
@Yes, it's crucial to your quest. Do you want to know what it is?@
text_zh: @是的，這對你的任務至關重要。你知道那是什麼嗎？@

source_en: @Perhaps I don't want to tell you!@
@Perhaps I'll tell you anyway!  Do you think I will?@
text_zh: @也許我還是會告訴你！你認為我會嗎？@

source_en: @How foolish of you to think so!@
text_zh: @你真以為自己知道得這麼多，多麼愚蠢！

source_en: @Congratulations! You're exactly right!  I won't tell you the clue.....But I will give you this hint that may lead you to it...
text_zh: @恭喜！你完全答對了！我不會告訴你線索.....但我給你的這個提示也許能引導你找到它...

source_en: Search the chest in Nystul's room.
text_zh: 搜尋 Nystul 房間裡的箱子。

source_en: @Woulds thou like to hear a joke?@
@If hints were mints and mints were hints, think what a world it would be!@
text_zh: @如果提示是薄荷糖，薄荷糖是提示，想想那該是個怎樣的世界！@

source_en: @A quest, a chest, oh what a jest!@
text_zh: @一個任務，一個箱子，真是個玩笑！@

source_en: @Have you heard the one about the nun, the dragon, and the drunken penguin?@
text_zh: @你聽過關於修女、龍和醉鵝的那個笑話嗎？@

source_en: @Good! Maybe you can teach it to me someday!
text_zh: @很好！也許你有一天可以教教我！

source_en: @To teach, to preach, what waste of speech!@
@I'll show you fun before I'm done!@
text_zh: @我會讓你見識什麼叫好玩，等我辦完事！@

source_en: You show Chuckles the leaflet from the remnants of the Royal Prison. He reads it and his facial expression changes to a concerned one. Before you can take it back, he shreds it into tiny pieces and shoves them in his mouth.
text_zh: 你將王國監獄遺留物中的傳單拿給Chuckles看。他讀過後，臉色變得擔憂起來。在你來得及拿回之前，他將其撕成碎片，並塞進嘴裡。

source_en: He swallows the pieces and his demeanor changes to a mischevious one once more. @Didst thou enjoy the vanishing act?@
text_zh: 他吞下碎片，態度再度變得調皮起來。@你喜歡這個消失術嗎？@

source_en: @I knew ye had it in ye, Avatar! Now, take his wretched remains to be cremated, lest his spirit be reunited with his body.@
text_zh: @我知道你辦得到，聖者！現在，帶著他那可惡的遺體去火化，以免他的靈魂與肉體重新結合。@

source_en: Chuckle's carefree demeanor changes to one of concern when you ask him of 'Lucy'.
text_zh: 當你問起「Lucy」時，恰克爾無憂無慮的態度轉為擔憂。

source_en: You tell Chuckles that you know what happened to Lucy, and his association with Drudgeworth.
text_zh: 你告訴Chuckles，你知道Lucy的遭遇，以及他與Drudgeworth之間的關聯。
