source_en: Chuckles falls to his knees, putting his face in his hands. @I confess, Avatar! She was my only confidant during such troubling times...I don't know what happened to her.. she was fine one minute and then...@
text_zh: Chuckles跪倒在地，雙手掩面。@我認罪，聖者！在如此動盪的時期，她是唯一傾訴衷腸的人...我不知道她發生了什麼事..前一秒還好好的，然後就...@

source_en: Chuckles chokes up for a moment. @I didn't mean to kill her, Avatar, honest! I don't know what happened. I couldn't let this secret get out.@
text_zh: Chuckles哽咽了一下。@聖者，老實說，我並非故意殺了她！我不知道發生了什麼。我不能讓這個祕密泄露出去。@

source_en: @Drudgeworth offered to help me hide her body until I figured out a way to bring her to a healer. He meant to blackmail me!@
text_zh: @Drudgeworth提出幫我藏起她的屍體，直到我找到辦法送她去見醫者為止。他企圖勒索我！@

source_en: @I admit, I tried to cover it all up. Our liege still doesn't know, and I wouldst like to keep it that way. I am ashamed of my behavior..@
text_zh: @我承認，我試圖掩蓋一切。我們的主人至今不知情，我希望保持這種狀態。我對自己的行為感到羞恥..@

source_en: A mysterious gypsy woman wearing an ankh pendant.
text_zh: 一位佩戴安卡項鍊的神祕吉普賽女子。

source_en: @You are the Avatar. I had a vision that you would come to seek aid from me.@
text_zh: @你是聖者。我曾預見你會來向我尋求幫助。@

source_en: @Some know me as Taynith. That is what you may call me.@*
text_zh: @有些人稱我為Taynith。你可以這樣稱呼我。@*

source_en: @Seek not my true name. Let 'Taynith' suffice.@*
text_zh: @不必探尋我的真名。稱呼我『Taynith』即可。@*

source_en: @Captain Johne? Yes, he brought us a silver tablet some time ago, to deliver to the Lycaeum.@*
text_zh: @Captain Johne嗎？是的，他前些時候送來一塊銀板，要交給Lycaeum。@*

source_en: @Zoltan took care of the deal, so he could tell you more than I@*
text_zh: @Zoltan處理了這樁交易，所以他能告訴你的比我多@*

source_en: @King of the gypsies, sure as my name's Taynith.@*
text_zh: @吉普賽人的王，沒錯，我的名字就是Taynith。@*

source_en: @My path leads to Paws, as soon as I have time to visit there.@*
text_zh: @我的旅程將前往Paws，只要我有時間去那裡。@*

source_en: @My good friend Dr. Cat lives there.@*

text_zh: @有空時去問問他關於那隻鴨子的事。@*

source_en: @Zoltan can tell you where it is.@*
@My advice will cost you two gold. Do you still want it?@*
text_zh: @我的建議將收取你兩枚金幣。你還想要嗎？@*

source_en: @Look through the books at the Lycaeum. You might learn something useful there.@
text_zh: @看看Lycaeum的書吧。也許你在那裡能學到些有用的東西。@

source_en: @I charge six gold to cast my tiles. Are you interested?@*
text_zh: @我擲運命卦收取六枚金幣。你有興趣嗎？@*

source_en: From the folds of her cloak, she withdraws a velvet pouch.*
text_zh: 從她的斗篷褶皺中，她取出一個絲絨袋。*

source_en: After shaking it gently, she casts forth three small squares of ivory, each with an image etched into its surface and a title at the bottom.*
text_zh: 輕輕搖晃後，她拋出了三塊小象牙片，每塊表面都刻有圖像，底部標有標題。*

source_en: @I have no time for those who are cruel to animals.@
text_zh: @我沒時間理會那些殘害動物的人。@

source_en: Taynith says: @There is something made of glass that plays a very important role in your future, but the signs are unclear. Seek out Penumbra. Her crystal ball should hold more of an affinity for this item. If you pay her enough, she can tell you more than I.@
text_zh: Taynith 說：@有一樣玻璃製成的東西在你的未來中扮演著極其重要的角色，但徵兆不明確。去尋找 Penumbra。她的水晶球應該更適合預測這件物品。如果你付給她足夠的錢，她能告訴我更多。@

source_en: Taynith says: @This is strange. The tiles show that to accomplish your ends, you must go down very far, then up very far, but you will not end up back where you started. The 'Maelstrom' indicates something important as well, but I cannot determine what it means.@
text_zh: Taynith 說：@這很詭異。骨牌顯示，為了達成你的目標，你必須先深入極底，再登上極高，但最終不會回到起點。'Maelstrom' 也暗示著某種重要意義，但我無法確定其含義。@

source_en: @The 'War' tile is particularly striking. It depicts a dragon and a tiger, each about to bite the others tail.@ Taynith says: @Britannia is on a path towards all out war, that is plain enough. The 'Rogue' is one who would go against the wishes of his Lord to find another path.@
text_zh: @'War' 骨牌尤其引人注目。它描繪了一條龍和一隻老虎，即將各自咬住對方的尾巴。@ Taynith 說：@Britannia 正走向全面戰爭，這再明白不過了。'Rogue' 是那些違背其領主意願，尋找另一條道路的人。@

source_en: @My chances to visit Dr. Cat come all too seldom.  Seek me out later and I will speak with you.@
text_zh: @我探望 Dr. Cat 的機會總是少之又少。稍後再來找我，我將與你詳談。@

source_en: Taynith frowns. @I cannot interpret this pattern. I'm afraid you'll have to seek its meaning on your own.@
text_zh: Taynith 皺起眉頭。@我無法解讀這個圖案。恐怕你必須自己去尋找其中的意義。@

source_en: Taynith says: @All of these things and more must you be to find success in your quest.@
text_zh: Taynith 說：@要在今後的探險中取得成功，你必須具備這些特質以及更多。@

source_en: @If you consult the tiles another time, perhaps they will have more to say of your future.@
text_zh: @如果你再次諮詢骨牌，也許它們會對你的未來說得更多。@

source_en: @I sense that you have met her already. There is no need for me to direct you there.@
text_zh: @我感覺你已經見過她了。我不必再指引你去那裡。@

source_en: @A gorgio - that's almost as good as being a gypsy!@*
text_zh: @個 gorgio——這幾乎就跟是個吉普賽人一樣！@*

source_en: @Our paths will cross again. I have foreseen it.@
text_zh: @我們的路再次交匯了。我早已預見到。@

source_en: @Anything else I can do for you?
The man looks up from his cooking. @Aye, hello there. 'Fraid I can't talk now. I have to cook tomorrow's lunch.@*
text_zh: 那人從烹飪中抬起頭。啊，你好。恐怕現在沒辦法聊天。我得準備明天的午餐。*

source_en: The man looks up from his cooking. @Aye, hello there. 'Fraid I can't talk now. I have to cook tonight's supper.@*
text_zh: 那人從烹飪中抬起頭。啊，你好。恐怕現在沒辦法聊天。我得準備今晚的晚餐。*

source_en: @Come back when it's ready and have some!@
@I sell rolls, ale, mead, wine, mutton, and rations.@
text_zh: 我賣麵包卷、麥酒、蜂蜜酒、葡萄酒、羊肉和口糧。

source_en: @I sell rolls, ale, mead, wine, mutton, and rations@
text_zh: 我賣麵包卷、麥酒、蜂蜜酒、葡萄酒、羊肉和口糧

source_en: @Come back when you have some gold@
@You don't have room to carry it.@
text_zh: 你的隨身空間不夠，無法攜帶它。

source_en: @Very well. Anything else I can do for you?@
text_zh: 非常好。還有其他我能為你所做的嗎？

source_en: He hands you a mug for a swallow. It is warmed mead, sweet and bubbly, with a cinnamon stick in it. @Comes from Verity Isle@, he says.
text_zh: 他遞給你一杯喝一口。那是溫熱的蜂蜜酒，甜美冒泡，裡面有一根肉桂棒。「來自 Verity Isle」，他說。

source_en: @Not a mead drinker, I guess.@ He shrugs.
text_zh: @不喝蜜酒啊，我猜也是。@他聳了聳肩。

source_en: @Some day I hope to join Zellivan's Stalwarts and be a guard.@
text_zh: @有一天我希望加入Zellivan的堅勇隊，成為一名衛兵。@

source_en: @It's mostly made of honey. Ask a brewer.@
text_zh: @主要是用蜂蜜做的。去問問釀酒師吧。@

source_en: @When that last earthquake struck, I was pinned 'neath a great tree branch. Lord Zellivan himself hoisted it up while a guard pulled me clear.@
text_zh: @上次那場大地震時，我被壓在一根巨大的樹枝下。領主Zellivan親自舉起樹枝，一名衛兵把我拉了出來。@

source_en: @It was a rat, as sure as the world is flat. Darndest thing, too. Nomaan dropped the rune and the rat took it into a little hole.@
text_zh: @那是一隻老鼠，千真萬確。太離奇了。Nomaan放過了法符，老鼠就把它拖進了一個小洞裡。@

source_en: @It's right there. On the north wall. See it?@
. Ye will see it if ye keep on looking.@
text_zh: 。只要一直看，你們就會看見的。@

source_en: Shamino points to a spot west of the bar where the wall meets the ground. @There it is.@
text_zh: Shamino指向酒吧西側牆面與地面交接處的一個點。@在那裡。@

source_en: @It's in the refrain of the song.@
@Well, I'd rather not sing alone. Get Culham to play it.@
text_zh: @嗯，我寧願不獨自演唱。叫Culham來彈奏吧。@

source_en: A slender man with boots that come up to his thighs.
text_zh: 一個身材修長的男子，穿著高至大腿的長靴。

source_en: @Don't you know it's rude to interrupt a man when he's brawling?@
text_zh: 你不知道男人廝殺時插嘴是很無禮的嗎？

source_en: @Care to join me in a drink?@
@I used to sell ships. But you bought them all!@
text_zh: 我以前賣船的。但你把船都買光了！

source_en: @My father was a sailor, but couldn't spell. He laughs out loud.@
text_zh: 我父親是水手，但不識字。他開心得大笑起來。
你買了我的最後一艘船！

source_en: @It'll cost you 200 gold for the deed.  Interested?@
text_zh: 產權證要 200 金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting the gold, Peer hands you the deed.
text_zh: 很好！接過金幣後，Peer 將產權證交給你。
你找不到比這更好的船了。

source_en: @So long friend.@ He lumbers back to his work.
text_zh: 再見，朋友。他蹣跚著走回工作崗位。

source_en: A tall, muscled man with a wide grin.
text_zh: 一個身材高大、肌肉發達、咧嘴微笑的男人。

source_en: @Hello,@ he says, lumbering over to you and extending a large hand.@
text_zh: @你好，@他說道，拖着步子向你走來，伸出一只大手。@

source_en: He squints at you. @We've met, haven't we?@
text_zh: 他眯起眼睛看着你。@我們以前見過面吧？@

source_en: @Haf a good journey and come back sometime!@
@Where is the key? Please return it.@
@Very vel, come back when you're ready to check out.@
text_zh: @很好，等你准備好退房時再回來吧。@
一個快活、滿臉通紅的旅店老板。

source_en: @Vat can I be doing for thee this
text_zh: @今天有什麼我能爲你效勞的

source_en: @Mine name ist Martin, but my friends call me Dutch.@
text_zh: @我的名字是Martin，但朋友們都叫我Dutch。@

source_en: @Come back tomorrow when de inn ist open!@
@Room und board ist 5 gold per night per person. Interested?@
text_zh: 每間房每夜每人5個金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: @Your room ist to de south. See me in de morning for breakfast before checkout!@
text_zh: 你的房間在南邊。退房前早上來找我吃早餐！

source_en: @Ach, I'm sorry, but I must haf my
text_zh: 啊，抱歉，但我必須保留我的

source_en: @Come back ven fortune makes you rich, ah?@
text_zh: 回頭運氣好賺了大錢再回來吧，哈？

source_en: Martin serves you a huge, tasty breakfast.*
text_zh: Martin 為你端上一大盤美味的早餐。*

source_en: @A good breakfast is the beginning of a good day!@ he cries.
text_zh: 「良好的早餐是一天良好的開始！」他喊道。

source_en: You give Martin back the room key.
@I'm pretending to be a beggar. That way nobody will suspect who I really am. Here, give me a few coins to keep anyone from getting suspicious.@
text_zh: 我在裝扮成乞丐。這樣沒人會懷疑我真正的身份。給，給我幾個錢，免得別人起疑。

source_en: Do you give him any money?
He takes the money. @Good. I'll get this back to you later.@
text_zh: 他接過了錢。「好的。我晚點會把錢還給你。」

source_en: You don't have that much money.
@Broke, are you? Well, come by after I'm done with this disguise, and I'll give you a loan from the royal treasury.@
text_zh: 沒錢了？好吧，等我卸裝後再來，我會從皇家金庫借點錢給你。

source_en: @Very convincing, don't you think? I made it myself.@
text_zh: 很逼真，你說是不是？我自己做的。

source_en: @Of course, nobody would dare say anything bad about me to my face. Nobody except Chuckles, anyway.@
text_zh: 當然，沒人敢當著我的面說我的壞話。除了 Chuckles，誰都不會這樣做。

source_en: @But as a beggar, people will tell me just about anything!@
text_zh: 但作為乞丐，人們會告訴我幾乎任何事情！

source_en: @He's in disguise too, you know. He's really Blackthorn.@
text_zh: 你可知他也在變裝。他其實是 Blackthorn。

source_en: @I decided banishment was too harsh for him, so I brought him back and made him my jester. The real Chuckles is tied up in my dungeons. I got tired of him making fun of my nose.@
text_zh: @我覺得放逐他太嚴厲了，所以把他帶回來，讓他當我的弄臣。真正的 Chuckles 被綁在我的地牢裡。我受夠他嘲笑我的鼻子了。@

source_en: @I'm Lord British, and I can do whatever I want to!@
text_zh: @我是 Lord British，我想做什麼就做什麼！@

source_en: @I've got forty million crowns. Not to mention my secret bank accounts.@
text_zh: @我有四千萬個王冠幣。更不用說我的祕密銀行賬戶了。@

source_en: @I told you not to mention that!@
He glances around quickly, to see if anyone seems to be listening.
text_zh: 他快速地環顧四周，看看是否有人在偷聽。

source_en: @I'm really Lord British. I can prove it to you. I know all of the eight mantras, and where the runes are, too!@
text_zh: @我真的是 Lord British。我可以證明給你看的。我認識所有的八句真言，還知道符文的所在！@

source_en: @I killed a dragon when I was eight, you know. With my bare hands, too!@
text_zh: @你知道的，我八歲的時候就殺了一條龍。而且還是用手殺的！

source_en: @He was a big one - but he hadn't reckoned with the likes of me. I was a tough kid.@
text_zh: @它很大——但它沒料到像我這樣的人。我很強壯。@

source_en: @I was so tough he couldn't chew me, and he had to spit me out. That's when I killed him.@
text_zh: @我太強壯了，它咬不動我，只好把我吐出來。那就是我殺了它的時候。@

source_en: @Ok, here are the mantras: justice - do,  compassion - re@
text_zh: @好吧，這是真言：正義 - do， 慈悲 - re@
@...靈性 - so，謙虛 - la，犧牲 - ti...@

source_en: @Gosh, wouldn't you know it? The Mantra of Honesty slips my mind at the moment...@
text_zh: @天啊，真是的？誠實的真言我現在想不起來了...@

source_en: @I'll tell you this, because you look like someone who can keep a secret.@
text_zh: @我告訴你吧，因為你看起來像是個能保守祕密的人。@

source_en: @I sent out eight fake runes to all the lords, to fool everybody. I put all the real ones in a little box, and hid it under my throne.@
text_zh: @我派出了八個假符文給所有的大人，來愚弄大家。我把所有真符文放在一個小盒子裡，藏在我的王座下面。@

source_en: @You can't see it there, because I turned it invisible!@
text_zh: @你在那裡看不到它，因為我把它隱形了！

source_en: @A clever trick, or am I not Finn!@
text_zh: @聰明的一招，不然我還不是 Finn ！@

source_en: @Oh, that's just the name I'm pretending to go by. Of course you know I'm really Lord British. I can see you're too smart to be fooled by this disguise.@
text_zh: @哎呀，那不過是我最喜歡假裝使用的名字。你當然知道，我真正的身份是 Lord British。我看你的聰明才智，應該不會被我的偽裝所欺騙吧。@

source_en: @I'm Lord British. But don't tell anyone. I'm in disguise so I can mingle with the commoners.@
text_zh: @我是 Lord British。但別告訴任何人。我穿著便服，以便與百姓們混在一起。@

source_en: @If you need me later, I'll be at the Blue Boar, disguised as the tavernkeeper. But I won't admit to it there if you ask me... Too many people that might hear.@
text_zh: @如果你之後需要我，我會去 Blue Boar，裝作是酒館的店小二。但如果你在那裡問我 我是絕不會承認的... 那裡太多人可能會聽見了。@

source_en: You see Shamino smiling - an unusual sight.
text_zh: 你看到 Shamino 在微笑——這可是很少見的景象。

source_en: Noticing your attention, he says @Perhaps there's a little of Lord British in us all.@
text_zh: 察覺到你在注視他，他說：@或許我們每個人身上，都有點 Lord British 的影子吧。@

source_en: A sly looking fellow, dressed in rags.
text_zh: 一個眼神狡猾的男子，穿著破爛不堪。

source_en: A small man in a handsome vest made of seashells.
text_zh: 一個矮小的男子，穿著一件用貝殼製成的漂亮背心。

source_en: Avatar. Let me tell ye a tale.@
text_zh: 聖者。讓我給你講個故事吧。@

source_en: . Let me tell ye a tale.@
. Have I told ye the one about the gypsies?@
text_zh: 。我跟你講過關於吉普賽人的那個故事了嗎？@

source_en: @When spirits be low, I play tunes to bring cheer.@
text_zh: @當人們心情低落時，我就彈奏音樂來讓他們開心起來。@

source_en: @Once I heard a haunting melody...in Old Magincia.@ He laughs.
text_zh: @有一次我聽到一首縈繞耳畔的旋律...就在舊Magincia。@ 他大笑起來。

source_en: @Well, it used to be a ghost town.@ He laughs and plays a little tune on his lute.
text_zh: @嗯，那裡曾經是個鬼城。@ 他邊笑邊撥動魯特琴彈起一段小調。

source_en: @The Mantra of Valour bringeth great cheer.@
text_zh: @勇者的禱詞帶來巨大的鼓舞。@

source_en: @I'm not a great singer, but I love to play a song of valor. It makes me sing.@
text_zh: @我不是個出色的歌手，但我熱愛演奏英勇之歌。這讓我忍不住想唱。@

source_en: The pub is filled with the sound of singing.
@It seemed like such an easy climb. I crawled upon the Serpent's Spine.@
text_zh: @那看起來似乎是個容易攀爬的地方。我爬上了巨蛇之脊。@

source_en: @I hadn't even time to blanch. When down there came an avalanche!@*
text_zh: @我甚至沒來得及變白。底下突然降下一場雪崩！@*

source_en: @And then my mantra came to mind. 'Tho boulders bounced and passed with speed. My frozen fingers gripped to rock. As sliding snow swept loose my feet.@
text_zh: 然後我的口訣浮現於腦海。‘儘管岩石飛躍且迅速掠過。我凍僵的手指緊抓岩壁。當滑落的白雪帶走我的雙腳。’

source_en: @'Tis a song to make thee strong. When the mountains be high. And the ground be far...Sing 'ra,' my friends, sing 'ra'!@
text_zh: 這是一首能讓你變強的歌曲。當山巒高聳，地面遙遠時...唱‘Ra’吧，朋友們，唱‘Ra’吧！

source_en: @Ah, yes. That's quite a story, too. Naughty Nomaan dropped the Rune of Valor, and the rat carried it off.@
text_zh: 啊，是的。那也是一個不錯的故事故。調皮的 Nomaan 弄丟了勇氣符文，而被一隻老鼠叼走了。
他大聲狂笑——笑得太響了。

source_en: Stelnar and Jerris begin to argue over whether it was a rat or a mouse. Once again a brawl breaks out!
text_zh: Stelnar 和 Jerris 開始爭論那是老鼠還是小家鼠。又是一場鬥打爆發了！
不！那是小家鼠！我親眼看見了！
你們這幫蠢貨，去外面打吧！

source_en: @Would ye really like to hear a story?@
@I call this story...Arturosis. Two gypsies come to Trinsic, hungry as usual.@*
text_zh: 我稱這個故事為...Arturosis。兩個吉普賽人來到 Trinsic，照例餓得發慌。*

source_en: @One goes out and gathers a poisonous weed from the swamps. The other sneaks into town and puts the plant into the trough of a horse.@
text_zh: ＠一個人出去，從沼澤地採摘一種有毒的雜草。另一個人潛入城鎮，將植物塞進一匹馬的水槽裡。＠

source_en: @Well, poor horse doesn't know better. He eats the stuff, swells up and takes ill. The owner, Immanuelle, doesn't know what to do.@
text_zh: ＠唉，可憐的馬兒不知道厲害。牠吃下了那些東西，全身腫脹，病的很重。馬的主人，Immanuelle，不知道該怎麼辦。＠

source_en: @Along come the gypsies. 'Aiee!' they cry. 'Yonder nag hath contracted 'Arturosis.' Unless it be immediately removed, the rest shall catch the same fatal disease.@
text_zh: ＠接著吉普賽人來了。「哎呀！」他們叫道。「那匹老馬感染了『Arturosis』。除非立刻把它移走，否則其他的馬也會染上這致命的疾病。＠
＠現在是決戰的時候，閒話留待以後再說。＠

source_en: @Immanuelle decides to sacrifice the diseased one and the gypsies agree heartily. 'For but a few coins,' say the gypsies,' we will lead it away and bury it far from here.'@*
text_zh: ＠Immanuelle 決定犧牲這匹病馬，吉普賽人也熱衷地附和。「只要幾枚硬幣，」吉普賽人說，「我們就會把它帶走， bury 在遠處。」＠*

source_en: @Immanuelle is too happy to hand them the doomed animal's bridle, plus ten coins.@
text_zh: ＠Immanuelle 非常高興地把這匹厄運之馬的馬籠頭交給他們，外加十枚硬幣。＠

source_en: @So the gypsies make a great kettle of horse stew and bury the rest. A great feast is held 'mongst gypsykind. Meanwhile, Immanuelle thanks virtue that the equine epidemic was caught early on!@
text_zh: ＠於是吉普賽人煮了一大鍋馬肉燉菜，剩下的部分 bury 起來。吉普賽人中間舉行了一場盛大的宴席。與此同時，Immanuelle 感激德性，因為馬瘟疫被及早發現了！＠

source_en: @Well, not everyone likes gypsy tales, I suppose.@
text_zh: ＠嗯，我想不是每個人喜歡聽吉普賽人的故事吧。＠

source_en: @Sometimes the bees in my head almost drive me mad!@
text_zh: ＠有時候，頭裡的蜜蜂幾乎要讓我瘋了！＠

source_en: @A clever ploy, pretending to be friendly...@*
text_zh: ＠裝作友好，真是個聰明的計謀...＠*

source_en: @But if I told you my name was Bonn, then you could work foul magic to destroy my mind...@
text_zh: ＠但如果我告訴你我叫 Bonn，那你就可以施展邪惡的魔法來摧毀我的精神...＠

source_en: @I have no job, nor shoes, nor any such thing.@*
text_zh: ＠我既沒有工作，也沒有鞋子，更沒有其他什麼東西。＠*

source_en: @But I've learned from my misfortune, learned never to trust anyone, let alone to love..@
text_zh: @但我從不幸中汲取了教訓，學會了絕不信任何人，更別提去愛了..@

source_en: @Who told you that? Alas, I am undone! I must flee!@
text_zh: @誰告訴你的？可憐，我完了！我必須逃！@

source_en: @I threw my shoes into the sea when I saw you coming!@
text_zh: @我看見你走來，就把鞋子扔進海裡了！@

source_en: @My shoes will be very happy there, dancing with the fishies!@
text_zh: @我的鞋子在那裡會很開心，和魚兒們跳舞！@

source_en: @I trusted Hawkins once, and it led to nothing but despair.@
text_zh: @我曾經信任Hawkins，結果除了絕望一無所獲。@

source_en: @Oh how I envy him his peaceful sleep!@
text_zh: @我真羨慕他能享有安寧的睡眠！@

source_en: @Death's embrace is the only true comfort a man can find in this world.@
text_zh: @死亡的擁抱是這個世界上人唯一能找到的真確慰藉。@

source_en: @A good chair is worth a thousand bumberchutes.@
text_zh: @一把好椅子比一千個bumberchute還值錢。@

source_en: @Flat as a pancake, and twice as tasty!@
text_zh: @像鬆餅一樣平坦，還好吃一倍！@

source_en: @Who told you about those? It's supposed to be a secret!@
@Love is a slippery sled that flips over and pins you to the slope.@*
text_zh: @愛是一種滑溜的滑板，會翻過來把你壓在坡上。@*

source_en: @And then, at night, the ice weasels come.@
text_zh: @然後，到了夜裡，冰鼬就會出現。@
@如果你幸運的話，它們會殺了你！@

source_en: @By the time you find out, it will be too late!@
text_zh: @等你找到的時候，就來不及了！@

source_en: @The buzzing, they're always buzzing in my head.@
text_zh: @嗡嗡聲，它們一直在我的頭裡嗡嗡響。@

source_en: @I can help you! I'm the only sane one left.@
text_zh: @我可以幫助你！我是唯一神志清醒的人。@

source_en: @Go to the Shrine of Honesty, and stand just to the east of it.@*
text_zh: @去 Shrine of Honesty，站在它東邊一點的地方。@*

source_en: @Take 3 steps north, 2 steps west, 5 steps south, and 4 steps east.@*
text_zh: @向北走3步，向西走2步，向南走5步，再向東走4步。@*

source_en: @Then eat some grapes, and all will become clear to you!@
text_zh: @然後吃些葡萄，一切就會變得清晰了！@

source_en: @They'll dance a waltz, I doubt it not!@
text_zh: @它們會跳圓舞曲，我深信不疑！@
他開始歇斯底里地大笑。

source_en: A strange light comes into his eyes.
text_zh: 一種奇怪的光芒進入他的眼睛。

source_en: @The map? The secret treasure map? I still have it, right here in my house. Do you want it?@
text_zh: @地圖？祕密寶藏地圖？我還有它，就在我的房子裡。你要嗎？@

source_en: @Too bad! I've hidden it well, and it will go to my grave with me! I'll die all the better for still having it!@
text_zh: @太可惜了！我藏得很緊，它會隨我入土！我帶著它死會死得更痛快！@

source_en: @I lived on the sea, and I'll die not far from it. Then my basement can be my tomb.@
text_zh: @我住在海邊，也會死在離海不遠的地方。那麼我的地下室就可以成為我的墳墓。@

source_en: @Too well hidden for the likes of you to find!@
text_zh: @藏得太好了，像你們這樣的人找不到的！@

source_en: @Farewell, sweet enemy. I love you more than my own death!@
text_zh: @再見，甜蜜的敵人。我愛你勝過愛我的死亡！@
一個身材矮小、赤腳的瘋子。*

source_en: @At last! I knew you'd come to steal my shoes someday! But I was too smart for you!@*
text_zh: @總算來了！我就知道你會有一天來偷我的鞋子的！但我比你想的聰明多了！@*

source_en: She is quick, and never spills a drop of ale.
text_zh: 她動作敏捷，倒酒時從不灑出一滴。

source_en: @It's Lyssandra, but ye can call me Andy.@*
text_zh: @我是 Lyssandra，但你也可以叫我 Andy。@*

source_en: @I know 'tis a boy's name, but I like it all the same..@
text_zh: 我知道那是男孩的名字，但我還是喜歡它..

source_en: @Sometimes 'tis rough here but I doesn't mind. Some day I'll be a fighter, ye know.@*
text_zh: 這裡有時很粗野，但我並不介意。你知道的，有一天我會成為一名戰士。*

source_en: @The fighting here usually begins over--@ Her voice drops to a whisper, @--the rat!@
text_zh: 這裡的鬥毆通常都因為老鼠而起，她的聲音壓低了，因為老鼠！

source_en: @Around sunset things get really rowdy here!@
text_zh: 夕陽西下時，這裡就會變得非常喧鬧！

source_en: @Shhh!@ She glances about to see if you have been overheard.
text_zh: 噓！她四下張望，看看你是否被人聽到了。

source_en: @See yon hole in the north wall? Look carefully at where floor and wall meet. That's where it took the rune!@
text_zh: 看北牆上那個洞？仔細看看地板和牆壁交界的地方。那裡就是它吞掉符文的地方！

source_en: @They tried all manner of tricks to get it out but they all failed.@*
text_zh: 他們試了各種方法想把它弄出來，但全都失敗了。*

source_en: @I had an idea, but nobody listened to me.@
text_zh: 我有一個主意，但沒有人聽我的。

source_en: @Do ye know of the talking mouse? Lord British's friend?@
text_zh: 你認識會說話的老鼠嗎？布里特男爵的朋友？ Lord British

source_en: @A mouse could get the rune, of that I'm sure!@
text_zh: 老鼠絕對可以拿到符文，我敢肯定！

source_en: @Well, ye would think it was a dumb idea anyways...@
text_zh: 反正，你一定會覺得這是個笨主意吧...

source_en: @I know how to get it from the you-know-what.@
text_zh: 我知道怎麼從「那個你知道的傢伙」那裡拿到它。

source_en: @The rat,@ she whispers conspiratorially to you.
text_zh: 「老鼠，」她神祕兮兮地對你低聲說。

source_en: @Culham has oft sung of it, with Jerris and Starhelm.@
text_zh: 庫拉姆常常提到他，還有Jerris和Starhelm。 Culham

source_en: @His real name is Stelnar. He would be much nicer if he were not so angry all the time.@
text_zh: 他的真名是Stelnar。如果他沒有一直那麼生氣，人會好相處得多了。

source_en: A girl of perhaps twelve years.*
text_zh: 一個大約十二歲的女孩。*

source_en: @He is brave when fighting, but he is afraid to sing by himself.@
text_zh: 他戰鬥時很勇敢，但他不敢獨自唱歌。

source_en: @Bye-bye, It was nice talking to you.@
She is agile, and balances trays of mugs deftly on each hand.
text_zh: 她很靈活，雙手熟練地托著滿盤的杯子。

source_en: It is a wonder how she can duck the hurled debris and avoid the flying fists.
text_zh: 真不知道她是如何躲開飛來的雜物和拳頭的。

source_en: @Bit of a brawl going on just now. Be glad to talk to you some other time.@
text_zh: 現在正有一場小打鬥。希望改天再跟你說話。

source_en: A man dressed in velvets and silks of yellow, green and blue. His voice is rich and mellow.
text_zh: 一個穿著黃、綠、藍三色天鵝絨和絲綢的男子。他的聲音低沉醇厚。

source_en: @I am the bard Van Kellian. Please, speak your name,
text_zh: 我是吟遊詩人Van Kellian。請報上您的大名，

source_en: @Why, singing is my trade. Songs to soothe the soul and refresh the mind. Shall I sing for ye?@
text_zh: 嗯哼，歌唱就是我的本業。用歌聲撫慰靈魂，用旋律刷新心智。要聽我唱一曲嗎？

source_en: Iolo rolls his eyes and whispers to you. @He believes he does us a favor. This I must hear.@
text_zh: Iolo 翻了個白眼，低聲對你說道。 @他覺得這樣是在幫我們一個忙。這話我必須聽聽看。@

source_en: The bard plays a harp and sings.*
text_zh: 吟遊詩人撥動里拉琴，唱起了歌。*

source_en: @Tho' she disdains to speak to me. Ah how I pine and sigh for her. I would that I were handsome- o Sing ho eyo he hum!@
text_zh: 雖然她吝於對我吐露心聲。唉，我為她苦苦相思。若我能英俊些該多好——啊，唱吧，Eyo He Hum！

source_en: @'Tis such a topsy-turvy world. When my sweet lady-love whirls by. I would that I could catch her eye. Sing ho eyo he hum!@
text_zh: 這世界真是天翻地覆。當我那甜美的情人旋身而過，我希望能捕捉到她眼中的光芒。唱吧，Eyo He Hum！
別把我的里拉琴弄壞了！

source_en: @Did ye know that the mantra of pride is 'mul?' A beggar told me that.@
text_zh: 你知道驕傲的口訣是 'mul' 嗎？有個乞丐告訴我的。

source_en: @There is little enough dignity in the life of a beggar. I gave him a few coins, of course.@
text_zh: 乞丐的生活 hardly 有什麼尊嚴可言。當然是給了他幾枚銅幣。

source_en: @Starhelm and I have often debated the nature of the gargoyle Sin 'Vraal.@
text_zh: 我和 Starhelm 經常討論石像鬼 Sin 'Vraal 的本質。

source_en: @If Lord British suffers him to live, then I will not harm him. What possible threat could one gargoyle living alone in the Dry Lands be?@
text_zh: 如果 Lord British 容許它生存，我便不會傷害它。一隻獨自生活在乾旱之地的石像鬼，能有什麼威脅呢？

source_en: Stelnar says @I'll tell ye, Van. If ye let one gargoyle live, then ye'll be tempted to spare trolls, and then even cyclopses. And then ye forget valor, and soon ye are overrun by monsters!@
text_zh: Stelnar 說： @我告訴你，Van。如果你放過一隻石像鬼，接下來你也會放過巨魔，然後甚至是獨眼巨人。到那時，你會遺忘勇氣，很快就會被怪物席捲！@

source_en: @Valour comes from the courage to be virtuous. Just as compassion comes from a love of all mankind.@
text_zh: 勇氣源於行善的膽識。正如仁慈源於對所有人的愛。

source_en: @Aha! That means monsters are not deserving of mercy!@ says Stelnar
text_zh: @哈！這意味著怪物不配得到仁慈！@ Stelnar 說道
勇氣在增長。愛為何不行？

source_en: @Well, I hear their skin is stony and rough. Their cries are fierce yowlings to make the blood run cold with fear.@
text_zh: 不過我聽說它們的皮膚石般粗糙。它們的吼叫如野獸嘶吼，令人血液凍結。

source_en: @Though, mind ye, I myself have never faced one in combat.@
text_zh: 不過，請原諒，我本人從未與之一戰。

source_en: He glances behind himself and ducks, as if expecting someone to throw something at him.
text_zh: 他回頭看了看，縮了縮身子，好像怕有人朝他扔東西。

source_en: An angry-looking man wearing short swords on either hip.
text_zh: 一名面帶怒容的男子，兩側腰際各掛著一把短劍。

source_en: , Stelnar.@ Shamino and Stelnar shake hands.

text_zh: 阿文？他看起來是個好人。 Arvin

source_en: @He's a bard. I do not really know him.@
text_zh: 他是位吟遊詩人。我不太認識他。

source_en: @Shamino and I travelled the Spiritwood together for a time.@
text_zh: Shamino和我也曾在Spiritwood一起旅行過一段時間。

source_en: @I hate all monsters. They are a blight on the face of Britannia! For the past year I've been killing wisps and the like in Spiritwood.@
text_zh: @我恨透所有的怪物。它們是 Britannia 的禍害！過去一年來，我一直在 Spiritwood 消滅 wisps 之類的東西。@

source_en: @Wisps are nasty flickers, very hard to kill. Not like gargoyles, now.@
text_zh: @Wisps 是很詭譎的閃爍光點，很難殺死。現在可不是石像鬼那樣。@

source_en: @There's one that they call Sin 'Vraal. If I had my way, that gargoyle would be a statue.@
text_zh: 有一隻被稱為罪弗拉爾的石像鬼。要是聽我的，它早該變成雕像了。

source_en: @They turn to stone when ye slay them.@
text_zh: 殺死牠們時，牠們會變成石頭。

source_en: @That's drivel, friend Starhelm!@ says Van Kellian.
@A gargoyle's a flesh and blood beast. Stone indeed!@
text_zh: 石像鬼是有血有肉的野獸。確實像石頭一樣硬！
像個男人一樣戰鬥吧，你這膽小鬼！

source_en: @Bards! A gargoyle is an ugly monster, and that's that.@
text_zh: 吟遊詩人！石像鬼是醜陋的怪物，就這樣。

source_en: @Gargoyle skin is very thick and deep, as everyone knows.@
text_zh: 石像鬼的皮很厚很深，人人都知道。
絕不要相信任何醜陋的東西。

source_en: Van murmurs @Ugliness is but skin deep, just as beauty is.@
text_zh: 范低聲說：“醜陋不過是皮膚深淺的問題，正如美麗一樣。”

source_en: @Yes, Sin 'Vraal is an evil wretch. How could Lord British imagine that a gargoyle could understand virtue?@
text_zh: 是的，罪弗拉爾是個邪惡的傢伙。Lord British怎麼能認為石像鬼能理解美德呢？

source_en: @Lord British defeated Sin 'Vraal in the underworld. The gargoyle went to live in the Drylands.@
text_zh: Lord British在下界擊敗了罪弗拉爾。石像鬼便去荒原居住了。 Drylands

source_en: @Tis a desert east of the Bloody Plains. There is a shrine there.@
text_zh: 那是Bloody Plains以東的一片沙漠。那裡有一座神龕。

source_en: @I've never been to that desert, or the Shrine of Sacrifice.@
text_zh: 我從沒去過那片沙漠，或是獻祭神龕。 Shrine of Sacrifice

source_en: He was just about to punch someone when you approached him. @This is no time for talk. There's fighting to do!@
text_zh: 他正要揍人，你就湊了過來。現在可不是說話的時候。我們得打起來！
那是一隻老鼠，你個混蛋！

source_en: @Excellent!@ Nomaan takes your gold and hands over the
text_zh: 很好！Nomaan收下你的金子，並交給你

source_en: @Can't you see there's a lovely brawl going on? Talk to me tomorrow.@
text_zh: @你沒看到那邊有一場精彩的混戰嗎？明天再來跟我說話吧。@

source_en: @I am Nomaan. What is thy name,
@What else can I help thee with?@
@I run the armoury, buying and selling weapons.@
text_zh: @我經營這家軍械店，買賣武器。@

source_en: @Come back to my shop when its open.@*
@'Tis just a nickname, of course. You see a hint of a smile on his face.@
text_zh: @當然只是綽號。你看到他臉上露出一絲微笑。@

source_en: @I won a rune in a tournament once. 'Tis gone now, though - and there's a fine tale about it!@
text_zh: @我曾經在錦標賽中贏了一枚符文。不過現在它已經不見了——關于這件事有一段精彩的故事！@

source_en: @I remember it as if it were yesterday...@*
text_zh: 「我記得那天的情形彷彿就在昨天...」*

source_en: @Zellivan held a tourney and I was awarded the Rune of Valour. Afterwards, we were at the pub, celebrating. I had drunk a full quart of ale, so my grip was a bit unsteady.@*
text_zh: 「Zellivan 舉辦了一場比武大會，我獲得了勇武符文。事後，我們在酒館裡慶祝。我喝了一整夸脫的麥酒，所以手腳有點不穩。」*

source_en: @I was showing the rune around when it fell from my grasp onto the floor. That's when the rat ran out.@
text_zh: 「我正拿著符文給眾人看，結果它從我手中滑落掉到地板上。就在這時，那隻老鼠跑了出來。」

source_en: @It scampered over, seized the trinket and ran back 'cross the floor. We all leapt at it, but the little beast was too quick. It was in the hole before anybody could stop it.@
text_zh: 「它跳過來，抓起那件飾物，然後橫穿地板跑了回去。我們所有人都衝上去抓它，但那隻小傢伙太快了。它在大家來得及阻擋之前，已經鑽進洞裡了。」

source_en: @It ran into a hole in the west wall of the pub, carrying the rune. We tried everything - banging on the wall, digging, poking with a sword. To no avail, though.@*
text_zh: 「它叼著符文跑進了酒館西牆上的洞。我們試遍了所有方法——敲牆、挖掘、用劍捅。但都沒用。」*
「自那以後，我們就再沒見過那枚符文了。」

source_en: @But thou dost not have enough gold,
@If thou art sure of that... Dost thou want anything else?@
text_zh: @如果你確定的話...你還需要別的東西嗎？@

source_en: @The valorous are often boisterous. I watch over the fighters.@
text_zh: @勇者們往往都很喧鬧。我守護著戰士們。@

source_en: @I held a tournament, to decide who would be entrusted with the rune's care.@*
text_zh: @我舉辦了一場比賽，來決定誰有資格保管符文。@*

source_en: @You might say that 'no man' was the victor...@ He smiles.
text_zh: @你可以說，沒有贏家...@ 他笑了。

source_en: @Hear it for thyself at the Sword and Keg Pub,
text_zh: @你可以去 Sword and Keg Pub 親自聽聽，

source_en: . The songs and tales do the heart good, I say!@
text_zh: 。那些歌謠和故事對人心很不錯，我這麼說！@
@我們還能再談談嗎，我的大人？@

source_en: @Those who live the warriors' life like to sing, and to regale one another with fanciful accounts of their exploits.@
text_zh: @過著武士生活的人喜歡唱歌，並喜歡彼此講述關於他們豐功偉業的奇妙故事。@

source_en: @Here in Jhelom we delight in the clash of arms and the din of battle.@
text_zh: @在這裡的耶洛姆（Jhelom），我們享受兵器交鋒的聲音與戰場的喧囂。@

source_en: @Speak to Nomaan if thou hast need of arms.@
text_zh: @如果你需要兵器，就去和諾曼（Nomaan）說話。@

source_en: @If thou hast tales of swordsmanship, then the Sword and Keg is the place for thee. 'Tis on the north side of town.@
text_zh: @如果你有關于劍術的故事，那麼「劍與桶」就是為你準備的地方。它在鎮子的北邊。@

source_en: @Ah, battle!@ he sighs. For a time he reminisces with you, trading stories about past exploits.
text_zh: @啊，戰鬥！@ 他嘆了一口氣。一時之間，他與你 reminisces，交換著關於過去豐功偉業的故事。

source_en: @Only an earthquake could make Jhelom tremble, I daresay. We had one just last year. The piers were broken up, but the shipwrights repaired them swiftly.@
text_zh: @我想，只有地震才能讓耶洛姆（Jhelom）顫抖。我們去年就經歷過一次。橋樑斷裂了，但造船匠們很快地修復了它們。@

source_en: @The shipwrights of Jhelom are fastidious and frugal craftsmen.@
text_zh: @耶洛姆（Jhelom）的造船匠是精細且節約的工匠。@

source_en: @I grew up near Castle Britannia. 'Twas the sunset o'er Brittany Bay and the ships at rest in the harbor which drew me away to the sea.@
text_zh: @我長大了不列顛城堡（Castle Britannia）附近。布列塔尼灣（Brittany Bay）的日落和港口中靜泊的船隻吸引了我，讓我前往大海。@

source_en: A man with a serpent-and-heart tabard covering his chainmail.*
text_zh: 一名男子，身上穿著鏈甲，外面罩著一塊繡有蛇與心臟圖案的束腰外衣。*

source_en: @Ah, the Avatar! Lord British has spoken fondly of thee,
text_zh: @啊，聖者！大英吉利爵士（Lord British）曾親切地談論過你，

source_en: @I welcome thee to Jhelom. I am Zellivan, and I am lord here.@
text_zh: @我歡迎你來到耶洛姆（Jhelom）。我是澤利萬（Zellivan），這裡的主人。@

source_en: Do you give him any money?

text_zh: @哼！@ 他朝地上吐了一口口水。

source_en: @Thank, ye kindly, matey. That should hold me over for a while.@
text_zh: @謝謝你，好朋友，伙計。這應該夠我過一陣子了。@

source_en: @Once Buccaneer's Den quaked at the mention o' me name. I was the greatest sabre fighter on all the high seas..@*
text_zh: 當年一提到我的名字，海盜巢穴都為之震動。我是高海上最厲害的劍術高手.. Buccaneer's Den*

source_en: @Then one day...I fought Captain Hawkins, that scurvy dog, an' he struck off me hand with his sword.@
text_zh: 然後有一天...我跟Captain Hawkins打了一仗，那該死的狗，他用劍砍斷了我的手。

source_en: @Twas a bitter fight; I almost died o' the wound. Hawkins threw me hand to the sharks.@
text_zh: 那是一場慘烈的戰斗；我差點死于傷口。Hawkins把我的手扔給了鯊魚。

source_en: @He be long gone now, he an' his ship the Empire. A pox on his memory!@
text_zh: 他和他那艘Empire船早就沒了蹤影。願瘟疫纏上他的記憶！

source_en: @That be an island, matey, and no place fer a decent soul like yerself.@
text_zh: 老兄，那是座島，不是你這種正派人該去的地方。

source_en: @That bit o' news will cost ye twenty coins. What say ye, matey? Aye or nay?@
text_zh: 這消息要二十枚硬幣。怎麼樣，老兄？要還是不要？

source_en: @I thank ye kindly, matey. The last I saw o' that bit o' parchment...I needed it to start a fire in a dungeon.@*
text_zh: 多謝你，老兄。我最後見到那張羊皮紙時...我需要用它在地下城裡生火。*

source_en: @But afore I could apply sparks to the tinder, a huge swarm o' rats drove me away. The scrap o' map lies in the dungeon Wrong, matey.@
text_zh: 但我還沒點著火，一大羣老鼠就把我趕跑了。那張地圖殘片就在錯誤的地下城裡，老兄。

source_en: @I can't help ye, matey. Not enough gold.@
text_zh: 我幫不了你，老兄。黃金不夠。
那要十枚呢？要還是不要？

source_en: @I thank ye kindly, matey. The last I saw o' that bit o' parchment...I needed it to start a fire in a dungeon. But afore I could apply sparks to the tinder, a huge swarm o' rats drove me away.*@
text_zh: 多謝你，老兄。我最後見到那張羊皮紙時...我需要用它在地下城裡生火。但我還沒點著火，一大羣老鼠就把我趕跑了。*

source_en: @The scrap o' map lies in the dungeon Wrong, matey.@
text_zh: 那張地圖殘片就在錯誤的地下城裡，老兄。

source_en: @Not enough gold. So be it, matey.@
text_zh: 黃金不夠。就這樣吧，老兄。

source_en: @I've been into the dungeon Wrong. There's a cave on this island that looks a lot safer.@
text_zh: 我去過錯誤的地下城。這座島上有個洞穴，看起來安全多了。

source_en: @I sleep in front of it every night. Soon as I've saved up a stake, I'm going in there to dig for gold.@
text_zh: 我每晚都睡在洞口前。等我存夠本金，我就進去挖金礦。

source_en: @'Twas certainly the wrong place for an old seadog to be!@ He laughs, chokes, and coughs for a while. @I'll be allright, matey.@
text_zh: 這對一個老海狗來說，絕對是錯的地方！他笑著，噎著，咳嗽了好一會。我沒事了，老兄。

source_en: You see a beggar, clad in the rags of a sailor, with a hook for a right hand.
text_zh: 你看到一個乞丐，身穿水手的破爛衣物，右手是一個鉤子。

source_en: @Spare a doubloon fer an old seahand?@ He holds out his hand.
text_zh: 老水手求您給枚雙柱幣？他伸出雙手。

source_en: @The pain, the pain... Will it never stop?@
text_zh: 痛苦，好痛苦...何時才能止住？

source_en: A heavily scarred man. He looks a little better than you saw him last.*
text_zh: 一個滿身傷疤的男人。他看起來比你上次見他時好了一點。*

source_en: @Too many... There were too many of them...@
@My head is pounding like a drum...@
The man momentarily opens his eyes, and struggles to speak. @Ye..ss...oh the pain!@
text_zh: 那男子短暫地睜開眼睛，掙扎著想要說話。 @是..是的...噢，好痛！@"

source_en: Artagel lets out a groan and passes out from the pain.
text_zh: Artagel 發出一聲呻吟，因疼痛而昏倒了。"

source_en: @I.. I'm a healer...@ He winces in pain.
text_zh: @我..我是一名治癒者...@ 他因疼痛而皺起眉頭。"

source_en: Lazeena wipes his forehead with a wet washcloth.
text_zh: Lazeena 用濕毛巾擦拭著額頭。

source_en: @Shhh.. easy now..you must get your rest.@
He manages to smile amidst the pain.
text_zh: 他在痛苦中勉強擠出一絲微笑。

source_en: @...there were too many... tried helping survivors...then I woke up here.@
text_zh: @...有太多人...我試著幫助倖存者...然後我就在這裡醒來了。@

source_en: @There.. there.. you did all you could for them.@
text_zh: @那裡..那裡..你已經為他們盡力了。@

source_en: , he's still in no condition to speak.@
@Once again, I must thank thee for thy kindness and helping reunite us.@
text_zh: @再次感謝你的善意與幫助我們團聚。@

source_en: A heavily scarred man with a look of agony on his face.*
text_zh: 一個滿身傷疤的男人，臉上帶著痛苦的表情。*

source_en: An unconcious man, his face twisted with pain.*
text_zh: 一名失去意識的男子，痛苦扭曲著他的臉。*

source_en: @After the shrine of Compassion fell, the gargoyles attempted to enter town. My pet was able to hold them back whilst we aided the survivors.@*
text_zh: @在慈悲神殿倒塌後，石像鬼試圖進入鎮上。我的寵物成功擋住了牠們，讓我們能去救助倖存者。@*

source_en: A dark, bearded man dressed in flowing white robes.*
text_zh: 一位深色膚色、留著鬍鬚的男子，身穿飄逸的白色長袍。*

source_en: @Greetings, mighty Avatar. For what hast thou come to my place?@
text_zh: @見禮，威猛的聖者。你到我這裡來所為何事？@

source_en: @I sell spell books and reagents, and teach spells..@
text_zh: @我販售魔法書和材料，並教導魔法..@

source_en: @I recognize you from before.@ She winks at you.
text_zh: @我認得你，以前見過。@她向你眨了眨眼。

source_en: She sighs deeply, her shoulders slumping. @I suppose I can't fool the Avatar. The truth is... I'm leaving with Michael.@
text_zh: 她深深嘆了口氣，肩膀垮了下來。@我想我騙不過聖者。事實是...我要和 Michael 離開。@

source_en: @My father chose an ancient word for my name. It means the cool breeze after a storm has passed. Marney.@
text_zh: @父親為我選了一個古老的名字。它意味著暴風雨過後的清涼微風。Marney。@

source_en: @It is in a poem my mother wrote to him when they first met.@ She grabs a locket that hangs around her neck and opens it. Inside is a folded piece of cloth with words printed on it. She begins to read. @At first we met and dark clouds gathered, the thunder sounding your approach. Then comes the storm of our hearts pounding and in the end the marney's touch.@
text_zh: @這出自一首詩，是我母親第一次遇見他時寫給他的。@她抓起掛在脖子上的吊墜並打開。裡面是一塊摺疊的布，上面印著文字。她開始朗讀。@起初我們相遇，烏雲聚攏，雷聲響起你的臨近。隨後是心靈的風暴，劇烈跳動，最終是Marney的觸碰。@

source_en: @Certainly you can look at it.@ She hands the tiny cloth to you. Looking at it, you discover that she has read only the first verse of the poem. The second reads, @If I should leave and you are lonely, Remember where my love is kept: Inside a basket made of promise, You'll find my dreams of us have slept.@
text_zh: @當然可以看了。@她把那塊小布遞給你。看著它，你發現她只朗誦了詩的第一節。第二節寫著：@如果我離開，而你孤單，記住我的愛存放之處：在那用承諾編織的籃子裡，你會發現我們的美夢安眠。@

source_en: @My father? He was a brave man and very strong. That he died in such a violent way was so wrong. But I am sure there is a reason for it.@*
text_zh: @我父親？他是一個勇敢且強壯的人。以那樣暴力的方式死去實在太不對了。但我相信這背後一定有原因。@*

source_en: Her blue eyes glisten with new-formed tears.
text_zh: 她藍色的眼睛閃爍著剛形成的淚光。

source_en: @My mother gave me this just before she was taken by those evil men. My mother told me to give it to father when he returned from the sea. Yorl gave it back to me after he was killed.@
text_zh: @我母親在那些惡人帶走我之前把這個給了我。母親告訴我，等父親從海上回來時把它給他。Yorl在陣亡後又把它還給了我。@

source_en: She bows her head a moment and with a shaky voice begins to speak. @It is something I care not to talk about. His memory brings only sadness to me.@
text_zh: 她低頭片刻，用顫抖的聲音開始說話。@有些事我不願談起。對他的回憶只能帶給我悲傷。@

source_en: She rubs her nose with the knuckle of her hand. @I can not see why those beasts would kill him, but perhaps it was just unfortunate.@*
text_zh: 她用手節揉揉鼻子。@我看不出來那些畜生為什麼要殺他，也許只是不幸的意外。@*

source_en: @Still, I can't see why he was at the inn that late. Had he been drinking, Yorl would have been with him.@
text_zh: @不過，我還是想不通他為什麼那麼晚還在旅館裡。如果他喝了酒，Yorl肯定會和他在一起。@

source_en: @I would rather not talk about this if you don't mind, it's still a lot to process.@
text_zh: @如果你不介意的話，我寧願不談這個，這對我來說還是很難接受的事。@

source_en: @A basket? I have one in my hope chest. Feel free to look for yourself.@
text_zh: @籃子？我的 hope chest 裡有一個。歡迎你自己去看看。@

source_en: @My father had gone out to help Yorl bring in the catch that afternoon.@
text_zh: @那天下午，我父親出去幫 Yorl 把捕獲的獵物運回來。@

source_en: @Oh, Yorl.@ She smiles to herself. @He and father were never apart. After my mother was kidnapped, Yorl helped my father get back on his feet. They were always together.@
text_zh: @噢，Yorl。@她對著自己微笑。@他和父親從未分開過。在我母親被綁架後，Yorl 幫父親重新站起來。他們總是在一起。@

source_en: @With my father's murder, the gargoyles, and my failing health... I need a fresh start. Michael suggested we leave together, and tonight he made all the arrangements.@
text_zh: @隨著父親的遇害、石像鬼的出現，加上我身體越來越差...我需要一個新的開始。Michael 建議我們一起離開，而今晚他已經安排好了一切。@

source_en: Her gaze returns to you. @If my father had been drinking at the inn, Yorl would have been there.@
text_zh: 她的目光重新回到你身上。@如果我父親在旅館喝酒，Yorl 肯定會在那裡。@

source_en: @My father and Yorl would go there after a good catch. Gideon had been a friend of theirs since youth. The three would would drink and reminisce together.@
text_zh: @我父親和 Yorl 在豐收後常會去那裡。Gideon 從年輕時起就是他們的朋友。三人會一起喝酒並回首往事。@

source_en: @He and his wife are very kind to me. They have taught me so much about how to treat others.@
text_zh: @他和他的妻子對我非常親切。他們教會了我許多待人接物的道理。@

source_en: She looks at you and swallows. @I cannot talk about these creatures.@
text_zh: 她望著你，吞嚥了一下。@我無法談論這些生物。@

source_en: @All this time we thought my father died at their hands. I hope that maybe they are just misunderstood, and not as evil as they are believed to be.@
text_zh: @這麼多年來，我們一直以為父親死在他們手上。我希望他們也許只是被誤解了，並沒有人們相信的那麼邪惡。@

source_en: @Oh, you're probably wanting a skiff to get out to old Horance's island. Well, we have none for sale, but feel free to borrow the one at the dock. Be sure to return it, though!@
text_zh: @喔，你可能想去老Horance的島上。嗯，我們沒有船賣，但你可以隨意使用碼頭的那艘。不過記得要還回來！@

source_en: @Ah, now, Horance is much wiser than most know. He is also my mentor when it comes to poetry.@*
text_zh: @啊，現在，Horance比大多數人認為的還要睿智。在詩歌方面，他也是我的導師。@*

source_en: @He has a way of reminding me that I am too concerned with myself. It is a gentle way, but a firm reminder.@
text_zh: @他有一種方式提醒我，我過於自我中心了。語氣雖溫和，但提醒卻很堅定。@

source_en: @I saw him once when I was a little girl. We had gone to his castle for a celebration and there he sat on a great white charger. What a sight he was.@
text_zh: @我小時候見過他一次。我們去他的城堡參加慶祝活動，那時他坐在一匹高大的白馬上。那場面真是壯觀。@

source_en: Her eyes brighten at the mention of his name. @He is a very handsome man. I see him only occasionally when he comes into town.@*
text_zh: 提到他的名字時，她的眼睛閃爍著光芒。@他是一位非常英俊的男人。只有當他進城時，我偶爾才能見到他。@*

source_en: She looks absently out the window. @Yorl would never let me see him though.@
text_zh: 她無神地望向窗外。@Yorl絕不讓我見到他。@

source_en: She looks down at the floor listlessly. @I still cannot believe he killed my father over a debt. I hope, however, that my father can finally be at rest.@
text_zh: 她無精打采地低頭看著地板。@我仍然無法相信他因為一筆債務就殺了我父親。然而，我希望父親終於能得到安息。@

source_en: @He is a sweet little man. He brought me wine on my sixteenth birthday. I'm quite fond of him.@
text_zh: @他是一個可愛的小人兒。我十六歲生日時他帶了酒給我。我非常喜歡他。@

source_en: @She has done as much as she can to heal my wounded heart. She bakes for me and we have long talks about almost everything.@*
text_zh: @她已盡力療癒我受傷的心。她為我烘焙食物，我們漫談各種事情。@*

source_en: @I wish I were as beautiful as she.@
@I believe he has done all he can for me. When my father was murdered, he took charge to find the gargoyles. None were found though.@
text_zh: @我相信他已為我盡力了。父親遇害時，他接手查找石像鬼。雖然沒有找到。@

source_en: @I am sorry for our town. You see, my father was the caretaker of the rune stone.@*
text_zh: @我為我們的小鎮感到抱歉。你看，父親是符文石的守護者。@*

source_en: @After he died, we had no way of finding out where he put it.@*
text_zh: @他死後，我們無從得知他把符文石放在哪裡。@*

source_en: @I am sorry that I wept. It is not your fault. Goodbye.@
text_zh: @抱歉我哭了。這不是你的錯。再見。@

source_en: @I am sorry that I am still emotional. Thanks to thee, I have some closure, and my heart is on the mend.@
text_zh: @抱歉我依然情緒激動。多虧了你，我得到了一些釋懷，我的心正在癒合。@

source_en: @Please, Avatar, don't tell Yorl. I just... I can't bear to stay here any longer with all the pain.@
text_zh: @請，聖者，不要告訴Yorl。我只是...我無法再忍受在這裡待著，滿心都是痛苦。@

source_en: Michael steps forward, his expression rigid, though his anger is barely contained. @This matter is none of your concern, Avatar. Marney has made her decision.@
text_zh: Michael走上前來，表情嚴肅，雖然憤怒幾乎壓抑不住。@這事不關你的事，聖者。Marney已經做了她的決定。@

source_en: @She seeks solace and healing, and I shall provide that. Now, let us go, my dear, before Yorl stirs.@
text_zh: @她尋求慰藉和療癒，我會提供這些。現在，我們走吧，親愛的，在Yorl察怒之前。@

source_en: Marney hesitates, her eyes glistening with unshed tears. She takes a steadying breath. @Yes... itâs time for me to move on and find peace.@
text_zh: Marney猶豫不決，眼淚在眼眶裡打轉。她深吸一口氣穩住情緒。@是的...是我該向前看並尋找平靜的時候了。@

source_en: She turns to you, her face a mixture of sadness and determination. @Farewell, Avatar. When I return, perhaps thou can visit, and Iâll share tales of our journey.@
text_zh: 她轉過身對著你，臉上交織著悲傷和堅定。@再見，聖者。等我回來，也許你可以來訪，我會分享我們旅程的故事。@

source_en: Dupre stares at you, disbelief etched across his face. @Avatar... thou canst not be serious! Art thou truly allowing her to leave with him?@
text_zh: Dupre盯著你，臉上寫滿不可置信。@聖者...你不可能認真的吧！你真的允許她跟他離開嗎？@

source_en: Iolo shakes his head in frustration. @Avatar, can't you see? Michael has poisoned her thoughts with lies! Are we just going to stand here and watch this unfold?!@
text_zh: Iolo生氣地搖頭。@聖者，你看不出來嗎？Michael用謊言污染了她的思想！我們就只會站著看這發生嗎？！@

source_en: ERROR! Boat not found at docks. Creating one.
text_zh: 錯誤！碼頭找不到船。創建一艘。

source_en: Shamino steps closer, his voice filled with disappointment. @Avatar, why didst thou remain silent? Surely thou dost see this is a grave mistake. This is not the path she should take...@
text_zh: Shamino 走近了一步，聲音中滿是失望。@聖者，你為何保持沉默？你應該看出這是一個嚴重的錯誤。這不是她該走的路...@

source_en: Michael glances at you with a mix of impatience and unease. @Make it quick,
text_zh: Michael 瞥了你一眼，眼神中混合著不耐煩與不安。@長話短說，

source_en: @Marney, I have uncovered evidence proving Michael was responsible for your father's murder. It was not the gargoyles.@
text_zh: @Marney，我發現了證據，證明 Michael 是你父親謀殺案的兇手。並不是石像鬼。@

source_en: @Milady, Michael killed thy father over an unpaid debt. He has been lying to thee all along. Trust him not.@
text_zh: @小姐，Michael 因為一筆未償還的債務而殺害了你的父親。他一直在欺騙你。不要相信他。@

source_en: Michael scowls, his voice sharp. @Lies! Baseless lies! Everyone knows it was the gargoyles who slew thy father.@
text_zh: Michael 皺起眉頭，語氣尖銳。@謊言！無稽之談！大家都知道是你父親被石像鬼所殺。@

source_en: @Oh! Avatar, what brings you here tonight?@ she asks, her voice trembling. @I was just... out for some air.@
text_zh: @哦！聖者，今晚什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？@她問道，聲音顫抖著。@我剛...出來透透氣。@

source_en: @How dost thou know this? What proof dost thou have? Michael has always been kind to me...@
text_zh: @你是怎麼知道這事的？你有什麼證據？Michael 一直對我很好...@

source_en: You hand Marney the bloodstained letter found in Michael's home.
text_zh: 你將在 Michael 家中發現的那封染血信件交給 Marney。

source_en: Her eyes widen as she scans it, her voice trembling. @This... this is my father's handwriting...@
text_zh: 她的眼睛睜大了，掃視著信紙，聲音顫抖。@這...這是我父親的字跡...@

source_en: She turns to Michael, her voice cracking. @Michael... is this true...?@
text_zh: 她轉過身對著 Michael，聲音哽咽。@Michael...這是真的...？@

source_en: Overwhelmed, Marney collapses into your arms, sobbing uncontrollably.
text_zh: Marney 情緒崩潰，倒在你的懷裡，淚如泉湧。

source_en: Michael's facade drops, and he sneers. @It was nothing personal, my dear. Thy father owed me a debt, and debts must be paid.@
text_zh: Michael 卸下了偽裝，露出一絲輕蔑的笑。@這不是針對個人的，親愛的。你父親欠我一筆債，債務必須償還。@

source_en: He glares at you, fury blazing in his eyes. @And now, Avatar, thou shalt pay for meddling in my affairs!@
text_zh: 他怒視著你，眼中燃燒著怒火。@現在，聖者，你必須為插手我的事務付出代價！@

source_en: Michael rushes to the boat, raises the anchor, and sails away into the night!
text_zh: Michael 沖向船隻，拋錨起航，消失在了夜色中！

source_en: You realize you don't have the scroll with you!
text_zh: 你意識到你身上沒有帶那份卷軸！

source_en: She waits a moment, then shakes her head. @What an awful thing to accuse Michael of, with no proof. Please, go away. I musn't keep Michael waiting.@
text_zh: 她等了一會兒，然後搖了搖頭。@沒有證據就指控 Michael，這太惡劣了。請離開吧。我不能再讓 Michael 等了。@

source_en: @Come milady, thy ship awaits. This will be an journey you'll never forget...@
text_zh: @來吧，小姐，你的船在等著了。這將是一段你難忘的旅程...@

source_en: From behind her, he looks at you with an evil grin as he raises the anchor.
text_zh: 從她身後，他帶惡意的笑容看著你，同時抬起錨。

source_en: Conditions aren't right for Marney trigger - hour is
text_zh: Marney 觸發條件不正確 - 時間是

source_en: Marney looks up at you, her face puffy and red from crying, tears rolling down her eyes.
text_zh: Marney 抬頭看著你，臉上因哭泣而紅腫，眼淚流了下來。

source_en: @Please, go away. I do not wish to speak to you again. I have been traumatized enough.@
text_zh: @請離開吧。我不想再和你說話了。我已經受夠折磨了。@

source_en: Marney looks up at you from sobbing, her eyes red from the tears.
text_zh: Marney 從哭泣中抬起頭看著你，眼睛因淚水而通紅。

source_en: , come back later when I've had some time to deal with everything that has come to pass recently.@
text_zh: ，稍後再來吧，我得花點時間處理最近發生的一切。

source_en: @It's all so overwhelming. I hope you understand.@
text_zh: 一切實在太令人不知所措了。希望你原諒我。

source_en: You see a tall, delicate looking female. Her smile puts you at ease.*
text_zh: 你看到一位身材高挑、外貌嬌弱的女性。她的微笑讓你放鬆了下來。*

source_en: , welcome to my home.@ Her eyes are as blue as the ocean and her movements as rythmic as the tide.
text_zh: ，歡迎來到我家。她的眼睛蔚藍如海，動作節奏如潮汐般優雅。

source_en: @Thy reign of murder and crime is over, Michael. You'll have the luxury of sitting in a cell awaiting the fate you deserve.@
text_zh: Michael，你製造殺人與犯罪的統治到此為止了。你將享有關在牢房裡等待你應得下場的「特權」。

source_en: whispers to you. @Perhaps we should go speak with Lady Lenora of Yew
text_zh: 在你身旁低聲說：「也許我們應該去見見 Yew 的 Lady Lenora，

source_en: , and bring this fiend to justice!@
text_zh: 讓這傢伙受到法律的制裁！」

source_en: He resumes cleaning his nails with his knife.
text_zh: 他繼續用小刀清理指甲。

source_en: @I'm not afraid of death Michael, I will be seeking the virtues and trying to make amends for the wrongs I have committed over the years. The captain is running out of time, and eventually, you will too...@
text_zh: 我不怕死，Michael。我會尋求美德，並嘗試彌補我多年來犯下的錯誤。船長的時間不多了，最終，你也會如此...

source_en: Michael seems to momentarily recoil, then yells: @The Captain will send aid for me, I am his chosen one! And then, I'll find you.. and make sure you suffer!@
text_zh: Michael 似乎短暫地畏縮了一下，然後大喊道：「船長會來救我的，我是他的摯愛之人！到時候，我會找到你..讓你生不如死！」

source_en: Renthar bounds Michael's hands with some rope. @Avatar, I will transport this swine to the jail in Yew and Rinaldo will decide his fate.@
text_zh: Renthar 用繩子綁住了 Michael 的手。「聖者，我會把這頭豬送到 Yew 的監獄，由 Rinaldo 決定他的命運。」

source_en: @I will try to loosen his tongue on the whereabouts of the girl on the long journey to Yew..@
text_zh: 我會試著在前往 Yew 的漫長旅途中撬開他的嘴，問出女孩的藏身之處..

source_en: Michael lifts his head slowly as you approach, his eyes burning into you.
text_zh: Michael 緩緩抬起頭，當他靠近時，他的雙眼死死地盯著你。

source_en: @I've no words for thee, Avatar. May the gargoyles feast upon thy bones!@ His tone is dripping with venom.
text_zh: 我無言以對，聖者。願石像鬼啃食你的白骨！他的語調充滿著惡毒。

source_en: Michael spits at your feet and turns away, his shoulders tense with fury.
text_zh: Michael 向你腳邊吐了口口水，轉身離去，肩膀因憤怒而繃緊。

source_en: Michael looks up as you approach his cell, a sneer curling his lips.
text_zh: Michael 抬頭看向靠近他牢房的你，嘴角掛著一絲譏笑。

source_en: @Ah, Avatar, thou dost look like you've lost something. Pray tell, what might it be?@ His voice carries a tone of mockery.
text_zh: 啊，聖者，你看上去像是丟了什麼東西。請告訴我，那會是什麼？他的聲音帶著一絲嘲諷。

source_en: . Sheâs in capable hands now and fetched a fair price for the captain.@
text_zh: 。她現在由能人照顧，而且為船長換取了不錯的身價。

source_en: Michael retrieves a trinket from his pocket, letting it dangle mockingly between his fingers. You recognize it instantlyâ itâs Marneyâs locket!
text_zh: Michael 從口袋裡掏出一件小飾物，讓它調皮地在指尖晃動。你立刻認出那是 Marney 的掛鎖！

source_en: @As for Renthar, his time will come soon enough, I can promise thee that.@
text_zh: 至於 Renthar，他的報應馬上就會來臨，我可以向你保證。

source_en: Michaelâs grin widens, his expression one of dark satisfaction, before he turns away.
text_zh: Michael 的笑意加深，臉上露出一種陰暗的滿足感，隨後轉身離開。

source_en: @Well then, run along, Avatar...@ He dismisses you with a wave of his hand.
text_zh: 「那麼，趕緊走吧，聖者...」他揮揮手，打發了你。

source_en: His grin stretches, revealing teeth clenched in malicious glee.
text_zh: 他的笑容擴大，露出一口緊咬的牙齒，顯得幸災樂禍。

source_en: Seeing you, Michael's eyes narrow with rage. @Leave here at once!@ he says, with clenched teeth. @Begone!!@
text_zh: 看到你們，Michael 的雙眼因憤怒而睜開。「立刻離開這裡！」他咬牙切齒地說道，「快滾！！」

source_en: @You vile worm!@ He spits up blood. @There's no hole you can hide in that the captain won't find you! Not even running behind the Avatar's skirt will save thee from his wrath!@
text_zh: 「你這條卑賤的蟲！」他噴出一口鮮血。「沒有任何藏身之處能逃過船長的眼線！就算躲在聖者裙下，也逃不過他的怒火！」

source_en: You see a tall man with muscles looking like huge snakes. @Speak,@ he growls at you, his voice as rough and cold as stone.
text_zh: 你看到一個高大的男人，肌肉像巨大的蛇一樣起伏。「說話，」他對著你低吼，聲音粗糙寒冷如石頭。

source_en: @Are you taking a census?@ His powerful gaze is fixed on you.
text_zh: 「你們是在做人口普查嗎？」他強勁的視線緊緊盯著你。

source_en: He ignores the question and you think it wise not to ask again.
text_zh: 他無視這個問題，你覺得明智的做法是不再詢問。

source_en: @Yes, you know, counting people, taking down names...@
text_zh: 「是的，你知道，就是數人數、記錄名字...」

source_en: @That name is given to friends so that they may feel they are close to me. Since I have none, refrain from its use.@
text_zh: 「這個名字是給朋友的，讓他們覺得自己與我親近。既然我沒有朋友，就別使用它了。」

source_en: @That is a concern of the town, not mine@
@He was not fortunate. It is written that it is better to be fortunate than skilled. He, I'm sure, would agree.@ His face betrays a slight grin.
text_zh: 「他的運氣不太好。傳說中說，幸運比技藝更重要。我相信他本人也會同意。」他的臉微微露出一絲笑容。

source_en: @All men have enemies. A debt needed to be settled. He hadn't the strength to settle it, so someone decided to take the initiative.@ He pulls out a knife and begins to pick at his nails.
text_zh: 「每個人都有敵人。有一筆債需要償還。他沒有力氣去清算，於是有人決定主動出手。」他掏出一把刀，開始剔指甲。

source_en: @Surely you don't buy the fable of the gargoyle. There wouldn't be enough left to bury if this were the case. This was no monster who settled the debt, it was the work of man's hands.@ He brings the knife to his teeth and delicately works it between them.
text_zh: “你不會相信翼魔的傳說吧。如果情況真是如此，剩下的屍體連埋葬都不夠。清償債務的不是怪物，而是人類的手筆。”他把刀送到牙齒邊，細心地用牙齒咬住。

source_en: @Have you ever seen one? If you had you would not believe the fairy tales being told by that incompetent mayor.@ He grabs the knife and holds it aloft. @See this blade? Their fangs are twice as long and thrice as sharp.@
text_zh: “你見過牠嗎？如果你見過，你就不會相信那個無能市長所講的民間傳說了。”他抓起刀，高高舉起。“看看這片刀刃？牠們的獠牙比這長兩倍，銳利三倍。”

source_en: @An annoying little man. Makes good wine though.@
text_zh: “討厭的小夥子。不過，他釀的葡萄酒還不錯。”
“也許是我們之中最睿智的人..”

source_en: @She is kind to me, and yet I believe this is genuine.@
text_zh: “她對我很溫柔，但我相信這是真心的。”

source_en: @He is one to be respected. I have seen him fight, firsthand. He is a mighty warrior, as well as a just opponent.@
text_zh: “他是令人尊敬的人。我曾親眼目睹他戰鬥。他是強大的戰士，也是公正的對手。”

source_en: @He is a fool. The perfect man for his job.@
text_zh: “他是個傻瓜。是這份工作的完美人選。”

source_en: Michael looks at you sternly, a hint of amusement playing across his face.
text_zh: Michael 嚴肅地看著你，臉上閃過一絲戲謔的神色。

source_en: @A bold accusation... but do you have the proof to back it up?@ He leans slightly forward, his gaze unflinching.
text_zh: “大膽的指控...但你有證據支持嗎？”他微微前傾，目光堅定不移。

source_en: Michael steps forward, towering over you as his smirk darkens. @Perhaps you should be careful about throwing around wild accusations...@ His voice lowers, laden with menace. @This is your only warning.@
text_zh: Michael 向前一步，壓迫著你，他的笑容變得陰沉。“也許你應該小心點，不要隨意揮舞無端的指控...”他的聲音低沉，充滿威脅。“這是你的最後警告。”

source_en: , seeing thee again, I feel as if the clouds have parted to reveal the sun once more.@
text_zh: ，再見到你，我彷彿覺得雲層散開，陽光再次照耀大地。@

source_en: ! If thou art as happy to see me as I to see thee, then this must be for thee a joyous occasion indeed.@
text_zh: ！如果你見到我像我看見你一樣開心，那麼對你來說，這必是喜事一樁。@

source_en: ! 'Tis an honor to welcome thee once more to my humble village.@
text_zh: ！歡迎你再次回到我貧瘠的村莊，是我的榮幸。@

source_en: @I am the Viscount Ahrmaand. And what is thy name?@*
text_zh: “我是 Ahrmaand 子爵。請問閣下尊姓大名？”*

source_en: @I govern here in Cove. 'Tis hard work, but my people love me for it.@*
text_zh: 我在此地 Cove 執政。這是一份艱鉅的工作，但我的子民因此愛戴我。*

source_en: @I always thought it a blessing to live so close to a shrine, though since the gargoyles came none dare go near it.@
text_zh: 我一直覺得能住在如此靠近神廟的地方是一種祝福，但自從石像鬼出現後，沒有人敢靠近那裡了。

source_en: @We have fine facilities here for healing the wounded and the sick.@
text_zh: 這裡有完善的設施，可以治療傷病者。

source_en: @In Britannia there are eight shrines, one for each of the Eight Virtues of the Avatar.@*
text_zh: 在 Britannia 有八座神廟，分別對應聖者的八大美德。*

source_en: @They are places where people can go to meditate on these virtues.@
text_zh: 那是人們可以前往冥想這些美德的地方。

source_en: @Alas, it was destroyed some time ago when the earthquakes happened. We were unable to save it.@
text_zh: 可惜，它在之前發生地震時被摧毀了。我們無能為力，無法保存它。

source_en: @The Virtues are Honesty, Compassion, Valor, Justice, Sacrifice, Honor, Spirituality, and Humility.@*
text_zh: 八大美德分別是：誠實、慈悲、勇氣、正義、犧牲、榮譽、靈性與謙虛。*

source_en: @'Tis good to meditate on these Virtues often.@
text_zh: 經常冥想這些美德是好事。

source_en: @Each shrine has its own mantra. This is a chant which one should recite whilst meditating therein. Once there was a time when a special rune was required to enter each shrine as well.@
text_zh: 每座神廟都有自己的真言。那是冥想時應該誦唸的咒語。曾經有一段時間，進入每座神廟還需要特殊的符文。

source_en: @Now the gargoyles have taken the Shrine of Compassion, and it is lost to the people once more.@
text_zh: 如今石像鬼佔據了Shrine of Compassion，它再次與百姓失聯了。

source_en: @A party of adventurers came here after their attempt to defeat the gargoyles at the Shrine of Compassion.@*
text_zh: 一隊冒險者在試圖擊敗Shrine of Compassion的石像鬼後來到了這裡。*

source_en: @I spoke with their leader when they arrived. Thou shouldst speak with him thyself. He told of a strange violet energy field. I think mayhap 'tis similar to the force which blocked entry to the shrines many years ago.@*
text_zh: 他們抵達時，我與他們的領隊談過話。你應該親自與他談談。他提到了一種奇怪的紫色能量場。我想那也許與多年前阻擋進入神廟的那種力量類似。*

source_en: @The eight mystic runes were most useful in those days.@
text_zh: 在那個年代，八個神祕符文非常實用。
他正在 Sasha 處休息，恢復體力。

source_en: @Use the Rune of Compassion whilst chanting the Mantra of Compassion. Methinks this may negate the gargoyle's magic at that shrine.@
text_zh: 在誦唸慈悲真言時，使用慈悲符文。我想這也許能抵消那座神廟上石像鬼的魔法。

source_en: @Ask Lord British's Chancellor, Tholden. He canst tell thee of the mantra, and like as not he will also know of the rune.@
text_zh: 去問 Lord British 的宰相 Tholden。他能告訴你真言，而且很可能他也知道那個符文的事。

source_en: , and welcome to the town of Cove.@*
@Twas a delight to converse with thee, my dear. My heart will be aflutter with anticipation till thou dost visit me again.@
text_zh: 與你交談是一種愉悅，親愛的。直到你再來拜訪我，我的心將充滿期待的顫動。

source_en: @Farewell sirrah, and good luck with thy quest.@

text_zh: @直到我們再次相遇，親愛的朋友。..@

source_en: @How might I be of assistance this fine
, thou hast come back to get better acquainted!@
You see a burly man, who looks a little healthier than the other patients.*
text_zh: 你看到一個魁梧的男人，看起來比其他病人健康一點。*

source_en: @I lead my men into battle whenever Geoffrey sends me.@
text_zh: @無論Geoffrey何時派遣，我都率領我的士兵投入戰鬥。@

source_en: @Artagel? He was our party's healer, brave soul. He was struck down by the gargoyles as he was tending to the fallen.@
text_zh: @Artagel？他是我們隊伍的治癒者，勇敢的人。他在照顧傷員時被石像鬼擊倒了。@

source_en: @He lies over there now, resting from his wounds.@*
text_zh: @他現在躺在那裡，從傷痛中休息。@*

source_en: Gertan gestures weakly toward one of the beds.
text_zh: Gertan無力地指向其中一張牀。

source_en: @We sought to liberate the Shrine of Compassion.@*
text_zh: @我們試圖解放 Shrine of Compassion。@*

source_en: @My men fought valiantly, but the gargoyles were too much for us. They didst slay more than half our party.@
text_zh: @我的士兵英勇戰鬥，但石像鬼對我們來說太多了。他們殺死了我們隊伍的一半以上的人。@

source_en: @He is the captain of the guard.@
@Aye, I doubt not they were using foul magic of some kind.@
text_zh: @是，我懷疑他們使用了某種邪惡的魔法。@

source_en: @A moonstone was upon the shrine, surrounded by a strange violet glow. I tried to get to it, but 'twas surrounded by some kind of force field.@
text_zh: @石像上有一塊月長石，周圍環繞著奇怪的紫色光芒。我試著去拿，但它被某種力場包圍著。@
@這是一件我無法理解的事情。@

source_en: @Hast thou heard, then, of the time I slew the great dragon Freitag? Ah, that was a long time ago.@
text_zh: @你聽說過我殺死巨龍 Freitag 的時刻嗎？啊，那已經是很久以前的事了。@

source_en: @May thy efforts meet with more success than mine!@
. My fellows and I are recovering from a fierce battle.@
text_zh: 。我和我的夥伴們正在從一場慘烈的戰鬥中恢復。@

source_en: @Leave these men alone! Can't you see they need to rest?@
text_zh: @別管這些人了！你看不出來他們需要休息嗎？@

source_en: @I tend the sick. I know how to heal, cure, and resurrect.@
text_zh: @我照顧病人。我知道如何治癒、解毒和復活。@

source_en: @Aye, these men's wounds need time to heal.@
text_zh: @是的，這些人的傷口需要時間來癒合。@

source_en: @Thou hast kept me from my duties long enough. Away with thee!@
text_zh: @你已經讓我離開職務太久了。快走！@

source_en: @More wounded? I'll do what I can.@ The poor nurse seems weary beyond words. @Which of you?@
text_zh: @更多傷員？我會盡力而為。@這位可憐的護士看起來精疲力竭。@你們中的哪一個？@

source_en: @Poison? Yes, I can cure that. Let me see...Which of you are poisoned?@
text_zh: @中毒？是的，我可以治癒那個。讓我看看...你們中的誰中毒了？@

source_en: Your question seems almost like a blow to the woman.*
text_zh: 你的問題對這位女性來說幾乎像是一種打擊。*

source_en: @Nay, I cannot. I no longer have the energy, or the reagents.@*
text_zh: @不，我做不到。我已經沒有精力，也沒有材料了。@*

source_en: @It has been a dark, dark day indeed. I am sorry that I cannot help you, but we all grieve today.@
text_zh: @今天確是一場黑暗、漫長的災難。很抱歉我無法幫助你，但今天大家都在哀悼。@

source_en: @I have aided many today. These men are the last; they are beyond the help of all save time itself.@
text_zh: @今天我已幫助了很多人。這些人是最後一批；除了時間本身，無人能再幫助他們。@

source_en: @These soldiers are the only survivors of an attempt to free the Shrine of Compassion.@
text_zh: @這些士兵是試圖解放 Shrine of Compassion 行動中僅存的倖存者。@

source_en: @Show thy compassion now and let them sleep.@
text_zh: @現在展現你的憫憫之心，讓他們安息吧。@

source_en: You see a pretty young nurse with violet eyes.*
text_zh: 你看到一位擁有一雙紫眼睛的年輕護士。*

source_en: @Now I can make Humble Pie!@ Overjoyed, he gives you a hug.
text_zh: @現在我可以做謙卑派了！@他欣喜若狂地擁抱了你。

source_en: @So, does the subject of pirates interest you?@
text_zh: @那麼，海盜這個話題讓你感興趣嗎？@

source_en: @Well, first, there is one in Serpent's Hold. I cannot recall her name, but she has a piece of the map with her.@*
text_zh: @首先，Serpent's Hold 有一位。我記不起她的名字，但她身上帶著一張藏寶圖的一部分。@*

source_en: @Second, there is one on Dagger Isle. A hermit.@
text_zh: @其次，Dagger Isle 有一位。是一位隱士。@

source_en: @Third, I know of a pirate at Empath Abbey, or thereabouts. Nathaniel Moorehead was his name.@
text_zh: @第三，我知道 Empath Abbey 附近有一位海盜。他叫 Nathaniel Moorehead。@

source_en: @The fourth... but then maybe I've said too much already.@
text_zh: @第四位...不過我可能已經說得太多了。@

source_en: @I guess I cannot help you much, then.@
@My name is Sandstone Angus. Most folks call me Sandy.@
text_zh: @我的名字是 Sandstone Angus。大多數人叫我 Sandy。@

source_en: @I cook for Lord Whitsaber. He especially likes my recipe for fish in a white wine sauce.@
text_zh: @我為 Lord Whitsaber廚藝服務。他特別喜歡我那道白醬魚食譜。@

source_en: @Hmmm. I'd better get back to cooking... Excuse me.@*
text_zh: @嗯。我最好回去繼續做飯...請原諒。@*

source_en: @Before Lord Whitsaber came to Trinsic to be our mayor, he had another job...@*
text_zh: @在 Lord Whitsaber來到 Trinsic 擔任市長之前，他還有另一份工作...@*

source_en: @As first mate to Captain Hawkins himself! His real name is Alastor Gordon.@
text_zh: @我是 Captain Hawkins 本人的大副！他的真名是 Alastor Gordon。@

source_en: @'A golden orb on a crystal sea, in a box sans hinges, lid, or key.'@*
text_zh: @「水晶海面上的金色球體，無鉸鏈、無蓋、無鎖的盒子。」@*

source_en: @I'll give you one guess to this riddle.@
A shifty-eyed man with a strange smile. He smells of rancid grease and cooking smoke.
text_zh: 一個眼神閃爍、帶著奇怪微笑的男子。身上散發著哈喇味和炊煙味。

source_en: @Very good! To make Magincian pastry, I require one dragon's egg.@
text_zh: @很好！要做魔術師糕點，我需要一顆龍蛋。@

source_en: @It's an egg, of course. To make Magincian pastry, I require one dragon's egg.@
text_zh: @當然是蛋。要做魔術師糕點，我需要一顆龍蛋。@

source_en: @There's a lair in the dungeon Destard, to the northwest. It's not far.@
text_zh: @西北方有一個名為 Destard 的地牢裡有個巢穴。離這裡不遠。@

source_en: @I could do you a favor if you did one for me first.@
text_zh: @如果你先幫我一個忙，我也能幫你一個忙。@

source_en: @Truly it shall be a magnificent desert!@

text_zh: 再見！願你的冒險一帆風順，聖者！

source_en: @That big, carefully wrapped bundle could only be a dragon's egg!@
text_zh: 那個大而小心包裹的包裹，肯定是一顆龍蛋！

source_en: @I am Lord Whitsaber, mayor of this honorable town!@
text_zh: 我是 Lord Whitsaber，這個光榮城鎮的市長！

source_en: @I am entrusted with an honor above all others-that of governing Trinsic, the Town of Honor!@
text_zh: 我被賦予了最崇高的榮譽——治理 Trinsic，光榮之城！

source_en: @Every citizen of this fine town strives every day to be a living example of honor.@
text_zh: 我們這座美好城鎮的每一位公民，每天都在努力成為榮譽的榜樣。

source_en: @Yet some who claim to walk the path of honor tread it with muddy boots.@
text_zh: 然而，有些自稱行走於榮譽之道的人，卻踩著沾滿泥濘的靴子在走。

source_en: @Of course, thy own example guides us all, Avatar!@
text_zh: 當然，你本身的榜樣引領著我們所有人，聖者！

source_en: @Me, a pirate? Absurd!@ He laughs out loud...but you sense a trace of fear in his voice!
text_zh: 我，海盜？荒謬！"他放聲大笑...但你感覺到他的聲音中透著一絲恐懼！

source_en: @I have changed since those dark days, truly I have!@
text_zh: 自那些黑暗的日子以來，我真的改變了！

source_en: @Did he say I was once a pirate?@
He seems strangely relieved. @Oh. Well, good, because it isn't true!@
text_zh: 他看起來顯得異常如釋重負。"噢。嗯，很好，因為那是不實的！"

source_en: @All right! If thou wouldst but promise to keep my secret, I'll give thee the map! Agreed?@
text_zh: 好吧！如果你願意答應保守我的祕密，我就把地圖給你！同意嗎？

source_en: He hands over his piece of the map.*
text_zh: 他交出了他的那塊地圖。*

source_en: @I'll rely on thy honor to keep my secret.@
text_zh: 我會依賴你的榮譽來保守我的祕密。

source_en: @But what more can I do? I cannot change the past!@*
text_zh: 但我還能做什麼？我無法改變過去！*

source_en: @By giving you the map, do I not prove that I have changed my ways?@
text_zh: 我將地圖給你了，這不是證明我已經改邪歸正了嗎？

source_en: @No pirate would willingly give up the key to such a treasure!@
text_zh: 沒有海盜會願意交出通往如此寶藏的鑰匙！

source_en: @I gave you the map. What more do you want?@
text_zh: 我已經把地圖給你了。你還想要什麼？

source_en: @The Rune of Honor? Why, it is on a pedestal in the center of town!@
text_zh: 榮譽符文？為什麼，它就在鎮子中心的底座上！

source_en: @Even though the rune is our most prized possession, we do not guard it!@
text_zh: 儘管符文是我們最珍貴的東西，我們並不守護它！

source_en: @Because Trinsic is the Town of Honor! None here would be dishonorable enough to steal it.@
text_zh: 因為Trinsic是榮譽之城！沒有人會不道德到偷走它。

source_en: @And surely, if any took the rune, they would do the honorable thing and return it afterwards!@
text_zh: 而且肯定地說，如果有人拿走了符文，他們也會做符合榮譽的事，事後將它歸還！

source_en: @The Mantra of Honor? Let me think...@
Recognizing you, fear fills the former pirate's eyes.
text_zh: 認出你後，恐懼充滿了這位前海盜的雙眼。

source_en: @Truly are thy compassion and honor an example to us all!@
text_zh: 你的慈悲與榮譽確實是我們所有人的榜樣！

source_en: @Goodbye, Avatar. Return again when thou hast more time to chat!@
text_zh: 再見，聖者。等你有更多時間閒聊時再回來！

source_en: @What do you want? I thought we had a deal!@
text_zh: 你想要什麼？我以為我們達成了交易！
一位頭髮稀疏但風度翩翩的男士。

source_en: @Anything else I can do for you?

text_zh: 一個身材矮小、模樣神經質的男人。*

source_en: @Welcome to the Fool's Pair o' Dice.@
@I sell grapes, ale, mead, wine, and mutton.@
text_zh: @我賣葡萄、艾爾啤酒、麥酒、葡萄酒和羊肉。@

source_en: @Come by the Fool's Pair O' Dice when I'm open for business.@*
text_zh: @我開業時歡迎光顧「愚人雙骰」。@*

source_en: @Come back when you have some gold.@
@You don't have room to carry it.@
text_zh: 你的隨身空間不夠，無法攜帶它。

source_en: @Anything else I can do for you?@
@What else can I do for thee?@
@Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, Brandon hands over the
text_zh: ＠很好！＠收到你的金子後，Brandon把交給你

source_en: @You've come to me to aid thee in thy quest! What an honor!@
text_zh: ＠你來找我，是為了在你的征途中尋求幫助！真是榮幸！＠

source_en: , and I'm honored to meet thee!@
@Oh, I'm not important like you. I'm just a weaponsmith--and only a journeyman at that.@
text_zh: ＠噢，我沒有你那麼重要。我只是一個武器匠——而且還只是個見習生。＠

source_en: @Aye, just a few years ago I was a simple apprentice. Now I supply arms to all Trinsic!@
text_zh: @幾年前我還是個普通的見習生。現在我為整個Trinsic供應武器！@

source_en: @I have to make weapons to help fight the gargoyles!@
text_zh: @我必須製造武器來對抗石像鬼！

source_en: @Perhaps you'd like to buy some. I'd be honored to have thee as a customer@
text_zh: @也許你想買一些。很高榮幸能讓你成為我的顧客@

source_en: @That would be a great honor! I'd love to!@*
text_zh: @那將是莫大的榮幸！我很樂意！@*

source_en: The man comes to his senses.*
@But no, I can't. I've responsibilites here, especially now.@
text_zh: @但我不行。我有責任在身，尤其是現在。@

source_en: @Come by my shop when I'm open!@
@I have a large inventory, so be more specific: Dost thou want arms or armor?@
text_zh: @我庫存很豐富，所以請具體說明：你是想要武器還是護甲？@

source_en: @Come to me shop when it's open!@

text_zh: 再見！願你的冒險一帆風順，聖者！

source_en: @I raise horses here, in the stables.@

text_zh: @也許哪天我會展示給你看看...@

source_en: @Never trust a gypsy! My poor horse..@
text_zh: @千萬別信吉普賽人！我的馬兒..@

source_en: As you leave, she blows you a kiss.
text_zh: 當你離開時，她對你飛吻。

source_en: @a sultry, dark-skinned woman dressed in riding-leathers@
text_zh: @一位膚色深暗、熱情奔放，穿著騎馬皮衣的女子@

source_en: . What can I do for thee this
. What can I do for you this
@It'll cost you 2 gold for the horseshoes, interested?@
text_zh: 馬蹄鐵售價 2 金幣，有興趣嗎？

source_en: @It'll cost you 15 gold per cannon ball. Interested?@
text_zh: 每顆砲彈售價 15 金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: @How many cannonballs do you want to buy?@
@Here you go.@ After accepting your gold, Harold hands over the cannonballs.@
text_zh: 給你了。收下你的金幣後，Harold遞給了你砲彈。

source_en: @Come back when my shop is open if you want some.@
text_zh: 如果你想買，等我的店門營業時再來。

source_en: You see a tall, muscular man with a solemn look on his face.
text_zh: 你看到一個高大、肌肉結實的男人，臉上帶著嚴肅的神情。

source_en: @Horseshoes are my living.  I also take orders for cannonballs.@
text_zh: 馬蹄鐵是我的生計。我也接受砲彈的訂單。

source_en: @If I weren't, why would you be here?@*
text_zh: 如果不是這樣，你為什麼會在這裏？*

source_en: @Now stop this foolishness and tell me what you want, youngster.@
text_zh: 現在別犯傻了，告訴我你要什麼，年輕人。

source_en: @That's ma'am to you, youngster. Respect your elders!@
text_zh: 對，叫你聲「太太」，年輕人。要尊敬長尊！

source_en: @That's better. Now, what did you want?@
text_zh: 這樣才對。現在，你到底想要什麼？

source_en: @I can heal, cure, and even raise dead!@
text_zh: 我可以治癒、解毒，甚至讓死者復活！

source_en: @Well, ain't that just like youngsters? Makin' mistakes and expecting their elders to bail them out.@
text_zh: 唉，年輕人就是這樣！犯了錯還指望長輩出來收拾殘局。

source_en: @Oh, sure! Thou art just trying to get on my good side.@*
text_zh: 噢，當然了！你只是想討我歡心罷了。*

source_en: @Hmph! And not so much as a thank-you.@*
@Well, that's kids today for ye! No manners, the lot of 'em!@
text_zh: 唉，現如今的年輕人就是這樣！沒一點禮數，全都一樣！
一個步履蹣跚的老太太。

source_en: @Who are you and what d'ye want?@
@But you can call me ma'am, youngster.@
text_zh: 不過你可以叫我太太，年輕人。

source_en: @Job? I'm a mender of the inflicted!@*
text_zh: 職業？我是治癒受難者的！*

source_en: @Iolo's apprentice has taken over my job at Iolo's Bows.@
text_zh: @Iolo 的學徒已經接替了我在 Iolo's Bows 的工作。@

source_en: @These days I've been transcribing the folk songs of Britannia into numerical notation for the artisan's guild.@
text_zh: @這段時間，我一直致力於將 Britannia 的民歌轉錄為數字譜記法，交給手工藝公會。@

source_en: @Of course, helping you on your quest is more important than that right now.@
text_zh: @當然，現在幫助你完成任務比那個更重要。@

source_en: @Of course, if you need my help, I could leave the guild for a time and join you.@
text_zh: @當然，如果你需要我的幫忙，我可以暫時離開公會與你同行。@

source_en: @Selganor can tell you more about the guild than I could.@
text_zh: @Selganor 能比我更詳細地向你介紹公會的情況。@

source_en: @You have enough travelling with you already. If you ask one of them to leave first, I'd be happy to join you.@
text_zh: @你身邊的旅伴已經足夠多了。如果你能先讓其中一人離開，我非常樂意加入你們。@

source_en: She runs over and hooks arms with Iolo, and they dance around and around. They're obviously very happy to see each other again.
text_zh: 她跑過來挽住 Iolo 的手臂，兩人邊跳邊轉圈圈。顯然他們非常高興能再次相見。

source_en: @Okay! It will be nice to spend some time on the road again.@
text_zh: @好極了！再次踏上旅途一定很美好。@

source_en: @I'd have to join you before I could leave, silly!@
text_zh: @我得先加入你們，才能離開，笨蛋！@

source_en: @Dost thou want me to wait here or should I go home?@
text_zh: @你想讓我在這裡等，還是應該讓我去家？@

source_en: @Very well. I shall wait here until thou dost return.@
text_zh: @很好。我會在此等候，直到你回來為止。@
一位穿著朴素的吟遊詩人。

source_en: I'll be waiting here for thee.
@All right. I'll head back home to Minoc. Come let me know if you need me to join you again later. I'll leave all my things here - some of them might come in handy for you.@
text_zh: @好的。我要回 Minoc 了。如果稍後你需要我加入你們，隨時告訴我。我會把所有東西留在此處——其中一些對你來說可能很有用。@

source_en: She gives Iolo a big hug before she leaves. @Remember to keep your socks dry@, she says, @and I'll see you when the quest is done.@
text_zh: 離開前，她緊緊擁抱了 Iolo。@記得保持襪子乾爽@，她說，@等任務結束我們再見。@

source_en: @The songs of a people are an important part of their heritage. Putting them down on paper helps preserve our traditions for future generations.@
text_zh: @一個民族的歌曲是其遺產的重要組成部分。將它們記錄下來有助於為後世保存我們的傳統。@

source_en: @Is there something you needed to know?@
@I'm so glad you appreciate the value of tradition.@
text_zh: @我很高興你能欣賞傳統的價值。@

source_en: @A bit scruffy, but he's the sweetest husband I could ever ask for.@
text_zh: @他有點邋遢，但他是我能遇到的最棒的丈夫了。@

source_en: @You're only saying that because it's true.@ He gives her a kiss.@
text_zh: @你這麼說是因為這是事實。@ 他親吻了她。@

source_en: @If you need a good crossbow, the shop is in Britain, over by the Blue Boar.@
text_zh: @如果你需要一把好弩，商店在 Britain，就在 Blue Boar 旁邊。@

source_en: @A number for every note, and a note for every number.@
text_zh: @每一個音符對應一個數字，每一個數字對應一個音符。@

source_en: @Each note is represented by one number@
@Oh, Selganor sent you, did he? I bet you want to learn '@Stones.@
text_zh: @噢，是 Selganor 派你來的嗎？我猜你是想學『@Stones.@

source_en: @In the standard numerical notation, it reads '678987 8767653'.@
@It's me, Gwenno. You have been away from our realm a long time, haven't you...@
text_zh: @是我，Gwenno。你離開我們領域很久了，對吧...@

source_en: He asks you a few alchemy questions and you answer them.
text_zh: 他問了你幾個煉金術問題，並由你回答。

source_en: @Thanks! Now what can I do for you?@
text_zh: @謝謝！那麼，我能為你做什麼呢？@

source_en: @My name is Selganor. 'Tis a name with a long history... But you have the look of one with more important business.@
text_zh: @我的名字是Selganor。這是一個擁有悠久歷史的名字...但你的神情顯示你有更重要的事情要忙。@

source_en: @It means 'seeker of the crystal'. Perhaps I'll tell you more some other time.@
text_zh: @這意思是「水晶的探索者」。也許改天我再多跟你說一點。@

source_en: @Perhaps you're interested in joining the guild.@
@I'd be glad to loan you the rune, but only members of the guild are allowed to handle it.@
text_zh: @我很樂意把符文借給妳，但只有公會成員才被允許接觸它。@

source_en: @If you want to join the guild, you need to do two things. First, you need to make a set of panpipes. Julia can teach you how to that. You also need to commit 'Stones' to memory. 'Tis a simple tune - ask Gwenno to play it for thee.@
text_zh: @如果你想加入公會，你需要做兩件事。首先，你需要製作一套排簫。Julia 可以教你如何做。你還需要記住《Stones》這首曲子。這是一首簡單的曲調——請 Gwenno 為你演奏一遍。@

source_en: @Wait a minute... You're already a member of the guild!@
text_zh: @等一下...你已經是公會的成員了！@

source_en: @Have you made a set of panpipes?@
He inspects the pipes. @Very good, very good indeed. Now play the sequence of notes in 'Stones' and I'll induct you into the guild.@
text_zh: 他檢查了排簫。@非常好，非常好。現在請演奏《Stones》中的音符序列，我就讓你加入公會。@

source_en: @Oh. Well, Julia can show you how if you need help.@
text_zh: @噢。好吧，如果你需要幫助，Julia 可以教你。@

source_en: @You should play your panpipes often - 'twill lighten your step on the long road ahead.@
text_zh: @你應該經常演奏你的排笛——它會在漫長的前路上讓你的步伐輕快起來。@

source_en: @She made my lute - and most of our other instruments as well. She lives just across the road, next door to Lady Isabella.@
text_zh: @她製作了我的魯特琴——以及我們大多數的其他樂器。她就住在過馬路對面，Lady Isabella 的隔壁。@

source_en: You see a a slender, graceful man tuning a lute.
text_zh: 你看見一位身材修長、優雅的男子正在調校魯特琴。

source_en: @Ah, I knew you'd be somewhere close by.@
@I prefer stringed instruments. They make such lovely sounds.@
text_zh: @我更喜歡弦樂器。它們發出的聲音如此美妙。@

source_en: @Oh, are you looking for the man who invented the balloon?@ He stares upward, stroking his chin pensively. @Ah yes, now I remember. He flew to Sutek's castle. Said something about a big job he had to do there.@
text_zh: @噢，你在找發明熱氣球的那個人嗎？@ 他望著上方，若有所思地撫著下巴。 @啊是的，我想起來了。他飛往了 Sutek 的城堡。說那裡有一件大事要處理。@

source_en: @Sutek lives on an island, far to the south.@
text_zh: @Sutek 住在南方很遠的一座島上。@

source_en: @Now play the first verse of 'Stones' on the panpipes and I'll induct you into the guild.@
text_zh: @現在用排簫演奏《Stones》的第一段，我就准你加入公會。@

source_en: You attempt to play the notes of 'Stones' on your panpipes --horribly.
text_zh: 你嘗試用排簫演奏《Stones》的樂句——慘不忍睹。

source_en: Iolo cringes, and shakes his head.
text_zh: Iolo 皺了皺眉頭，搖了搖頭。

source_en: @No, I'm afraid that's not it. Gwenno can help you learn the notes.@
text_zh: @不，恐怕不是這樣。Gwenno 可以教你學習這些樂句。@

source_en: @Oh, hello. Maybe you can help me with something. My nephew is studying alchemy, and he needs to know this.@
text_zh: @噢，你好。也許你能幫我個忙。我的侄子正在研究煉金術，他需要了解這一點。@

source_en: You play the first verse of 'Stones' on your panpipes.*
text_zh: 你用排簫演奏了《Stones》的第一段。*

source_en: @Excellent!@ He strums a chord on his lute, then taps you lightly once on each shoulder with it.
text_zh: @精彩！@ 他在魯特琴上撥了一個和弦，然後輕輕地用琴身在你每個肩膀上各敲了一下。

source_en: @You are now a full member of the guild of artisans. He reaches into a belt-pouch, takes out the Rune of Sacrifice, and hands it to you.*
text_zh: @現在你是工匠公會的全權成員了。他從腰間錢包裡取出犧牲符文，遞給你。*

source_en: @I'm sure you'll be needing this in your travels. I know you'll find some solution to this gargoyle problem.@
text_zh: @我相信你在旅途中會用到這個。我知道你會找到解決石像鬼問題的辦法。@

source_en: @I'm the healer for this town. I've cared for the unfit here for threescore years!@
text_zh: 我是這個鎮子的治療師。我已經在這裡照顧病人六十多年了！

source_en: @Those who need healing, curing, or to be resurrected.@
text_zh: 那些需要治療、解除疾病或復活的人。

source_en: @'Cah,' that is the word of sacrifice.@
@Welcome to my place of healing, Avatar.@*
text_zh: 歡迎來到我的治療所，聖者。*

source_en: @I hope thou needest not my services!@*
text_zh: 我希望你不需要我的服務！*

source_en: @Welcome again, noble Avatar. I hope this visit is for pleasure, not business!@
text_zh: 歡迎再次光臨，尊貴的聖者。我希望這次來訪是為了愉悅，而不是為了業務！

source_en: @How can I help thee this fine

text_zh: 你無需告訴我在下你的名字，

source_en: . The Avatar is famous throughout the land!@
@I weave baskets and beehives, just like my father and his father before him.@
text_zh: 我編織籃子和蜂巢，就像我的父親和他父親以前做的那樣。

source_en: @My baskets are sold throughout Britannia!@ she adds proudly.
text_zh: 我的籃子賣遍了Britannia！她驕傲地補充道。

source_en: @Father once told me a story of weaving a basket large enough for eight people! He never showed me the plans, though.@
text_zh: 父親曾給我講過一個故事，說他曾編織過一個足以容納八個人的大籃子！不過，他從未給我看過圖紙。

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open!@
text_zh: @我營業時間時歡迎來到我的商店！@

source_en: @Wouldst thou like to buy one of my weavings?@

text_zh: 這裡有細緻編織的蜂巢！

source_en: @These baskets are sturdy and decorative. Thou'lt find no better in all Britannia for the price, a mere
text_zh: 這些籃子結實又美觀。以這個價格，你在整個Britannia都找不到比這更好的了，只要

source_en: Michelle takes your money and hands over the baskets. @I appreciate thy business.@
text_zh: Michelle收下你的錢，並交出了籃子。我很感謝你的惠顧。

source_en: Michelle takes your money and hands over the basket. @I appreciate thy business.@
text_zh: Michelle收下你的錢，並交出了籃子。我很感謝你的惠顧。

source_en: @Is there aught else thou wouldst buy?@
text_zh: 還有其他想買的東西嗎？

source_en: @But thou canst not carry any baskets!@
text_zh: 但你帶不了那麼多籃子！

source_en: @Thou hast not enough gold for that many!@
@If thou hast need of beehives, these woven ones are the best thou'lt find! And cheap, too, at
text_zh: 如果你需要蜂巢，這些編織的是你能找到的最好的！而且很便宜，只要

source_en: Michelle takes your money and hands over the beehives. @I appreciate thy business.@
text_zh: Michelle收下你的錢，並交出了蜂巢。我很感謝你的惠顧。

source_en: Michelle takes your money and hands over the beehive. @I appreciate thy business.@
text_zh: Michelle收下你的錢，並交出了蜂巢。我很感謝你的惠顧。

source_en: @But thou canst not carry any beehives!@
text_zh: 但你帶不了那麼多蜂巢！

source_en: @I fear my schedule is packed. I have no time to create a basket for which I have no plans.@
text_zh: 我怕我的時間表已經排滿了。我沒有時間去製作一個沒有圖紙的籃子。

source_en: @All right, though I can give thou the best price in the land!@
text_zh: 好的，不過我能給出全地最低的價格！

source_en: @I have all I need, and have no reason to purchase anything more. But I appreciate thy offer.@
text_zh: @我所需要的都有了，也沒有理由再購買更多。但我感謝你的好意。@
問我什麼時候開始營業！

source_en: @Yes, without accurate plans it takes far too much time to craft a basket.@
text_zh: 是的，沒有準確的圖樣，編織籃子要花太多時間了。

source_en: @Then it was true! Father did weave a basket that big!@*
text_zh: 原來是真的！父親確實編織過那麼大的一個籃子！*

source_en: @Surely I could do the same.@ She studies the plans for a moment.
text_zh: 「我相信我也能做到。」她研究圖樣片刻。

source_en: @Such a basket would cost 300 gold, in advance. Art thou still interested?@
text_zh: 這樣的籃子需預付300金幣。你還感興趣嗎？

source_en: She begins weaving the huge basket, chatting with you as she works.*
text_zh: 她開始編織巨大的籃子，一邊工作一邊和你閒聊。*

source_en: @Hast thou found a silk weaver yet?@
@Thou art wise, then. 'Tis a huge bag this will require.@
text_zh: 那你真明智。這需要一個巨大的袋子。

source_en: @Well, I can see that this will require a huge silk bag. I know not where thou might find a silk weaver to craft it!@
text_zh: 嗯，我看這需要一個巨大的絲製袋子。我不知道你在哪裡能找到絲織工來製作它！

source_en: She continues weaving the basket. @I do not mean to pry, but why dost thou need a balloon anyway?@
text_zh: 她繼續編織籃子。「我不是想打聽，但為什麼你需要氣球？」

source_en: She continues weaving the basket. Time passes...*
text_zh: 她繼續編織籃子。時間流逝...*

source_en: @Finished! It took less time than I had thought it might!@
text_zh: 完成了！花時間比我以來的預估短！
