source_en: She gives the basket to you, and you struggle under its weight.
text_zh: 她把籃子給你，你在它的重量下掙扎。

source_en: @But it would weigh six stones! Thou couldst not carry such a basket, loaded as thou art.@*
text_zh: 但它會重六石！以你現在的負載，你不可能攜帶這樣一個籃子。*

source_en: @Lighten thy load, and then I will weave thee this basket.@
text_zh: 減輕你的負重，然後我會為你編織這個籃子。

source_en: @Thou hast not enough money for the basket. I fear I cannot afford to start such a task on a mere
text_zh: 你的錢不夠買這個籃子。我擔心我不能接受這麼少的

source_en: @I do not blame thee. 'Tis a huge undertaking!@
text_zh: 我不怪你。這是個巨大的工程！

source_en: @Farewell! I hope I've aided thy quest!@
text_zh: @告別了！希望我能幫助你的旅程！@

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open!@
text_zh: @我營業時間時歡迎來到我的商店！@

source_en: @My mill makes smooth boards and planks out of rough-cut logs.@
text_zh: @我的鋸木廠將粗加工的原木製成光滑的木板和方木。@

source_en: @Aye, I see you have a yew log.@ He inspects the wood with a practiced eye.*
text_zh: @啊，我看到你有一根紫杉原木。@ 他用練就的眼神 inspect 這塊木材。*

source_en: @Good grain. Yes, I can make a fine board out of this log. But it will cost thee 5 gold! Still interested?@
text_zh: @紋路很好。是的，我可以用這根原木製成優質的木板。但這將花去你 5 金幣！還感興趣嗎？@

source_en: Aaron goes to his saw and turns the log into a flat, sanded board.
text_zh: Aaron走向他的鋸子，將原木鋸成一塊平整、打磨過的木板。

source_en: @There!@ He hands you the finished product.
@You don't have room to carry it.@
text_zh: 你的隨身空間不夠，無法攜帶它。

source_en: @Sorry, but I can't work for free! Come back when you have the 5 gold!@
text_zh: @抱歉，但我不能免費工作！當你有了 5 金幣時再回來吧！@

source_en: @Oh. Well, perhaps some other time then.@
A plump blond man with curly blond hair and a cheerful face.*
text_zh: 一個體型魁梧的金髮男人，留著金色捲髮，面帶喜色。*

source_en: @What can I do for you this
@I run the sawmill! Is there anything I can do for thee?@
text_zh: 我經營這家鋸木廠！有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？
身材矮小、胸部寬闊的男子。*

source_en: @I make glassware, the finest in the land!@
text_zh: 我製作玻璃器皿，全境最精緻的！

source_en: @If you'd like to buy some of my glassware, just say the word!@
text_zh: 如果你想買些我的玻璃器皿，只要說一聲！

source_en: @Aye, I know how to make glass swords. But there is little demand for them.@
text_zh: 是的，我知道怎麼打造玻璃劍。但對它們的需求很少。

source_en: @I require five gems for the crafting. This is too expensive for most. Aye, but things of beauty they are...@
text_zh: 製作需要五顆寶石。這對大多數人來說太貴了。是的，但它們確實很美...

source_en: @Thou seemst like a person who appreciates art. I'll make thee one, if thou hast the gems.@
text_zh: 你好像是個欣賞藝術的人。如果你有寶石，我就為你打造一件。

source_en: @Come to my shop when it's open!@
text_zh: 開門的時候來我的商店吧！

source_en: @Aye, a glass sword needs fine gems to complete its beauty!@
text_zh: 是的，玻璃劍需要精美的寶石來成全其美麗！

source_en: , I see the gems you carry. Dost thou wish me to craft thee a glass sword?@
text_zh: ，我看見你帶著的寶石了。你希望我為你打造一把玻璃劍嗎？

source_en: @It will cost thee 5 gems! Art thou certain?@
text_zh: 這將花費你 5 顆寶石！你確定嗎？

source_en: Dale turns to the furnace and begins crafting the sword. Soon it is finished, and you marvel at its beauty!*
text_zh: Dale 轉向熔爐，開始打造那把劍。不久它便完成了，你驚嘆於它的美麗。*

source_en: @There she is, and a finer work thou'lt never see!@
text_zh: 喏，這就是你見的，從未見過比這更精緻的作品！

source_en: @But thou dost not have enough gold,
@Hmm@, he scowls, @perhaps I was mistaken about thee.@
text_zh: “嗯”，他皺著眉頭說，“也許我對你的判斷出錯了。”

source_en: @Hmmm...You'd have to see a lensmaker about that. I hear there's one near the Lycaeum.@
text_zh: 嗯...這件事你得去問眼鏡匠。我聽說 Lycaeum 附近有一家。

source_en: @Do you have any gems to sell me?@

text_zh: 作為每顆寶石的價格。可以嗎？

source_en: @How many gems dost thou wish to sell?@
@Great!@ Dale takes your gems and gives you your gold.
text_zh: “太好了！”Dale 收下你的寶石，並把金幣付給你。

source_en: @Hmm@, he scowls, @Maybe some other time then..@
text_zh: “嗯”，他皺著眉頭說，“也許改天再說吧..”

source_en: @I'm always needing them for my glassblowing, let me know when you want to sell any.@
text_zh: 做玻璃器皿時我一直都需要寶石，你想賣的時候告訴我。

source_en: @Anything else can I do for thee?@
text_zh: 還有其他我能為你做的嗎？

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, Dale hands over the
text_zh: 「太好了！」Dale 收下你的金幣後，交出了

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, James hands over the
text_zh: 「太好了！」James 收下你的金幣後，交出了

source_en: @Is there more I can do for thee?@
@I'm just the apprentice, but if you want to buy or sell somethin' I can help ya.@
text_zh: 「我只是個見習生，但如果你想買賣東西，我可以幫你。」

source_en: @Me master went off to fight the gargoyles. 'E ain't been 'eard from since. I'm just mindin' the place 'til 'e gets back@
text_zh: 「我師父去討伐石像鬼了。自從他離開後就再也沒有音訊。我一直在照看店裡，直到他回來」

source_en: @Come to me shop when it's open!@
. Me master 'as quite a large inventory. Dost thou want arms or armor?@
text_zh: 。我的貨主擁有相當龐大的庫存。閣下是想買武器還是防具？@

source_en: to ya, and I 'ope ye come back soon!@
text_zh: 給你，希望你能盡快再來！@

source_en: @But thou dost not have enough gold,
@I used to sell ships. But you bought them all!@
text_zh: 我以前賣船的。但你把船都買光了！
你買了我的最後一艘船！

source_en: @It'll cost you 250 gold for the deed.  Interested?@
text_zh: 這份契書要價 250 金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting the gold, Trebor hands you the deed.
text_zh: 太好了！接下金幣後，Trebor 將契書遞給了你。
你找不到比這更好的船了。

source_en: @So long friend.@ He lumbers back to his work.
text_zh: 再見，朋友。他蹣跚著走回工作崗位。

source_en: A tall, muscled man with a wide grin.
text_zh: 一個身材高大、肌肉發達、咧嘴微笑的男人。

source_en: @Hello,@ he says, lumbering over to you and extending a large hand.@
text_zh: @你好，@他說道，拖着步子向你走來，伸出一只大手。@

source_en: He squints at you. @We've met, haven't we?@
text_zh: 他眯起眼睛看着你。@我們以前見過面吧？@

source_en: @My grandfather clocks require a six month order in advance. I do have pocketwatches readily availiable, however. Would you like to buy a pocketwatch for 50 gold pieces?@
text_zh: 我祖父的鐘錶需要提前半年訂購。不過我這裡有現成的懷錶。你願意花 50 金幣買一個懷錶嗎？

source_en: @Troy takes your money and hands you a pocketwatch.@*
text_zh: Troy 收下你的錢，將懷錶遞給你。*
或許等你負擔輕一些的時候吧。

source_en: @You don't have enough money for a pocketwatch.@
@The ticking of clocks is the pulse of civilization.@
text_zh: 鐘錶的滴答聲是文明的脈搏。

source_en: @Without clocks, people would just sit around uselessly, with no idea what to do next!@
text_zh: @沒有時鐘，人們只會無所事事地坐著，完全不知道接下來要做什麼！@

source_en: @Of course, the ticks would be useless without the tocks.@
text_zh: @當然，沒有『嗒』聲，那些『滴』聲也沒用了。@

source_en: @They're much deeper sounding and more satisfying than ticks.@
text_zh: @它們的聲音比『滴』聲更深沉，也更令人滿足。@

source_en: @Ephemerides is going to build a model of the whole system. I helped him design the gearwork that makes it go.@
text_zh: @Ephemerides 打算建造一個涵蓋整個系統的模型。我幫他設計了讓它運轉的齒輪機構。@

source_en: @If you didn't run around asking foolish questions all the time, you might learn something yourself!@
text_zh: @如果你不是到處問些愚蠢的問題，也許你自己能學到點東西！@

source_en: A spidery looking man with delicate hands.*
text_zh: 一個長著蜘蛛般外觀、雙手靈巧的男人。*

source_en: @I like to play chess. Keeps ones mind fit.@
text_zh: @喜歡下棋。這能讓腦子保持靈活。@

source_en: @Some people don't use theirs - but I do.@
text_zh: @有些人不用他們的腦子——但我會用。@

source_en: @I make clocks. The movements of the various parts are very complex and interconnected. Like the moons and stars, or the pieces on a chess board.@
text_zh: @我製造時鐘。各個部件的運動非常複雜且相互關聯。就像月亮和星星，或者國際象棋盤上的棋子。@

source_en: @Where is key? You go find it.@
You see a a stunningly beautiful young woman.*
text_zh: 你看到一位美麗動人的年輕女子。*

source_en: The woman never looks up from the book she's reading, even when you speak to her.*
text_zh: 這位女子始終低頭閱讀著手中的書，即使你在跟她說話也是如此。*

source_en: Doris never looks up from the book she's reading, even when you speak to her.*
text_zh: Doris始終低頭閱讀著手中的書，即使你在跟她說話也是如此。*

source_en: @My name's Doris, but you can just call me 'Hey you'. Everyone else does.@
text_zh: @我名叫Doris，不過你直接叫我「喂，那誰」就好。其他人也都這麼叫。@

source_en: @I'm in charge of the Tinker's Inn while my father's away. If you have any complaint, no matter how trivial, please feel free to bother me.@
text_zh: @我父親不在的時候，由我負責管理錫克爾旅館。如果你有任何意見，無論多麼微不足道，都請儘管找我。@

source_en: It doesn't really sound like she means what she said.
text_zh: 聽起來她似乎不是真心這麼想的。

source_en: @Room and board's 5 gold per night per person, cash in advance. Interested?@
text_zh: @食宿費每人每晚 5 金幣，須預付現金。有興趣嗎？@

source_en: @Your room is first door on the left. Checkout time is noon and be here earlier than that if you want breakfast.@ She gives you the key to your room and goes back to her book.
text_zh: @你的房間在左邊第一間。退房時間是中午，如果想吃早餐請比那時間更早過來。@她把房間鑰匙遞給你，然後繼續回去看書。

source_en: @No pay, no stay. 5 gold each, cash in advance.@
text_zh: @不付錢就不能住。每人 5 金幣，預付現金。@

source_en: @My father called me back from the Lycaeum so that he could go fight the gargoyles.@
text_zh: @我父親把我從Lycaeum叫回來，這樣他才能去對抗石像鬼。@

source_en: @Yes, I'm learning the mystic arts from the great Xiao. Though I doubt you'd know much about that sort of thing.@
text_zh: @是的，我正在向偉大的Xiao學習神祕藝術。不過我懷疑你對這種事情知之甚少。@

source_en: @She is the wisest mage in all Britannia. Only she can teach the spells of the greatest power.@
text_zh: @她是 Britannia 最睿智的法師。只有她能教導最強大的法術。@

source_en: Doris sullenly serves you breakfast and then returns to her studies.
text_zh: Doris 不情願地為你準備早餐，然後回去繼續她的研究。

source_en: @I hope you enjoyed your stay.@ Doris says without any hospitality in her voice.
text_zh: 「我希望你過得愉快。」Doris 冷淡地說道，語氣中毫無待客之道的跡象。

source_en: , Avatar. I'm glad thy travels have brought thee here again.@
text_zh: 興，聖者。很高興你的旅途再次將你帶到這裡。

source_en: @I am Lady Isabella. Thy name, of course, is well known throughout the land.@
text_zh: 我是Lady Isabella。當然，你的名字在整個土地上都廣為人知。

source_en: @Tis my privilege to be mayor of Minoc, the City of Sacrifice. We are renowned for our fine craftsmen.@
text_zh: 我有榮幸成為 Minoc，犧牲之城的市長。我們以精湛的工匠聞名。

source_en: @The tales of thy exploits are known by even the smallest of children. I recognized thee from the portrait Woodroffe made the last time thou came to our land.@
text_zh: 關於你的事蹟，連最小的孩子都知道。我是從 Woodroffe 上次你來我們這裡時畫的肖像畫中認出你的。

source_en: @One of the finest artisans that ever dwelt in Minoc. Alas, he died of the flu two years ago.@
text_zh: Minoc 曾住過的 finest 工匠之一。可惜，他在兩年前因流感去世了。
我們還能再說話嗎，夫人？

source_en: @We were entrusted with the Rune of Sacrifice.@
text_zh: 我們被委託保管犧牲之靈紋。

source_en: @I gave it to Selganor, the artisan's guildmaster.@
text_zh: @我把它交給了 Selganor，也就是工匠公會的公會長。@

source_en: @When the Rune of Sacrifice was sent to our city, I entrusted it to their care.@
text_zh: @當犧牲之符被送到我們城市時，我把它託付給他們保管了。@

source_en: @He's a fine musician. He lives just across the road from me, in the guild hall.@
text_zh: @他是一位出色的音樂家。他就住在我對面的馬路另一邊，就在公會館裡。@

source_en: @If I weren't so busy, I'd take lessons from him myself.@
text_zh: @如果我不這麼忙碌，我自己都會去跟他學藝。@

source_en: @The good healer Tara should be able to tell you the mantra. Go ask at her house, on the north side of town.@
text_zh: @善良的治癒者 Tara 應該能告訴你可口訣。去她在城鎮北側的房子問她吧。@
@Tara 是一位非常慈悲的女士。@

source_en: @I've heard rumors of such creatures, but I know no one who has actually seen one.@
text_zh: @我聽說過這種生物的傳聞，但我認識沒有人真正見過它。@

source_en: @Ah, thou wouldst be interested to hear of that. The balloonist flew off on an important mission and never returned. Selganor should be able to tell you more about it.@*
text_zh: @啊，你應該會對這件事感興趣。氣球飛行員執行一項重要任務飛走了，卻再沒有回來。Selganor 應該能告訴你更多關於這件事的情況。@*

source_en: Before you stands a woman of elegant demeanor, wearing a finely embroidered dress.*
text_zh: 在你面前站著一位儀態優雅的女士，身穿精細繡花長裙。*

source_en: @Tell me, is it true you once rode in a balloon whilst on the quest of the Avatar?@
text_zh: @告訴我，聽說你曾騎著氣球執行聖者的任務，這是真的嗎？@

source_en: @It must have been wonderful, to drift amongst the very clouds...@
text_zh: @那一定很棒吧，在雲海中飄蕩...@

source_en: @Ah, well...Some tales are but empty words, with less substance than the breath that carries them.@
text_zh: @啊，呃...有些傳說只是空話，比傳揚它們的氣息還要空洞。@

source_en: @Farewell, and please honor us with your presence again soon.@
text_zh: @再見，希望您能盡快再次蒞臨。@

source_en: @I have heard much of thy exploits, but never expected to meet you in person.@*
text_zh: @我聽過許多關於你的英勇事蹟，但從沒想到能親自見到你。@*

source_en: You don't have that much money.
After a while the dog sets down the bowl, lies down, and starts whimpering.
text_zh: 過了一會兒，狗放下碗，躺了下來，開始發出哀鳴。

source_en: The dog looks at you with a puzzled expression on his face.
text_zh: 那隻狗帶著困惑的表情看著你。

source_en: The dog looks at you expectantly.
text_zh: 那隻狗滿懷期待地看著你。

source_en: The dog shakes paws with you.
The dog fetches a stick and lays it at your feet.
text_zh: 狗取回了一根木棍，放在你的腳邊。

source_en: @I feel that the whole debate over 'free will' versus 'determinism' arises from an artificial semantic division. In light of the work of Godel and Heisenberg, it is evident that the two concepts are indistinguishable and thus, for all practical purposes, identical.@
text_zh: @我覺得，關於『自由意志』與『決定論』的整個爭論，源於一種人為的語義劃分。鑒於 Godel 和 Heisenberg 的研究，顯然這兩個概念是無法區分的，因此，就實際目的而言，它們是完全相同的。@

source_en: The dog picks up a bowl in his mouth and holds it up to you. You see that it has several coins in it already.
text_zh: 這隻狗用嘴叼起一個碗舉到你面前。你看到裡面已經有一些硬幣了。

source_en: You see an amiable, shaggy mutt.
text_zh: 你看到一隻溫和的、毛髮蓬亂的混種狗。

source_en: The dog jumps up and tries to lick your face.
text_zh: 這隻狗跳起來試圖舔你的臉。

source_en: The dog gets up and brings you his bowl again, looking at you expectantly.
text_zh: 這隻狗站起來，再次把碗帶到你面前，滿懷期待地看著你。

source_en: Do you give him any money?
@Then thou hast seen enough. Leave me to my shame.@
text_zh: @既然你已經看得夠清楚了。請讓我獨自承受這份恥辱。@

source_en: @So... Geoffrey pardons me, then? Hmph. Strange... I thought the law would claim me.@
text_zh: @所以...Geoffrey原諒我了？哼。真奇怪...我以為法律會懲罰我。@

source_en: @Well, it changes nothing. I will go on hiding, same as before. Do not expect gratitude from me.@
text_zh: @嗯，這改變不了什麼。我還是會繼續躲藏，和以前一樣。別指望我會感激你。@

source_en: @If thou thinkest me redeemed by a scrap of parchment, thou art sorely mistaken.@
text_zh: @如果你以為憑藉一張紙片就能救贖我，那你大錯特錯了。@

source_en: A nervous man with gaunt features.*
text_zh: 一個緊張的男人，面頰消瘦。*

source_en: @Wh..who are you? Did Geoffrey send thee to drag me back?@
text_zh: @誰..你是誰？是Geoffrey派你來抓我回去嗎？@

source_en: @You again... I suppose it was only a matter of time.@
text_zh: @又是你...我想時間早晚會輪到的。@

source_en: @I... I am Myron. Once a guard of Britannia... though not much of one.@
text_zh: @我...我是 Myron。曾是 Britannia 的衛兵...雖然算不上稱職的衛兵。@

source_en: @My duty was to serve in the guard. But my courage failed me... I could not face the gargoyles.@
text_zh: @我的職責是擔任衛兵。但我的勇氣讓我失望了...我無法面對石像鬼。@

source_en: @Sir Geoffrey was our captain. A true warrior... unlike me. He sent us to reclaim the Shrine of Sacrifice... but... I fled.@
text_zh: @Sir Geoffrey 是我們的隊長。一位真正的戰士...不像我。他派我們去奪回 Shrine of Sacrifice...但是...我逃跑了。@

source_en: @The Shrine of Sacrifice... aye. We were to take it back from the gargoyles. I saw their wings blot out the sun... their growls shook the very air... and I... I ran.@
text_zh: @Shrine of Sacrifice...是的。我們要從石像鬼手裡奪回它。我看見它們的翅膀遮蔽了太陽...它們的咆哮震動了空氣...而我...我跑了。@

source_en: @Call it what it is: cowardice. I abandoned my comrades... left them to face the gargoyles without me. If Geoffrey knew where I hid, he'd send me to the guillotine as a deserter... and perhaps I deserve it.@
text_zh: @就叫它什麼吧：膽怯。我拋棄了我的同伴...讓她們獨自面對石像鬼。如果Geoffrey知道我藏在哪裡，他會把我當作逃兵送上斷頭台...也許我活該如此。@
@那你走吧..我會等待我的命運。@

source_en: You see a weary man behind iron bars.*
text_zh: 你看見鐵欄後一個疲倦的男人。*

source_en: @Well, here I sit. Mayhap âtis better this way... Iâll not trouble the realm further.@
text_zh: @嗯，我坐著吧。或許這樣更好...我不會再給王國帶來麻煩了。@

source_en: @Dost thou come to gloat, Avatar? Or merely to see the coward in his cage?@
text_zh: @你是來看笑話嗎，聖者？還是僅僅來看困在籠子裡的膽小鬼？@

source_en: @Though thou art but a peasant shepherd, thou art discovered to be the sole descendant of a noble family long thought extinct. Dost thou-  Honorably take up the arms of thy ancestors; or Humbly resume thy life of simplicity and peace?@
text_zh: @雖然你不過是個牧羊農夫，但人們發現你是早已絕跡的貴族家族的唯一後裔。你會-  以榮耀的方式拿起祖輩的武器；還是以謙遜的態度回歸你簡單和平的務農生活？@

source_en: @Thou hast sworn to do thy Lord's bidding in all. He covets a piece of land and orders its owner removed. Dost thou - Serve Justice, refusing to act, thus being disgraced; or Honor thine oath and evict the landowner?@
text_zh: @你發誓要完全聽從主人的命令。他看中了一片土地，下令將地主趕走。你會 - 為正義拒絕執行，從而身敗名裂；還是榮耀你的誓言，驅逐地主？@

source_en: @Unwitnessed, thou hast slain a mighty dragon in defense of thy life. A poor warrior claims the offered reward. Dost thou- Justly step forward to claim the bounty; or Humbly go about thy life, secure in thy self-esteem?@
text_zh: @無人見證之下，你為保護性命而殺死了一頭巨龍。一名窮兵餉的戰士聲稱他獲得了報酬。你會-  正義地站出來領取賞金；還是謙遜地過著日子，安於自尊？@

source_en: @During a pitched battle, thou dost see a fellow desert his post, endangering many. As he flees, he is set upon by several enemies. Dost thou - Justly let him fight alone; or Risk the Sacrifice of thine own life to aid him?@
text_zh: @在一場激戰中，你見到一名同袍棄守崗位，危及其餘眾人。當他逃跑時，數名敵人包圍了他。你會 - 依據正義讓他自己應戰；還是冒著犧牲自己性命的風險去救助他？@

source_en: @Thou dost believe that virtue resides in all people. Thou dost see a rogue steal from thy Lord. Dost thou - Call him to Justice; or Personally try to sway him back to the Spiritual path of good?@
text_zh: @你相信德性存於所有人之中。你看到一名盜賊偷竊你領主（Lord）的財物。你會 - 依正義將他繩之以法；還是親自嘗試引他回到向善的靈性道路？@

source_en: @At last thou hast come to fulfill thy destiny@, the gypsy says. She smiles, as if in great relief.
text_zh: 「終於，你來實現你的命運了。」吉普賽人說道。她微笑著，彷彿如釋重負。

source_en: @Thou art a bounty hunter sworn to return an alleged murderer.  After his capture, thou dost come to believe him innocent.  Dost thou - Sacrifice thy sizeable bounty for thy belief; or Honor thine oath to return him as promised?@
text_zh: 你是一名誓約將涉嫌殺人者押送回來的賞金獵人。逮捕他後，你認為他是無辜的。你會 - 為了你的信念犧牲可觀的賞金；還是恪守承諾，按約將他押送回?

source_en: @Thou art an elderly, wealthy merchant. Thy end is near. Dost thou - Sacrifice all thy wealth to feed hundreds of starving children, receiving public adulation; or Humbly live out thy life, willing thy fortune to thy heirs?@
text_zh: @你是一位富有的老商人，大限已至。你願意——犧牲全部財富以救濟數百名飢餓的兒童，獲得公眾的讚譽；還是謙卑地度過餘生，將財富留給繼承人？@

source_en: @Thou hast spent thy life in charitable and righteous work. Thine uncle the innkeeper lies ill and asks thee to take over his tavern. Dost thou - Sacrifice thy life of purity to aid thy kin, or Decline and follow the call of Spirituality?@
text_zh: @你一生行善義舉。你的叔父，一家旅店的主人，身患重病，請你接管他的 tavern。你願意——犧牲純潔的生活以助親屬，還是拒絕並順從靈性的召喚？@

source_en: @During battle thou art ordered to guard thy commander's empty tent. The battle goes poorly and thou dost yearn to aid thy fellows. Dost thou - Valiantly enter the battle, or Honor thy post as guard?@
text_zh: @戰鬥中，你被命令守護將軍的空帳篷。戰事不利，你渴望援助同伴。你願意——英勇地投入戰鬥，還是恪守崗位，履行守護之責？@

source_en: @Although a simple fisherman, thou art also a skillful swordsman. Thy Lord dost seek to assemble a peacetime guard. Dost thou - Answer the call, so that all may witness thy Valor, or Humbly decline the offer to join thy Lord's largely ceremonial knighthood?@
text_zh: 雖然你只是一個簡單的漁夫，但你也是一位熟練的劍客。你的領主希望組建一支和時期的衛隊。你願意——回應召喚，讓眾人見證你的勇毅；還是謙遜地拒絕加入你領主那主要具儀式性質的騎士團？

source_en: @Sit before me now, and I shall pour the light of Virtue into the shadows of thy future.@
text_zh: 現在坐到我面前來，我將把美德的光輝注入你未來的陰影中。

source_en: @Thou hast been sent to secure a needed treaty with a distant Lord. Thy host is agreeable to thy proposal but insults thy country at dinner. Dost thou Valiantly bear the slurs or Justly rise and demand an apology@
text_zh: 你被派往遠方，與一位領主締結必要的條約。你的主人對你的提議持開放態度，但晚餐時卻辱罵了你的國家。你是要英勇地承受這些謾罵，還是正當地站起來要求道歉？

source_en: @A burly knight accosts thee and demands thy food. Dost thou Valiantly refuse and engage the knight, or Sacrifice thy rations unto the hungry knight?@
text_zh: 一名魁梧的騎士攔住你，強求你的食物。你是要英勇地拒絕並與該騎士交戰，還是將你的口糧犧牲給這名飢餓的騎士？

source_en: @Thy parents wish thee to become an apprentice. Two positions are available. Dost thou - Become an acolyte in a worthy Spirtual order; or Become an assistant to a humble village cobbler?@
text_zh: 你的父母希望你成為一名見習生。現有兩個職位空缺。你要——成為一個值得的靈性修會的見習弟子；還是成為一個謙卑的鄉村鞋匠的助手？

source_en: @A local bully pushes for a fight. Dost thou- Valiantly trounce the rogue, or Decline, knowing in thy Spirit that no lasting good will come of it?@
text_zh: 當地的惡霸挑釀打架。你要——英勇地擊敗這個流氓，還是拒絕，因為在你的靈性中你知道這不會帶來任何長久的好處？

source_en: @In thy youth thou didst pledge to marry thy sweetheart. Now thou art on a sacred quest in distant lands. Thy sweetheart doth ask thee to keep thy vow. Dost thou - Honor thy pledge to wed; or Follow thy Spiritual crusade?@
text_zh: 年輕時，你曾承諾與你的心上人結婚。現在你正在遙遠的土地上進行神聖的任務。你的心上人要求你履行誓言。你要——信守你結婚的承諾；還是追隨你的靈性聖戰？

source_en: @Entrusted to deliver an uncounted purse of gold, thou dost meet a poor beggar. Dost thou- deliver the gold Honestly, knowing the trust in thee was well-placed; or show Compassion and give the beggar a coin, knowing it won't be missed?@
text_zh: 受托送交數不清的金幣，你卻遇到了一個貧窮的乞丐。你是——誠實地交付金幣，因為你知道委託人的信任是正當的；還是展現慈悲，給乞丐一枚硬幣，你知道這不會被察覺？

source_en: On a wooden table eight bottles stand, a rainbow of bubbling liquids.
text_zh: 木桌上擺著八個瓶子，裡面是冒著泡泡、色彩如彩虹般的液體。

source_en: ERROR - this isn't supposed to happen...
text_zh: 錯誤 - 這不應該發生...

source_en: ERROR - Virtues undefined! Virtues chosen are:
text_zh: 錯誤 - 美德未定義！選擇的美德是：
除錯 - 獲勝的美德是
增加給聖者的魔法點數

source_en: Combat points added to Avatar is
text_zh: 增加給聖者的戰鬥點數是

source_en: @The path of the Avatar lies beneath thy feet, worthy
text_zh: 聖者之路就在你腳下，可敬的

source_en: @, the gypsy intones. With a mysterious smile, she passes you the flask of shimmering liquids.
text_zh: ，吉普賽人吟誦著。帶著神祕的微笑，她將一瓶閃爍的液體遞給你。

source_en: @Drink of these waters and go forth among our people, who shall receive thee in joy!@
text_zh: 飲下這些水，然後到我們的人羣中去吧，他們將欣喜地接待你！

source_en: As you drink from the flask, vertigo overwhelms you. A soothing mist obscures the gypsy's face, and you sink without fear into an untroubled sleep.
text_zh: 當你從瓶中飲水時，眩暈感席捲而來。柔和的霧氣遮蔽了吉普賽人的臉龐，你毫不恐懼地沉入安寧的睡眠。

source_en: You awake in a different time, upon another world's shore. Though the Avatar's quests brings you both triumph and tragedy, never do you stray from the path of the Eight Virtues.
text_zh: 你在另一個時代、另一片世界海岸上醒來。雖然聖者的冒險給你帶來了勝利和悲劇，但你從未偏離八美德的道路。

source_en: @Behold, the Virtues of the Avatar,@ the woman says. @Let us begin the casting!@
text_zh: 看，聖者的美德，女子說道。讓我們開始擲筊！

source_en: is remaining in the 1st round winners array.
text_zh: 仍留存在第一輪獲勝者陣列中。

source_en: @The Captain of the King's Guard asks that one among thee visit a hospital to cheer the children with tales of valiant personal deeds. Dost thou - Show thy Compassion and play the braggart; or Humbly let another go?@
text_zh: @國王衛隊隊長要求你們其中一人去醫院，用英勇的個人事蹟為孩子們鼓舞士氣。你會——展現同情心並扮作夸口者；還是謙遜地讓另一個人去？@

source_en: @After twenty years thou hast found the slayer of thy best friends. The villain proves to be a man who provides the sole support for a young girl. Dost thou - Spare him in Compassion for the child; or Slay him in the name of Justice?@
text_zh: @二十年後，你終於找到了殺死你最好朋友兇手。歹徒原來是一個年輕女孩唯一的養育者。你會——出於對孩子的同情而饒恕他；還是為正義之名殺死他？@

source_en: A lonely stroll along an unfamiliar forest path brings you upon a curious gypsy wagon, its exotic colors dappled in the summer shade.
text_zh: 沿著一條陌生的森林小徑獨自漫遊時，你發現了一輛奇異的吉普賽馬車，其異域的顏色在夏日樹蔭下斑駁閃爍。

source_en: @Thou art sworn to uphold a Lord who doth participate in the forbidden torture of prisoners. Each night their cries of pain reach thee. Dost thou - Show Compassion by reporting the deeds; or Honor thy oath and ignore the deeds?
text_zh: @你宣誓效忠一位參與禁止對囚犯進行拷問的領主。每晚，他們的痛苦喊叫都傳到你耳邊。你會——展現同情心並揭發這些行為；還是恪守誓言並忽略這些行為？

source_en: @Thee and thy friends hath been routed and ordered to retreat. In defiance of thy orders, dost thou- Stop in Compassion to aid a wounded comrade; or Sacrifice thyself to slow the pursuing enemy so that others might escape?@
text_zh: @你的軍隊已被擊潰並下令撤退。儘管違抗了你的命令，你是否——停下腳步，以憐憫之心援助一名受傷的同志；還是犧牲自己，拖慢追擊的敵軍，讓其他人能夠逃生？@

source_en: @Thou hast been taught to preserve all life as sacred. A man lies fatally stung by a venomous serpent.  He prays for a merciful death. Dost thou- Show Compassion and end his pain; or heed thy Spiritual beliefs and turn away?
text_zh: @你被教導要視所有生命為神聖。一名男子被毒蛇咬傷，命在旦夕。他祈求能獲得慈悲的死亡。你是否——展現憐憫，結束他的痛苦；還是恪守你的靈性信念，轉身離去？

source_en: @Thou dost manage to disarm thy mortal enemy in a duel. He is at thy mercy. Dost thou- Show Compassion by permitting him to yield, or Slay him, as expected of a Valiant duelist?
text_zh: @你在決鬥中成功奪下了 смертного 敵人（註：原文為 mortal enemy，此處譯為「致命敵人」或保留語境，依 U6 風格常譯為「敵手」）的武器。他已在你掌握之中。你是否——展現憐憫，允許他投降；還是按照英勇決鬥者的期望，將他斬殺？

source_en: @Thou art sworn to protect thy Lord at any cost, yet thou knowest he hath committed a crime. Authorities ask thee of the affair. Dost thou - Break thine oath by Honestly speaking; or uphold Honor by silently keeping thine oath?@
text_zh: @你發誓不惜一切代價保護你的主人，但你得知他犯下了罪惡。當權者詢問你此事。你是否——誠實地說出真相，從而打破誓言；還是為了維護榮譽，保持沉默以恪守誓言？@

source_en: @Thy Lord doth mistakenly believe he slew a dragon. Thou hast proof that thy lance felled the beast. When asked, dost thou - Honestly claim the kill; or Humbly permit thy Lord his belief?@
text_zh: 主君誤以為是他屠龍。你有證據表明是你的長矛擊倒了獸怪。當被問及時，你——誠實地宣稱斬首之功；或謙遜地讓主君保留他的信念？

source_en: @A merchant owes thy friend money, now long past due. Thou dost see the same merchant drop a purse of gold. Dost thou- Honestly return the purse intact; or Justly give thy friend a portion of the gold first?
text_zh: 一名商人欠你朋友一筆錢，如今早已逾期。你看到同一名商人遺落了一袋金幣。你——誠實地原封不動地歸還錢袋；或公正地先將部分金幣給你的朋友？

source_en: @Thee and thy friend are valiant but penniless warriors. Thou both set forth to slay a mighty dragon. Thy friend dost think he slew it, but the killing blow was thine. Dost thou - Honestly claim the reward; or Sacrifice the gold for the sake of thy friendship?
text_zh: 你與你朋友都是英勇但一貧如洗的戰士。你們兩人一同出發去屠殺一條mighty的龍。你朋友以為是他屠龍，但致命一擊是你造成的。你——誠實地宣稱獎勵；或為了友誼而犧牲金幣？

source_en: A woman's voice rings out with friendship, beckoning you into across the wagon's threshold and, as it happens, into another life...
text_zh: 一位女子的聲音響起，充滿友誼，邀你跨過馬車門檻，而正如順理成章地，步入另一段人生...

source_en: @Thy friend doth seek admittance to thy spiritual order. Thou art asked to vouch for his purity of spirit, of which thou art uncertain. Dost thou-  Honestly express thy doubt; or Vouch for him, hoping for his Spiritual improvement?@
text_zh: 你的朋友尋求加入你的靈性秩序。你被要求為他的靈魂純潔作證，但對此不確定。你是—— 誠實地表達你的疑慮；還是為他作證，期望他的精神有所提升？

source_en: @Thou has been prohibited by thy absent Lord from joining thy friends in a close-pitched battle. Dost thou - refrain, so thou may Honestly claim obedience; or show Valor and aid thy comrades, knowing thou may deny it later?@
text_zh: 你因不在場的主人所頒布的禁令，被禁止與朋友參加激烈的戰鬥。你是—— 克制自己，以便誠實地宣稱服從；還是展現英勇並援助你的同志，明知之後可以否認？

source_en: @She tried to have me arrested! I evaded and lived in solitude until I found that Rinaldo had returned.@*
text_zh: 她試圖讓逮捕我！我逃過一劫，獨自生活，直到發現 Rinaldo 回來了。*

source_en: @Rinaldo was skeptical at first, but the Captain never had any defections, and the Royal Navy had been searching for 'The Revenge' for many years.@*
text_zh: Rinaldo 起初將信將疑，但隊長從未有過叛變事件，而且皇家海軍尋找‘復仇號’多年了。*

source_en: @Captain Zagros...many pirates believe him to be a myth... but he's no myth.@*
text_zh: Zagros 隊長...許多海盜認為他是傳說中的人物...但他並非虛構的。*

source_en: @Now that he is safely behind bars, I have something that might interest you. After I left the crew, I managed to steal a great treasure from one of the Captain's hoards.@
text_zh: 現在他已安然入獄，我有一個可能讓你感興趣的東西。我離開船員後，成功從隊長的寶藏中盜取了一大筆財富。

source_en: @He was the Captain of Mondain's Black Fleet. It was believed his proximity to Mondain and the Gem of Immortality gave him an unnaturally long life.@*
text_zh: 他是 Mondain 黑船隊的隊長。據信，他與 Mondain 及永生寶石相近，賦予了他異常長壽。*

source_en: @Zagros served under Minax, and Exodus as well during the golden age of piracy.*
text_zh: Zagros 曾服役於 Minax 和 Exodus 麾下，正值海盜的黃金時代。*

source_en: @I watched Michael for a while, from a safe distance.@*
text_zh: 我在安全距離觀察了 Michael 一段時間。*

source_en: @The scars and pain I was feeling from the attempt on my life screamed at me to kill him...@*
text_zh: 我因企圖謀殺我而受的傷和痛苦在尖叫著要殺了他...*

source_en: @But my quest for Spirituality would have been all for naught.@*
text_zh: 但我的精神追求將會是毫無意義的。*

source_en: You tell him that Michael has escaped when confronted about his crimes and his whereabouts unknown.*
text_zh: 你告訴他，當被質問他的罪行和下落時，Michael 已逃逸。*

source_en: You tell him that Michael has escaped with Marney when confronted about his crimes and his whereabouts unknown.
text_zh: 你告訴他，當被質問他的罪行和下落時，Michael 已與 Marney 一起逃逸。

source_en: @I know where Michael might be. And as tempting as it might be to have thee to slay him...@*
text_zh: 我知道 Michael 可能在這裡。儘管殺死他可能很誘人...*

source_en: @I want him to truly face justice for his crimes, and dread the fate that will await him.@*
text_zh: 我希望他真正為他的罪行面對正義，並害怕等待他的命運。*

source_en: @I will take you to the place he is most likely hiding, and we will bring him back -alive- and let him contemplate his fate and his actions...@
text_zh: 我會帶你去他最可能藏身的地方，我們將帶他回來——活着——並讓他反思他的命運和行為...

source_en: Renthar joins your party. @I will lead you to the safehouse Michael is probably hiding. We must hurry because he won't be there for long.@
text_zh: Renthar 加入你的隊伍。 @我將帶你去 Michael 可能藏身的安全屋。我們必須趕路，因為他不會在那裡待太久。@

source_en: @You have too many following you at the moment. Have one of them stay behind and we will continue, but make haste!@
text_zh: 現在跟隨你的人太多了。讓其中一個留下來，然後我們繼續，但要加快速度！

source_en: @Time is running out, Avatar. You must reconsider if catching Michael is a priority to thee...@
text_zh: 時間在流逝，聖者。你必須重新考慮是否捕獲 Michael 是你的優先事項...

source_en: @She likens herself to be the second coming of Minax...her loyalty to him is only outmatched by her sheer insanity.@*
text_zh: @她自比為Minax的轉世...她對他的忠心，唯有她的瘋狂能與之匹敵。@*

source_en: @She's a dangerous one though, not to be trifled with. Do thou be careful, and don't let her put a hex upon thee.@*
text_zh: @不過她很危險，切勿輕忽。你要小心，別讓她在妳身上下咒。@*

source_en: @Thou wilt surely encounter her magical traps, so stay alert!@
text_zh: @妳會遇上她的魔法陷阱，所以保持警戒！@

source_en: @I hid it in a safe place, lest Michael managed to slay me, to keep it out of their hands. It's a powerful artifact.@
text_zh: @我把它藏在安全的地方，以免被Michael殺害後落入他人之手。那是一件強大的神器。@

source_en: @I believe it to be the Mystic Armour, created by the legendary blacksmith, Zircon. I would like thee to have it.@
text_zh: @我認為那是神祕盔甲，由傳說中的鐵匠錫爾康打造。我希望能把它交給你。@

source_en: @It will serve thee well in thy quest. It will be safe with the Avatar.@
text_zh: @它會在妳的任務中派上用場。交給聖者保管是安全的。@

source_en: He hands you the Mystic Armour
@Farewell, Avatar, I have much to learn from the townsfolk here.@
text_zh: @再會了，聖者，我要在這裡向鎮民學習很多事情。@

source_en: @We need to journey southeast of Skara Brae, where the river Maelstrom splits and empties into the sea. There is a small strip of land where a safehouse was built.@
text_zh: @我們需要前往Skara Brae的東南方，那裡是旋瀾河分流並匯入大海的地方。有一小片陸地，上面建了一座安全屋。@

source_en: @Michael is most likely staying there until he moves on. Let us be off, shall we?@
text_zh: @Michael很可能會留在那裡直到他離開。我們走吧，好嗎？@

source_en: A solemn looking man, who looks as if the weight of the world was on his shoulders.*
text_zh: 一位神情肅穆的男子，看起來彷彿揹負著世界的重量。*

source_en: , I must speak with Rinaldo about an important matter.@
@I am trying to put those days behind me, and become more virtuous.@
text_zh: @我正在試圖拋卻那些日子，變得更加正派。@

source_en: @My apologies for my shortness earlier. It was urgent that I spoke with him.@*
text_zh: @剛才我的失禮之處，請見諒。情況緊急，我必須和他談話。@*

source_en: , I had to inform him of the whereabouts of my former crew...@*
text_zh: , 我必須告知他我前船員的下落...@*

source_en: @Aye, I used to be an assassin for my Captain. I have since been reformed. Rinaldo has agreed to give me a pardon for my former life, in return for information leading to their capture.@*
text_zh: @是的，我曾是船長的刺客。後來我改邪歸正了。Rinaldo 同意就我從前的罪過頒布特赦令，以換取能導致他們被捕的情報。@*

source_en: @Greetings Avatar.  Michael has been brought to justice finally and is awaiting his fate. I have given Rinaldo all of the information I know on the other pirates.@
text_zh: @問候，聖者。Michael 終於受到制裁，正在等待他的命運。我將我知道的其他海盜的所有資訊都提供給了 Rinaldo。@

source_en: @My former Captain sent his latest protege' to kill me, thinking I was plotting his demise.@
text_zh: @我以前的隊長派他最新的門徒來殺我，以為我在密謀他的死。@

source_en: @Michael almost succeeded...but I was able to jump from the ship and make it to shore.@
text_zh: Michael差點就成功了...但我還是從船上跳下，遊到了岸上。

source_en: @As I lay on that shore dying, darkness surrounded my mind and I could see the Void opening up to consume me...@
text_zh: 當我躺在岸上瀕死時，黑暗籠罩了我的思緒，我看見虛無正張開巨口將我吞噬...@

source_en: @But then...it came to me in the form of a vision... an Ankh glowing in the clouds.@*
text_zh: 但後來...它以幻象的形式降臨於我...一朵安卡神光在雲端閃爍。@*

source_en: @It vanquished the darkness in my mind, then I knew I had to seek out redemption through the virtue of Spirituality.@*
text_zh: @它驅散了我心中的黑暗，那一刻我明白，必須透過靈性之德尋求贖罪。@*

source_en: @It gave me the strength to keep fighting, and I've recovered, but the scars will always remain.@*
text_zh: @它賦予我繼續戰鬥的力量，我已經康復，但傷疤將永遠存在。@*

source_en: @He was recruited at a young age, and the Captain trained him well.@*
text_zh: @他年少時就被招募，上尉把他訓練得很好。@*

source_en: @Michael was often sent to the mainland to collect debts from the Captain's 'legitimate businesses'@*
text_zh: @Michael 常被派到大陸，為上尉的「合法生意」收帳@*

source_en: @Or assassinate those who didn't pay, or tried to evade us.@*
text_zh: @或是刺殺那些拒不付賬或試圖逃避的人。@*

source_en: @He is very cunning, and sought my position as the Captain's most trusted henchman.@*
text_zh: @他非常狡猾，曾圖謀奪取我作為上尉最信賴副手的地位。@*

source_en: @The seeds of discontent were sown within the Captain's mind, that I was plotting against him.. thus Michael betrayed me and was ordered to kill me.@*
text_zh: @上尉心中不滿的種子已經種下，他認為我在謀反..於是 Michael 背叛了我，並奉命殺害我。@*

source_en: @Thanks to thee, his reign of murder is over. The guillotine is a proper fate for him.@
text_zh: @多虧了你，他殘暴的統治終結了。斷頭台是他應得的結局。@

source_en: @With the guidance of the people of Skara Brae, my journey of Spiritual enlightenment will continue to grow.@
text_zh: @在 Skara Brae 人民的指引下，我追求靈性啟悟的旅程將繼續成長。@

source_en: @When I recovered, I traveled to the nearby city of Skara Brae to learn more and seek out the Shrine. The townsfolk were in mourning.@*
text_zh: @康復後，我前往附近城市 Skara Brae 學習更多知識並尋找神殿。鎮民們正沉浸在哀傷中。@*

source_en: @I learned some pirates landed in a ship, bearing the crest of Mondain on it's sails. My former crew.@*
text_zh: @我得知一些海盜駕著帆船登陸，帆上印有 Mondain 的紋章。那是我從前的船員。@*

source_en: He looks down at the floor. @They had abducted and killed the woman, and were only there because of me.@*
text_zh: 他低頭看著地板。 @他們綁架並殺害了那名女子，而來這裡只因為是我。@*

source_en: @They must have knew I was still alive, and assumed I had sought out the healer there.@*
text_zh: @他們一定知道我還活著，並認為我已經去那裡尋求醫者幫助。@*

source_en: @Aye, the black sails, skull and glowing gem.@*
text_zh: @是的，黑帆、骷髏和發光的寶石。@*

source_en: @The Captain's ship, 'The Revenge', was rumored to be the finest and most feared vessel in Mondain's fleet.@
text_zh: @據說船長的船「復仇號」是Mondain艦隊中最新穎、最令人畏懼的戰艦。@

source_en: @It was rumored to have a magical protection hex put upon it by either Mondain himself, or Minax...@
text_zh: @據說那艘船被Mondain本人或Minax施加了魔法保護法術...@

source_en: @They're the meanest, most cutthroat pirates the Captain could find.@*
text_zh: @他們是船長能找到的最兇狠、最心狠手辣的海盜。@*

source_en: @I am hoping Rinaldo can bring them to justice, with everything I know about them.@*
text_zh: @我希望Rinaldo能憑藉我所知道的一切將他們繩之以法。@*

source_en: @The other woman, Lady Lenora, scoffed at my request for a pardon in exchange for information on the arrests of the pirates and my former Captain.@*
text_zh: @另一位女士，Lenora夫人，對我以海盜和我前船長被捕資訊換取赦免的要求嗤之以鼻。@*

source_en: @I sell reagents, teach spells, and craft magic staves.@
text_zh: @我出售法藥，教授咒語，並製作法杖。@

source_en: @Oh, nothing a great adventurer such as yourself would be interested in.@
text_zh: @哦，那些你這樣偉大的冒險家不會感興趣的東西。@

source_en: @He gets a suspicious look in his eyes.@*
@Come to my shop when it's open!@
text_zh: 開門的時候來我的商店吧！

source_en: @Yes, I make magical yew staves. If thou knowest the Enchant spell, thou canst lock a spell within the staff for quick use!@*
text_zh: @是的，我製作魔法紫杉法杖。如果你知道附魔術，你可以將咒語封存在法杖中以便快速使用！@*

source_en: @A yew staff costs 100 gold pieces, but it's worth twice that!@*
text_zh: @一根紫杉法杖要100金幣，但它值兩倍於此！@*

source_en: @The old man hands over a yew staff.@*
A wizened old man with a ready smile.*
, Avatar. For what purpose hast thou come?*@
You see a sunken-faced, starving man, dressed in rags.*
text_zh: 你看到一個面容憔悴、衣衫襤褸的飢民。*

source_en: It takes a few moments for the man to notice you.*
text_zh: 過了幾秒，那人才注意到你。*

source_en: @Please, you must help me.@ he says weakly.
text_zh: @求求你，你一定要幫幫我。@ 他虛弱地說道。
@求求你，求求你！給點食物我吧。@

source_en: @I used to sail under Captain Hawkins on the Empire.@*
text_zh: @我曾跟隨 Captain Hawkins 在 Empire 上航行。@*

source_en: @Yes, food! The last thing I ate was my belt. And that was three weeks ago.@*
text_zh: @對，食物！我上回吃東西是我的皮帶。而那已經是三個星期前的事了。@*

source_en: @If only you could give me some food...@
text_zh: @如果你能給我一點食物就好了...@

source_en: @Oh, the map. Yes, I still have that. I couldn't eat it.@*
text_zh: @哦，地圖。是的，我還留著那張圖。我吃不下它。@*

source_en: @It ought to be worth some food, surely?@
He hands you the map piece and rubs his hands, eagerly awaiting his food.*
text_zh: 他把地圖碎片遞給你，搓著雙手，迫不及待地等著他的食物。*

source_en: You share some food with the pathetic man.*
text_zh: 你分給這個可憐的男人一些食物。*

source_en: @Thunff fou,@ Ybarra says, stuffing the food into his mouth.
text_zh: @Thunff fou，@ Ybarra 邊說邊把食物塞進嘴裡。

source_en: After finishing the offered meal, however, Ybarra still seemes starved.
text_zh: 然而，吃完整頓提供的美食後，Ybarra 看起來依然飢腸轆轆。

source_en: Suddenly, you realize that you have no food to give him!*
text_zh: 突然，你意識到你沒有食物給他。*

source_en: @No food?@ he asks. @Then thou art doomed too!@
text_zh: @沒有食物？@ 他問道。@那你也會註定毀滅的！@

source_en: @You must! I'll die! Just a little bit of food for the map?@
text_zh: @必須給我！我會死的！就給一點食物換這張地圖吧？@

source_en: His last shred of hope torn away from him, the withered man leaps at you, screaming @Food! @Food!@
text_zh: 他最後一絲希望被奪走，那枯瘦的男人撲向你，大喊著 @食物！@ 食物！

source_en: @Not very tasty, but it was filling.@
@Leave here? No! I've almost gotten the tunnels figured out!@*
text_zh: @離開這裡？不！我快把隧道摸清了！@*

source_en: @Just a few more days and I'll be free!@
@Can I have a little before you go?@
The man collapses, the last of his energy gone.
text_zh: 那人倒下了，最後一點力氣也已耗盡。

source_en: But finally his tales come to an end.
text_zh: 但最終，他的故事就此結束。

source_en: @I sing better if I keep my belly full, and my wineskin as well.@
text_zh: @如果肚子填飽了，酒囊也是滿的，我唱得更好聽。@

source_en: @Would you care to donate a coin or two?@*
@The dragon is a scaly sort, Who spouts flame when he sneezes..@
text_zh: @那條龍身上長滿鱗片，打個噴嚏就噴出烈焰..@

source_en: @Many a bold knight has he fought, For he goes where e'er he pleases.@*
text_zh: @無數英勇的騎士與它戰鬥，因為它為所欲為，到處橫行。@*

source_en: @Mister Porcupine's naught but spines, To the dismay of him and his missus..@
text_zh: @豪豬先生身上全是尖刺，讓他和他的妻子都感到懊惱..@

source_en: @For that for which he truly pines, Is one of her sweet kisses.@
text_zh: @因為他真正渴望的，是她甜美的一吻。@

source_en: @A gypsy girl and a butterfly, Were out in the woods at play..@
text_zh: @一個吉普賽女孩和一隻蝴蝶，在森林裡玩耍..@

source_en: @And when I saw them I said 'Oh my! What a perfect sunny day!'@
text_zh: @當我看到她們時，我說『我的天！這真是個完美的晴朗日子！’@

source_en: @Avatar, thou hast done me a great kindness. These stones are safe once more, thanks to thee.@
text_zh: @聖者，你幫了我大忙。多虧了你，這些石頭現在安全了。@

source_en: @Kytyn will be overjoyed to see them returned. I've kept her waiting far too long, and I do not intend to disappoint her again.@
text_zh: @Kytyn 看到它們被找回來一定會欣喜若狂。我讓她們等待太久了，我不打算再次讓她們失望。@

source_en: . I hope I'll be seeing a lot more of you.@ He gives you a sly wink.
text_zh: . 希望以後還能常見到你。@ 他給了你一個狡黠的眨眼。

source_en: @When next thou seest me, perhaps we shall celebrate with a song and a mug of Frasier's Folly!@
text_zh: @下次你再見到我的時候，也許我們可以邊唱歌邊喝杯 Frasier's Folly 慶祝一番！@

source_en: @So Kytyn told you about the Virtue Stones? Funny you should mention that...@
text_zh: @所以 Kytyn 跟你提到了美德 Stones？真巧，你正好提起這個...@

source_en: @...I'm afraid I no longer have them.@
@Are you finished with the Virtue stones and ready to return them?@
text_zh: @你已經用完德性石，準備歸還了嗎？@

source_en: @I don't see any Virtue stones, I hope you didn't misplace them?@
text_zh: @我看不到任何德性石，希望你沒有弄丟它們？@

source_en: @Where are the rest of them? Please bring all eight of them back when you are done using them.@
text_zh: @其他幾塊在哪裡？請在用完後把八塊全部帶回來。@

source_en: , I cannot thank thee enough for helping me recover them from those thieves.@
text_zh: ，我無法用言語表達對你幫我從那些竊賊手中搶回石頭的感激。@

source_en: @I shall return them to Kytyn as soon as I can.@
@Have a seat and a drink, and I'll tell you all about it..@
text_zh: @坐下來喝一杯，我會把整件事告訴你。..@

source_en: @So there I was, in the Blue Bottle having a Frasier's Folly with Derydlus, to celebrate successfully making the transaction for the stones.@
text_zh: @當時我在 Blue Bottle 酒吧，正和 Derydlus 喝著 Frasier's Folly，慶祝成功達成石頭的交易。@

source_en: @Derydlus, bless his soul, was feeling a little tipsy and pulled out one of the stones from my pack to inquire what they do. @Perhaps they are for teleportation@, says I, @ and I put them back into my backpack.@
text_zh: @Derydlus，願主保佑他，有點醉了，從我的背包裡拿出一塊石頭，問那是做什麼用的。@也許是用來傳送的@，我說著，@便把它放回背包裡。@

source_en: @Unfortunately, a few ruffians were listening in from behind us. A mage named Morwyn, and a warrior named Daglar. I've had a few run ins with them in the past..@
text_zh: @不幸的是，幾個流氓在我們身後偷聽。一位名叫 Morwyn 的法師，和一位名叫 Daglar 的戰士。過去我曾和他們有點過節。..@

source_en: @They must have been in Moonglow to rob the antiquities dealer. At the time, I didn't think anything of it so I continued making merry well into the night.@
text_zh: @他們一定是來 Moonglow 搶劫古董商的。當時我沒多想，於是繼續盡興歡樂，直到深夜。@

source_en: @As I was leaving the Blue Bottle, they waylaid me in my inebriated state and took the Virtue stones! I suspect they delivered them to the mage who lives somewhere in the Dungeon Deciet, doing unspeakable experimentations.@
text_zh: @當我離開 Blue Bottle 酒吧時，他們趁我醉酒伏擊了我，搶走了德性石！我懷疑他們把它們交給了住在 Dungeon Deciet 某處的那位法師，進行不可告人的實驗。@

source_en: @You look like the sort who knows how to enjoy a good story.@
text_zh: @你看起來像是那種懂得欣賞好故事的人。@

source_en: @I've been traveling all over Britannia in hopes of hiring some warriors to get them back for me so I can deliver them to Kytyn...@
text_zh: @我一直在 Britannia 各地奔波，希望能僱些戰士幫我把石頭搶回來，好讓我能交給 Kytyn...@

source_en: @Aye, I belive he is called Morgoth. I know Morwyn and Daglar purloin items and things for his experimentations. I stumbled upon them once whilst exploring Hythloth.@
text_zh: @是的，我相信他叫 Morgoth。我知道 Morwyn 和 Daglar 為他的實驗偷竊物品。有一次我在 Hythloth 探險時撞見過他們。@

source_en: @I'd hate to go back to Kytyn empty handed, will you help me?@
text_zh: @我可不想空手回到 Kytyn 那裡，你會幫我嗎？@

source_en: @Bring them back here and I will tell you their secret. If thou dost promise to return them after thy quest is over, thou mayest use them.@
text_zh: @把他們帶回來，我就告訴妳它們的祕密。如果你承諾在任務結束後歸還它們，你便可以使用它們。@

source_en: @Morgoth lives somewhere deep into the Dungeon Deceit. It is located on an island north of Moonglow. I would guarantee those daft thugs Morwyn and Daglar took them to him in hopes of making a little coin.@
text_zh: @Morgoth 住在 Dungeon Deceit 深處。它位於 Moonglow 北邊的一座島嶼上。我敢打賭那些愚蠢的強盜 Morwyn 和 Daglar 是為了賺點錢才把石頭帶給他的。@

source_en: @I hope he doublecrosses them someday - they would surely deserve it!@
text_zh: @我希望有一天他能反悔騙走他們——他們確實該受此報應！

source_en: @Good luck, and return here once you have found them to ease my mind!@
text_zh: @祝你好運，找到後回到這裡讓我的心放下！

source_en: @Oh. Well, I'm sure I can find someone else, then.@
text_zh: @噢。好吧，我想我肯定能找到別人，然後。@

source_en: ! It's been too long. What brings you to this part of the realm?*
text_zh: ！好久不見了。是什麼把你帶來這片領域的？*

source_en: @Since they are safely in thy possession, thou mayest use them. I believe when the 'Recall' and 'Mark' spells are used upon them, one can teleport to the marked location.@
text_zh: @既然它們現在安全地在你手中，你便可以它們。我相信當 'Recall' 和 'Mark' 咒語用於它們之上時，人可以傳送到標記的位置。@

source_en: @I am sure that Kytyn wouldn't mind loaning them out to the Avatar, as long as you return them before your quest is over.@
text_zh: @我肯定 Kytyn 不會介意將它們借給聖者，只要你在任務結束前歸還它們。@

source_en: @Maybe I'm daft, but I don't see any stones in thy possession.@
text_zh: @也許我是傻了，但我看不到你身上有任何石頭。@

source_en: ? And I was enjoying your company so.@ He bows and kisses your hand.
text_zh: ？我還在享受與你的相處時光。@他鞠了一躬並輕吻你的手。

source_en: , I'm glad you stopped by to chat with me. We must do it again sometime.@
text_zh: 很高興你能來找我聊天。我們以後再這樣做吧。@

source_en: I'll be glad to play another song for you when next we meet.@
text_zh: 下次我們見面時，我很樂意再為你彈唱一首歌。@

source_en: @Well, never mind that for the moment. Let me sing thee a song!@
text_zh: @好了，先不管那個了。讓我為你唱首歌吧！@

source_en: @Mandrake, my friend, Mandrake. Like the root, but taller, handsomer, and louder.@*
text_zh: @Mandrake，我的朋友，Mandrake。像根一樣，但更高、更帥氣、也更吵鬧。@*

source_en: @I travel all over to spread important news throughout the realm - and tales and songs as well.@
text_zh: @我四處奔走，為了在王國中傳播重要的消息——還有故事和歌曲。@

source_en: @If you have time enough, I'll favor you with all three.@
text_zh: @如果你有足夠的時間，我會把這三樣都送給你。@

source_en: @It grows in swamps, but I'm found mostly in taverns.@*
text_zh: @它生長的沼澤，但我主要出現在小酒館。@*

source_en: @I visit them all. The Fallen Virgin and the Sword and Keg are rowdy and rough.@*
text_zh: @我全去過。The Fallen Virgin和劍桶既吵鬧又粗魯。@*

source_en: @The Blue Bottle serves Frasier's Folly - the finest ale in all Britannia.@*
text_zh: @The Blue Bottle 提供 Frasier's Folly——全 Britannia 最好的麥酒。@*

source_en: @But the Cat's Lair is still my favorite.@*
text_zh: @但貓穴仍然是我最喜歡的地方。@*

source_en: @'Tis in Buccaneer's @Den - no place for the timid.@*
text_zh: @它在@海盜巢穴 - 膽小鬼不適合去那裡。@*

source_en: @Over in Jhelom, it is. They always love a good brawl.@*
text_zh: @在Jhelom那邊。他們總是喜歡看一場好架。@*

source_en: @Derydlus often drinks there - the man can put away more ale than any other I've met.@*
text_zh: @Derydlus經常在那裡喝酒 - 這人喝的酒比我在任何地方見過的人都多。@*

source_en: @Many's the time he's drunk me under the table.@*
A charming fellow with a peacock feather in his cap.
text_zh: 一個迷人的傢伙，帽子上插著孔雀羽毛。

source_en: @You should try some! 'Twill do thee a world of good.@*
text_zh: @你應該試試看！這對你會有莫大的好處。@*

source_en: @A wonderful place! Dr. Cat gives me free drinks just for singing.@
text_zh: @好地方！Dr. Cat因為我唱歌給我免費飲料。@

source_en: @He loves games of all kinds too. Mention my name to him and he'll be sure to treat thee well.@*
text_zh: @他也喜歡各種遊戲。跟他說我的名字，他一定會好好款待你。@*

source_en: @If thou knowest not where it is, I'll not be the one to say.@*
text_zh: @如果你不知道在哪裡，我就不說了。@*

source_en: @Lots of warriors there. They fight just about every night, but they don't mean anything by it. 'Tis all in fun.@*
text_zh: @那裡有很多武裝人員。他們幾乎每晚都打架，但不是認真的。只是玩玩。@*

source_en: @Give him my regards if you see him.@*
@Too honest a town to be much fun, but some fine people live there.@*
text_zh: @這個小鎮太誠實，沒什麼樂子，但那裡住著一些好人。@*

source_en: @You should have Penumbra tell your fortune sometime.@*
@My travels were interrupted recently in a most fearsome manner.@*
text_zh: @我最近以一種極其可怕的方式打斷了旅行。@*

source_en: @I was captured by the gargoyles, and taken down to the other side of the world, where they held me prisoner.@*
text_zh: @我被石像鬼抓住了，被帶到世界另一邊，在那裡被關了起來。@*

source_en: @Welcome, welcome! 'Tis always a pleasure to see a new face.@
text_zh: @歡迎，歡迎！見到一張新臉總是樂趣。@

source_en: @But such was my good fortune that one of them helped me to escape. He spoke but little of our tongue, but I believe he said his name was 'Beh Lem.@*
text_zh: @但幸好，其中一個幫我逃脫。他很少說我們的話，但我相信他說他的名字是 'Beh Lem。@*

source_en: @I've seen their handiwork many a time in my travels.@*
text_zh: 我在旅途中多次見過它們的手筆。*

source_en: @I believe they have taken over all of the shrines of the Eight Virtues.@*
text_zh: 我相信它們已經佔據了所有八種美德的神龕。*

source_en: @Oh, you know: honesty, compassion, valor, justice, sacrifice, honor, spirituality, and humility.@*
text_zh: 哦，你知道的：誠實、慈悲、勇氣、正義、犧牲、榮譽、靈性和謙虛。*

source_en: @That's what you get for choosing such stuffy principles as a basis.@*
text_zh: 這就是你選擇這些迂腐原則作為基礎的下場。*

source_en: @If it had been up to me, I'd have chosen wine, women and song instead.@*
text_zh: 如果由我來決定，我會選擇酒、女人和歌曲來代替它們。*

source_en: @Think of the virtues those would lead to!@*
text_zh: 想想那些會引導出的美德吧！*

source_en: @The principles of wine, women and song would lead to the Eight Virtues of drunkenness, sensuality, harmony, lust, laziness, dance, indulgence, and happiness.*
text_zh: 酒、女人和歌曲的原則會引導出八種美德：醉酒、感官享受、和諧、情慾、慵懶、舞蹈、享樂和幸福。*

source_en: @Now there would be the foundation for a fine world to live in!@*
text_zh: 這將會是構建一個美好世界的基礎！*

source_en: @Perhaps my stories would be worth a few coins?@*
text_zh: 也許我的故事值幾枚銅板？*

source_en: @My name is Mandrake. And what may I call thee?@
text_zh: 我叫 Mandrake。請問我該怎麼稱呼你？

source_en: Mandrake tells you tales for quite a while, yet listening to them you lose track of time.
text_zh: Mandrake 給你講了好一會兒的故事，聽着聽着，你便忘記了時間。

source_en: He tells you of ships sailing off the edge of the world, of earthquakes, and mad wizards, and fierce battles.
text_zh: 他告訴你，有船隻駛向世界的邊緣，還有地震、瘋魔的巫師和激烈的戰役。

source_en: He speaks of spells that halt the flow of time, a man who found a way to fly, and the strange secret of the wisps.
text_zh: 他談到能停止時間流動的法術、找到飛行方法的人，以及 wisps 的奇怪祕密。

source_en: He tells you that there are two bands of gypsies who travel the King's Way, who are often mistaken for each other.
text_zh: 他告訴你，有兩羣吉普賽人在 King's Way 上旅行，他們常被彼此誤認。

source_en: He speaks of the pirate ship Empire, which was much dreaded in its day, and of the giant ants that can be found in the Dry Land.
text_zh: 他談到海盜船 Empire，它在當年是令人畏懼的存在，還有在 Dry Land 可以找到巨型蟻羣。

source_en: Your head is filled with wondrous visions.
text_zh: 你的頭腦充滿了奇妙的幻象。

source_en: But finally he notices that Dupre has begun to doze off, and decides to bring his tales to an end.
text_zh: 但最後他注意到 Dupre 開始打瞌睡了，便決定結束他的故事。

source_en: A good looking young man with a wine glass in his hand.
text_zh: 一個長相英俊的年輕男子，手裡拿著一個酒杯。

source_en: @Hello,@ he says, extending a delicate hand.
text_zh: @你好，@ 他說道，伸出手來握手。

source_en: @I have seen your face before,@ he says, cocking his head sideways.
text_zh: @我以前見過你的臉，@ 他說道，歪著頭。

source_en: @Faren. Faren the drunk as some call me.@ He winks at you.
text_zh: @Faren。有些人叫我『醉漢Faren』。@ 他向你眨了眨眼。

source_en: @I sell many types of wine, made right here.@  He clicks his tongue.
text_zh: @我賣許多種類的酒，都是這裡現做的。@ 他咂了咂嘴。

source_en: @You might have noticed the similarity between my sister and me.@
text_zh: @你可能已經注意到我妹妹和我很像。@

source_en: Have you met her? Then you know she is blind.@
text_zh: 你見過她嗎？那你應該知道她是盲人。@

source_en: @Yes, has been so since birth. For her it is like being born a gargoyle.@
text_zh: @是的，她天生如此。對她來說，這就像生來就是滴水嘴怪一樣。@

source_en: @She knows no other life. It is her lot to make the best of her situation.  In this she is no different than you or I.@*
text_zh: @她從不知道其他的生活。她的命運就是盡量適應現狀。 在這方面，她和你我沒有不同。@*

source_en: He pauses to gather his thoughts.*
text_zh: 他停頓了一下，整理思緒。*

source_en: @Even gargoyles face this dilemma, I'll wager. But we know them more by the ways they differ from us, rather than their similarities.@
text_zh: @我打賭，連石像鬼都面臨這個困境。但我們更多是透過它們與我們的差異來認識它們，而非相似之處。@

source_en: @For that bottle of wine it will cost you
@Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the
text_zh: @非常好！@ 收下你的金幣後，他遞給你
@沒有魚？@ 獨眼巨人看起來很難過。

source_en: @One-eye little one die long ago. Female want little one, so keep tiny one.@
text_zh: @獨眼小人很久以前就死了。那女人想要那個小人，所以留了這個小家伙。@
@沒有一個眼的小人那麼強壯。@
一隻巨大的男性獨眼巨人。*
@你帶了很好的魚。還帶更多嗎？@

source_en: The cyclops hands you a large, rusted key.
text_zh: 獨眼巨人遞給你一把生鏽的大鑰匙。

source_en: @We have no 'jobs' here as such. But I can heal, cure and resurrect@
text_zh: @這裡沒有那種「工作」。但我可以治癒、祛病和復活@

source_en: @Come to my shop when it's open.@
, my friend. Take care.@  Her long lashes flitter a moment.
text_zh: , 我的朋友。保重。@ 她的長睫毛眨動了一下。

source_en: A young woman who stares into the distance.
text_zh: 一位凝望遠方的年輕女子。
@我聽得出你的聲音。@她露出了微笑。
@我是 Stephanie，不過你可以叫我 Steph。@

source_en: @Wow! Two-eyed people like me! You gotta go see my folks!@
text_zh: @哇！像你這樣有兩隻眼睛的人真難得！你一定要去看看我的家人！

source_en: @I'm Myles. But Mama and Papa aren't good with names.@*
text_zh: @我叫 Myles。但Mama和Papa不太會起名字。@*

source_en: @Though sometimes I think Papa wishes I were big and strong like a cyclops, so I could help more.@
text_zh: @雖然有時候我覺得Papa希望我像獨眼巨人那樣高大強壯，這樣就能幫更多忙。@

source_en: @There's a whole lot of junk lying around the castle.@*
@They're not my real parents. Mama and Papa found me on the beach.@*
text_zh: @他們不是我的親生父母。是Mama和Papa在海邊撿到我的。@*

source_en: @I guess my real parents drowned or something. That was long ago. I don't remember much about it.@*
text_zh: @我猜我的親生父母可能溺斃了，或者怎麼的吧。那是很久以前的事了。我記得不多。@*

source_en: @Mama and Papa said they used to have a son of their own, but he died. So they adopted me!@*
text_zh: @Mama和Papa說他們曾經有個兒子，但他去世了。所以他們收養了我！@*

source_en: @We all live in that big old castle!@*
text_zh: @我們都住在那座大舊城堡裡！@*

source_en: @It's a real neat place, with all sorts of rooms and cellars and stairs and stuff.@*
text_zh: 這真的是個棒極了的地方，有各種房間、地窖、樓梯等等。*

source_en: @There's a whole lot of junk lying around the castle. Ask Mama or Papa about it.@
text_zh: 城堡裡到處都是廢棄雜物。去問Papa或Mama吧。

source_en: @Papa doesn't let me play with much of it.@
@A lot of places are locked. Papa keeps the keys.@*
text_zh: 很多地方都鎖著。Papa保管著鑰匙。*

source_en: @Come play in the castle with me!@
text_zh: 來城堡裡跟我一起玩吧！

source_en: @Many cataclysms have occurred since thou last visited Britannia!@
text_zh: 自你上次造訪Britannia以來，已發生許多災變！

source_en: @Ah, my good friend! Thou hast returned!@
text_zh: 啊，我親愛的朋友！你回來啦！

source_en: @For several years I have been here in the catacombs, studying the gargoyles.@
text_zh: 幾年來，我都在墓穴裡研究石像鬼。

source_en: @The gargoyle world, once as large as Britannia itself, is slowly being destroyed!@*
text_zh: @石像鬼的世界，曾經與 Britannia 一樣廣大，正在緩慢地毀滅！@*

source_en: @The forces thou set in motion have caused great sections of their land to fall off into the void!@*
text_zh: @你引發的力量導致他們的大片土地墜入了虛無！@*
@只剩下最後一座石像鬼的城市了。@

source_en: @Yes, I have learned much about them!@*
@I had a silver tablet that contained much of what I had learned.@*
text_zh: @我有一塊銀色石板，記錄了我所學到的大部分內容。@*

source_en: @I gave it to some gypsies to take to Mariah, at the Lycaeum.@*
text_zh: @我把它交給了些吉普賽人，讓他們送到Lycaeum的Mariah那裡。@*

source_en: @Good! I am glad to know that the gypsies kept their word.@*
text_zh: @太好了！知道吉普賽人遵守承諾，我很高興。@*

source_en: @No?! But I paid money, good money, for them to carry it to her!@*
text_zh: @不？！但我可是付了好多錢讓他們把東西送給她的啊！@*

source_en: @No matter. Now that thou art here, all is well.@*
text_zh: @沒關係。既然你來了，一切都好。@*

source_en: @You can study the gargoyles yourself, and carry the knowledge back to the surface!@
text_zh: @你可以親自研究石像鬼，並將知識帶回地表！@

source_en: @They are not evil, as most humans believe!@
text_zh: @他們並不像大多數人類認為的那樣邪惡！@

source_en: A long-haired gentleman with a scholarly demeanor.*
text_zh: 一位長發紳士，學識淵博，舉止文雅。*

source_en: @I have spent much time talking to them, and I have found them to be almost human.@
text_zh: @我花了很多時間與他們交談，發現他們幾乎與人類一樣。@

source_en: @I have learned about their society, their beliefs, and their language.@
text_zh: @我學會了他們的社會、信仰和語言。@

source_en: @There are two kinds of gargoyles, winged and wingless ones.@
text_zh: @石像鬼有兩種，有翅膀的和無翅膀的。@

source_en: @At first it seemed as if the wingless ones were slaves.@*
text_zh: @起初我以為無翅膀的是奴隸。@*

source_en: @But now I know that the wingless ones are beloved and valued family members.@*
text_zh: @但現在我知道，無翅膀的是受寵愛且珍視的家庭成員。@*

source_en: @They must be told what to do, because they are not truly intelligent.@*
text_zh: @必須告訴他們該做什麼，因為他們並不真正聰明。@*

source_en: @The gargoyles live honorably, by their own set of beliefs.@*
text_zh: @石像鬼活得正派，遵循他們自己的信念。@*

source_en: @The gargoyles' beliefs are much like our own.@
@Where we have the three principles of Truth, Love and Courage,@*
text_zh: @我們有真理、愛與勇氣三大原則，@*

source_en: @they have the principles of Control, Passion and Diligence.@*
text_zh: @他們則有控制、激情與勤奮的原則。@*

source_en: @Directly, these lead to the virtues of Direction, Feeling, and Persistence.@*
text_zh: @直接來說，這些導致了方向、感覺和恆心的美德。@*

source_en: @Combined, they lead to Balance, Achievement and Precision.@*
text_zh: @綜合起來，它們指向平衡、成就與精準。@*

source_en: @Praise the virtues! Humans have arrived here at last!@*
@Taken all together, they point to Order.@*
@And the sum of all the principles is Singularity.@*
text_zh: @而所有原則的總和即為唯一性。@*

source_en: @Gargoyle society stresses unity and singularity in all things.@*
text_zh: @石像鬼社會強調萬物之一的統一與唯一。@*

source_en: @They have to; their world has always been harsh, even before the cataclysms.@*
text_zh: @他們必須如此；他們的世界始終嚴酷，即使在大災變之前也是如此。@*

source_en: @With the help of a gargoyle child, Beh Lem, I have learned how to speak their language.@
text_zh: @在一隻名叫 Beh Lem 的石像鬼孩童幫助下，我學會了說他們的語言。@

source_en: @Use this scroll- it contains a basic vocabulary of the Gargoyle language.@
text_zh: @使用這卷羊皮卷——裡面包含了石像鬼語言的基本詞彙。@

source_en: @You cannot carry the scroll at this time.@
text_zh: @你現在無法攜帶這卷羊皮卷。@

source_en: @But you must! Thou hast no chance of saving the gargoyles if thou knowest not their language!@
text_zh: @但你必須帶它！如果你不懂他們的語言，就不可能拯救石像鬼！@

source_en: @The gargoyle City of Investigation, their place of learning and government, is all that is left.@
text_zh: @石像鬼的探究之城，也就是他們學習與治理之地，是僅存之地。@

source_en: @Thou must do something to save the gargoyle race!@*
text_zh: @你必須做些什麼來拯救石像鬼一族！@*

source_en: @He and I meet every day at noon, where Hythloth emerges in the gargoyle lands.@*
text_zh: @我和他每天正午在 Hythloth 浮現於石像鬼領土之處會面。@*

source_en: @But what's this? Not just any humans--the Avatar!@*
text_zh: @但這是什麼？不只是任何人類——是聖者！@*

source_en: @Go and speak with him, learn about the gargoyles.@*
@No, I cannot. I must stay here and continue my writing.@
text_zh: @不，我不能。我必須留在此處繼續我的寫作。@

source_en: @But Beh Lem may join thee. With his help, thou canst travel the gargoyle lands and learn how to save them.@
text_zh: @但 Beh Lem 可以加入你。有他的幫助，你可以在石像鬼領土旅行並學習如何拯救他們。@

source_en: @Wait! Thou must meet Beh Lem and travel with him among the gargoyle people.@
text_zh: @等等！你必須見 Beh Lem 並與他一起在石像鬼羣中旅行。@

source_en: @That is the only way you can save them, and save them you must!@
text_zh: @這是拯救他們的唯一方式，而你必須拯救他們！@

source_en: @And without Beh Lem with you, the gargoyles will attack!@
text_zh: @而且如果沒有 Beh Lem 與你同在，石像鬼會攻擊！@

source_en: @Farewell again, noble Avatar. As the gargoyles say, 'May thy persistence and precision lead to success.@*
text_zh: @再會，高貴的聖者。正如石像鬼所說，‘願你的堅持與精準引領成功。@*

source_en: @Upon you rests the future of an entire race.@
text_zh: @一個種族的未來系於你一身。@

source_en: @'Tis most fortuitous that thou hast returned, noble

text_zh: @獨眼的小不點很久以前就死了。@*

source_en: @Oh, me seen that! Big black block!@*
@Cellar no go. Deep deep deep. Locked.@*
text_zh: @地窖不能去。很深很深很深。鎖住了。@*

source_en: @Come back soon, play with tiny one more!@
text_zh: @盡快回來，再和小不點一起玩！@
一位巨大的女性獨眼巨人。*

source_en: @Oh you cute! You funny-looking like tiny one!@
text_zh: @哦，你真可愛！你長得像小不點一樣好笑！

source_en: @You come back! Play with tiny one?@
text_zh: 你回來了！和小家伙一起玩嗎？

source_en: @But he needs tiny friends! He get lonely!@
text_zh: 但他需要小夥伴！他會感到孤獨！

source_en: @I'm the beekeeper here at the abbey. If you want to buy honey, or sell me a honey jar I'm all ears -if only one-armed-.@
text_zh: 我是修道院裡的養蜂人。如果你想買蜂蜜，或者賣給我一個蜂蜜罐，我洗耳恭聽——雖然我只有一只手臂——。

source_en: @Lost me arm and gained that name in battle.@ He flashes a yellowed grin at you.
text_zh: 戰鬥中失去了手臂，獲得了這個名字。他向你露出泛黃的笑容。

source_en: @'Twas a horrid affair, but Mondain's men had to be thwarted.@
text_zh: 那是一場可怕的戰鬥，但必須挫敗 Mondain 的人。

source_en: @You must be new here.@ He looks to the ground.
text_zh: 你一定是新來的。他望向地面。

source_en: @He brought an age of great evil unto our land. Yet try and tell today's children of the age of darkness...@
text_zh: 他給我們的土地帶來了極大的邪惡。然而試著告訴今天的孩子關於黑暗時代的事情...

source_en: @They believe nothing can go wrong, as long as the Avatar lives.@
text_zh: 他們相信只要聖者還在，什麼事都不會出錯。

source_en: @It'll cost you 10 gold for the 'oney, interested?@
@Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the honey.
text_zh: 很好！收下金子後，他遞給你蜂蜜。

source_en: @You ain't that good-looking. My price is 10 gold.@
text_zh: 你不長得太好看。我的要價是10金。
你找不到比這更好的了。

source_en: . He lives east of here, between two rivers.@
text_zh: . 他住在這裡以東，兩條河之間。

source_en: @His hut be due north of Britain, or so they tell me..@
text_zh: 他的小屋在 Britain 正北方，據他們說..

source_en: @Bees are true friends. They work all day, making honey and scattering pollen. All we have to do is provide them with hives.@
text_zh: 蜜蜂是真正的朋友。它們整工作日，製作蜂蜜並傳播花粉。我們只需為它們提供蜂巢。

source_en: A strong looking man with just one arm.
text_zh: 一個看起來很強壯的男人，只有一只手臂。

source_en: He laughs. @And get stung once in a while!@
text_zh: 他笑了。有時還被蜇一下！

source_en: @I buys all my hives from a nice lady in Minoc named Michelle. She weaves them out of straw.@
text_zh: 我從Minoc一位名叫 Michelle 的女士那裡買下所有蜂巢。她用稻草編織而成。

source_en: @Will you take 7 gold for that honey jar?@
text_zh: 你願意用 7 枚金幣換這個蜂蜜罐嗎？

source_en: @Done!@ He hands you 7 gold pieces and takes the honey jar.@
text_zh: 成交！他把 7 枚金幣遞給你，然後拿走了蜂蜜罐。

source_en: @You've met Zeke before, 'aven't ya?@ he says, glaring at you. @What d'ya need?@
text_zh: 你以前見過 Zeke，對吧？他盯著你說，有什麼事嗎？

source_en: @I eat Iolo's hay to keep it from piling up everywhere and making a mess.@
text_zh: 我吃 Iolo 的乾草，防止牠堆得到處都是弄髒地方。

source_en: Iolo winks at you. @And a fine job you do of it, too. I don't know what I'd do without you.@
text_zh: Iolo 對你眨眨眼。你做得很好。我不知道沒有你會怎麼辦。

source_en: @Oh, that's right, I have a clue for you! You're the Warrior of Destiny, right?
text_zh: 噢，對了，我有一個線索給你！你是命運戰士，對嗎？

source_en: @Well, when you go to rescue Lord British from the underworld, be sure to bring his sandlewood box with you!@*
text_zh: 當你下黃泉去救 Lord British 時，務必帶上他的檀木盒！*

source_en: @We went to all that trouble just to hear this?@ says Dupre.
text_zh: 「我們費了那麼大的勁，就為了聽這個？」Dupre 說。

source_en: @We rescued Lord British from the underworld years ago!@
text_zh: @多年前，我們從地獄中拯救了Lord British！@

source_en: @Well, even if you didn't like my clue, it wouldn't kill you to say 'thank you.'@
text_zh: @好吧，即使你不喜歡我的線索，說聲『謝謝』也不會要你命。@

source_en: @I don't know what it all means, I just know it's important.@*
text_zh: @我不知道這意味著什麼，我只知道這很重要。@*

source_en: @They're nailed to my feet, see?@ He holds up a hoof for you to look at.*
text_zh: @你瞧，它們是用釘子釘在我腳上的。@ 他舉起一個蹄子讓你看了看。*

source_en: @You should try it. Saves you from looking for your shoes every morning.@*
text_zh: @你可以試試。這樣你每天早上就不用找鞋子了。@*

source_en: @Hay is the greatest menace to the well being of Britannia.@
@It takes constant vigilance to keep it from engulfing the entire realm.*
text_zh: @必須時刻警惕，才能防止它吞噬整個王國。*

source_en: @I've devoted my life to the task.@*
@It's a thankless job, but I am a determined horse.@*
text_zh: @這是一份吃力不討好的工作，但我是一匹意志堅定的馬。@*

source_en: @Hay, thou hath met thy nemesis, thy doom, and his name is Smith!@*
text_zh: @乾草啊，你終於遇到了你的死敵，你的毀滅者，他的名字是Smith！@*

source_en: You see Iolo give Dupre a nudge in the ribs. @You owe me a drink, @he says, grinning.
text_zh: 你看到Iolo推了Dupre的肋骨一下。@你欠我一瓶酒，@他說，咧嘴笑著。

source_en: He turns to you. @Sir Know-it-all here bet me that there was no such thing as a talking horse!@
text_zh: 他轉過身來對你說。@這邊這位自以為是的先生跟我打賭，說根本沒有會說話的馬！@

source_en: @Now I've seen everything. I suppose we'll be inviting some ducks over for tea next.@
text_zh: @現在我什麼都見識到了。我想接下來我們得邀請一些鴨子來喝下午茶了。@

source_en: You see a fine looking horse.*
text_zh: 你看到一匹體型健壯的馬。*

source_en: @Hello, my name is Smith. Who are you?@
@Oh, I had something important to tell you!  I can't remember what it was, though...@
text_zh: @哦，我本有件要事要告訴你！不過我忘了是什麼了...@

source_en: @I care for the garden and tend the vines.@
You notice the bees have regular aerial routes all about the vineyard.
text_zh: 你注意到蜜蜂在葡萄園周圍有固定的飛行路線。

source_en: @Zeke keeps bees on the other side of the abbey.@
text_zh: @Zeke 在修道院另一邊養蜜蜂。@

source_en: @Some of our rosebushes were planted by druids hundreds of years ago.@
text_zh: @我們這裡的一些玫瑰叢是數百年前由德魯伊德種下的。@

source_en: @Eventually, we became the Brotherhood of the Rose.@
text_zh: @最終，我們成為了玫瑰兄弟會。@
@這些排，@ 他指了指， @是無籽葡萄。@

source_en: @Here at the abbey we grow seedless grapes.@
text_zh: @我們在這座修道院種植無籽葡萄。@

source_en: . The enchanter made them for us.@
text_zh: . 是魔法師為我們製造的。@

source_en: @Now I grow new vines by grafting seedless grapevines onto regular rootstocks.@
text_zh: @現在我通過將無籽葡萄嫁接在普通砧木上來種植新的葡萄藤。@

source_en: @Yes. He lives east of here, between two rivers.@
text_zh: @是的。他住在這裡東邊，兩條河流之間。@

source_en: @His hut be due north of Britain, or so they tell me..@
text_zh: 他的小屋在 Britain 正北方，據他們說..

source_en: @Now those grapes there are for making wine.@
text_zh: @現在那些葡萄是用來釀酒的。@

source_en: @I cannot say which I like better: wine from grapes or mead from honey!@
text_zh: @我說不出我更喜歡哪種：葡萄釀的酒還是蜂蜜釀的蜜酒！@

source_en: @And these over here are for eating.@
He gives you a plump little bunch of sweet table grapes.
text_zh: 他給你一串飽滿甜美的食用葡萄。

source_en: @Visit me in the fields some time and I'll give you some!@
text_zh: 有空來我的田裡看看，我會給你一些！

source_en: He waves and turns back to work.
text_zh: 他揮了揮手，轉身回去工作。

source_en: A gnarled man with knobby muscles.
text_zh: 一個肌肉結實的粗獷男人。

source_en: He has a very sharp knife with which he prunes off less productive branches. @Mind that you stay out of the flight paths of the bees,
text_zh: 他有一把非常鋒利的刀，用來修剪產量較低的枝條。小心別擋到蜜蜂的飛行路線，

source_en: @I was trained in the conservatory, like most of us.@
text_zh: 我和大多數人一樣，是在音樂學院受訓的。

source_en: @Of course, there are always oddballs like Mandrake.@
text_zh: 當然，總有一些怪人，比如Mandrake。
真是位出色的吟遊詩人。

source_en: @Completely self taught, he is. Got some odd ideas about the Eight Virtues.@*
text_zh: @他完全是自學的。對八大美德有一些奇怪的想法。@*

source_en: @I have to give him credit, though...@*
text_zh: @不過，我得承認他還是有兩下子的...@*

source_en: @Last time we gathered together for a songwriting competition, he won first prize easily.@
text_zh: @上次我們舉辦詩歌創作比賽時，他輕鬆地贏得了冠軍。@

source_en: @The owl and the pussycat sailed to sea..@*

text_zh: @乘坐一艘美麗的豌豆綠色小船。@*

source_en: @Along came a spider and sat down beside them,@*
text_zh: @來了一隻蜘蛛，坐在他們旁邊，@*

source_en: @And the cat said 'Whose been sleeping in my bed!'@*
@The clock struck one, the owl fell down,@*
@And three little piggies went 'Wee wee wee wee wee' all the way home.@*
text_zh: @然後三隻小豬一路「嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚」地回了家。@*

source_en: @I don't understand it at all, but Dr. Cat says that's his favorite story.@
text_zh: @我完全不懂，但Dr. Cat說這是他最喜歡的故事。@

source_en: @He's a decent guy, and he doesn't water his drinks either.@*
text_zh: 他是個正直的好人，而且他調酒時也不加水。*

source_en: @He told me I should learn a story with some ducks in it, though.@*
text_zh: 他告訴我應該學一首關於鴨子的詩，真是如此。*

source_en: @Don't ask me. If he likes ducks that's his business.@
text_zh: 別問我。如果他喜歡鴨子，那是他的事。

source_en: @Being a bard can be thirsty work.@
text_zh: 當吟遊詩人可是個會讓人乾喉嚨的活計。

source_en: @A warrior mustn't let his blade grow dull, right?@*
text_zh: 戰士可不能讓他的刀刃變鈍，對吧？*
一位衣衫華麗的吟遊詩人。*

source_en: @Well, so also must a bard keep his throat from getting too dry!@
text_zh: 好吧，吟遊詩人也必須讓喉嚨保持潤濕，不能太乾！

source_en: @A lusty young smith at his feist stood a-firing,@*
text_zh: 年輕力壯的鐵匠守在爐火旁，*

source_en: @His hammer lay by but his forge still aglow,@*
text_zh: 錘子雖置一旁，但熔爐仍泛著紅光，*

source_en: @When to him a buxom young damsel came smiling,@*
text_zh: 這時，一位嬌美的少女帶著微笑走來，*

source_en: @And asked if to work at her forge he would go.@
text_zh: 並問他是否願意去她的鍛爐工作。

source_en: @With a jingle vang jingle vang jingle vang jingle,@*
@With a jingle vang jingle vang jingle hi ho.@
@'I will' said the smith and they went off together,@*
text_zh: 「我愿意」鐵匠說道，於是他們一起出發了，*

source_en: @Unto the young damsel's forge they did go.@*
@They stripped to go to it--'twas hot work and hot weather,@*
text_zh: 他們脫下衣服準備工作——那是苦力活，天氣也熱，*

source_en: @She kindled the fire and she soon made him glow.@*
text_zh: 她生起了火，很快讓他熱血沸騰。*

source_en: @With a jingle vang jingle vang jingle hi ho!@*
@Same as any bard - telling stories, singing songs, that sort of thing.@
text_zh: 跟一般的吟遊詩人一樣——講故事、唱歌，這類事情。

source_en: @Why you bargin' inta my house?@ he shouts.*
text_zh: 「你爲什麼要闖進我家？」他大喊。*

source_en: Hefting his large axe, he prepares to defend his home.
text_zh: 他舉起大斧頭，准備保衛家園。

source_en: @I told ya once already that I want to be left alone!@
text_zh: 我已經告訴過你，我想一個人待着！

source_en: @Ben. My friends call me Big Ben.@
text_zh: @Ben。我的朋友稱我為大Ben。 Big Ben@

source_en: @But you ain't one of my friends.@
@I guess you can call me 'Big Ben'.@ He smiles broadly.
text_zh: @我想你可以叫我 ‘Big Ben’。@ 他咧嘴笑了。

source_en: @Have ya never seen a lumberman before? Look around. Those stacks o' wood don't cut themselves.@
text_zh: @你從沒見過伐木工嗎？看看周圍。那堆堆木頭不會自己砍好。@

source_en: @Ever since I won that choppin' contest, the king's had a notion I'd be good at wittlin' on men the same way.@
text_zh: @自從我贏得了那次劈柴比賽，國王就覺得我在砍人這方面也很有天賦。@

source_en: @Well, you can tell him I'm not interested.@
text_zh: @好吧，你可以告訴他我不感興趣。@

source_en: @Aye, this is where I cut trees, and I don't like strangers wanderin' through!@
text_zh: @對，這是我的伐木場，我不喜歡陌生人閒逛！@

source_en: He fires a look at you. @I said only my friends call me that.@
text_zh: 他瞪了你一眼。 @我說只有我的朋友這樣叫我。@

source_en: @'Tis my name. Don't wear it out.@ He laughs resoundingly at his wit.
text_zh: @這是我的名字。別把它用舊了。@ 他為自己的機智大笑起來。

source_en: @It surprises you that I would have some. Sometimes it surprises me too.@ He laughs.
text_zh: @你對我有這麼多感到驚訝嗎？有時候連我自己都吃驚。@ 他笑了。

source_en: @You are from the king, ain't ya?@

text_zh: @噢。@ 現在他看起來友善多了。

source_en: @Aye, are ya here to buy a log?@
@Logs is 5 gold apiece. Ya still want one?@
He takes your gold and hands over a fine yew log. Ben seems friendlier now.
text_zh: 他收下你的金子，遞給你一根精美的紫杉原木。Ben現在看起來友善多了。

source_en: @Well, come back sometime and I'll cut one for ya.@
text_zh: @好吧，回來的時候我再幫你砍一根。@

source_en: You see a man as large as the trees that surround his cottage.
text_zh: 你看到一個身形壯碩如環繞小屋周圍樹木的男人。

source_en: @Hah, sneakin' around in my forest, huh? I told the last one of ya that came by that I'll have nothin' t'do with yer wars, so shove off!@.
text_zh: @哈，在我森林裡鬼鬼祟祟地溜達，是吧？我跟上一個來的人說過，你們的戰爭跟我沒有半點關係，給我滾！@.

source_en: @Thindle the spindler.@ He grins at you.
text_zh: @Thindle，紡線師。@ 他對你咧嘴一笑。

source_en: @Sew, sew, I sew 'cause I said so.@
@Yes, yes, yes. That was quite a guess!@
@Oh my, oh my, you must need cloth.@
@Come to my shop when I'm open and I'll sell you some!@
text_zh: @等我開店時再來，我就賣給你！@

source_en: @Oh my, oh my, you must need cloth. It'll cost you 15 gold for the cloth. Interested?
text_zh: @天哪，天哪，你一定需要布料。這些布料每匹要15金幣。你有興趣嗎？

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, Thindle hands over the cloth.@
text_zh: @太好了！@ Thindle收下你的金幣後，把布料遞給你。@

source_en: @Very well, but 'tis fine cloth, yes indeed...@
text_zh: @好吧，但這可是上好的布料，真的...@
@賣吧，現在，我感覺那是一團線。@

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open and I'll buy it.@
text_zh: @等我開店時再來，我就買下來。@

source_en: @Will you take 6 gold for that thread?@
text_zh: 你願意以 6 枚金幣出售那捲線嗎？

source_en: @Done!@ He hands you 6 gold pieces and takes the thread.@
text_zh: 成交！他把 6 枚金幣遞給你，並帶走了那捲線。

source_en: @Very well, very well, I can see you don't want to sell.@
text_zh: 很好，很好，我看出來你不想賣了。

source_en: @Shorty is my friend. We play flippits together.@
text_zh: Shorty 是我的朋友。我們一起玩擲豆遊戲。

source_en: @You should learn, you should learn. A nice piece of bone and a small hard pea--that's all ya need.@
text_zh: 你該學學了，你該學學了。一塊光滑的骨頭和一顆小硬豌豆——這就是你需要的所有東西。

source_en: @Like an old dog bone. You'll need a hat too.@
text_zh: 就像一根老狗骨頭。你還需要一頂帽子。

source_en: @The smaller, the better.@ He pulls an old bone from his pocket and a small pea. @Now you get a hat.@
text_zh: 越小越好。他從口袋裡掏出一根舊骨頭和一顆小豌豆。現在你需要一頂帽子。

source_en: A little, white haired man hunched over with age.*
text_zh: 一位白髮蒼蒼、因年邁而彎腰的老人。*

source_en: He puts the hat down and mumbles @Put the pea in front of bone...@ He gestures with his hands. @...and flippit on home.@*
text_zh: 他放下帽子，咕噥道：“把豌豆放在骨頭前面...”他用雙手比劃著。“...然後擲豆回家。”*

source_en: The pea sails into the hat.
@Silk? Oh no, oh no. Can't work silk, oh my, no. See Charlotte. She can, yes she can!@
text_zh: 絲綢？哦不，不行。我處理不了絲綢，天哪，不行。去找 Charlotte 吧。她可以，她真的可以！

source_en: @Humble Charlotte, yes. She can help you. She lives in New Magincia.@
text_zh: 謙虛的 Charlotte，是的。她可以幫你。她住在 New Magincia。

source_en: @Bye now. Bye. Say hi to Mortude if you see him.@
text_zh: 再見了。再見。如果你見到 Mortude，替他問好。

source_en: @Yes, yes, yes,@ he says, bobbing his head up and down.
text_zh: 是，是，是，”他說著，頭顱不停地上下點動。

source_en: @Back, back, back they come.@ He smiles to himself and claps his hands.
text_zh: 他們回來了，回來了，回來了。他自顧自地笑了起來，並拍手稱快。

source_en: @The strongest you'll ever tug!@ he says, pushing out his chest.
text_zh: 你拉得最穩固的繩子！他挺起胸膛說。

source_en: Mortude smiles at you, @For my fine rope it will cost you 5 gold. Interested?@
text_zh: Mortude 向你微笑，說：“我這條優質繩子要 5 金幣。你有興趣嗎？”

source_en: @Fine, fine!@ After accepting your gold, Mortude hands over the rope.
text_zh: 「好吧，好吧！」收好你的金子後，Mortude把繩子遞了過來。

source_en: @Too bad. You'll never find better rope.@
text_zh: 「真遺憾。你再也找不到更好的繩子了。」

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open and I'll show you!@
text_zh: 「等我開店的時候再來我的店，我就展示給你看看！」

source_en: @What?@ He snorts a bit then clears his throat.
text_zh: 「什麼？」他哼了一聲，然後清了清喉嚨。

source_en: @You have a bone on ya? We'll play.@
text_zh: 「你身上有帶子嗎？我們來玩一場。」

source_en: @The smaller, the better. And maybe a hat. @
text_zh: 「越小越好。也許還需要一頂帽子。」

source_en: @A haaat,@ he repeats, mockingly. @Never played 'ave ya?@

source_en: You are back. Gut.@ He leans back on his heels.

@It is a busy one - this job, that is. I find it rewarding, though, meeting friendly faces. Maybe you want a room, eh?@

text_zh: 這是個友善的美麗小鎮。鎮上的居民彼此都很熟絡。我們也常接待不少遊客。

source_en: @I chose Paws for my tavern because it's right on the King's Way, midway between Britain and Trinsic. There's no better travelled spot in all Britannia, and that makes for good business.@
text_zh: 我選擇「Paws」作為我 tavern 的名字，因為它就在King's Way上，位於Britannia和Trinsic之間的中點。這裡是ブリタニア全境最繁忙的地段，這對生意來說再好不過了。 Britain

source_en: @I like the name of the town too, of course!@
text_zh: 我當然也很喜歡這個鎮子的名字！
是個不錯的度假勝地，是吧？

source_en: @A bit too honorable for my tastes, if you know what I mean...@
text_zh: 對我的品味來說，他們似乎太正直了，你懂我的意思...

source_en: @Taynith is my dearest friend. Her gypsy band travels the King's Way. Once a week, she stops in to say hello.@
text_zh: Taynith是我最好的朋友。她的吉普賽樂隊沿著King's Way旅行。每週她都會來問候一下。

source_en: @Don't get the two gypsy bands mixed up... Taynith travels with Zoltan. The other group are a bunch of pickpockets and scallawags..@
text_zh: 別把兩個吉普賽樂隊搞混了...Taynith和Zoltan一起旅行。另一羣人是一羣扒手和流氓..

source_en: @I guess you can call yourself king of anything, if nobody comes along to dispute it...@
text_zh: 我想只要你自稱是什麼之王，只要沒人來挑戰，就可以是任何之王...

source_en: @A friend of Taynith's, are you? Here, have one on the house.@
text_zh: 你是Taynith的朋友，是吧？來，這杯我請。

source_en: @You've got your hands full at the moment, ask me again later.@
text_zh: 我現在忙著呢，晚點再來問我。

source_en: @Taynith bet me one time I couldn't catch a duck with my bare hands. So I did, and had a leash made for it, so I could give it to her as a pet.@*
text_zh: 有次Taynith跟我打賭，說我赤手空拳抓不到鴨子。結果我抓到了，還給它做了個牽繩，好把它作為寵物送給她。*

source_en: @I doubt she still has it, though. I saw Zoltan eyeing it hungrily...@
text_zh: 不過我懷疑她現在還保著它。我看Zoltan饞嘴地盯著它...

source_en: @Very good! you purr almost as well as Kytyn.@
text_zh: 非常好！你的呼嚕聲幾乎和克汀一樣好了。 Kytyn

source_en: @Are you friends of that deadbeat? He owes me for more drinks than I care to think about. The only reason I give him food and drink is because he can't sing with his mouth full!@
text_zh: @你們是那個白飯的朋友嗎？他欠我的酒錢多到我都不太想算了。我之所以給他飯吃給他酒喝，是因為他嘴巴裡塞滿東西時就唱不了歌！@

source_en: @I sell ale, mead, wine, milk, and mutton.@
text_zh: @我賣麥酒、蜜酒、葡萄酒、牛奶和羊肉。@

source_en: @Of course I like to chat with my patrons, and indulge in a friendly game every now and then.@
text_zh: @當然，我很喜歡和顧客聊天，偶爾也玩玩友誼遊戲。@

source_en: @If you treat my cats well, they'll treat you the same.@*
text_zh: @如果你善待我的貓，牠們也會善待你的。@*

source_en: @Thindle and Mortude may not agree, but I like a game that provides a little intellectual challenge.@
text_zh: @Thindle 和 Mortude 可能不認同，但我喜歡有點智力挑戰的遊戲。@

source_en: @I'm sure they'd be glad to play a few rounds of flippits with you.@
text_zh: @我相信牠們很樂意和你玩幾輪 Flippits。@

source_en: @You haven't any room in your pack.@
@If only I had a copy of Snilwit's Big Book of Boardgame Strategy...@*
text_zh: @要是我有一本 Snilwit 的《棋類策略大典》就好了...@*

source_en: @Then I could find some really fine games to teach everyone.@
text_zh: @那樣我就能找到一些很棒的遊戲教大家。@

source_en: Snilwit's Big Book of Boardgame Strategy
@Have you got a copy of Snilwit's that you'd be willing to sell?@
text_zh: @你有 Snilwit 的那本書嗎？願意賣給我嗎？@

source_en: @Great! This is the definitive reference on boardgames. He takes the book and gives you 200 gold crowns.@
text_zh: @太好了！這可是棋類遊戲的權威參考書。他接過書，給了200金幣。@

source_en: , so you can carry some gold!@
@That's too bad. I'd pay well for it.@
@Come by the Cat's Lair when I'm open for business.@*
text_zh: @等我營業時間時，歡迎到貓窩來。@*

source_en: @I think I've got time for a quick game of Nim...@
text_zh: @我想我有時間快玩一把 Nim...@

source_en: @Would you care to wager on the outcome, just to keep things interesting?@
text_zh: @你要不要賭一把結果，讓事情更有趣點？@

source_en: @Tell you what... I'm in a reckless mood. This time you can bet as much as you like.@
text_zh: @我就跟你說吧...我現在心情不錯，敢於冒險。這回你想賭多少都行。@

source_en: @How much would you like to bet?@
@That's a little steep for a friendly game.@
text_zh: @對於友誼局來說，這賭注有點高了。@

source_en: @Let me just remind you of the rules, in case you don't remember. We start with ten pieces.@ He takes some colorful glass beads out of his pocket.@
text_zh: @我再提醒一下規則，萬一你忘了的話。我們每個人先拿十顆珠子。@他從口袋裡掏出一些彩色的玻璃珠。@

source_en: @Each player takes turns, taking one, two or three beads out of the pile. Whoever gets the last one wins!@
text_zh: @輪流進行，每人每次可以拿走一顆、兩顆或三顆珠子。拿走最後一顆的人獲勝！@

source_en: @Well, maybe after you've had a few practice games.@
text_zh: @嗯，或許等你多練習幾次之後吧。@

source_en: , and flights of angels tend thee to thy rest.@
@Goodbye text if you want, otherwise delete for SI style goodbye barks@
text_zh: @如果需要再見文案可以填寫，否則刪除以符合SI風格的再見台詞@

source_en: @Britain is the wealthiest city in the world, and I make a tidy living sneaking up there at night to 'liberate' a few possessions.@
text_zh: @Britain是世界上最富有的城市，我靠夜間潛入那裡‘解放’一些財物過著不錯的日子。@

source_en: @Of course, I only steal from those who have too much wealth for their own good..@
text_zh: @當然，我只從那些財富過頭、對自身有害的人那裡下手..@

source_en: @It's an honorable profession, with as long a tradition as any other.@*
text_zh: @這是一門正當的職業，擁有與其他行業一樣悠久的傳統。@*

source_en: @If you want to join the guild, go talk to Budo about it.@*
text_zh: @如果你想加入公會，去跟Budo談談吧。@*

source_en: @She was the finest ship that ever sailed. But those days are past. The crew's scattered to the four corners of the earth, and the Thechu's off amongst the stars.@*
text_zh: @那曾是航行過的最好的一艘船。但那些日子已經過去。船員散落天涯海角，Thechu也已消失在星海之間。@*

source_en: @We were at port one day when the anchor chain snapped, and the Thechu drifted off the edge of the world.@*
text_zh: 有天我們正在港口，錨鏈突然斷了，Thechu 船就這樣漂到了世界邊緣之外。*

source_en: @I'd join her if I could, and sail through space...@*
text_zh: 如果能的話，我真想加入她，在太空中遨遊...*

source_en: @The world is flat, you know.@ She eyes you appraisingly*
text_zh: 「你知道的，世界是平的。」她審視著你*

source_en: @Surely any well educated person would be aware of that.@*
text_zh: 「任何受過良好教育的人應該都知道這一點。」*

source_en: @He lives in Buccaneer's Den. These tunnels can take you there - unless you get lost, or the rats get you...@*
text_zh: 「他住在海盜洞。這些隧道可以帶你到那裡——除非你迷路了，或者被老鼠抓了...」 Buccaneer's Den*

source_en: @The rumors of pirates there are just idle chatter.@*
text_zh: 「那裡的海盜傳聞不過是閒言閒語。」*

source_en: She smiles. @I haven't been there in a while. It's a lovely little town...@*
text_zh: 她微笑著。「我已經很久沒去那裡了。那是個可愛的小鎮...」*

source_en: @Pirates? I'm sure I wouldn't know a thing about them.@*
@I don't know about you, but some of us have more important things to do with our time.@*
text_zh: 「我不知道你是怎麼想的，但我們中有些人有更重要的事情要做。」*

source_en: A graceful, silver haired woman in robes of blue.
text_zh: 一位優雅的銀髮女子，身著藍色的長袍。

source_en: , but I'm not ready to retire just yet.@*
@No way! I'm making too good a living to give it up now. If you want to get my belt, use your wits.@*
text_zh: 「絕對不行！我的收入很好，現在不會放棄的。如果你想拿走我的腰帶，就得動點腦子。」*

source_en: @About time you were on your way. One thing before you go...@
text_zh: 「你總算要走了。在你離開前，還有一件事...」

source_en: She draws her dagger. @Don't tell anyone where my hideout is. If you do, some night you'll go to sleep and never wake up again.@*
text_zh: 她拔出匕首。「不要告訴任何人我的藏身之處。如果你這麼做，某個夜晚你會睡著，然後永遠醒不過來。"*

source_en: You'll never know when it's coming.*@
text_zh: 你永遠不會知道它什麼時候來。*"

source_en: She turns and throws the dagger at a little mouse that was sniffing around for food, pinning it to the wall by its tail.
text_zh: 她轉身將匕首投擲向一隻正在覓食的小老鼠，將其尾巴刺在牆上。
