source_en: @Eeeeek!@ Sherry runs up your leg, and takes several minutes before you can coax her back down again.
text_zh: 「嘎吱！」Sherry鑽上你的腿，過了好幾分鐘你才能勸她下來。

source_en: She eyes you suspiciously. @What do you want?@
text_zh: 她 suspiciously 地盯著你。@你想幹嘛？@

source_en: @I used to be captain of the Black Thechu. But now I'm a member of the thieves guild, and I don't care who knows it..@
text_zh: @我曾經是 Black Thechu 的隊長。但現在我是盜賊公會的一員，我才不在乎誰知道..@

source_en: @Anything else I can do for you?
A plump, jovial fellow chewing on a leg of lamb.*
text_zh: 一個肥胖、快樂的男人，正啃著一根羊肉腿。*

source_en: @Anything else I can do for you?@
@My name is Dunbar@, he says between bites of mutton.
text_zh: @我叫 Dunbar@，他在咀嚼羊肉間隙說道。

source_en: @I sell fish, ale, mead, wine, and mutton.@
text_zh: @我賣魚、麥酒、蜂蜜酒、葡萄酒和羊肉。@

source_en: @Come back during business hours and I'll be happy to serve thee.@
text_zh: @請在營業時間再來，我很樂意為你服務。@

source_en: @I hear he used to be the head of some important guild.@
text_zh: @我聽說他曾經是某個重要公會的會長。@

source_en: @I don't know anything about it, but maybe it explains that strange glow you can see over by his house at night.@
text_zh: @我不知道這是什麼，但也許這能解釋為什麼夜裡在他家附近能看到奇怪的光芒。@

source_en: @Serving others it the humblest occupation I could imagine. That's why I opened this place.@*
text_zh: @服務他人是我能想像中最謙卑的工作。這就是我開這家店的原因。@*

source_en: He pauses to wipe his mouth with the back of his hand.
text_zh: 他停下來說，用背手擦了擦嘴。

source_en: @If I can help you with anything else, let me know.@
text_zh: @如果你還需要其他幫助，請告訴我。@

source_en: @I'm afraid you haven't enough money for it.@
Dunbar looks at you. @You haven't any room in your pack.@
text_zh: Dunbar 看著你。 @你的背囊沒有空間了。@

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, she hands over the
text_zh: @很好！@ 收下你的金幣後，她遞給你

source_en: You see a vaguely familiar woman in her middle ages.*
text_zh: 你看到一位中年女子，感覺有些熟悉。*

source_en: @Avatar! I remember thee, from the Temple of Virtue. I was but a young girl then, gathering offerings with my sister.@
text_zh: @聖者！我還記得你，在Temple of Virtue時。當時我只個小女孩，正和姐姐一起收集供品。@

source_en: @It is good to see thee again, Avatar. How may I aid thee?@
text_zh: @很高興再見到您，聖者。我能為您做什麼？@

source_en: @I am Ava. Mayhap thou dost not remember me. Years ago, I was a girl who tended the offerings at the Temple of Virtue in Cove.@
text_zh: @我是艾娃。你或許不記得我了。很多年前，我是在Cove的Temple of Virtue負責供品的小女孩。@

source_en: @After the earthquakes laid the Temple to ruin, I turned to alchemy. I make potions now.. remedies, restoratives, and the like. If thou art in need, I can sell some.@
text_zh: @地震摧毀了神殿後，我轉向了煉金術。現在我製作藥水..藥劑、修復劑之類的東西。如果你有需要，我可以賣一些給你。@

source_en: @Cove is quieter now. Pilgrims are fewer since the Gargoyles seized the Shrines... but some still come to reflect. Compassion endures.@
text_zh: @Cove現在安靜多了。自從石像鬼佔據了神龕以來，朝聖者變少了...但還有一些人來此沉思。悲憫之心長存。@

source_en: @It is the heart of Cove. Even if the Temple is gone and the Shrines defiled, the virtue lives on..in us.@
text_zh: @這是Cove的核心。即使神殿已毀，神龕被褻瀆，美德依然存在..存在於我們心中。@

source_en: @It grieves me, what has become of them. The Shrines were sacred. Now the Gargoyles have seized them as if they were theirs by right.@
text_zh: @我為它們如今的境遇感到哀傷。神龕曾是聖地。現在石像鬼佔據了它們，彷彿那是它們應得的權利。@

source_en: @I served in its inner sanctum with my sister, Leona. The earthquakes left little behind but cracked stone and memories.@
text_zh: @我和姐姐Leona曾在那裡內殿服務。地震之後，只留下破碎的石塊和記憶。@

source_en: @Leona passed a few years ago, an illness took her quickly. She was kind, stronger than I ever was. I still dream of her sometimes.@
text_zh: @Leona幾年前提前去世了，疾病迅速奪走了她的生命。她很善良，比我堅強得多。有時我還會夢見她。@

source_en: @Potions to heal wounds, cure poison, protect against harm, and wake those enchanted by sleep. Simple things, but they help.@
text_zh: @可以癒合傷勢、解 Poison 的藥水，抵禦傷害，喚醒被睡眠魔法影響的人。簡單的東西，但很有幫助。@

source_en: @May thy path be guided by Compassion.@
@But thou dost not have enough gold,
@Anything else can I do for thee?@
text_zh: 還有其他我能為你做的嗎？

source_en: @I turn wool into cloth. I am not very good, but some people take pity on me and buy my cloth anyway.@
text_zh: 我把羊毛織成布料。我不太在行，但有些人憐憫我，還是會買我的布料。

source_en: @Wouldst thou like some cloth? My cloth costs 25 gold. Interested,
text_zh: 你要些布料嗎？我的布料售價 25 金幣。有興趣嗎，

source_en: @Many thanks!@ After accepting your gold, Charlotte hands over the cloth.@
@Come to my shop when I'm open!@
text_zh: @我營業時間時歡迎來到我的商店！@

source_en: @Will you take 10 gold crowns for a bale of wool,
text_zh: 一捆羊毛你賣 10 金幣嗎，

source_en: @Done!@ Charlotte hands you 10 gold pieces and takes the wool.@
@Begging thy pardon, but I see no wool!@
text_zh: 恕我直言，我沒看到羊毛！

source_en: , I can weave thy silk thread into cloth. It will cost thee 10 gold. Interested?@
text_zh: ，我可以把你的絲線織成布料。這會花你 10 金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: Turning to her loom, Charlotte soon weaves the thread into fine silk cloth.
text_zh: Charlotte轉向她的織布機，很快就把線織成了精美的絲綢布料。

source_en: @Finished!@ She takes your gold and hands over the cloth.
text_zh: @好了！@ 她收下你的金子，遞給你布料。

source_en: , but thou dost not have 10 gold!@
@Take the cloth to Marissa. Mayhap she can sew it into a bag for thee.@
text_zh: @把布料交給 Marissa。也許她可以幫你把這做成一個袋子。@

source_en: @If you had some silk thread, I could help thee. Go ask Arbeth if he has any to spare.@
text_zh: @如果你有一些絲線，我可以幫你。去問問Arbeth是否有多餘的。@

source_en: @I can weave that silk for thee... Then thou should speak with Marissa.@
text_zh: @我可以為你織這絲綢... 然後你應該去見 Marissa。@

source_en: @Tis really not my place to speak of that,
. But honesty is a virtue too, and honesty forces me to admit that I am the humblest person in New Magincia.@
text_zh: 。但誠實也是一種美德，誠實迫使我承認，我是New Magincia最謙卑的人。

source_en: A pretty young woman with downcast eyes.*
text_zh: 一位低著頭、漂亮的年輕女子。*
我不過是個謙卑的織工，

source_en: @I govern New Magincia. Fortunately the fine people of this town have few disputes to settle, leaving me plenty of time for my hobby.@
text_zh: 我統治著New Magincia。幸好，這裡的體面人沒什麼糾紛要調解，留給我的時間 plenty 用來發展我的興趣。

source_en: @The city of humility is a lovely place to live.@
text_zh: 謙虛之城是一個非常宜居的地方。

source_en: @I do magic tricks. It brings a bit of cheer into this imperfect world.@
text_zh: 我表演魔法把戲。這給這個不完美世界帶來了一些歡欣。

source_en: @Splendid!@ Antonio reaches into his pocket and takes out a balloon. He blows it up until it bursts, and four doves appear from inside it, flying off towards the four points of the compass.
text_zh: 「精彩！」Antonio 把手伸進口袋，拿出一個氣球。他把它吹到爆開，四隻鴿子從裡面飛出來，朝四面八方飛去。

source_en: @I knew you would. That's my favorite trick!@
text_zh: 「我知道你會喜歡。這是我最喜歡的把戲！」

source_en: @Too bad. Perhaps I should learn a better trick.@
text_zh: 「太可惜了。也許我該學個更厲害的把戲。」

source_en: @The most humble one amongst us knows the mantra. If thou canst find out who that is, tell me, and I will give thee the rune.@
text_zh: 我們之中最謙虛的人知道那段真言。如果你能查出那是誰，告訴我，我便將符文給你。

source_en: @Dost thou know who is the most humble person in this town?@
text_zh: 你知道這鎮上誰是最謙虛的人嗎？
那麼那人的名字是什麼？

source_en: @Very astute of thee! Here is the rune, and I wish thee success on thy mission.@
text_zh: 你真聰明！這是符文，祝你在任務中一帆風順。

source_en: @Tis not fitting that thou shouldst guess. Make sure thou dost know the answer before you speak with me again.@
text_zh: 憑猜測是不合適的。確保你知道答案後，再來找我。

source_en: A gentleman of slight build and refined manners.*
text_zh: 一位身形瘦削、舉止得體的紳士。*

source_en: @Until we meet again, may your road be short and your fortunes long.@
text_zh: 直到我們再會，願你的路短暫而命運長久。

source_en: @Greetings! I am Lord Antonio. Might I ask thy name?
text_zh: 問好！我是Antonio大人。我能問問你的名字嗎？

source_en: @I came here to meditate, tend sheep and sell wool.@
text_zh: @我來這裡冥想、照顧羊羣並出售羊毛。@

source_en: @To make wool. People buy it from me.@
text_zh: @為了製造羊毛。人們向我購買。@

source_en: @I wear a robe while I tend sheep. It's all part of life's great circle.@
text_zh: @我放牧時穿著長袍。這是生命大循環的一部分。@

source_en: @From earth, to grass, to sheep, to me... when I die, I'll return to the earth.@
text_zh: @從泥土，到草地，到羊羣，再到我...當我死去，我將回歸泥土。@

source_en: @I used to be a powerful and wealthy mage. I wore silk robes, and fine jewelry. In fact, I even had my own castle.@*
text_zh: @我曾經是一位強大而富有法師。我穿著絲質長袍，佩戴精美首飾。事實上，我甚至擁有自己的城堡。@*

source_en: @But one day in my travels I visited the Shrine of Humility. Meditating there, I had an idea. I would give up all my earthly possessions and quit the practice of magic. I would live as a shepherd! Surely this would be the greatest act of humility a man could perform. And so you see me here today.@
text_zh: @但有一天，在我旅途中拜訪了Shrine of Humility。在那裡冥想時，我產生了一個念頭。我要放棄所有世俗財物和魔法修行。我要像牧人一樣生活！這一定是一個人能做出的最謙遜的舉動。所以你就看到了今天的我。@

source_en: @I should go there again soon... It changed my life.@
text_zh: @我應該很快再那裡...它改變了我的人生。@

source_en: A short man dressed in shepherds clothing.*
text_zh: 一個穿著牧人服裝的矮小男人。*

source_en: @You should go meditate at the shrine yourself. I find 'lum' a most effective mantra.@
text_zh: @你自己也應該去聖殿冥想。我覺得'lum'是最有效的咒語。@

source_en: @I charge 5 gold for a bale of wool. Would you like some?@
@Very good.@ After accepting your gold, Aurendir hands over the wool.@
text_zh: @非常好。@ 收下你的金幣後，Aurendir把羊毛交給你。@

source_en: @I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money.@
text_zh: 「很抱歉，你似乎沒有足夠的錢。」

source_en: @Hi there! Is there anything I can do for you?@
@Once I was Aurendir the mighty - now I live a more modest life.@
text_zh: @我曾是強大的Aurendir，如今過著更樸素的生活。@

source_en: . Is there anything I can do for you?@
. It's good to see you again.@
@Oh, forgive me for not introducing myself. I am Conor Starfalcon. And what is your name?@
text_zh: @抱歉，我忘了介紹自己。我是 Conor Starfalcon。請問尊姓大名？@

source_en: @I am a fisherman. In catching fish, as in all of life, there is something to be learned.@
text_zh: @我是一名漁夫。在捕魚中，如同在生活中，總有值得學習之處。@

source_en: @We've met before. But that was many years ago.@
text_zh: @我們見過面。但那已是很多年前的事了。@

source_en: @I still have not mastered the way of the fisherman. But I think perhaps the key to enlightenment lies not so much in the destination as in the road one travels.@
text_zh: @我仍未精通漁夫之道。但我認為，開悟的關鍵不在目的地，而在旅程本身。@

source_en: @I am satisfied to live here and learn what I can from the fish.@
text_zh: @我知足於在此生活，從魚兒身上學習所能學到的。@

source_en: @The Shrine of Humility is far to the southeast. I'd be glad to take you there in my boat but I'm afraid it is too small to weather the high seas.@
text_zh: @Shrine of Humility在東南方很遠的地方。我很樂意帶你去，但我的船太小，恐怕無法承受驚濤駭浪。@

source_en: @It's down at the beach. Feel free to borrow it if you have need.@
text_zh: 船就在海灘那邊。若你需要，儘管拿去用。

source_en: @You seek to find the humblest in New Magincia? That's a difficult task. I'd hate to commend one of my neighbors to you and fail to do justice to the others. The one thing I can tell you for certain is that it isn't me you're looking for.@
text_zh: 你想在New Magincia找到最謙虛的人？這可不容易。我不希望推薦了我的鄰居，卻無法公正地對待其他人。我能確切告訴你的只有一件事：你要找的人不是我。

source_en: @The Mantra of Humility is 'lum'. If you seek the shrine, I hope you find it.@
text_zh: 謙虛的咒文是 'lum'。若你在尋找神殿，祝你順利找到。

source_en: A stalwart fellow, with a look of placid concentration.
text_zh: 一位堅毅的男子，神情平靜而專注。

source_en: @I used to be a guildmaster. But that was long ago.@
text_zh: 我曾經是公會領袖。但那已是很久以前的事了。

source_en: @I no longer follow the way of the warrior.@
@If I can help you with anything else, let me know.@
text_zh: @如果你還需要其他幫助，請告訴我。@

source_en: You think you see a brief flicker of recognition pass between Iolo and the fisherman. But before you can be certain, he turns to address you.
text_zh: 你以為自己看見Iolo和漁夫之間閃過一絲認出的目光。但還沒等你確定，他已轉過身來對你說話。
那就是你現在所在的地方。

source_en: @Working the earth is the lowest form 'o labor. But it provides food for them as writes books, plays music, and other such things. Surely 'tis a humble living, to devote yer life to farmin'. It's about all I do with meself, 'cept when I find time for carvin' hippos.@
text_zh: 耕種是最卑微的勞動。但它為那些寫書、演奏音樂或做其他事的人提供食物。顯然，將一生奉獻給耕作是一種謙卑的生活方式。這也是我唯一的職業，除了偶爾找時間刻河馬之外。

source_en: @I'll show ya one.@ The old man gets a fiendish gleam in his eyes as he reaches into his pouch and takes out a small wooden hippo. @Aint she purty? If I don't make the purtiest gol' danged hippos you ever did see, you can call me Mortimer.@
text_zh: 讓我給你看一個。老者眼中閃過一絲狡黠的光，從袋子裡取出一隻小木製河馬。這不是很漂亮嗎？如果我雕的河馬不是世上最漂亮的，你可以叫我Mortimer。

source_en: An old farmer who looks to have has made his peace with life.
text_zh: 一位老年農民，看起來已與生活和解。

source_en: . I haf no other job now.@
@I be a fighter, a homeless vanderer.@
text_zh: 我是一名戰士，一個無家可歸的流浪者。

source_en: @Here I vait until I find somevun else to trafel mit.@
text_zh: 我待在這裡，直到找到其他人一起旅行。

source_en: @Much vould I like to vander again, but I haf no vun to trafel mit now.@*
text_zh: 我很想再次流浪，但我現在沒有同伴一起旅行。*

source_en: @Somevun vill ask me to join mit them zooner or later.@*
text_zh: 早點或晚點，會有人邀請我加入他們的。*

source_en: @I vould be much happy to join mit thee,
, but I dislike such large groups.@*
@You vant me to leave? Shall I vait here or go home?@
text_zh: 你想讓我離開？我要在這裡等候還是回家？

source_en: @Very vell, I shall wait here for you to return.@
text_zh: 很好，我將在此等候你回來。

source_en: I shall wait here for thee.
@Ok, if that's vat you vant. Maybe I'll zee you later.@*
text_zh: @好吧，既然那是你的願望。也許我們以後再見。@*

source_en: @You keep all zis stuff meanwhile, ya?@*
text_zh: @這期間你把這些東西收好，好嗎？@*

source_en: He leaves everything he was carrying in a pile on the ground.
text_zh: 他將身上攜帶的所有物品都堆在地上。

source_en: @He is very dangerous. I vould avoid him if I vere thee.@*
text_zh: @他非常危險。如果我是你，我會避開他。@*

source_en: @But he does know many tings, und is sometimes helpful.@*
text_zh: @但他懂得很多，有時也有幫助。@*

source_en: @It is alvays a pleasure to talk mit thee.@
@Vy talk ven dere's fighting to do?@
! I haf heard of thy deeds, Avatar!@
@Iolo, I saw that thou didst find a book. Might I examine it?@
text_zh: Iolo，我看到你找到了一本書。我可以檢查一下嗎？

source_en: @Certainly, milord. Perhaps thou canst make better sense of it than I.@ says Iolo.
text_zh: @當然可以，大人。也許你能比我更理解它的意思。@ Iolo 說道。

source_en: @Strange... This has a picture on its cover of a gargoyle standing with one foot on the chest of a slain human. This is interesting. It's written in a language I know not.@
text_zh: @奇怪...這本書封面上一隻石像鬼踩在一具死去的人類屍體上。這很有趣。它是用一種我不認識的語言寫的。@

source_en: @Take it to Mariah at the Lycaeum, the finest scribe on the great Council of Wizards.  She has studied many languages, and perhaps she can decipher this book for thee.@
text_zh: @帶去給在Lycaeum的 Mariah 看看，她是偉大的法師會議中最好的抄寫員。她研究過許多語言，也許她能為你破解這本書。@

source_en: @I no longer have the book, milord.@ replies Iolo
text_zh: @我已經沒有那本書了，大人。@ Iolo 答道

source_en: @That is too bad. I had hoped thou might take it to Mariah and have her translate it.@
text_zh: @太糟糕了。我曾 hoped 你把它帶去給 Mariah，讓她翻譯一下。@

source_en: , I saw that Iolo didst find a book. Might I examine it?@
text_zh: , 我看到 Iolo 找到了一本書。我可以看看嗎？@

source_en: @Certainly, milord. Perhaps thou canst make better sense of it than I.@
text_zh: @當然可以，大人。也許你能比我更好地理解它。@

source_en: @I no longer have the book, milord.@
@One more thing, Avatar... I noticed that thou didst arrive through a red gateway. Dost thou have the stone that opened the gate?@
text_zh: @還有一件事，聖者...我注意到你是通過紅色傳送門到來的。你還有那塊打開門的石頭嗎？@

source_en: @From whence could it have come? The gargoyles, perhaps?
text_zh: @它可能是從哪裡來的？可能是那些滴水嘴獸吧。

source_en: @Best ask Lord British about it. I believe he has some knowledge of such items.@
text_zh: @最好問一下 Lord British。我相信他對這類物品有些了解。@

source_en: @Such items are quite rare. Indeed, the only one I have ever seen is that which Lord British himself possesses.@
text_zh: @這類物品非常稀有。事實上，我見過唯一的例子就是 Lord British 自己擁有的那件。@
@你應該去跟 Lord British 談談...@

source_en: @Hast thou gone to the Lycaeum and shown Mariah the book? 'Tis most important.@*
text_zh: @你去過 Lycaeum 並把書給 Mariah 看過了嗎？這非常重要。@*

source_en: @There is naught else I can help thee with at this time.@
text_zh: @此時此刻，我無法為你提供更多幫助。@
替換為 NPC 的道別語

source_en: You see a concerned looking mage.
text_zh: 你看到一位面露關切法師。

source_en: , and well met. 'Twas I who learned of thy peril through my mystic arts, so that aid might be sent unto thee.
text_zh: , 很高興見到你。正是我透過神祕的藝術預知了你的危險，以便派人前去援助。

source_en: @They said that after she got them past their pursuers she would be freed.@ He hides his face in his hands. Our beliefs held us still.@*
text_zh: @他們說，等她帶他們擺脫追兵後，她就會被釋放。@ 他雙手掩面。我們的信仰讓我們保持堅定。@*

source_en: @She turned and handed something to her crying little girl. Then she boarded the skiff, and they were gone.@*
text_zh: @她轉過身，把一樣東西遞給她哭泣的小女兒。然後她登上小艇，他們便消失了。@*

source_en: @I questioned them about the night of the murder. Still, of all of us, my Marta and I had the best vantage point from which to witness, or even hear, the murder.@*
text_zh: @我詢問過大家關於謀殺當晚的情況。不過，在我們所有人中，Marta 和我擁有最佳的視角，足以目擊，甚至聽見那起謀殺案。@*

source_en: @Still, of all of us, my Marta and I had the best vantage point from which to witness, or even hear, the murder.@
text_zh: @不過，在我們所有人中，Marta 和我擁有最佳的視角，足以目擊，甚至聽見那起謀殺案。@
@然而，我們什麼都沒看見，也沒聽見。@

source_en: @She is still missing. I pray she will be found safe.@ He wipes his eyes.
text_zh: @她仍然失蹤了。我祈禱她能平安被找到。@ 他拭去眼淚。

source_en: @She, like her mother, is strong in her beliefs. When we buried her father, she sang a song she wrote for him.@ He softly sings.*
text_zh: @她和她母親一樣，信念堅定。我們埋葬她父親時，她唱了一首為他創作的歌。@ 他輕聲哼唱。*

source_en: @'You put your love in my heart, and now it's fallen apart, but all alone in the dark, I will remove the pain.'@
text_zh: @「你將愛植入我的心，如今它已支離破碎，但獨自置身於黑暗中，我將消除這痛苦。」@

source_en: @'There is a sting in my eyes, and your name in my cries, but still I realize, that you are part of me.'@*
text_zh: @「我的眼中帶著刺痛，我的哭喊中滿是你的名字，但我依然明白，你已成為我的一部分。」@*

source_en: He looks at you a moment, then leans closer. @They say that Quenton was killed by a Gargoyle.@
text_zh: 他看了你片刻，然後湊近了一些。@據說 Quenton 是被食屍鬼殺害的。@

source_en: @Okay just let me know when you're ready to check out.@
text_zh: @好的，等你準備退房時告訴我就行。@

source_en: @I've heard these beasts eat their prey. Why did they leave Quenton alone then?*
text_zh: @我聽說這些 Beast 會吃掉獵物。那為什麼它們讓 Quenton 獨自留下？*

source_en: @We are a peaceful people. We believe that all men have hearts that can possess either good or evil.@*
text_zh: @我們是和平的民族。我們相信所有人的心中都擁有善或惡。@*

source_en: @These evil ones believed that by tearing down others, they could become more powerful.@*
text_zh: @這些邪惡者相信，通過摧毀他人，他們就能變得更加強大。@*

source_en: @The truth is, when you tear down another's ladder you become no higher, they just become lower. It is harder to build your ladder on your own, but you will see farther in the end.@*
text_zh: @真相是，當你拆毀別人的梯子時，你並未因此變高，他們只是變低了。獨自搭建梯子更難，但最終你能看得更遠。@*

source_en: @Gwen bowed her head as they sailed off.@ He looks absently at the floor and attempts to clear his throat.
text_zh: @Gwen 低下了頭，看著船隻啟程。@ 他心不在焉地看著地板，試圖清清喉嚨。

source_en: Speaking again, his voice is a whisper. @They found her body along the coast south of here.@*
text_zh: 他再次開口，聲音輕如耳語。@他們在南方海岸發現了她的遺體。@*

source_en: He looks at you, his eyes red and his lip quivering. He simply nods.*
text_zh: 他看著你，雙眼通紅，嘴唇微微顫抖。他只是點了點頭。*

source_en: @He means well, it's just his attitude is all wrong for the job. He should spend some time in New Magincia.@*
text_zh: @他是個好人，只是他的態度不適合這份工作。他應該去 New Magincia 待上一陣子。@*

source_en: A man bent over with age. An old brown tunic hangs loosely on him. He looks at you, then looks over his shoulder and shouts to someone behind him.*
text_zh: 一位老邁佝僂的男子。一件舊褐色的長袍鬆鬆地掛在他身上。他看著你，然後回頭朝身後的人大聲喊道。*
你應該有一天會航行到那裡。

source_en: @We had no such person in this town. Not by that name.@
text_zh: 我們鎮上沒有這樣的人。沒有叫那個名字的。

source_en: @We have welcomed into this town, so that he may continue his path to Spirituality. He is staying with us as long as he wants to, such a good soul.@
text_zh: 我們已歡迎他來到這鎮上，讓他能繼續走向靈性之路。只要他願意，他就可以一直和我們住在一起，他真是個心地善良的人。

source_en: His eyes light up. @He is one of the friendliest people in this hamlet. You must go see him, down by the pier. He's been like a father to Marney.@
text_zh: 他的眼睛亮了起來。@他是這個小村子裡最友善的人之一。你一定要去碼頭那邊見見他。他對 Marney 來說就像父親一樣。@

source_en: @Now there's a sad soul. He was so young when he got tangled up with the wrong group of kids. Had he been raised by someone with a good heart, he might have been one of Lord British's greatest knights.@
text_zh: @現在他可真是一個人間悲劇。他年輕時跟錯了朋友。如果當年是由一位心地善良的人撫養長大，他或許會成為 Lord British 最偉大的騎士之一。@

source_en: @It saddens me that his soul has gotten so dark he would have done such a terrible thing. I hope with his time in prison he will contemplate the Virtues.@
text_zh: @他的靈魂變得如此黑暗，竟會做出那樣可怕的事，讓我很難過。希望他在監獄裡能好好思考美德的道理。@

source_en: @She's a dear soul. I sometimes feel sorry for her. I mean, her weight and all. Still, she is one of the most interesting people I've ever met.@
text_zh: @她真是個好人。我有時會為她感到難過。我的意思是，她的體重之類的。不過，她是我見過的最有趣的人之一。@

source_en: @He's the alchemist who lives on @Iver's Rounding. You'll need a boat to get there though.@
text_zh: @他是住在Iver's Rounding的煉金術士。不過你得乘船才能到那裡去。@

source_en: @It was named after a famous pirate who beached his craft there during a storm.@
text_zh: @它是為了紀念一位著名的海盜，他在暴風雨中將船擱淺在那裡。@

source_en: @He means well, it's just his attitude is all wrong for the job. He should spend some time in New Magincia.@
text_zh: @他心地不壞，只是態度不對，不適合這份工作。他應該去New Magincia待上一陣子。@

source_en: @I'm just an innkeep. Ask Yorl: his father used to sail for our ruler.@
text_zh: @我不過是個旅店老闆。去問Yorl吧：他父親曾經為我們的主人航行。@

source_en: @There, I told you, Marta. New people, new food for our souls.@ He turns back to you. @Welcome to the Haunting Inn. Come and sit, for you must have many tales.@
text_zh: @在那裡，我跟你說過了，Marta。新面孔，新食物，滋養我們的身心。@他轉過身面對你。@歡迎來到Haunting Inn。請坐，你肯定有很多故事要講。@

source_en: ? he says, leaning close and staring you in the eyes.@
text_zh: ?他說道，湊近並直直地注視著你的眼睛。@

source_en: @Of course it is! Welcome back, traveler.@
@Gideon, my friend, Gideon's what I'm called by one and all.@*
@My wife would say it is to annoy the customers with idle banter. She's dear. I have rooms for let.@
text_zh: @我妻子會說這是為了用閒聊逗弄客人。她很好。我有空房出租。@

source_en: @Tis an old family name meaning 'one who spreads the word.' My wife tells me I spread too many of them around.@
text_zh: @這是很古老的家名，意思是“傳道者”。我妻子告訴我，我說得太多的閒話了。@

source_en: @When I was a young man I visited the shrine to contemplate an emptiness I felt inside. Marta was there, so beautiful and shy.@
text_zh: 我年輕時曾去聖堂，冥想內心深處的虛空。Marta也在那裡，美若天仙，卻十分羞澀。

source_en: @We sat in silence together for hours. Finally, she could take no more and turned and kissed me.@*
text_zh: 我們沉默地坐了幾個小時。終於，她忍不住了，轉過身吻了我。*

source_en: A shout comes from the room behind him. He answers, @No, Marta, our guests are not asleep yet.@*
text_zh: 身後房間傳來一聲喊叫。他回答說：“不，Marta，我們的客人還沒睡。”*

source_en: @The word I spread is one of kindness to all souls!@
text_zh: 我傳揚的是對所有靈魂的慈悲！

source_en: @The shrine of Spirituality. It is where we go when we are troubled. You should visit it sometime.@*
text_zh: 靈性聖堂。那是我們陷入困擾時去的地方。你也該去參訪一次。*

source_en: , are you ready to check out?@
@She hasn't come out of that room since she saw that darn ghost in the dining room a few nights ago.@*
text_zh: 幾晚前她在餐室看到那個該死鬼影後，就一直沒從房間出來過。*

source_en: @She told me the lanterns went out and a spectre drifted in front of her. She let out such a scream that I heard her from our bedroom.@*
text_zh: 她說燈滅了，然後一個幽靈飄到她面前。她尖叫了一聲，我在臥室都聽到了。*

source_en: He shakes his head and glances at the room behind him.*
text_zh: 他搖了搖頭，瞟了一眼身後的房間。*

source_en: @My Marta doesn't spook that easy. After all, she's woke up next to me all these years. At first I thought maybe I should lock the cupboard where we keep the wine.@*
text_zh: 我的Marta不容易被嚇到。終究，這些年她一直和我睡在一起。起初我想，也許我該把放酒的櫃子鎖起來。*

source_en: @But I don't think my Marta's been nippin'. I wish I knew what she saw.*
text_zh: 但我覺得我的Marta沒在撒謊。我真希望知道她看到了什麼。*

source_en: @If you've never had Stivius' wine, you're in for a treat.@*
text_zh: 如果你沒喝過Stivius的酒，那真是損失大了。*

source_en: @He lives next door. Strange fellow...I think he's sampled too much of his own wares.@*
text_zh: 他住在隔壁。奇怪的人...我覺得他大概喝了自己釀的太多酒。*

source_en: gold for a room and a meal. Interested?@
text_zh: 金幣換一晚住宿和一餐。感興趣嗎？

source_en: a large breakfast and you hand him the key.
text_zh: 豐盛的早餐，你把鑰匙遞給了他。

source_en: @Enjoy your room, be sure to stop by for breakfast at checkout!@
text_zh: 祝你住得愉快，退房時記得回來吃早餐！

source_en: @You don't have room for the key.@
@I'm sorry, but we require cash in advance for our rooms.@
text_zh: @對不起，我們需要預先支付現金來預訂房間。@

source_en: @I'm sure by now you've heard such banter about old Quenton. He was a dear soul.@ Gideon looks past you into the distance.*
text_zh: 我想你現在肯定聽過不少關於老Quenton的閒話。他是個心地善良的人。 ”Gideon目光越過你，望向遠處。*

source_en: @I could not believe it was him by the well.@ His eyes become watery. @He lay so quiet, no sign of pain on his face, and just an amulet in his bloody hand.*@
text_zh: 我在井邊看見他時，簡直不敢相信那就是他。 ”他的眼眶濕潤了。 “他躺得那麼安靜，臉上看不出痛苦，隻有沾血的手裡握著一枚護身符。*

source_en: He looks at the floor and mumbles. @Quen, I miss you, old mate.@*
text_zh: 他低頭看著地板，咕噥道。“昆，我想你，老朋友。”*

source_en: @The word I spread is one of kindness to all souls!@*
text_zh: @我傳揚的話語，是給所有靈魂的仁慈！@*

source_en: @Yes, let us swap stories for a while...@*
@That name used to be just words. But now, with what Marta saw...@*
text_zh: @那個名字曾經只是些文字。但現在，經過Marta所看到的...@*

source_en: @We went and told Yorl what had happened. When he returned with us to the well, he removed the amulet from Quenton's hand and took it to Marney.@*
text_zh: @我們去告訴Yorl發生了什麼事。當他隨我們回到井邊時，他從Quenton手中取下了護符，並交給了Marney。@*

source_en: @It took courage to tell her the news.@*
text_zh: @告訴她這個消息需要很大的勇氣。@*

source_en: @We came to this island many years ago. As children we'd take the boats and race around the point. Marta and I took care of him when pirates sailing under Mondain's flag killed his wife Gwen.@*
text_zh: @我們多年來前來到這個島上。小時候，我們會乘船繞著海岬競速。當掛著Mondain旗幟的海盜殺害了Marta和我的看法的丈夫Gwen時，我們照顧了他。@*

source_en: @We care for his daughter, Marney, now. She's such a brave girl.@ He pauses a moment then continues.
text_zh: @現在我們照顧他的女兒Marney。她是個非常勇敢的女孩。@ 他停頓了一下，然後繼續說。

source_en: @Well, where is the key? Perhaps you left it in your room. Come back when you're ready to check out.@
text_zh: @嗯，鑰匙在哪裡？也許您忘在房間裡了。準備好退房時再來吧。@

source_en: @Neither I nor the travelers staying here heard anything the night he was killed.@*
text_zh: @我或住在這裡的旅人，在他被殺的那晚都沒聽到任何聲響。@*

source_en: @Yes, Quenton and Yorl were out fishing when a few of those evil ones landed here. They were fleeing Lord British's men and apparently thought our hamlet was safe haven.@*
text_zh: @是的，Quenton 和 Yorl 外出捕魚時，幾個惡徒在此登陸。他們正在逃竄 Lord British 的手下，顯然認為我們的村莊是安全的庇護所。@*

source_en: @Their ship's sail bore the crest of Mondain. They went around asking for some person named Relthor, or Renthar... something like that.@*
text_zh: @他們的船帆上印有 Mondain 的紋章。他們四處詢問一個名叫 Relthor 或 Renthar 的人...大概類似這樣的名字。@*

source_en: @She was an angel to view. Blonde hair, green eyes, tall slender body. Marney could be her twin. I can still see Elisa's brave face as the men led her to their boat.@*
text_zh: @她生得一副天使面容。金髮碧眼，身材高挑苗條。Marney可能就是她的孿生姐妹。我仍能看見伊莉莎勇敢的面容，當那些人帶她登上船時。@*

source_en: @If I am relenting, In my mystery.@
@If you need such things my friend, @*
You see a bent, aging man with a scraggly beard and few teeth.*
text_zh: 你看到一個彎曲背脊、年老的男人，留着凌亂的山羊胡，牙齒稀疏。*

source_en: He purses his lips and lets out an eery, high-pitched cry.*
text_zh: 他抿着嘴唇，發出一聲詭異的、尖銳的叫聲。*

source_en: @That is my impression. Tell me what you think.@*
text_zh: @這是我的印象。告訴我你的看法。@*

source_en: @Can you learn a lesson, From what it has to teach?@
text_zh: @你能從它必須教授的內容中，@學到一課嗎？@
並非所有仇敵都長著翅膀。
遠勝那些璀璨奪目的事物 *

source_en: @And those who share it with you @*
@Dogs are at my doorstep, Yapping at my heels.@
text_zh: 狗羣在我的門前，在我腳後跟狂吠。
那會耗去我們半個夜晚！

source_en: @The mention of business brings the senile man to his senses momentarily.@
text_zh: 一提到生意，這位健忘的老人瞬間恢復了神智。

source_en: As you ask Horance about the Seance spell, an eerie seriousness seems to overcome his usual mannerisms. He looks at you thoughtfully.
text_zh: 當你詢問 Horance 關於 Seance 咒語時，一種詭異的嚴肅神情似乎取代了他平時的舉止。他若有所思地望著你。

source_en: @Thou dost know about the 'Seance spell'? Not many mages sell this spell. Very few can withstand the ravaging toll it can take on one's mind...@*
text_zh: 你知道「Seance 咒語」嗎？沒多少法師販售這個咒語。極少有人能承受它對心智造成的巨大摧毀...*

source_en: @I shall sell it to thee for 150 gold. Is this agreeable?@
text_zh: 我願意以 150 金幣賣給你。這成交嗎？

source_en: After accepting your gold, he teaches you the spell.
text_zh: 在接受了你的金幣後，他教你這個咒語。

source_en: @Do thou be careful with this spell...@*
text_zh: 使用這個咒語時務必小心...*

source_en: @Speaking with the dead can be very dangerous...@
text_zh: 與亡者對話可能非常危險...

source_en: @...especially for one who hath vanquished so many into the Void such as thee...@*
text_zh: ...特別是對於像你這樣將無數人送入虛無的人來說...*

source_en: @No way to ignore them. Just pretend that they are eels.@
text_zh: @沒法子無視它們。就當它們是鰻魚吧。@

source_en: As you depart, Horance laughs to himself softly at first, then the laughter becomes more ominous.*
text_zh: 當你離開時，Horance 先是輕輕地自顧自笑了起來，隨後 laughter 變得更加不祥。*

source_en: You get a strange feeling in the pit of your stomach but you can't quite put your finger on it.*
text_zh: 你胃部泛起一股奇怪的感覺，但說不出到底是什麼。*

source_en: It is obvious to you that Horance is a few bolts short of a full quiver, but you can't help but to get the chills as you leave.
text_zh: 你很明顯地看出 Horance 缺了幾根箭，但當你離開時，你還是忍不住感到陣陣寒意。
@我已經把這道法術賣給你了。@

source_en: @I hope thou hast found it as useful as I have...@ Horance displays a smile that makes you quite uneasy.
text_zh: @我希望你覺得它和我一樣有用...@ Horance

source_en: @Once they came for wanting, Twice they came to see.@
text_zh: @他們來了一次是為了渴望，來了一次是為了看看。@

source_en: @He sniffs the air as if smelling something bad. @I am, of course, Trenton Bell, the mayor. You may call me 'Your Honor'.@
text_zh: @他聞著空氣，好像聞到了什麼不好的東西。@ 當然，我是市鎮長 Trenton Bell。你可以稱我為「閣下」。@
@你忘了嗎？好吧，稱呼你『閣下』也可以。@

source_en: @Job? I do not labor like others.@
text_zh: @工作？我不像其他人那樣勞動。@

source_en: @I would appreciate if you would use my title, 'Your Honor'.@
text_zh: @我希望你能稱呼我的頭銜，『閣下』。@

source_en: @You know: rigging the masts or swabbing the decks.@
text_zh: @你知道的：綁扎桅桿或擦洗甲板。@

source_en: @Yes, reading books is good for your spiritual side.@
text_zh: @是的，讀書對你的精神世界很有益處。@

source_en: @You aren't much of a sailor are you? Yorl and that young Delancy girl can tell you about that.@
text_zh: @你不太懂海員的工作，對吧？Yorl 和那個年輕的 Delancy 女孩可以告訴你。@

source_en: @He works at the pier with the Delancy girl.@
text_zh: @他在碼頭與 Delancy 女孩一起工作。@

source_en: @She has run the pier ever since her father, Quenton, was attacked by a gargoyle.@ He coughs then clears his throat.
text_zh: @自從她的父親 Quenton 被石像鬼襲擊後，她就一直在管理碼頭。@ 他咳嗽了一聲，然後清了清喉嚨。

source_en: @Huge fierce creatures, they are. Quenton didn't even have time to scream before one of those beasts had killed him.@
text_zh: @那是巨大而兇猛的生物。Quenton 還沒來得及喊叫，其中一隻怪獸就殺了他。@

source_en: @We were not friends...not good friends, that is. He resented my position.@
text_zh: @我們不是朋友...不是好朋友，就是這樣。他怨恨我的地位。@

source_en: @Quenton, not I, was in charge of its safe keeping. Just as I suspected, when he died, so too did our chances of finding the rune. You see, he never told anyone where it was located.@
text_zh: @負責保管它的是 Quenton，不是我。正如我所料，當他死去時，我們找到符文的可能性也隨之消失了。你看，他從未告訴任何人它在哪裡。@

source_en: You see a tall, rather well dressed man with a wilted smile.*
text_zh: 你看到一個高挑、穿著相當體面的男人，帶著蒼白的微笑。*

source_en: @Speak to Horance of that. He may be mad, but he is still quick and astute in the ways of magic.@
text_zh: @去問問 Horance 吧。他可能瘋了，但在魔法方面他仍然敏捷且敏銳。@

source_en: @Yes, well, as mayor, I am the shepherd of the spiritual people of this hamlet.@
text_zh: @是的，嗯，作為市長，我是這個小村莊精神人們的牧者。@

source_en: @We do not believe in violence as a solution to our problems. My flock would not fight against anyone. Therefore, I'm alarmed at the recent gargoyle sightings.@
text_zh: 我們不認為暴力是解決問題的方法。我的羊羣不會與任何人戰鬥。因此，最近石像鬼的出現讓我感到擔憂。

source_en: @Many believe if he had screamed, someone in the inn would have heard him.@
text_zh: 許多人認為，如果他大聲尖叫，客店裡的某人會聽見。

source_en: @A couple of travelers were staying there that night, but they said they heard nothing. Still, I find this strange.@
text_zh: 那晚有幾位旅人住在該處，但他們說什麼也沒聽見。不過，我覺得這很奇怪。

source_en: @Yes, you see, my brother is a guard for Lord British. A few months ago, a gargoyle attempted to enter the castle proper. He said that although they killed the beast, it's horrifying noises still give him nightmares.@
text_zh: 是的，你看，我哥哥是布里坦領主的衛兵。幾個月前，一隻石像鬼試圖進入城堡主體。他說，雖然他們殺死了那畜生，但它恐怖的噪音至今仍讓他夜夜惡夢。 Lord British

source_en: @I do not know their names. 'Twas Gideon questioned them, not I.@
text_zh: 我不知道他們的名字。是Gideon盤問了他們，不是我。

source_en: @Yes?@ he asks, reaching over and removing something invisible from your shoulder.
text_zh: 「是的？」他問道，伸手把你肩膀上某個看不見的東西拂去。

source_en: @The one the travelers were at. It's across the way.@ He frowns at you.
text_zh: 「就是旅人住的那間。就在對街。」他皺眉看著你。

source_en: @He keeps hearing its deep growl. I'm sure that even if Quenton couldn't scream, someone would have heard that growl.@
text_zh: 他一直聽見它那低沉的咆哮聲。我敢肯定，即使Quenton無法尖叫，也會有人聽見那咆哮聲。

source_en: @For the life of me I've never understood a word he's ever said. They say he drank one too many potions.@
text_zh: 天哪，我從來沒聽懂他說過的一個字。聽說他喝了太多的藥水。

source_en: @She is a peaceful woman. Very pleasant to talk to.@
text_zh: 她是一位平和的女子。很令人愉快地與她交談。

source_en: @He is a very private sort. I've never been to his abode. He lives east of here, along the road to Britain.@
text_zh: 他非常注重隱私。我從未去過他的住所。他就住在這裡東方，沿著通往Britain的路。

source_en: @Investigate him? Why? We already determined it was the gargoyles who killed Quenton.@
text_zh: 「調查他？為什麼？我們已經確定是石像鬼殺了Quenton。」

source_en: @If you wish to re-open the investigation, you should take that up with Lady Lenora in Yew. I'm much too busy..@
text_zh: 「如果你想重啟調查，你應該去找Yew城的Lenora女士。我忙得很..」

source_en: Recognizing you, his smile flickers a moment. @You have come back. Well?@
text_zh: 認出你後，他的笑容閃過一瞬。「你回來了。那麼？」

source_en: @Dezana.@ She smiles like a cat preparing for a meal.
text_zh: @Dezana.@ 她像準備進食的貓一樣微笑著。

source_en: @I can heal, cure, and even resurrect.@
@There are many words which travel about this small hamlet. Many are intriguing, some are even dangerous. What words have you heard?@
text_zh: @這個小村莊裡流傳著許多傳聞。許多都很有趣，甚至有些很危險。你聽說了什麼？@

source_en: @That is correct. Now, are you here to chat, or are you in need?@
text_zh: @說得對。那麼，你是來閒聊的，還是有什麼需要？@

source_en: @I don't see a body that can be resurrected.@
@That is one worth speaking about. You see, many people travel the spirit world. Some are lost souls, others have a purpose. Quenton is not a lost soul.@
text_zh: @這是一件值得一談的事。你看，許多人穿梭於靈界。有些是迷路的靈魂，有些則有目的。Quenton 不是迷路的靈魂。@

source_en: @It is a mystical place between here and the hereafter. Quenton resides there.@
text_zh: @那是個神祕之地，位於此地與來世之間。Quenton 就居住在那裡。@

source_en: @He had attained much wisdom before he was forced from here. If his ghost has been seen...And I believe he has...Then he must be attempting to communicate with us about some unfinished business.@
text_zh: @他在被迫離開這裡之前，已獲得了許多的智慧。如果他的鬼魂曾被見過...我相信確實有...那麼他一定試圖通過某種未完成的事務與我們溝通。@

source_en: @They spent their whole life without learning anything or growing inside. They are as children left alone in a crib. Never learning, always seeking.@
text_zh: @他們度過了一生，卻什麼都沒學到，內部也毫無成長。他們就像被獨自留在嬰兒牀裡的兒童。永遠學不到東西，永遠在尋求。@

source_en: @I know this much: if you wish to find out who murdered him, you won't be able to ask his ghost. You see, the spirit world can not communicate with ours directly. Although his ghost can hear your questions, he'll respond by manipulating the environment.@
text_zh: @我知道這麼一點：如果你想查明是誰殺害了他，你無法直接問他的鬼魂。你看，靈界無法與我們的領域直接溝通。雖然他的鬼魂能聽到你的問題，但他會通過操縱環境來回應。@

source_en: You see a very large woman with a deliberate smile.*
text_zh: 你看到一位身材高大的女子，帶著故意的微笑。*

source_en: @Yes, you know, make him demonstrate his answers by, say, shaking a branch.@
text_zh: 是的，你知道，讓他透過示範來證明他的答案，比如搖晃樹枝。

source_en: @Those creatures are dangerous. I have heard that they can tear a man to pieces.@
text_zh: 那些生物很危險。我聽說它們能把人撕成碎片。

source_en: @So why, then, did the gargoyles not attack Stivius as well? Certainly he would have tasted just as good.@
text_zh: 那麼，為什麼石像鬼沒有攻擊 Stivius 呢？他的味道肯定也一樣好。

source_en: @A quaint little man. He has strong feelings for me. I must admit, he has a cute way about him.@
text_zh: 一個怪異的小男人。他對我充滿了強烈的情感。我得承認，他有一種可愛的風度。

source_en: @He was once a great man. Discovered many of the herbs I use in healing. He discovered something else, however: that total knowledge can corrupt totally. I don't know what drove him mad. And I don't want to know.@ She shudders slightly.
text_zh: 他曾經是一個偉大的人。發現了我用於治癒的許多草藥。然而，他還發現了另一件事：完全的知識會帶來完全的腐敗。我不知道是什麼讓瘋狂了他的。我也不想知道。" 她輕輕地顫抖著。

source_en: @This town has suffered through much tragedy already, hopefully she can be found safe.@
text_zh: 這個小鎮已經遭受了許多的悲劇，希望她能平安無事地找到。

source_en: @Mmm...yes?@ She looks down at you, her eyes merely slits.@
text_zh: 嗯...是的？" 她低頭看著你，她的眼睛只是細縫。

source_en: @She has seen much pain in her life. More than even I can heal. I pity her.@
text_zh: 她一生中見過許多的痛苦。甚至比我能治癒的還多。我同情她。

source_en: @It's a terrible thing to learn about her father being killed by Michael, but at least she has some sort of closure.@
text_zh: 得知她的父親被 Michael 殺死是一件可怕的事，但至少她得到了一些解脫。

source_en: @He is a dear old man. Never has a mean thing to say of anyone.@
text_zh: 他是一個親切的老頭子。從未說過任何人的壞話。

source_en: @I know something about everyone in this village. However, this man is unknown to me. He never talks about his past.@
text_zh: 我認識這個村莊裡的每個人。但是，這個男人對我是個謎。他從不談論他的過去。

source_en: @There was always something suspicious about him, I am glad he will finally pay for his crime against Quenton.@
text_zh: 他總有些可疑之處，很高興他終於要為他對 Quenton 的罪行付出代價了。

source_en: @He is a very stiff man. I believe he may be hiding something about his past.@
text_zh: 他是一個非常嚴肅的人。我想他可能在隱藏他過去的某些事情。

source_en: @A nice fellow, but a bit too simple for me.@
text_zh: 一個不錯的人，但對我的口味來說太單純了。

source_en: @As I said, spirits cannot communicate with our world directly...@
text_zh: 正如我所說，靈魂無法直接與我們的世界溝通..."

source_en: @However... it is said that old Horance may know of the 'Seance' spell...what he does with it, I do not wish to know.@
text_zh: 然而... 據說老 Horance 可能知道「靈媒」魔法...他要做什麼，我不想知道。"

source_en: @Gives me the chills just thinking about it.@
text_zh: 光是想到我就直冒冷汗。"

source_en: @Perhaps, you being the Avatar, wouldst be brave enough to ask him.@
text_zh: 也許，作為聖者，你會勇敢 enough 去問他。"

source_en: @Dezana knows much. Have you returned for more talk or are you in need?@
text_zh: Dezana 知道很多。你是回來繼續聊天的，還是需要幫助？"

source_en: @I've already told you how... I'd rather not speak of it again. The thought makes me uncomfortable.@
text_zh: 我已經告訴過你了...我不願意再提起這件事。這個想法讓我很不舒服。"
當你需要的時候再來治療。"

source_en: @Oh dear, my husband runs the inn. I tend my garden.@
text_zh: @哎呀，我丈夫經營這間旅館。我照顧我的花園。@

source_en: @It is a plain name, but I must live with it.@
text_zh: @這是一個平凡的名字，但我必須與它共度一生。@

source_en: @You've not seen it? I have the loveliest roses.@
text_zh: @你沒見過嗎？我有最美的玫瑰花。@

source_en: @Red as the evening sun on the sea.@
@He's a messy person - and smelly too.@
@Oh... my sweet Marney... She left with that man, and now... now she is gone. Please, if thou dost find her, tell her to come home...@
text_zh: @噢...我親愛的Marney...她跟那個男人走了，現在...現在她不見了。請你，如果你找到她，告訴她回來...@

source_en: @My dear little one? She is an angel - well minded, kind, thoughtful. She's a dear.@
text_zh: @我親愛的小傢伙？她像天使一樣——心智健全，善良，體貼。她真好。@

source_en: @Nasty creatures, or so I hear. Can stomp a garden to pieces in minutes.@
text_zh: @我聽說它們很兇殘。能在幾分鐘內把花園踩得粉碎。@

source_en: @My husband talks a bit too much, but I love him.@
text_zh: @我丈夫說話有點多，但我愛他。@

source_en: @I want to move from this house as soon as we can.@
text_zh: @我們越快離開這棟房子越好。@

source_en: @I cut myself one time in the garden. She healed it.@
text_zh: @有一次我在花園割傷了自己。她治好了我。@

source_en: @Another strange man. We have so many here.@
text_zh: @又一個怪人。這裡有太多這種人了。@

source_en: @It was the scariest thing I ever saw! I'm sure it's still lurking about somewhere...@
text_zh: @那是我見過最可怕的事！我敢肯定它還藏在某處...@

source_en: @Goodbye and watch out for that ghost..@
A rather plump woman with darting eyes.
text_zh: 一個相當肥胖、眼神靈動的女人。

source_en: @Hello. How are you this fine day? What is it you need?@
text_zh: @你好。今天天氣真好，你過得怎麼樣？你需要什麼？@

source_en: Yorl's voice cracks with anger. @It's all I kin do from taking this here hook and jammin it through yer skull. Get out of here, and don't come back...@
text_zh: Yorl 的聲音因憤怒而破裂。@我就想把這鉤子刺穿你的頭蓋骨。滾出這裡，別再回來...@

source_en: He turns his head back towards you, purses his lips, then speaks. @It was a calm night, it was. Quen and I had 'cided to go out on that glassy sea for a fish. Not just any fish, mind ya, a light-horn.@
text_zh: 他把頭轉回看向你，緊抿著嘴唇，然後說道。@那是一個平靜的夜晚，沒錯。Quen 和我決定去那片如鏡的海面上釣魚。不是普通的魚，注意了，是發光角魚。@

source_en: @Never mind.@ He sticks his hands in his apron.
@Mondain, of course, was slain many years ago. There are pirates who sail under his banner still. Legend has it, the captain sailed under Mondain himself.@
text_zh: @當然，Mondain 多年前就被殺害了。如今仍有海盜在他的旗幟下航行。傳說說，那位船長曾在 Mondain 本人麾下 sailing。@

source_en: @Aye. My father used to tell me the tales he'd hear of a pirate captain who commanded Mondain's armada of pirates and other riff-raff.@
text_zh: @嗯。我父親以前常給我講他聽來的故事，關於一位指揮著 Mondain 海盜艦隊以及其他烏合之眾的海盜船長。@

source_en: @Legend has it that the captain swore allegance to Mondain himself, and vowed to serve him until death... and beyond.@
text_zh: @傳說那位船長向 Mondain 本人宣誓效忠，並發誓效忠至死...乃至身後。@

source_en: @Mondain's armada was vast, but supposedly only one ship remained. The tattered sail still bears the crest of Mondain.@
text_zh: @Mondain 的艦隊龐大無邊，但據說只剩下一艘船。那破舊的帆上仍印有 Mondain 的紋章。@

source_en: @When we were boys, Quen's father often talked about such a fish. Said if a body could catch one, good fortune would be his.@
text_zh: @我們小時候，Quen 的父親常談論這種魚。他說如果一個人能釣到它，就會獲得好運。@

source_en: @Yes, good fortune. He said the fish had a glowing horn on it's snout. It only comes close to the surface when the sea is like glass.@
text_zh: @是的，好運。他說那魚的鼻樑上長著發光的角。它只會在海面如鏡時靠近水面。@

source_en: @You see, the fish thought the surface was a mirror and it came up to admire its horn.@ He chuckles to himself, teeth clenched around the pipe. @Anyway, Quen and I 'cided we'd catch us one in our skiff.@
text_zh: @你聽，那魚把水面當成了鏡子，於是上來欣賞它的角。@他自顧自地笑了起來，牙齒咬著煙斗。@反正，Quen 和我們決定用我們的小船去抓一條。@

source_en: He pulls the pipe from his mouth and blows some smoke rings. @Well, even though the skiff was small, we figured that we'd spear the beast and drag it back to port.@
text_zh: 他把煙斗從嘴裡抽出，吐幾個煙圈。@嗯，雖然小船很小，但我們以為可以用矛刺傷那怪物，然後把它拖回港口。@

source_en: @I know it sounds crazy now, but you have to remember, we were only boys. Anyway, we rowed out past Ivers Rounding and sat in our skiff waiting to see one.@ He looks out to sea again and chuckles.
text_zh: @我知道這聽起來很瘋狂，但你必須記住，我們那時只是孩子。總之，我們划到 Ivers Rounding 外面，坐在小船裡等待看到一條。@他又望向海面， chuckled。

source_en: @You know, past where the alchemist lives. Anyway, we sat there for hours with 'nary a sign of life...Then, suddenly, in the distance we could see a tall neck rising out of the water and heading towards us.@
text_zh: @你聽說過，在煉金術士住的地方附近。總之，我們在那裡坐了好幾個小時，連一點生機都沒有...然後，突然間，在遠處我們看見一條長長的脖子從水中升起，朝我們遊來。@

source_en: @Old Horance? He's a crazy old coot who lives on the isle.@
text_zh: @老 Horance？他是個住在島上的瘋老頭。@

source_en: @As it came closer, a huge wave preceded it and we could make out a giant mouth.@ He takes his pipe from his mouth and gestures at you. @I tell you, you've never seen two boys make a skiff travel so fast in all your life.@ He laughs out loud, this time bending over to support himself.
text_zh: @當它靠得更近時，前面伴隨著一個巨大的波浪，我們能看清一張巨大的嘴。@他把煙斗從嘴裡拿出，朝你揮手。@我跟你說，你從來沒見過兩個男孩讓小船跑得那麼快。@他大聲笑了出來，這次彎下腰支撐著自己。

source_en: @Never use 'em myself. I stick to nets--faster and easier.@*
text_zh: @我自己從不用它們。我靠網——更快更省力。@*

source_en: @I took it from Quenton's dead body to give to Marney for safe keeping.@
text_zh: 我從 Quenton 的屍身上取出來，交給 Marney 保管。

source_en: @He's a stuffy one. Never likes to come down here, says it smells.@
text_zh: 他個性古板，從不願下來，說這裡味道太大。

source_en: @She's a heavily rigged one, she is.@ He winks at you and laughs.
text_zh: 她可是個手段高明的，你知道的。他朝你眨眼大笑。

source_en: @Not only did the bastard murder my best friend, he had been sneaking around here under my nose, trying to ensnare Marney with his charm.@
text_zh: 那個混蛋不只殺了我最好的朋友，還在我眼皮底下鬼鬼祟祟，想靠他的魅力勾引 Marney。

source_en: A huge, imposing man adorned in a leather apron.*
text_zh: 一個高大的男人，身穿皮圍裙，氣度威嚴。*

source_en: @I thank thee for bringing him to justice, otherwise, he would meet a worse fate at my hands!@
text_zh: 感謝你將他繩之以法，否則我親自動手，他下場會更慘！

source_en: @I don't much care for that one. He used to sail under the command of a zealot of Mondain.. I'd plot a course 'round him if I were you.@
text_zh: 我不太喜歡那艘船。他以前聽命於 Mondain 的一個狂信者..要是換作我，我會繞道航行。

source_en: @This is a fishhouse. It's meant to be an eyesore.@ He laughs again.*
text_zh: 這可是個魚屋。本來就該看起來難看。他又笑了。*

source_en: He slaps a hand on your back. @Good fortune, and may the wind be at your back!@
text_zh: 他拍拍你的背。「祝你好運，願順風助你！」

source_en: , friend.@ He extends a huge hand which resembles a slab of meat.
text_zh: ，朋友。他伸出碩大的手掌，像塊肉排。

source_en: @Ah!@ He rumbles up to you with a large, bloody hook.
text_zh: 啊！他提著一隻沾血的大鉤，隆隆地走過來。

source_en: @You feel like bolting, but then he drops it in a pocket on his apron and extends a bloody hand. He smells strongly of fish.
text_zh: 「你本想溜之大吉，但隨後他把它塞進圍裙口袋裡，並伸出一隻沾血的手。他身上有股濃烈的魚腥味。」

source_en: @Yorl. A short name, but a strong one!@
@I'm a fisherman. 'Tisn't quite as exciting as some jobs, but it keeps me near the sea.@
text_zh: 「我是個漁夫。這工作雖不如某些職業那麼刺激，但能讓我貼近大海。」

source_en: @My father was a coastal raider. But don't let that out.@ He lets out a holler and laughs loudly.
text_zh: 「我父親曾是海盜。但別把這件事說出去。」他大聲吼叫了一陣，然後狂笑起來。

source_en: @Yes, I had one.@ He hollers again, this time slapping you on the back.
text_zh: @是的，我有一個。@ 他再次大喊，這次拍了一下你的背部。

source_en: He suddenly stops laughing and looks at you, his eyes angry and wide. @Who told you?@ With that he throws his head back and laughs again.
text_zh: 他突然停止大笑，盯著你看，眼神憤怒且瞪大。@誰告訴你的？@ 說完后，他仰起頭又開始大笑。

source_en: Yorl looks like he has seen better days, his eyes look bloodshot and he looks worried.
text_zh: Yorl 看起來像是經歷了艱難的日子，眼睛充血，神情擔憂。

source_en: @Oh, aye, love the sea I do. Even if the fishing's been poor of late.@
text_zh: @噢，是的，我愛大海。即使最近釣魚收穫不好。@

source_en: @Fish come, fish go. Right now, the fish have gone. But they'll come back! And when they do, I'll be waitin' for 'em with my nets!@
text_zh: @魚來魚去。現在，魚沒了。但牠們會回來的！到時候，我會用漁網等著牠們！@

source_en: @Aye, you haveta use nets to do serious fishing. A pole'll never catch you enough to sell.@
text_zh: @是的，要認真釣魚就得用漁網。只靠釣竿絕對捕不到足夠賣錢的量。@

source_en: @That's a tale they tell in town. I've seen no spirits. Except at old Stivius'.@
text_zh: @那是鎮上流傳的故事。我沒見過鬼魂。除了在老 Stivius 那兒。@

source_en: @You know, 'bout Marn's pa haunting the vineyard.@ He leans closer wiping his hands on his apron. @I think Stivius has been drinkin' his profits.@
text_zh: @你知道，關於 Marn 的父親在葡萄園出鬼的事。@ 他湊近一些，用圍裙擦著手。@我覺得 Stivius 一直在喝他的利潤。@

source_en: He removes a large hook from his pocket and begins to clean it as he talks. @He's a strange little guy. They say he's the only one who saw Quen murdered. I wish we'd had a better witness.@
text_zh: 他從口袋裡拿出一個大鉤子，邊說邊開始擦拭。@他是個奇怪的小夥計。他們說他是唯一目擊 Quen 被殺的人。我真希望我們有更好的證人。@

source_en: He flips the hook over and over examining it. @Still, those gargoyles would frighten any man. 'Specially one as small as him.@
text_zh: 他反覆翻轉著鉤子仔細檢查。@不過，那些滴水嘴會嚇到任何男人。特別是像他這麼小的人。@

source_en: @I can't believe she ran away with Michael, and I wasn't there to stop her. She's not been the same since.@
text_zh: @我無法相信她跟 Michael 跑了，而我沒在場阻止。自那以後她就不對勁了。@

source_en: @I can thank ya enough Avatar, for saving my dear Marney from that scoundrel Michael. She's still heartbroken and feels guilty for wanting to leave, but she's on the mend and seems more at peace now.@
text_zh: @聖者，我要感謝你，救了我親愛的 Marney，擺脫了那個無賴 Michael。她仍然心碎，對想離開感到愧疚，但她正在好轉，看起來更平靜了。@

source_en: @She's the loveliest thing ever seen in these parts. I'm her father now. And if any man should want her hand, he'd better be able to take me square!@ He gives you a huge grin and flexes a massive bicep.
text_zh: @她是這片土地上見過的最美麗的人。我是她的父親。如果任何男人想追求她，他最好能跟我正面過招！@ 他給你一個大大的笑容，並展示他結實的肱二頭肌。

source_en: @She's gone... Marney's gone. I was supposed to protect her. You let her leave with that bastard!@
text_zh: @她走了... Marney 走了。我本該保護她的。你讓她和那個混蛋跑了！@

source_en: @They say that Quen's ghost haunts that area of town. I can't imagine why. The sea was his lifeblood.@
text_zh: @他們說 Quen 的鬼魂盤踞在鎮上的那個區域。我無法想像為什麼。大海是他的生命源泉。@

source_en: @He and I were mates. I can still remember the moment they told me he was dead.@ He swallows hard and his eyes become glassy. @I miss old Quen.@
text_zh: @他和我是好友。我仍記得他們告訴我他去世的那一刻。@ 他用力吞了一口，眼神變得空洞。@我想念老 Quen。@

source_en: @Gideon and Stivius. They came to my house before dawn and told me that Quen had been killed by gargoyles.@
text_zh: @Gideon 和 Stivius。他們在黎明前來到我家，告訴我 Quen 被滴水嘴殺了。@

source_en: @He owns the Haunting Inn. He's good people, though his wife is a bit of a nag.@
text_zh: @他擁有「Haunting Inn」。他是個好人，只是他的妻子有點愛囉嗦。@

source_en: @She always complains that my house is an eyesore. I tell you if she comes around here, I'll show her what an eyesore really is!@ He slaps you on the back and laughs.
text_zh: @她老是抱怨我的房子難看極了。我跟你說，如果她再來這裡，我非得讓她見識見識什麼才叫真正的難看不可！@他拍著你的背大笑。

source_en: @I never seen a one. I seen alot o' things out at sea, serpents as big as the biggest four-master. But 'nary a single gargoyle.@ He looks out towards the sea.
text_zh: @我從來沒見過石像鬼。我在海上見過許多東西，連比最大的四桅帆船還要大的巨蛇都見過。但就是沒見過石像鬼。@他望向大海。

source_en: @One o' the tall ships. My father used to pilot one o' the biggest in Lord British's fleet. The Merideth Ann. She was a sight to behold, she was.@
text_zh: @其中一艘高桅帆船。我父親曾駕駛過Lord British船隊中最大的一艘。Merideth Ann。那真是壯觀。@

source_en: @My father used to sail in one of his fleets. A brave and mighty ruler he is.@
text_zh: @我父親曾在他的一支船隊中航行。他是一位勇敢而偉大的統治者。@

source_en: @She'd seen many a battle with pirates. Then she went to her grave in a storm. Took nearly two hundred men with her.@
text_zh: @她經歷過許多與海盜的戰鬥。後來她在風暴中沉沒。幾乎帶著兩百名船員一起去了。@

source_en: @Came up all of a sudden. I say it was Mondain's doing.@ He pulls the pipe from his mouth and tamps the tobacco with his stout thumb. @Anyhow, that's when I lost my father.@
text_zh: @來得突然。我猜那是Mondain的作為。@他從嘴裡抽出煙斗，用厚實的大拇指敲敲打打菸草。@總之，那是我失去父親的時候。@

source_en: He stops trying to relight his pipe and looks at you. @Where have you been scuttled? That's too long a story for this
text_zh: 他停下點煙斗的動作，看著你。 @你從哪裡冒出來的？故事太長了，沒空跟你說，

source_en: You notice his mouth doesn't quite synch up with the voice that seems to be somewhere in the back of your mind. The spirit's eyes grow larger and more intense as if he was concentrating harder on his message. The voice starts to synch up more with the words, which are still muffled but becoming a bit more clear.*
text_zh: 你發現他的嘴型並不完全合拍，那聲音似乎來自你腦海的深處。靈魂的眼睛變得更大、更專注，彷彿他在更努力地傳達訊息。聲音開始更貼合那些模糊但漸趨清晰的詞語。*

source_en: Quenton's eyes grow more desperate and a sense of frustration comes over him. The voice, now sounding like muffled shouting from another room, starts to echo louder in your mind. You feel a draining sensation, as if your life's energy was being sucked from you and your overwhelmed with a feeling of despair.*
text_zh: Quenton的眼神變得更加絕望，一股挫折感籠罩著他。聲音現在聽起來像是從隔壁房間傳來的模糊喊叫，在你腦中迴盪得更響。你感到一種抽離感，彷彿你的生命力正被吸食，一陣絕望的壓迫感淹沒了你。*

source_en: After casting the Seance spell, you approach the restless spirit of Quenton. He attempts to speak to you.
text_zh: 施展「靈媒術」後，你靠近了不安的靈魂Quenton。他試圖與你說話。

source_en: You attempt to break concentration but find yourself unable to. The spirit's eyes appear to glow, and you feel like your almost being sucked into them. Everything seems to be going black around you, and you feel faint. The shade's eyes don't avert their gaze from you as the voice starts to become a little more audible.
text_zh: 你試圖中斷專注，但發現自己無法做到。靈魂的眼睛似乎在發光，你感覺自己幾乎被吸進去。周圍的一切都變得漆黑，你感到眩暈。幽靈的注視沒有從你身上移開，而聲音開始變得稍微清晰一些。

source_en: In a flash, you see a series of events that happens so fast you cannot comprehend them, but you understand that you are seeing -- or somehow experiencing -- Quenton's final moments.
text_zh: 瞬間，你看到一系列發生得太快而無法理解的事件，但你明白自己正在目睹——或某種程度經歷——Quenton的死亡時刻。

source_en: From the muffled voice, now almost shouting, you discern the name 'Michael' and the look in the shade's eyes is now one of complete terror, mouth gaping open. The instantaneous image of a dagger cutting through the darkness seems to bring you to your knees, as if your mind was literally stabbed by it.*
text_zh: 從那模糊的聲音，現在幾乎是尖叫中，你辨認出「Michael」這個名字，幽靈眼中的神情變成了純粹的恐懼，嘴巴張開。一柄短刀劃破黑暗的瞬間影像讓你雙腿發軟跪倒在地，彷彿你的心靈被它刺穿了一般。*

source_en: A bloodcurdling scream from beyond tears through your mind. It is one of the most horrifying things you've ever heard. You don't even feel yourself hitting the ground as everything around you fades to black.
text_zh: 一聲刺骨驚叫穿透你的腦海。這是你聽過最恐怖的事物之一。你甚至沒感覺到自己摔在地上，周圍的一切就Fade成黑色。

source_en: You feel it's probably a good idea to avoid speaking with Quenton again in this state, as his painful memories made the connection more powerful - and frightening.
text_zh: 你覺得最好避免在這個狀態下再與Quenton說話，因為他痛苦的回憶讓連結變得更加強大——也更加的恐懼。

source_en: A vaporous form hovering before you.
text_zh: 一個漂浮在你面前的朦朧形態。

source_en: The form is that of a man. His mouth moves, yet no words can be heard...
text_zh: 那個形態是一個人類。他的嘴在動，卻聽不到任何聲音...

source_en: A shiver runs up your spine as you feel a chilling draft...
text_zh: 一陣寒意沿著你的脊椎竄起，你感受到一股冰冷的風...

source_en: You speak the word and the spectre responds by pointing a boney hand to his chest.
text_zh: 你念出這個詞，幽靈回應時用骨瘦如柴的手指了指自己的胸膛。

source_en: At first, his mouth moves and you hear nothing. Moments later, you hear the faint voice of a man, but it is as if someone was speaking to you from another room entirely.*
text_zh: 起初，他的嘴唇在動，但你聽不到聲音。片刻之後，你聽見一個男人微弱的聲音，彷彿有人從另一個房間對著你說話。*

source_en: You hear no answer save the rustle of the leaves on the ground around you.
text_zh: 除了周圍地面樹葉的沙沙聲，你沒有聽到任何回答。

source_en: You speak the word and the spectre responds by pointing a boney hand to his eye.
text_zh: 你念出這個詞，幽靈回應時用骨瘦如柴的手指了指自己的眼睛。

source_en: A whirlpool of leaves, twigs and stones whips up around you. Your clothing is yanked by the strong wind forcing you to grip it tightly in your hands.
text_zh: 葉子、樹枝和石頭的漩渦在你周圍狂舞。強勁的風吹得你的衣服緊貼身體，迫使你不得不緊緊抓住它們。

source_en: A cool breeze blows through your hair. You suddenly smell the scent of a storm approaching.
text_zh: 涼風拂過你的頭髮。你突然聞到了風暴來臨的氣味。

source_en: A wind from behind blows your hair, covering your eyes.
text_zh: 背後吹來一陣風，把你的頭髮吹亂，遮住了你的眼睛。

source_en: The ghostly image shimmers for a moment and then he points a boney finger to his neck.
text_zh: 鬼影閃爍了一下，然後他用骨瘦如柴的手指了指自己的脖子。

source_en: The spectre's arm thrusts out, pointing to the sea.
text_zh: 幽靈的手臂伸出，指向大海。

source_en: The spectre's arm thrusts again, this time. This time you see it points towards the pier.
text_zh: 幽靈的手臂再次伸出，這次是指向碼頭。

source_en: , the spirit feels compelled to join you!
text_zh: ，這靈體覺得有義務加入你們！

source_en: ...but your party is too full. The spectre looks disappointed.
text_zh: ...但你的隊伍已經滿員。幽靈看起來很失望。

source_en: The spirit looks dejected, but leaves the party.
text_zh: 那靈魂看起來很沮喪，但還是離開了隊伍。

source_en: A strong breeze suddenly assaults you with twigs and leaves.
text_zh: 一股強風突然襲來，吹得枝葉亂舞。

source_en: He looks you up and down and then claps his hands together. @Yeah. Ok. Yeah. What can I do you for?@
text_zh: 他上上下下打量了你一番，然後拍了拍手。「嗯。好。嗯。有什麼事要我幫忙嗎？」

source_en: Stivius looks at you. @Thou dost not have enough gold.@
text_zh: Stivius 看著你。「你身上的黃金不夠。」

source_en: @Come back tomorrow when my shop is open.@
text_zh: 「明天再來吧，屆時我的店會營業。」

source_en: @Yeah. Maybe you want to buy some?@
@Stivius smiles at you. For Skara Red wine it will cost you 20 gold. Interested?@
text_zh: Stivius 對你笑了笑。一瓶 Skara 紅酒要價 20 金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: @Stivius smiles at you. For Skara White wine it will cost you 10 gold. Interested?@
text_zh: Stivius 對你笑了笑。一瓶 Skara 白酒要價 10 金幣。有興趣嗎？

source_en: @Stivius smiles at you. For Skara Dry wine it will cost you
text_zh: Stivius 對你笑了笑。一瓶 Skara 干紅酒要價

source_en: @Stivius smiles at you. For Red wine it will cost you 20 gold. Interested?@
text_zh: @Stivius 對你微笑。紅酒要 20 黃金。感興趣嗎？@

source_en: @What else can I do for you?@
@It's not just a tale you've been hearing.@
text_zh: @這不僅是你聽來的一個傳說。@

source_en: @Everyone knows that Quenton haunts this town. If I had been murdered by those evil ones...but that's just gossip.@*
text_zh: @大家都知道 Quenton 在鎮上作祟。如果我被那些壞蛋殺害了...但那只是閒話。@*

source_en: @He was a nice enough soul. I sold many bottles to him.@*
text_zh: @他是個還不錯的人。我賣給了他很多瓶酒。@*

source_en: @It was late one night and I had just returned from my fields. 'Course my path takes me right by Gideon's garden.@*
text_zh: @那天深夜，我剛從田裡回來。我的路徑正好經過 Gideon 的花園。@*

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the wine.
text_zh: @很好！@ 收下你的黃金後，他把酒遞給你。

source_en: @I heard a noise by the well and saw some dark forms hunched there. They had huge wings and evil red eyes. I ran like the wind to my doorway.@
text_zh: @我聽到井邊有動靜，看到幾個黑影蜷縮在那裡。它們有巨大的翅膀和邪惡的紅眼睛。我像風一樣跑回門口。@

source_en: @Gideon runs the Haunting Inn. His wife has a garden which you can see from my front door.@*
text_zh: @Gideon 經營著 Haunting Inn。他的妻子有個花園，你可以從我家門口看到。@*

source_en: @Twas a strange whispering, in a tongue I could not understand.@*
text_zh: @那是奇怪的低語，用一種我聽不懂的語言。@*

source_en: @I couldn't see too clearly. They were about man-sized though.@*
text_zh: @我看不太清楚。不過它們大約有人的大小。@*

source_en: @It's the Inn straight across the lane from here.@*
@She doesn't do much. Helps him run the place.@*
text_zh: @她沒做什麼大事。只是幫他打理地方。@*

source_en: @It didn't sound like any language I ever heard. More like one o' them guild languages.@*
text_zh: @那聽起來不像是我聽過的任何語言。更像是行會的那種語言。@*

source_en: Go ask old Horance. He can tell ya - if you can understand him!@*
text_zh: 去問問老 Horance 吧。他可以告訴你——如果你聽得懂的話！@*

source_en: @He lives over on Ivers Rounding by himself.@*
@You must be new to this village. Go see Marney, she'll get you there.@*
text_zh: 你一定是剛來到這個村子。去找 Marney 吧，她能帶你去那裡。*

source_en: @She's the daughter of Quenton - the ghost.@*
text_zh: 她是 Quenton 的女兒——那個幽靈。*

source_en: @Yes, but they were hunched down so it was hard to see them.@*
text_zh: 是的，但它們蹲得很低，很難看清。*

source_en: @His eyes widen. @Gargoyles they were! Must'a been ten or twelve of 'em.@*
text_zh: 他的眼睛瞪大了。是石像鬼！大概有十隻或十二隻。*

source_en: @Yes. Big, ugly, snarling beasts. 'Course, they were kneeling when I saw 'em.@*
text_zh: 是的。巨大、醜陋、咆哮的怪物。當然，我看到它們時，它們是跪著的。*

source_en: @Well, perhaps more like two or three. I didn't stay around and count 'em.@*
text_zh: 嗯，也許更接近兩隻或三隻吧。我沒有留在原數數。*

source_en: @I don't care much for him. He's always trying to get me to sell him my wine cheaper.@
text_zh: 我對他印象不深。他總是想讓我以更低的价格把酒賣給他。

source_en: @She's my sweetie.@ He clasps his hands next to his cheek. @I count the hours until I can see her.@
text_zh: 她是我的甜心。他把手放在臉頰旁。我數著時刻，等著見她。

source_en: @I have never talked to him. He bought wine from me once but that's it.@
text_zh: 我從未和他說過話。他曾經向我買過一次酒，但就那麼一次。

source_en: @Well, what's to say? I am glad he is again our ruler.@
text_zh: 嗯，說來話長？很高興他又成為我們的統治者了。

source_en: ?@ You notice Stivius starting to sweat!
text_zh: ?@ 你注意到 Stivius 開始出汗！

source_en: You tell him that you don't buy the gargoyle story and that you believe he saw Michael committing the crime.
text_zh: 你告訴他你並不相信石像鬼的說法，並且認為他看到的是 Michael 犯下的罪行。

source_en: Stivius looks at you with wide, unbelieving eyes. @Please
text_zh: Stivius 瞪大眼睛，滿臉不相信地看着你。請

source_en: After seeing your skeptical face, he sighs. @Alright, alright...@ he says, voice trembling. @I saw Michael do it. He caught me as I was trying to go back into mine home. He brandished the knife and swore he'd kill me!@
text_zh: 看到你懷疑的表情，他嘆了口氣。好吧，好吧...他說，聲音顫抖著。我看到 Michael 做的。當我試圖返回我家時，他抓住了我。他揮舞著刀，發誓要殺了我！

source_en: @I made up the gargoyle tale, because I fear him and his retribution!@
text_zh: 我編了石像鬼的故事，因為我害怕他和他的報復！

source_en: He looks at you incredulously. @Oh, no
text_zh: 他滿懷疑惑地看著你。 @不，不會

source_en: . I know what you ask of me, and I cannot - and will not - do it. Please, leave me be. I'm terrified enough as it is of the man. Please go...@
text_zh: . 我知道你要我做些什麼，但我不能——也絕不會——這麼做。求求你，讓我安靜待著。我已經夠害怕那個人了。請走吧...@

source_en: A tiny little man with wild eyes.*
text_zh: 一個眼神狂亂的小矮人。*

source_en: @If thou art so brave, confront Michael yourself!@
text_zh: @如果你這麼勇敢，自己去找Michael對峙吧！@

source_en: @Thou art carrying too much for me to reward thee properly...Bring the book back later, when thou art less burdened.@
text_zh: @你身上攜帶的東西太多了，我無法好好獎勵你...等你負擔輕些時再帶書回來吧。@
@我最喜歡的故事是《Hubert the Lion》。@

source_en: @I've known it by heart, ever since I heard it as a child.@*
text_zh: @自從小時候聽過，我就能將它背誦出來。@*

source_en: @Hubert the Lion was haughty and vain, and especially proud of his elegant mane.@*
text_zh: @Hubert the Lion 高傲而自滿，尤其為他那優雅的鬃毛感到自豪。@*

source_en: @But conceit of this sort is not proper at all, and Hubert the Lion was due for a fall.@
text_zh: @但這類自滿絕非正道，Hubert the Lion 註定要遭受報應。@

source_en: @Well, I'd rather thou didst not call me that.@
@'Tis I who should thank thee, Avatar, for all thou hast done for Britannia.@
text_zh: @該是我感謝你，聖者，感謝你為Britannia所做的一切。@

source_en: @Chuckles? Hast thou seen him? I do hope nothing hath happened to him, he hasn't been around lately...@
text_zh: @Chuckles？你見過他嗎？我希望他沒有發生什麼事，他最近都不見人影...@

source_en: You break your promise to Chuckles and explain to Lord British that Chuckles usurped his power during his absence, hid Lucy's death from him and hid his association with Drudgeworth.
text_zh: 你背負起對Chuckles的承諾，向英格蘭伯爵揭露Chuckles趁其不在時篡奪了他的權力，並對他隱瞞了Lucy的死訊以及他與杜德沃斯的往來。 Lord British Drudgeworth

source_en: Lord British looks incredulous.  @Avatar, those are pretty serious accusations. How dost thou know of this, is there proof?@
text_zh: Lord British 滿懷疑惑地看著你。 @聖者，這些可是很嚴重的指控。你是怎麼知道這些的？有證據嗎？@

source_en: @I have the proof in this leaflet right here, milord.@
text_zh: @證據就在這張小冊子裡，我的陛下。@

source_en: Lord British reads the leaflet and furrows his brow. @This is definitely not my handwriting but it its my stationary. Conspiring to keep this secret from me for all those years...@
text_zh: Lord British 閱讀小冊子，眉頭緊皺。 @這確實不是我的筆跡，但確是我的信紙。隱瞞這個祕密這麼多年...@

source_en: @..and wenching! Such lewd behavior is inappropriate for members of my royal court. That poor girl.@
text_zh: @還有嫖妓！這種下流行為根本不該發生在我王宮成員身上..可憐的女孩。@

source_en: He sighs. @I must have a talk with Chuckles over this. What else shall you have me do, after all these years? And why now, bring it to my attention when we have more pressing matters such as the gargoyle invasion?@
text_zh: 他嘆了口氣。 @我必須為此和Chuckles談談。過了這麼多年，你還要我做些什麼？而且為什麼是現在，把這事告訴我，而我們還有像石像鬼入侵這樣更緊迫的問題？@

source_en: , I knowest Honesty is one of the virtues and all..@
Chuckles, let us have a talk..
Chuckles.. I must speak with thee!
@Well Avatar, where is it? Why are you wasting time with wild accusations while the gargoyles are running amok?@
text_zh: @那麼聖者，它在哪？石像鬼四處亂跑，你為什麼要浪費時間進行這些荒謬的指控？@

source_en: @The same key will also let you into the sewers under the castle. Now let me tell thee what hath transpired since thy last visit.@*
text_zh: 同一把鑰匙也能讓你進入城堡下的下水道。現在讓我告訴妳，自你上次造訪以來發生了什麼事。*

source_en: @The vast underworld from which thou didst rescue me hath collapsed. Yet still there are forces of evil abroad in the land.@*
text_zh: 你曾救我脫身的龐大地下世界已經崩塌了。然而，惡勢力仍在境內橫行。*

source_en: @Britannia is under attack by gargoyles such as those thou just fought. They have been coming up through the dungeons.@*
text_zh: Britannia正遭受你剛剛戰鬥過的那種石像鬼的襲擊。它們是通過地牢爬上來的。*

source_en: @Thus far they have mainly been attacking the shrines of the Eight Virtues.@*
text_zh: 迄今為止，它們主要是在攻擊八項美德的神廟。*

source_en: @When the Shrine of Compassion didst fall, Sir Geoffrey sent a party to free it. Do thou ask him of this mission. Perhaps thou canst prove of some assistance.@
text_zh: 當 Shrine of Compassion 倒塌時，Sir Geoffrey 派了一支小隊去解放它。你可以向他詢問這次任務。也許你能提供一些幫助。 Sir Geoffrey

source_en: @Whilst thou art here, I have a room in the castle set aside for thy personal use. 'Tis in the west wing of the castle, just south of mine own chambers. I have had my servants place some equipment there, in case thou shouldst have need of it.@**
text_zh: 趁你來的空擋，我讓人在城堡裡為你的個人使用預留了一間房。它在城堡的西翼，就在我自己臥室的南邊。我已讓我的僕人放了一些裝備在那裡，以防你需要用到。**

source_en: @Of course, thou mayst feel free to borrow anything in my castle, if thou shouldst need it.@
text_zh: 當然，如果你需要的話，你可以隨意借用我城堡裡的任何東西。

source_en: @Lastly, any time thou dost need healing, do thou but ask me. If thou doth wish me to repeat all this later thou need but ask.@
text_zh: 最後，任何時候你需要治療，都可以找我。如果你希望我稍後重複這些話，只需開口即可。

source_en: ! 'Tis good to see thee again. Much hath happened since thou last departed our realm.@
text_zh: ! 很高興再次見到你。自你上次離開我們王國以來，發生了很多事情。

source_en: @I am Lord British, as thou knowest well.@
text_zh: @我是 Lord British，你應該很熟悉了。@

source_en: @Thanks to thee, I sit once more upon the throne of Britannia.@*
text_zh: @多虧了你，我得以再次坐上Britannia的王座。@*

source_en: @Though 'tis a heavy burden in such troubled times as these.@
text_zh: @在這樣的動盪時期，這是沉重的負擔。@

source_en: Lord British waves his hand, and your whole party is healed!
text_zh: 英格蘭男爵揮了揮手，你們全隊都治癒了！ Lord British

source_en: @The gargoyles art indeed the greatest threat our realm has ever known.@*
text_zh: @石像鬼確實是我們王國歷史上最大的威脅。@*

source_en: @We are fortunate indeed that fate hath brought thee here in our hour of need.@
text_zh: @命運讓你在此危急時刻來到這裡，我們深感幸運。@

source_en: @Perhaps thou canst drive these vile creatures back into the bowels of the earth from whence they came.@*
text_zh: @也許你能將這些醜惡的生物驅回它們所來地底深淵。@*

source_en: @All our efforts thus far have availed us naught.@
text_zh: @我們 finora 的努力毫無成果。@

source_en: @By now the gargoyles may have captured them all.@*
text_zh: @到這時，石像鬼可能已經將他們全部俘虜了。@*

source_en: @Thou must hurry if thou wouldst foil their evil schemes...@
text_zh: @如果你要挫敗牠們的邪惡陰謀，必須加快速度...@

source_en: @Stay strong in thy commitment to the Eight Virtues.@*
@It is our belief in them that sets us apart from the cruel invaders who would destroy all that we hold dear.@
text_zh: @正是對美德的信念，讓我們與那些想毀滅我們珍視之物的殘酷入侵者有所區別。@

source_en: @He is the Captain of the Guard.@
You show Lord British the black stone.*
text_zh: 你向英格蘭男爵出示黑石。 Lord British*

source_en: @Hmmmm... I have such a stone, as thou may recall. I did not know that there were more such orbs.@*
text_zh: @嗯... 你應該記得，我也有一塊這樣的石頭。我不知道還有其他的法球。@*

source_en: @'Twill serve thee well in thy travels if thou dost learn to master its powers.@*
text_zh: @如果你能掌握它的力量，在旅途中將非常有用。@*

source_en: @To open a gate, use the stone, and carefully position it a few feet from thee.@
text_zh: @要打開傳送門，使用石頭，並小心地將它放在離你幾英尺遠的地方。@

source_en: @Thou wilt discover that the placement is the key. In the proper positions, the stone canst conjure gates to take thee to numerous destinations.@
text_zh: @你會發現位置是關鍵。在正確的位置，石頭可以召喚通往許多目的地的傳送門。@

source_en: @Ask the leaders of each town to tell thee of that.@
text_zh: @問問每個城鎮的領袖，讓他們告訴你。@

source_en: No LB key in party, adding one
text_zh: 隊伍中沒有英格蘭男爵，加入一個

source_en: @Please take good care of my little friend.@
@Ah, thou hast heard of my little friend? Her name is Sherry, and I'm quite proud of her.@*
text_zh: @啊，你聽過我那小夥伴的事嗎？牠的名字叫 Sherry，我非常為牠感到自豪。@*

source_en: @I'm certain she is the only talking mouse in all of Britannia. Thou art welcome to see her, if thou dost wish. Thou canst find her wandering throughout the castle.@*
text_zh: @我敢說牠是 Britannia 全境唯一會說話的老鼠。你若願意的話，歡迎你去看看牠。你可以在城堡各處巡邏時找到牠。@*

source_en: @She comes by my room every night, so I can tell her stories.@
text_zh: @牠每晚都會來我的房間，這樣我就能給牠說故事了。@

source_en: @Take this key. It will unlock the gatehouse by the southern entrance to the castle. Then you can use the lever inside to raise the portcullis, and the crank will lower the drawbridge.@*
text_zh: @拿好這把鑰匙。它能打開城堡南入口旁的衛堡門。然後你可以使用裡面的扳手升起閘門，再轉動曲柄放下吊橋。@*

source_en: @I collect rare books. There's one in particular I've been hunting for many years.@*
text_zh: @我收藏稀有的書籍。有一本我特別在找，尋找它已經很多年了。@*

source_en: @It's called 'The Wizard of Oz.' Ever heard of it?@
text_zh: @它叫《The Wizard of Oz》。你聽過它嗎？@

source_en: @I hath promised a great reward to whosoever shalt bring me a copy. If thou dost run across it in thy travels, I would greatly appreciate if thou couldst bring it here.@
text_zh: @我已承諾向任何帶一本副本給我的人給予豐厚的報酬。若你在旅途中偶然遇到它，若你能帶它來這裡，我將非常感激。@

source_en: @Well, I hath promised a great reward to whosoever shalt bring me a copy.@
text_zh: @好吧，我已承諾向任何帶一本副本給我的人給予豐厚的報酬。@
@我期待這個時刻已經許久了...@*

source_en: @Not since my childhood have I read this wondrous story.@
text_zh: @自從我童年時讀過這個奇妙的故事以來，再未讀過。@

source_en: Gingerly, he takes the tome. @Here is your reward.@ He gives you some glowing gems.
text_zh: 輕輕地，他拿起了這本書。 @這是你的報酬。@ 他給你一些發光的寶石。

source_en: @Should I answer you today? If asked tomorrow, I would say...@*
text_zh: @我今天該回答你嗎？如果明天問起，我會說...@*

source_en: @That my partner and I are the Pushme Pullyu, and speaking in riddles is what we do. @*
text_zh: @我和我的夥伴是Pushme Pullyu，說謎語就是我們的本行。 @*

source_en: @But which is Pullyu, and which is Pushme? If you'd asked yesterday, I'd have told thee!@*
text_zh: @但哪個是 Pullyu，哪個是 Pushme？如果你昨天問過，我會告訴你的！@*

source_en: @If my partner said you should go west, then he would be a lying pest!@
text_zh: @如果我夥伴說你該往西走，那他就在撒謊！@

source_en: @If my partner said you should go east, then he would be a lying beast!@
text_zh: @如果我夥伴說你該往東走，那他就在說瞎話！@

source_en: @If my partner said 'Go east.' to you, then he'd have said that which is true.@
text_zh: @如果我夥伴對你說『往東走。』，那他說的就是真話。@

source_en: @If my partner said to you 'Go west.', then his advice would be the best.@
text_zh: @如果我夥伴對你說『往西走。』，那他的建議就是最好的。@

source_en: @If you asked my partner, thinking him wise, he'd tell you the Pushme always lies!@*
text_zh: @若你問我的夥伴，這智慧之人，他會告訴你 Pushme 總是說謊！@*

source_en: @If you asked my partner, then forsooth, he'd say the Pullyu always speaks truth!@*
text_zh: @若你問我的夥伴，那麼誠然，他會說 Pullyu 總是說實話！@*

source_en: @My partner lies, and that is true. It is because he's the Pullyu!@*
text_zh: @我的夥伴說謊，這是真的。那是因為他是 Pullyu！@*

source_en: @I'll always tell the truth to thee. That's because I am the Pushme!@*
text_zh: @我會永遠向你說實話。那是因為我是 Pushme！@*

source_en: @If you asked my partner which was best, he'd say 'East lie beasts, so go quest west.'@*
text_zh: @若你問我的夥伴何者最佳，他會說‘東方有謊獸，故往西尋蹤。’@*

source_en: @Take three blind mice, a dish and spoon!@*
text_zh: @帶三隻盲鼠，一個盤子和一把湯匙！@*

source_en: @Am I one, or are we two?@
@And if, perhaps, you've solved our riddle,@*
text_zh: @如果你已經解開了我們的謎題，@*

source_en: @Then go dance with the cat and the fiddle!@*
text_zh: @那麼就去和貓與小提琴跳舞吧！@*

source_en: Both heads smile innocently at you.
text_zh: 兩個頭都天真的對你微笑。

source_en: Dupre is staring at them, his jaw hanging wide open.
text_zh: Dupre 正盯著它們，下巴張得老大。

source_en: Iolo says @That's got to be the most baffling thing I've ever heard.@
text_zh: Iolo 說 @這一定是我聽過最令人困惑的事情。@

source_en: @Leaving so soon? So soon to leave?@
text_zh: @這麼快就要走了嗎？這麼快離開？@

source_en: @Are we as confused as you are?@
A bizarre, two-headed beast. Both heads take turns speaking to you*
text_zh: 一隻怪異的雙頭獸。兩個頭輪流與你對話*
@來聽聽我們在任何地方的謎題吧！@

source_en: @I am the one known as Penumbra.@
@I am the daughter of the eclipse.@
@Yes, I can foretell your future for you.@
@I require a small donation for my services.@
text_zh: @我需要一小筆捐款來提供服務。@

source_en: How much do you give her?
She holds her hands out on either side of her crystal ball, not quite touching it, and closes her eyes. After a time, she speaks.*
text_zh: 她雙手張開，置於水晶球兩側，幾乎沒有觸碰到它，並閉上了眼睛。片刻之後，她開口了。*

source_en: @The future looks dark. All is unclear. Some more gold would shed further light on your destiny...@
text_zh: @未來一片昏暗。一切都不明確。再給一些金幣，就能讓你的命運更清晰...@

source_en: @Though all is dark, I see a light at the end of the tunnel. Quickly - more coins before I lose the thread of this vision!@
text_zh: @雖然一切昏暗，但我看見隧道盡頭有一絲光明。快點——再多幾枚金幣，在我失去這個景象的線索之前！@

source_en: @Much conflict lies before you. Your end... I cannot see it. More gold is needed.@
text_zh: @前方充滿了紛爭。你的結局...我看不見。需要更多金幣。@

source_en: @You shall travel throughout the land before you are through. A few more coins and all should be clear.@
text_zh: @在你結束之前，將會穿越大地。再多幾枚金幣，一切就都清楚了。@

source_en: @You will journey into the depths of the earth... Strange creatures will you face...I can almost see the end now.@
text_zh: @你將深入大地深處...你會面對奇異的生物...我幾乎看見結局了。@

source_en: @You and your companions will face terrible choices...You will need powerful magic to prevail...Wait...There is some barrier before me. Give me just one more coin and I think I can break through it.@
text_zh: @你和你的同伴將面臨可怕的選擇...你需要強力的魔法才能獲勝...等等...我前面有一道障礙。再給我一枚金幣，我想我能突破它。@

source_en: @Yes, now all is made clear to me! I see a great Vortex. There is a violet lens that is crucial to your quest.@
text_zh: @是的，現在一切我都看清了！我見到一個巨大的旋渦。有一個紫色透鏡對你的任務至關重要。@

source_en: @It is broken, and must be made whole. But one lens is not enough! A blue lens is needed as well. You must have two lenses, else all is for naught.@*
text_zh: @它是破碎的，必須修復。但一個透鏡不夠！還需要一個藍色透鏡。你必須有兩個透鏡，否則一切都是徒勞。@*

source_en: She opens her eyes. @I can see no more for now. Leave me, that I might rest.@
text_zh: 她睜開眼睛。@我現在再也看不見了。離開吧，讓我休息。@

source_en: @Yes he was a terribly honest fellow. Alas, though, he lacked the virtue of tact. He told the truth once too often, and those he spoke of did not appreciate it. He's buried in the catacombs under Moonglow now, pushing up daffodils. Even virtue has its price.@
text_zh: @是的，他是一個極誠實的人。可惜，他缺乏謙遜的美德。他太 frequently 說出真話，而他談論的人並不喜歡這樣。他現在埋在 Moonglow 下面的墓穴裡，讓水仙花長出來。即使美德也有其代價。@

source_en: A small, inscrutable woman, cloaked in shadows.*
text_zh: 一位小個子、難以捉摸的女人，身披陰影斗篷。*

source_en: @I can tell you of both the @rune and the mantra.@
@Twas buried with Beyvin, rest his shade.@
text_zh: @它被隨Beyvin埋葬了，願他的幽靈安息。@

source_en: @For five gold coins I can use my powers to divine the mantra for you. Shall I do this?@
text_zh: @花五枚金幣，我就能運用我的力量為你卜算咒語。要我這麼做嗎？@

source_en: She closes her eyes in concentration. For long minutes you wait.*
text_zh: 她閉上眼睛專心致志。你等了許久。*

source_en: @What are we waiting for!@ whispers Dupre. @She's doubtless fallen asleep, and you've wasted good money for nothing...@
text_zh: @我們還在等什麼！@ Dupre低聲說。@她肯定已經睡著了，而你卻白白浪費了寶貴的錢財...@

source_en: Finally Penumbra opens her eyes again. @The word you seek is 'ahm.'@
text_zh: 終於，Penumbra再次睜開眼睛。@你尋找的那個詞是「ahm。」@

source_en: @It is a small price for so profound a word.@
text_zh: @對於如此深奧的一個詞來說，這是很小的代價。@

source_en: @Ah, hello Avatar. I was wondering when you would get here..@*
text_zh: @啊，你好，聖者。我一直在想你會什麼時候到..@*

source_en: @I see you have yet to fulfill your destiny.@
The old man never turns away from his telescope.*
text_zh: 老人永遠不離開他的望遠鏡。*

source_en: @Shhh! Can't you see I'm busy?! Whoever you are, come back in the morning.@
text_zh: 噓噓！你看不到我很忙嗎？不管你是誰，明天再來吧。

source_en: The old man adjusts the telescope, exclaims @Aha!@ and starts scribbling on a scroll.
text_zh: 老人調整了望遠鏡，喊道「啊哈！」，然後開始在卷軸上潦草地記錄。

source_en: You see a solemn man, constantly dusting and polishing the items in his shop.
text_zh: 你看到一位莊嚴的男士，不斷地為他店裡的物品除塵和打蠟。

source_en: @Ahem. Yes, what can I help you with,
text_zh: @嗯。是的，有什麼我可以幫你的，

source_en: @I am an astronomer. More precisely, I calculate movements of the stars, phases of the moons...@
text_zh: @我是一名天文學家。更精確地說，我計算星辰的運行、月亮的光相...@

source_en: @My field of specialization is tidal predictions. I also make various glasswares and instruments.@
text_zh: @我的專長領域是潮汐預測。我也製造各種玻璃器具和儀器。@

source_en: @Lord British has requested the publication of an almanac for use by the general populace. It will contain high tides, low tides, ebb tides, flood tides, spring tides, and neap tides.@
text_zh: @Lord British 要求出版一本年曆，供一般大眾使用。其中將包含高潮、低潮、退潮、漲潮、大潮和餘潮。@

source_en: @Britannia's tides are a function of the two moons, Felucca and Trammel, interacting with our world, Sosaria.@
text_zh: @Britannia 的潮汐是兩顆月亮 Felucca 和 Trammel 與我們的世界 Sosaria 相互作用的結果。@

source_en: @I plan to publish a paper about how the world is flat, to dispel all this foolish talk to the contrary. Afterwards, I will construct a model of how it all works: an orrery.@
text_zh: @我打算發表一篇論文明確世界是平的，以駁斥那些相反的愚蠢談論。之後，我會製作一個模型來說明其運作方式：一個天象儀。@

source_en: Pleased with your interest, Ephemerides shows you papers with plans for a clockwork model of the Sosarian system.
text_zh: Ephemerides 對你的興趣感到高興，並向你展示Sosaria 系統機械模型圖紙。

source_en: @This, ahem, flat piece is Britannia. Each moon would exert a pull on the oceans thus, resulting in the tides. You turn that little handle there to get it to go!@
text_zh: @這個，嗯，平的面就是 Britannia。每顆月亮都會對海洋施加拉力，從而產生潮汐。轉動那裡那個小手柄讓它運轉起來！@

source_en: Ephemerides looks at you. @That costs more gold than you have.@
text_zh: Ephemerides 看著你。 @這需要的金幣比你擁有的多。@

source_en: The normally staid Ephemerides is practically giggling with glee.
text_zh: 平時沉穩的「Ephemerides」現在興奮得幾乎要咯咯笑起來了。

source_en: @Low and high tide marks are close together. The planets are in quadrature.@
text_zh: @低潮和滿潮的標誌靠得很近。行星處於直角位置。@

source_en: @Angular separation of two celestial bodies -as measured from a third- being ninety degrees, of course. A very safe tide.@
text_zh: @兩個天體從第三個天體測量的角距離為九十度，當然。這是一個非常安全的潮汐。@

source_en: @The opposite of a neap tide- the sun, earth and moons are all aligned. Thus, lines of low and high tide are far apart. Once I construct my orrery, I'd be able to demonstrate the principles involved.@
text_zh: @小潮的相反——太陽、地球和月亮都排成一線。因此，低潮和滿潮的線相距甚遠。一旦我製作出我的天象儀，我就能夠演示其中涉及的原理。@

source_en: @What sort of lens do you want?@
@Ooooh, let me see it... That's a very interesting lens. You need a concave copy of it? Let me think...@*
text_zh: @哦哦，讓我看看...這是一個非常有趣的鏡頭。你需要一個凹形的複製品嗎？讓我想想...@*

source_en: @It would be very tricky to duplicate, being magical in nature, but I believe I might be able to do it.@*
text_zh: @複製它會非常困難，因為它是魔法本質的，但我相信我可能能做到。@*

source_en: @The material and the nature of the enchantment appear similar to those involved in the making of glass swords. If I could keep this to analyze while you go get me a glass sword, I'll try and make a copy for you.@*
text_zh: @材料和 enchantment 的本質看起來與製作玻璃劍涉及的類似。如果我能在你去幫我找一把玻璃劍的時候保留這個來分析，我會試著為你製作一個複製品。@*

source_en: @You don't have enough room to carry it.@
Before you can protest, he pockets the lens.
text_zh: 在你來得及抗議之前，他把鏡頭放進口袋裡。

source_en: @Let me know when you have the glass sword.@
@When you bring me a glass sword, I should be able to duplicate your lens for you.@
text_zh: @當你帶一把玻璃劍給我時，我應該能夠為你複製你的鏡頭。@

source_en: @I hope the lens I made you will prove suitable.@
text_zh: @我希望我為你製作的鏡頭能證明是合適的。@

source_en: @I once heard of a master glassblower who could make glass swords...@
text_zh: @我曾聽說過一位能製作玻璃劍的大師玻璃吹制者...@

source_en: @Ah, you've brought me a glass sword! Let me just get your lens...@*
text_zh: @啊，你帶給我一把玻璃劍！讓我先拿你的鏡頭...@*

source_en: He fumbles through his pockets. @Oh no! I seem to have lost the lens!@*
text_zh: 他在口袋裡翻找。@哦不！我好像把鏡頭弄丟了！@*

source_en: @Just kidding... Here it is. Now I'll melt down the glass sword and try to cast a lens for you.@
text_zh: @開玩笑的...在這裡。現在我要熔掉玻璃劍並試著為你鑄造一個鏡頭。@

source_en: You watch as he works, intently focused on his task. Finally he pronounces the job a success.*
text_zh: 你看著他工作，他專注於他的任務。最後他宣布工作成功。*

source_en: @Here's your lens back, and the duplicate. There's no charge - the challenge of the task was reward enough. I don't know what you need these lenses for, but I wish you luck!@
text_zh: @這是你的鏡頭，還有複製品。不收費——這項任務的挑戰本身就是足夠的報酬。我不知道你需要這些鏡頭做什麼，但祝你 luck！@

source_en: @Minoc is the logical place to look. That town is filled with master craftsmen. Why, I once heard of a man from Minoc who built a flying machine!@
text_zh: @Minoc是尋找它的邏輯之地。那個城市裡充滿了大師工匠。為什麼，我曾經聽說過Minoc有個人建造了一台飛行機器！@

source_en: @Must have been a fairy tale, of course.@
@Come to my shop when its open!@
@Anything else I can do for you?@
@Come by the Blue Bottle Tavern during business hours and I'll be glad to serve you.@
text_zh: @營業時間內請到藍瓶子小酒館來，我很樂意為你服務。@

source_en: @I sell mead, wine, bread, baked brie, and the house brew, Frasier's Folly.@
text_zh: @我賣蜂蜜酒、葡萄酒、麵包、烤布裡歐，以及本店特製的 Frasier's Folly。@

source_en: @You haven't any room in your pack.@
@They call me Mariah, as thou knowest.@
@I'm the newest member of the Council of Wizards. Somebody has to keep things running smoothly.*@
text_zh: @我是魔法師公會最新加入的成員。總得有人讓事情順暢運轉才行。*@

source_en: @In my spare time I use the library to pursue my own studies.@
text_zh: @在我閒暇時，我會利用圖書館進行我自己的研究。@

source_en: @They get so caught up in their work sometimes that they forget even to eat and sleep!@
text_zh: @他們有時太投入工作，甚至忘記吃飯和睡覺！@
