source_en: @'Tis the finest library in all Britannia. I study many different things, but I find learning old languages the most interesting.@*
text_zh: @這是整個Britannia最好的圖書館。我研究許多不同的東西，但我發現學習古語言最有趣。*@

source_en: @One can learn so much about how our own language developed!@
text_zh: @人可以從中了解到我們自己的語言是如何演變的！@

source_en: @Such things matter little to them. They often dwell apart from the realm of the senses.@
text_zh: @這些對他們來說無關緊要。他們經常超脫於感官世界之外。@

source_en: @Nystul sent word to me that thou hast a book written in a strange tongue.@
text_zh: @Nystul傳話給我，說你有一本用奇怪語言寫成的書。@

source_en: @I'd be glad to look at it for thee.@ She examines the book.*
text_zh: @我很樂意為你看一看。@ 她檢查了那本書。*

source_en: @Oh! I've seen this script before! I have part of an ancient silver tablet in my study with writing both in our language and this. I have learned only a little from studying it, but I can make out a few words.@
text_zh: @哦！我以前見過這種文字！我研究室內有一塊古老的銀板，上面有我們語言和這種語言的文字。我從中只學到一點，但我能辨認出幾個詞。@

source_en: @The title is 'The Book of Prophecies,' and it says something about 'the end of our world.'@*
text_zh: @書名是《預言書》，裡面提到了「我們世界的終結」。*@

source_en: @If only I had the other half of the tablet, perhaps I'd be able to decipher the rest of the book.@
text_zh: @要是我有那塊銀板的另一半，也許我就能解讀整本書了。@

source_en: @I'd not mind looking at it for thee...But I'd find the task much easier if thou wouldst bring it here!@
text_zh: 我不介意替你細看...但如果你能把它帶過來，我的任務就會容易得多！

source_en: @I got my piece of the tablet from some gypsies whom I met at a pub. Mayhap they can tell thee where to look for the other piece.@
text_zh: 我從在酒館遇到的吉普賽人那裡得到了這塊石板碎片。也許他們能告訴你該去哪找另一塊。

source_en: @Bring both pieces of the tablet here and I will tell thee what I can.@
text_zh: 把石板碎片都帶過來，我會盡力告訴你我所知的一切。

source_en: @Ah, thou hast found the rest of the tablet! With the two of them together I should be able to tell you more.@
text_zh: 啊，你找到了石板的其餘部分！把兩塊合在一起，我應該能告訴你們更多。

source_en: A freckled young lady with an enchanting smile.*
text_zh: 一位滿臉雀斑、笑容迷人的年輕女子。*

source_en: @Ah, thou hast found the rest of the tablet! Go get the other half from my study and bring it here. With the two of them together I should be able to tell you more.@
text_zh: 啊，你找到了石板的其餘部分！去我書房裡拿出另一半，帶到這裡來。把兩塊合在一起，我應該能告訴你們更多。

source_en: @I must have both halves of the tablet before I can tell you any more. This piece I have had for quite some time, and I've learned all I can from it.@
text_zh: 我必須同時持有石板的兩半，才能告訴你們更多。這塊碎片我已經有了很久，我能從中學到的都已經學完了。

source_en: @I must have both halves of the tablet before I can tell you any more.@
text_zh: 我必須同時持有石板的兩半，才能告訴你們更多。

source_en: @With both pieces of the tablet, I should be able to work out a translation.@ She studies the tablet for a while, and then starts reading, haltingly, from the book.*
text_zh: 有了石板的兩塊碎片，我應該能破譯出翻譯內容。她研究了石板一陣子，然後開始斷斷續續地從書中朗讀。*

source_en: @An ancient prophecy tells of the final days, when the end of our world shall come.@*
text_zh: 古老的預言告訴我們末日將至，當我們的世界走向終結之時。*
終結之前會有三個預兆。*

source_en: @Thrice shall a being of great evil come unto our land, and by this it shall be known that the end is nigh.@*
text_zh: 極大的邪惡存在將三次降臨我們的土地，藉此便可知終結已近。*

source_en: , it has been a long time since thou wert in our realm! How can I help thee in thy noble quest?@*
text_zh: 距離你上次來到我們領地已過了很久！在你崇高的征途中，我能如何助你？*

source_en: @This evil one is of another race, who consider the evil one a great prophet.@*
text_zh: 這個邪惡存在屬於另一個種族，他們視其為偉大的先知。*

source_en: @Yet this false prophet follows not the principles of Control, Passion and Diligence.@*
text_zh: 然而這位偽先知並不遵循控制、熱情和勤勉的原則。*

source_en: @One day the false prophet will come and desecrate our most holy shrine.@*
text_zh: 有一日，偽先知將到來，褻瀆我們最神聖的神廟。*

source_en: @And the false prophet will steal our most holy artifact, the Codex of Ultimate Wisdom.@*
text_zh: 偽先知將偷走我們最神聖的聖物，《終極智慧法典》。*

source_en: @This shall be the first sign of the end.@*
text_zh: 這將是終結的第一個預兆。*

source_en: @Then, it is written, the false prophet shall descend deep into the bowels of the earth.@*
text_zh: 然後，據記載，偽先知將深入大地深處。*

source_en: @And the false prophet will cause the underworld to collapse.@*
text_zh: 偽先知將導致地底世界崩塌。*

source_en: @This will cause great earthquakes to tear our world asunder, and there will be a time of plague and famine.@*
text_zh: 這將引發大地震，撕裂我們的世界，隨後將是瘟疫與饑荒。*

source_en: @This shall be the second sign of the end.@*
text_zh: 這將是終結的第二個預兆。*

source_en: @One last time shall the false prophet come.@*
text_zh: 偽先知將最後一次到來。*

source_en: @This time, the false prophet will come with a band of warriors.@*
text_zh: 這次，偽先知將帶領一羣戰士前來。*

source_en: @And they will destroy all that remains of the gargoyle race.@*
text_zh: 他們將摧毀剩下的所有石像鬼種族。*

source_en: @There is only one way that this prophecy may be averted: That is by the sacrifice of the false prophet...@*
text_zh: 避免這個預言實現只有一種方法：那就是犧牲這位偽先知...*

source_en: Mariah pauses for a while, deep in thought. @When they refer to 'the false prophet,' they must mean you.@ she says.
text_zh: Mariah 停頓了一下，陷入深思。「當他們提到‘偽先知’時，指的肯定是妳。」她說道。

source_en: @It would seem that they have reason to think you evil, from their perspective. This is a difficult matter to resolve. I think you'd better seek out more information.@*
text_zh: @看來他們有理由認為你是邪惡的，至少從他們的觀點來看是如此。這是一件難以解決的事情。我想你最好去蒐集更多的情報。@*

source_en: @There's a gargoyle named Sin'Vraal living out in the desert. He speaks our language. Perhaps he could tell you more about this book, and of how the gargoyles view us.@
text_zh: @沙漠裡住著一個名叫 Sin'Vraal 的石像鬼。他說得通我們的語言。也許他能告訴你更多關於這本書的事情，以及石像鬼如何看待我們。@

source_en: @Some people think Penumbra's a hoax. But she knows her stuff. You should bear with her - she can truly be of great assistance to you.@
text_zh: @有些人認為 Penumbra 是騙局。但她很懂行。你應該容忍她——她真能對你幫助很大。@

source_en: ! Come have a drink with me!@
@The Avatar?...Oh, yes, of course. Come, have a seat.@
...Oh, yes, of course. Come, have a seat.@
@Trying to discover all the subtleties of Frasier's Folly is almost a career in itself!@
text_zh: @想要發掘 Frasier's Folly 的所有奧妙，幾乎本身就是一門職業了！@

source_en: @Aye, this is the home of Frasier's Folly!@
text_zh: @是的，這裡就是 Frasier's Folly 的家！@

source_en: @In all the towns of Britannia, you'll find no better brew.@
text_zh: @在 Britannia 的所有城鎮中，你找不到比這更好的酒了。@

source_en: @My drinking buddy! Let's drink a toast to him, wherever he is.@
text_zh: @我的酒友！讓我們為他乾杯，無論他在哪裡。@

source_en: @She's a strange one, but she has the gift.@

text_zh: @而且你連醉醺醺的樣子都還沒出來...@

source_en: A man who looks very amused--whether with his surroundings or himself is hard to say.
text_zh: 一個看起來非常開心的人——很難說他是對周圍環境感到高興，還是對自己感到滿意。

source_en: ! Come have a drink with me!@*
@Have you had your fortune told yet?@
@I am Dargoth, master of medical lore.@
@My true calling is research. My studies here have advanced the healing art throughout the world! But, more often than not, I am called upon to cure poison ivy and heal paper cuts!@*
text_zh: @我的天職是研究。我在此的研究促進了全世界醫術的發展！但往往，我只是被叫來治療蕁麻癢和紙割傷！@*

source_en: @Why do you waste my time? None of you are wounded!@
text_zh: @你們為什麼浪費我的時間？你們沒有人受傷！@

source_en: @You may not be my choice for dinner conversation, but none of you are dead.@
text_zh: 或許我不適合做晚餐時的對話夥伴，但你們沒人死掉。

source_en: @Oh.@ Seeing the dead body, he becomes more polite.*
@I am sorry you've lost a compatriot.@
text_zh: 很抱歉你失去了一位同胞。

source_en: @Why do you waste my time? None of you are poisoned!@
text_zh: 你們為什麼浪費我的時間？你們沒人中毒！

source_en: @Stay out of trouble! I don't want to see my fine workmanship wasted!@
text_zh: 別惹麻煩！我不希望看到我的傑出作品被浪費！
那麼，回去繼續我的研究..

source_en: You see a stern, severe man in white robes.*
text_zh: 你看到一個身穿白袍、神情嚴肅的男人。*

source_en: You interrupt the man from his research.*
, Avatar. Is there ought else I can aid thee with?@
text_zh: 聖者。還有其他我能協助你的事嗎？
我是月輝城（Moonglow）的 Aganar 爵士。

source_en: @I keep things running smoothly here. 'Tis not difficult in a town of such honesty.@
text_zh: 我讓這裡的一切都井然有序。在這樣一個誠實的小鎮裡，這並不難。

source_en: @Verily, 'tis a fine town. Hast thou ever thought of moving here?@
text_zh: 確實，這是一個美好的小鎮。你有考慮過搬來這裡嗎？

source_en: @Thou wouldst not regret it. There's good fishing off our shores, and plenty of merriment to be found over at the Blue Bottle.@
text_zh: 你不會後悔的。我們岸邊漁獲豐富，在藍瓶子那裡也能找到許多樂趣。

source_en: @It just so happens, there is a house for sale, on the north side of town. The previous owner...well, he had an unfortunate incident.@
text_zh: 剛好有一間位於鎮北的房子正在出售。前主人...嗯，他遭遇了一場不幸的事故。

source_en: @We can have the house ready for thee, if thou wishest. 300 gold pieces and it's yours. What say you?@
text_zh: 如果你願意，我們可以為你把房子準備好。只要300金幣，它就是你的了。你覺得如何？

source_en: Aganar gives you the key. @I'll send someone to clean it up for thee. Enjoy thy new house in our fine city!@
text_zh: Aganar 交給你鑰匙。我會派人為你打掃乾淨。祝你在我們美麗的城市裡享受你的新家！

source_en: @Come back when thou hast the room in thy pack.@
text_zh: 等你背包裡有空間了再來吧。

source_en: @Thou art short in thy funds. Come back when thou hast enough to purchase it.@
text_zh: 你的資金不足。等你足夠購買時再來吧。

source_en: @Oh well, let me know if thou dost change your mind.@
text_zh: 唉，如果你改變主意，告訴我就好。

source_en: @Thou wilt see much drinking at the Blue Bottle Tavern, and singing, and revelry, and telling of tales. But mostly drinking.@
text_zh: 你在藍瓶子 tavern 會看到很多人喝酒、唱歌、歡慶、說故事。不過主要是喝酒。

source_en: @If thou art curious, why not go pay a visit? Thou cannot miss it - 'tis the biggest building in town.@
text_zh: 如果你好奇，為何不去拜訪一下？你不會迷路的——它是鎮上最大的建築。

source_en: A gentleman with an air of leadership about him.
text_zh: 一位具有領袖氣質的紳士。

source_en: @Honesty is the virtue we prize most highly here in Moonglow. We are closest to the Shrine of Honesty, and indeed, the Rune of Honesty was entrusted into my care some years ago.@
text_zh: @誠實是我們在Moonglow最為珍視的美德。我們距離Shrine of Honesty最近，事實上，誠實符文幾年前便託付於我保管。@

source_en: @Tis north of here, on Dagger Isle.@
@Aye, just a ways to the north.@
@I had it once, but I entrusted it to Beyvin's care, as he is the most honest man I know. He lives with Penumbra.@
text_zh: @我曾擁有過它，但我已託付給Beyvin保管，因為他是我所知最誠實的人。他與Penumbra住在一起。@

source_en: @Penumbra might be able to help you with that.@
text_zh: @Penumbra或許能在那方面助你一臂之力。@

source_en: @Haven't seen him around lately. Penumbra should be able to tell you where to find him.@
text_zh: @最近沒見他出沒。Penumbra應該能告訴你上哪找他。@

source_en: @I can't imagine what Beyvin sees in her!@
@Thou art the Avatar! I saw thy portrait in Lord British's castle. If there be any assistance I can offer, thou needst but ask it.@
text_zh: @您便是聖者！我在 Lord British 的城堡裡見過您的畫像。若您有任何需要協助之處，儘管開尊口。@

source_en: @Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, Manrel hands over the
text_zh: @非常好！@ 收下您的黃金後，Manrel交出了

source_en: A pipe-smoking gentleman with the symbol of the Codex tattooed on his forehead.*
text_zh: 一位抽著煙斗、額頭紋有法典圖騰的男士。*

source_en: @I'm a woodworker. I also dabble in alchemy from time to time.@
text_zh: 我是木匠。我偶爾也涉足煉金術。

source_en: @I make furniture, cabinets, walking sticks, and the like. Perhaps I can make something for you someday.@
text_zh: 我製作家具、櫃子、手杖之類的東西。也許哪天我可以為你做些什麼。

source_en: @I'm trying to learn how to make healing potions, but I don't have the formula right yet. I did stumble across a wicked recipe for red mead, though.@
text_zh: 我正在學習如何製作治癒藥水，但我還沒搞對配方。不過，我倒是不小心發現了一個很棒的紅蜜酒食譜。

source_en: @Alas, there's little call for my brew in this town, with the Blue Bottle serving Frasier's Folly.@
text_zh: 唉，鎮上沒人想喝我釀的酒，因為藍瓶館賣的是 Frasier's Folly。

source_en: @Come back tomorrow and then we can talk business,
text_zh: 明天再來吧，到時我們再談生意，

source_en: @One of the finest libations you'll find anywhere.@
text_zh: 這是你能找到的最精美的酒飲之一。

source_en: @I went drinking with some friends the night we heard of the discovery of the Codex. When I woke up the next morning, I had this tattoo.@
text_zh: 我們得知《Codex》被發現的那晚，我和幾個朋友去喝酒了。第二天早上醒來，我就有了這個紋身。

source_en: @Oh, are you wanting to visit my cousin's grave?@
text_zh: 哦，你是想去看望我表親的墓嗎？

source_en: He looks at you suspiciously. @You wouldn't be wanting the key to his crypt, would you?@
text_zh: 他懷疑地看著你。你不會是想拿他墓穴的鑰匙吧？

source_en: @Well, perhaps you have your reasons... Okay, you can have the key. But you have to take these flowers and leave them there.@
text_zh: 嗯，也許你有你的原因...好吧，鑰匙給你。但你必須帶些花去並放在那裡。

source_en: @You're carrying too much right now. Come back for it later.@
text_zh: 你現在背的東西太多了。改天再來拿吧。

source_en: @I hope you got a chance to deliver the flowers.@
@Daffodils were always his favorites... It's too bad I couldn't find any.@
text_zh: 「水仙花一直是他最喜歡的...真可惜我找不到。」

source_en: @Take care, my dear. I hope I'll see you again soon.@
text_zh: 「保重，親愛的。希望很快能再見到妳。」

source_en: @It was a pleasure speaking with you.@
@But thou dost not have enough gold,
@Anything else can I do for thee?@
text_zh: 還有其他我能為你做的嗎？

source_en: @I am Thariand, of the blue star.@
@I'm the librarian. I prefer to spend my time studying magic, but I also teach it on the side, for a fee of course. I can also help you find some books if you keep it quick.@
text_zh: 「我是圖書館員。我喜歡花時間研究魔法，但也順便教書，當然要收點學費。如果你動作快點，我也能幫你找找書。」

source_en: @All the students of Nicodemus bear this sign.@
text_zh: @Nicodemus 的所有學生都佩戴這個標誌。@

source_en: @I charge 55 gold for each training session, since my time is valuable and I am a very busy man. Which of you wishes to learn?@
text_zh: @我每次授課收取 55 金幣，因為我的時間很珍貴，而我也非常忙碌。你們誰想學習？@

source_en: @I sense you aren't ready to learn yet. Come back when you have more experience with spellcasting.@
text_zh: @我感覺你還未準備好學習。等你有更多施法經驗後再來吧。@

source_en: @I sense that you haven't any magical abilities! I cannot help you.@
text_zh: @我感覺你沒有任何魔法能力！我無法幫助你。@

source_en: I sense that your abilities have surpassed even mine!@
text_zh: 我感覺你的能力甚至超越了我！@

source_en: You pay 55 gold and the training session begins.
text_zh: 你支付了 55 金幣，授課開始。

source_en: You and Thariand dive into the pages of several tomes. Following an extensive study session, you find the ability to comprehend and dissiminate much more information than ever before. In addition, you have a better grasp at the theory behind spellcasting.
text_zh: 你和 Thariand 沉浸在幾卷書的頁碼中。經過一番廣泛的研讀，你獲得了理解和傳播比過去多得多的資訊的能力。此外，你對施法背後的理論有了更深刻的掌握。

source_en: and Thariand dive into the pages of several tomes. Following an extensive study session,
text_zh: 和 Thariand 沉浸在幾卷書的頁碼中。經過一番廣泛的研讀，

source_en: finds the ability to comprehend and dissiminate much more information than ever before. In addition,
text_zh: 獲得了理解和傳播比過去多得多的資訊的能力。此外，

source_en: A busy looking man wearing a blue robe.
text_zh: 一個看起來很忙碌的男人，身穿藍袍。

source_en: has a better grasp at the theory behind spellcasting.
text_zh: 對施法背後的理論有了更深刻的掌握。
為 NPC 增加魔法點

source_en: coins. I am much too busy to teach it for free.@
text_zh: 硬幣。我太忙了，無法免費教授。@

source_en: @Somebody there should be able to give you directions.@
text_zh: @那裡的某人應該能為你指路。@

source_en: @Were I to master all the arcane lore contained within these volumes, I'd be the greatest sorcerer of all time!@*
text_zh: @如果我能精通這些書卷中包含的所有奧祕，我將成為歷史上最偉大的巫師！@*

source_en: @Of course, finding all the right books is no small task...@
text_zh: @當然，找到所有合適的書可不容易...@

source_en: @Were you interested in: A. Fiction B. Non-fiction C. Reference?@
text_zh: @你有興趣的是：A. 虛構 B. 非虛構 C. 參考書？@

source_en: @In that category I can recommend- The Caverns of Freitag...@*
text_zh: @在該類別中，我可以推薦——《Freitag 的洞窟》...@*

source_en: @In that category I can recommend- Mating Rituals of the Northern Plains Centaur...@*
text_zh: @在該類別中，我可以推薦——《北平原半馬駒的交配習性》...@*

source_en: @So many books to keep organized, it's a wonder I have any time for my own studies...@
text_zh: @有這麼多書要整理，真奇蹟我還有時間進行自己的研究...@
《為趣味與獲利而召喚小惡魔。》

source_en: @In that category I can recommend- Dilzal's Almanac of Good Advice...@*
text_zh: 在這個類別中，我可以推薦- 迪茲爾的良言 Almanac...*

source_en: @Fine. You should have no trouble finding what you want once you have the call number.@*
text_zh: 好吧。只要你有了分類號碼，你就該沒問題找到你想要的書。*

source_en: @You do understand how our books are organized, don't you?@
text_zh: 你懂我們的書是怎麼分類排列的，對吧？

source_en: @Good. I have more important things to do than explain it to you.@
text_zh: 很好。我有更重要的事要做，沒空跟你解釋。

source_en: @Well then, I'd suggest you look it up in The Beginner's Guide to the Dewey Decimal System. Its call number is T17 0035 r16RL.5 v43.@
text_zh: 那麼，我建議你查閱《杜威十進分類法初學者指南》。它的分類編號是 T17 0035 r16RL.5 v43。

source_en: Beginner's Guide to Dewey Decimal System
text_zh: 杜威十進分類法初學者指南

source_en: @Oh, I'm sorry, I just remembered. That book was checked out last week. Try coming back for it later.@
text_zh: 哦，抱歉，我剛想起。那本書上週被人借走了。請稍後再來試試看。

source_en: @We have a book that tells the history of the shrines. If only I could remember the title...@
text_zh: 我們有一本講述神龕歷史的書。如果我記得書名就好了...

source_en: @Remember, any books you take out of here are due back before the next bipolar lunar conjunction!@
text_zh: 記住，你從這裡借出的書，必須在下一次雙相月合之前歸還！

source_en: @Their secret is far more powerful than anything I might teach thee.@
text_zh: 他們的祕密比我能教你的任何東西都要強大得多。

source_en: @Truly, it would be terrible if the wrong person were to learn it. Only we of the Council of Wizards know the secret. But, since thou art the Avatar, surely it is safe for thee to learn it as well.@
text_zh: 說實話，如果錯誤的人獲得了這個祕密，那將是非常可怕的。只有我們法師議會的人知道這個祕密。但是，既然你是聖者，讓你學會它肯定是安全的。
你的榜樣鼓舞了我們所有人。

source_en: @Tis our task to keep the forces of magic in balance throughout the land. We also do what we can to promote the Eight Virtues.@
text_zh: 我們的工作是在全境維持魔法力量的平衡。我們也會盡力推廣八種美德。

source_en: @We created the shrines, many years ago.@
text_zh: 我們多年前建造了這些神龕。

source_en: @He is the librarian at the Lycaeum.@
text_zh: 他是 Lycaeum 的圖書館員。

source_en: @Surely you know where the Lycaeum is.@
text_zh: 妳肯定知道 Lycaeum 在哪裡。

source_en: , Avatar. For what purpose hast thou come?@
@I serve on the Council of Wizards. I also teach spells and sell magical reagents.@
text_zh: 我在法師評議會服務。我也教授魔法並出售魔藥材料。

source_en: @Gideon is a Psychopath! He secretly hates his wife Marta!@
text_zh: Gideon 是個心理變態！他祕密地憎恨他的妻子 Marta！
Drudgeworth 關於 Chuckles 的說法是對的！

source_en: @The Great Heist shall go down in history!@

text_zh: 現在不行.. 我在抓蟲！

source_en: @Get out! Flee before the awesome wrath of the mad mage Sutek!*
text_zh: @快滾！在瘋狂法師 Sutek 的雷霆怒火中逃走吧！*

source_en: @So, Avatar, you disturb the musings of the mad mage Sutek!@*
text_zh: @啊，聖者，你打擾了瘋狂法師 Sutek 的沉思！@*

source_en: @What brings you back to disturb the musings of the mad mage Sutek again?
text_zh: @是什麼讓你回來，再次打擾瘋狂法師 Sutek 的沉思？

source_en: @The name Sutek strikes fear in the hearts of mere mortals!@*
text_zh: @Sutek 這名字讓凡夫俗子聞風喪膽！@*

source_en: @I shall turn thee into a newt!@
@Everyone knows the name of Sutek the Mad!@
text_zh: @人人都知道瘋狂的 Sutek 的大名！@

source_en: @Sutek the Mad is the greatest mage the land has ever known!@
text_zh: @瘋狂的 Sutek 是這世上已知最強的法師！@

source_en: @Even the Avatar acknowledges the power and wisdom of Sutek! Don't you,
text_zh: @連聖者都承認 Sutek 的力量與智慧。你不覺得嗎？

source_en: @But Sutek is mad, and so he will grant you one last nugget of wisdom before thy death!@*
text_zh: @但 Sutek 是瘋子，所以他在你死前還會給你最後一點智慧！@*

source_en: @They say there is a fine line between genius and madness. Well, Sutek hops up and down on that line, cursing the fools that surround him!@
text_zh: @人們說天才與瘋子之間只有一線之隔。好吧，Sutek 就在這條線上跳上跳下，咒罵著周圍的蠢貨！@
@氫氣球飛行員？是的，Sutek 記得他。@*

source_en: @He died in Sutek's catacombs, like most of the others who have ever worked for Sutek!@
text_zh: @他死在 Sutek 的墓穴裡，就像其他大多為 Sutek 工作的人一樣！@

source_en: @Thy question is answered. Now flee before the awesome wrath of the mad mage Sutek!@
text_zh: @你的問題得到了回答。現在快逃吧，躲開瘋狂法師 Sutek 的雷霆怒火！@

source_en: @Dost thou seek employment with Sutek the Mad?@*
text_zh: @你想為瘋狂的 Sutek 工作嗎？@*

source_en: @Well, too bad! Sutek isn't hiring today!@
@No?! What sort of fool passes up the opportunity to work for the greatest genius of this age?@*
text_zh: @什麼？！什麼樣的蠢蛋會放棄為本時代最偉大的天才工作的機會？@*

source_en: @Sutek hired many brilliant engineers to build the catacombs that lie beneath his castle.@*
text_zh: @Sutek僱用了許多傑出的工程師，建造位於他城堡下方的地下墓穴。@*

source_en: @The catacombs are filled with the bones of those engineers!@*
text_zh: @地下墓穴中堆滿了那些工程師的骸骨！@*

source_en: @The Pushme-Pullyu knows where all such bones can be found!@
text_zh: @Pushme-Pullyu 知道所有這些骸骨在哪裡可以找到！@

source_en: @Sutek created the Pushme-Pullyu as a test for fools! If you can pass the test, you will learn what you wish to know!@
text_zh: @Sutek創造 Pushme-Pullyu 是為了測試蠢蛋！如果你能通過測試，你將學到你想知道的一切！@

source_en: @Sutek grants thou a piece of wisdom to take to thy grave, and thou refusest it?@*
text_zh: @Sutek賜予汝一則智慧帶入墳墓，汝竟拒絕？@*

source_en: @How darest thou leave the presence of Sutek the Mad before he has dissmissed you?!@*
text_zh: @你敢在Sutek（瘋狂者）尚未宣示終止之前離開他的面前？！@*

source_en: @If thou art so rude, then I banish thee from my presence!@*
text_zh: 若你如此粗魯，我便將你逐出我的面前！*

source_en: A white-haired mage in flowing robes with a mad gleam in his eye.*
text_zh: 一位身穿長袍、頭髮花白，眼中閃著瘋狂光芒的法師。*

source_en: @To be willing to die to save my people?@
@Begone, False Prophet! To seize you for sacrifice the instant my army returns from the Underworld!@
text_zh: @走開吧，偽先知！等我的軍隊從Underworld回來，立刻就把你抓去獻祭！@

source_en: @To be honored by your presence, noble
. To feel sorrow that matters of state prevent conversation.@*
text_zh: 。很遺憾公務繁忙，無暇與您交談。@*

source_en: @To summon you when proper time for your sacrifice has come.@
text_zh: @等你獻祭的時候到了，再叫你來。@

source_en: To summon you when it's time.
@To refrain from slaying you only because of the presence of the child, False Prophet!@*
text_zh: @只因為那孩子在場，我才沒殺了你，偽先知！@*

source_en: @To express astonishment at your audacity, False Prophet!@
text_zh: @對你的膽大妄為感到震驚，偽先知！@

source_en: @To demand to know why you have returned here, False Prophet!@
text_zh: @質問你為何又回到這裡，偽先知！@

source_en: @To be named Draxinusom, leader of our race.@*
text_zh: @被命名為 Draxinusom，我們種族的領袖。@*

source_en: @To demand to know why you have come before me!@*
@To be the leader of our race. To have little time to waste chatting with the False Prophet!@
text_zh: @成為我們種族的領袖。沒時間跟偽先知閒聊！@

source_en: The gargoyle shows you a crystal amulet dangling from a leather cord.*
text_zh: 石像鬼向你展示一枚懸掛在皮繩上的水晶護符。*

source_en: Trusted Dupre whispers frantically to you, @You musn't! It's some sort of magical trap!@
text_zh: 受信任的 Dupre 急切地在你耳邊低語："@你千萬不能！這是某種魔法陷阱！@"

source_en: The gargoyle waits impatiently for an answer.*
text_zh: 石像鬼不耐煩地等待著你的回答。*

source_en: The gargoyle hands you the amulet, and you slip the leather loop over your head.
text_zh: 石像鬼把護符遞給你，你將皮繩套過頭部。

source_en: @To surprise me with the nobility of your deed. To no longer be a threat to my people.@
text_zh: @對你的高貴舉動感到驚訝。不再威脅我的人民。@

source_en: @To bid you to travel among my people, talk to them, learn our ways.@
text_zh: @指示你在我的人民中穿行，與他們交談，學習我們的習俗。@

source_en: @To inform you when the time of your sacrifice has come.@
text_zh: @在你獻祭時刻到來時通知你。@

source_en: Amulet of submission should be added to Avatar
text_zh: 順從護符應被添加給聖者

source_en: Something went wrong, did not create Amulet of Submission!
text_zh: 出了點問題，未創建順從護符！

source_en: Avatar is wearing an amulet, moving it
text_zh: 聖者正佩戴著護符，正在移動它

source_en: Avatar is NOT wearing an amulet
@To be To be necessary for surrender! To ask again for your acceptance of this.@ Your answer:
text_zh: @投降所必需！再次請求你接受此事。@ 你的回答：

source_en: To die soon for thy crimes, False Prophet!
text_zh: 虛假先知！你將因你的罪孽很快死去！

source_en: @To have known it all along! To be a fool for trusting the False Prophet for a moment!@
text_zh: @早知道就好了！竟有一瞬間信任了虛假先知，真是愚不可及！@

source_en: @Flee, False Prophet! To seize you for sacrifice the instant my army returns from the Underworld!@
text_zh: @逃吧，虛假先知！等我軍隊從Underworld回來，我會立刻抓你做獻祭！@

source_en: A large, winged gargoyle of regal bearing.*
text_zh: 一隻體型龐大、氣勢尊貴的有翼石像鬼。*

source_en: The gargoyle screams, @An-bal-sil-fer! Klep lem! Por-aylem ter-ort ka!@
text_zh: 石像鬼尖叫著，@An-bal-sil-fer! Klep lem! Por-aylem ter-ort ka!@

source_en: @Among my people, those who can fly rule. Though I have wings, I cannot fly. So I was a slave.@*
text_zh: @在我的族中，能飛的居於統治地位。雖然我有翅膀，卻無法飛行。所以我曾是奴隸。@*

source_en: @There are two kinds of gargoyles: winged ones and wingless ones.@*
text_zh: @石像鬼有兩種：有翼的和無翼的。@*

source_en: @Wingless ones are mute and unintelligent. They do all the manual labor.@*
text_zh: @無翼的石像鬼沉默且智力低下。它們從事所有體力勞動。@*

source_en: @Winged ones are smart, and do all the  planning and leading. Being able to fly is, to them, a sign of intelligence.@*
text_zh: @有翼的石像鬼聰明，負責所有的規劃與領導。對它們而言，能飛行是智力的象徵。@*

source_en: @Even the Temple can only be reached by air.@*
text_zh: @即使是神殿，也只能透過空中抵達。@*

source_en: @I am not a daemon, though humans think so. I am a gargoyle.@*
text_zh: @我並非惡魔，儘管人類如此認為。我是石像鬼。@*

source_en: @I fled here to the Underworld because I was not free among the gargoyles.@*
text_zh: @我逃到Underworld，是因為我在石像鬼中並不受自由。@*

source_en: @Yet as some in Minoc can tell you, flying can be achieved by anyone.@*
text_zh: @不過，Minoc的一些人可以告訴你，任何人都有可能學會飛行。@*

source_en: @The great Temple of Singularity held the Codex. The Temple is the most holy gargoyle place. A human could learn much by traveling there.@*
text_zh: @偉大的單一性神殿中藏有法典。神殿是石像鬼族最神聖的地方。人類若前往那裡旅行，可以學到很多。@*

source_en: @But you could never get to the temple. Not only is it deep below the surface, but it can only be reached by flying.@
text_zh: @但你永遠無法到達神殿。不僅因為它深藏地表之下，更因為只有飛行才能抵達。@

source_en: @Yes, I once met a pirate here in the desert. He seemed to be hunting me, but he got dragged off by the ants!@*
text_zh: @是的，我曾經在這裡的沙漠中遇過一個海盜。他好像是在追殺我，但後來被螞蟻拖走了！@*

source_en: @The great desert ants build huge mounds, and are very dangerous!@*
text_zh: @沙漠巨蟻會建造巨大的土丘，非常危險！@*

source_en: @The Book of Prophecies says that the False Prophet will come to destroy the gargoyle race.@*
text_zh: @《預言之書》說，偽預言者將會來毀滅石像鬼族。@*

source_en: @Only the sacrifice of the False Prophet will save us.@*
text_zh: @唯有獻祭偽預言者，才能拯救我們。@*

source_en: @Sacrifice means many things in my language.@*
text_zh: @在我的語言中，獻祭有很多含義。@*

source_en: @You should seek out a gargoyle scholar to learn more. Travel the other side of the world, and you should be able to find one.@*
text_zh: @你應該去找一位石像鬼學者了解更多。環遊世界，你應該能找到一位。@*

source_en: @You can go down through Hythloth to get to the realm of gargoyles.@*
text_zh: @你可以穿過 Hythloth 到達石像鬼的領域。@*

source_en: @May your persistence and precision lead to success!@
text_zh: @願你的堅韌與精準帶來成功！@

source_en: . I am free to wander where I wish.@
text_zh: . 我可以自由地漫遊想去的地方。@

source_en: @Good, to see that you have the Vortex Lens.@
@To have read the Book of Ritual as well?@
text_zh: 居然連儀式之書都讀過了？

source_en: @Good. To be unable to reverse the ritual myself.@
text_zh: 很好。我自己無能為力，無法逆轉儀式。

source_en: @But to know that the Codex itself will say how to return it to the Vortex.@
text_zh: 但我知道，法典本身會說明如何讓它重返渦流。

source_en: @To know also that you will need a second lens. To require a human-crafted lens, so that your people may also see the Codex.@
text_zh: 你也知道，你需要第二個鏡片。需要一個由人類製造的鏡片，這樣你的族人也能看到法典。

source_en: @Then go to the Hall of Knowledge and do so!@
@To require the Vortex Lens, foolish human!@
@To waste no more time! To go to the Hall of Knowledge and get the lens!@
text_zh: @不要再浪費時間了！去Hall of Knowledge把鏡片拿回來！@

source_en: @To bring it to me personally, Avatar!@

text_zh: 一個皮膚粗糙、面目黝黑的石像鬼。*

source_en: The venerable gargoyle does not acknowledge your presence.*
text_zh: 這位尊貴的石像鬼不承認你的存在。*

source_en: @To have nothing to say to you, False Prophet!@
@To see the Amulet of Submission around your neck. To consider this your acceptance of this both noble and wise.@
text_zh: @看見你的頸上掛著順服項鍊。認為這是你對此既高貴又明智之事的接受。@

source_en: @To observe by your aura that such honorable deeds are rare for you. To not be surprised, then, that you are fated to destroy a world.@
text_zh: @從你的氣場觀察到，這樣尊貴的舉動對你來說極為罕見。因此，對於你註定毀滅一個世界一事，並不感到驚訝。@

source_en: @To observe by your aura that you are not a being of evil. To regret for your sake, then, that you are fated to destroy a world.@
text_zh: @從你的氣場觀察到，你並非邪惡的存在。因此，為了你好，對於你註定毀滅一個世界一事，感到遺憾。@

source_en: @To observe by your aura that you are truly a being of honor. To be surprised, then, that you are fated to destroy a world.@
text_zh: @從你的氣場觀察到，你確實是榮譽的存在。因此，對於你註定毀滅一個世界一事，感到驚訝。@

source_en: @Then surely to know what harm you have caused my world!@*
text_zh: @那麼，你肯定知道對自己世界造成了多大的傷害！@*

source_en: @Yes, to see that the Vortex Lens is no longer whole.@
text_zh: @是的，看到漩渦透鏡不再完整。@

source_en: @To have no choice but to return the Codex!@*
@To have wreaked great havoc in this land by your theft of the Codex!@
text_zh: @偷走法典，在這片土地上造成了巨大的混亂！@

source_en: @To have no choice but to return it!@
@To see only two alternatives- to return the Codex, or to give up your life.@*
text_zh: @只看到兩個選擇——歸還法典，或獻出你的生命。@*

source_en: @To be a seer, mystic advisor to my people.@*
text_zh: @作為預言者，我族人的神諭顧問。@*

source_en: @But to be unable to avert what is written in the Book of Prophecies.@*
text_zh: @但無法避免《預言書》中寫下的命運。@*

source_en: @Hss...Yes, to know of the three meanings of that word.@*
text_zh: @嘶...是的，知道那個詞有三種含義。@*

source_en: @To ask to which type of sacrifice you refer: self, others or items of value?@*
text_zh: @詢問你指的是哪種犧牲：自我、他人，或有價值的物品？@*

source_en: @To admire your willingness to sacrifice your life for the good of my people.@*
text_zh: @讚賞你為我族人的福祉而願意犧牲生命的意願。@*

source_en: @But to doubt that that is the meaning of he prophecy.@*
text_zh: @但懷疑這才是預言的真正含義。@*

source_en: @To suggest that you can atone for your misdeed by bathing in the blood of others?!@*
text_zh: @建議你可以通過沐浴在他人的血中來贖罪？！@*

source_en: @To find such thoughts well in keeping with the blackness of your aura!@
text_zh: @認為這樣的想法與你光環中的黑暗十分相稱！

source_en: @To go to the lensmaker, whos house is northeast of here.@
text_zh: @去找磨鏡師，他的房子在東北方。@

source_en: @To find such thoughts unworthy of your honorable aura!@
text_zh: @認為這樣的想法不配得上你那高尚的光環！

source_en: @To know of only one item of true value--the Codex itself.@*
text_zh: @只認出一件真正有價值的物品——法典本身。@*

source_en: @To be utterly without hope in the face of such ignorance.@
@To refuse to converse with a daemon.@
@Yes! To return the Codex to the Vortex!@
@Then to be availiable to both our peoples!@
text_zh: @那樣對我們兩個民族都有利！

source_en: @used to break out of convo if doesn't work right@*
text_zh: @若對話卡住，用此指令結束對話@*

source_en: @To direct you to go to the Hall of Knowledge, south of here.@*
text_zh: @請前往這裡南方的Hall of Knowledge。@*

source_en: @There to read the Book of Ritual.@*
@There also to get the Vortex Lens!@*
@Then to return here, where I will tell you what must be done!@*
text_zh: @然後回到這裡，我會告訴你該做什麼！@*

source_en: @To be able to see the Vortex from both sides of the world!@*
text_zh: @這樣就能從世界的兩端看到漩渦！@*

source_en: @To benefit both races equally if the Codex is returned there!@*
text_zh: @若將法典歸還於彼，兩個種族將同等受益！@*

source_en: @To find the Vortex Lens in the Hall of Knowledge, south of here.@*
text_zh: @去這裡南方的Hall of Knowledge尋找漩渦透鏡。@*

source_en: @To be sure to show the human lensmaker the Vortex Lens.@*
text_zh: @務必將漩渦透鏡展示給人類的鏡匠。@*

source_en: @Also to be sure to tell the human lensmaker that his lens must be concave!@*
text_zh: @也要務必告訴人類鏡匠，他的鏡片必須是凹面鏡！@*

source_en: @To get the lens repared there! Then return here with the whole lens!@
text_zh: @去那裡修復鏡片！然後帶著完整的透鏡回來！

source_en: @To know not where the Codex is.@*
@But to remember that Captain Bolesh just returned from the Codex!@*
text_zh: @但要記住，Bolesh 船長剛從法典那裡回來！@*

source_en: @To suggest you seek him. To try the healer's house to the north.@*
text_zh: @建議你去尋找他。試試北邊醫者的房子。@*

source_en: @Farewell! To return when you have visited the Hall of Knowledge!@
text_zh: @再見！等你訪問過 Hall of Knowledge 後回來！@

source_en: . To return when there is more we can discuss.@
text_zh: . 等我們有更多可談的內容時再來。

source_en: @To be unwilling to help you, False Prophet. To be a healer, a being of peace.@*
text_zh: @不願協助你，假預言者。我是醫者，是和平的化身。@*

source_en: @Elsewise, to summon the guards to slay you!@ The gargoyle says nothing else.
text_zh: @否則，我會召喚衛兵來殺了你！@ 石像鬼無再多言。

source_en: @To see the amulet, the symbol of your courage and nobility. To wish to help you however I can.@
text_zh: @看到你的護身符，那是你勇氣與高貴的象徵。我希望盡我所能幫助你。

source_en: @To be happy to see you again, noble one. But to be sad that you seek my services.@
text_zh: @很高興再次見到你，高貴的人。但聽到你尋求我的服務，我感到傷心。

source_en: @To be nameless, being only a healer.@
@To be entrusted with the tasks of healing those wounded and curing those sick.@
text_zh: 奉託於治療受創者與醫治病患者之職責。

source_en: @To do this for all, as a service to society.@
text_zh: 為此而服務於所有人，以回饋社會。

source_en: The gargoyle mixes strange powders into a foul-smelling brew.
text_zh: 石像鬼將奇怪的粉末摻入一杯惡臭的藥湯中。

source_en: You drink the potion and feel
@To apologize for the error! But to know exactly what I did wrong.@
text_zh: 為錯誤道歉！但要确切知道我做錯了什麼。

source_en: The gargoyle mixes a different drink that somehow smells worse than the last.
text_zh: 石像鬼調製了另一種飲料，不知怎的比上一次的味道更臭。

source_en: The gargoyle shrugs. @To assure you that it is safe and invigorating. But not to force anyone to act against their will.@
text_zh: 石像鬼聳聳肩。向你保證它既安全又提神。但不會強迫任何人違背意願行動。

source_en: @To be unwilling to help you, False Prophet.@
text_zh: 不情願幫助你，假預言者。

source_en: @To ask if there is aught else I can do for you?@
text_zh: 問問我還能為你做些什麼？

source_en: @To ask that you see me at my shop.@*
text_zh: 請你到我的小店裡看我。*

source_en: @The gargoyle mixes strange powders into a foul-smelling brew.@*
text_zh: 石像鬼將奇怪的粉末摻入一杯惡臭的藥湯中。*

source_en: To be unfamiliar with human anatomy...But to be certain that all of you are well!@
text_zh: 對人體解剖學如此陌生...但為了確定你們大家都平安！@

source_en: @To ask me to raise the dead? To apologize, but that is beyond my power.@
text_zh: @請求我讓死者復活嗎？很抱歉，這超出了我的能力。@

source_en: @To doubt that anyone can do that!@*
@The goodscrafter? To regret his condition. To know that he is in great pain after the loss of his family.@
text_zh: @那位工匠？對自己的處境感到遺憾。知道他在失去家人後正遭受巨大的痛苦。@

source_en: @To know that his family was lost when the edges of the world fell off.@*
text_zh: @知道他的家人在世界邊緣脫落時喪生了。@*

source_en: @But to have less and less patience for his dispassionate self-pity.@*
text_zh: @但越來越沒耐心去忍受他冷眼的自憐。@*

source_en: @Yes, during the cataclysms. To have lost friends myself during that bad time.*@
text_zh: @是的，在那場災難期間。我也在那段糟糕的時期失去了朋友。*@，

source_en: @To wish to help you however I can.@
@But to maintain the struggle for life diligently!@*
text_zh: @但要勤奮地堅持活下去的鬥爭！@*

source_en: He shouts, @The False Prophet! Guards! Guards!@
text_zh: 他喊道：@偽先知！衛兵！衛兵！@

source_en: @But to wear the Amulet of Submission? Then to express awe at your honor and courage.@
text_zh: @但佩戴順服護身符？然後表達對你的榮譽和勇氣欽佩。@

source_en: @To be named Bolesh Us-agra-lem, Bolesh the Troop-Leader.@*
text_zh: @被稱為 Bolesh Us-agra-lem，即領隊 Bolesh。@*

source_en: @To lead what remains of our forces into battle. To have recently returned from a mission to your side of the world.@
text_zh: @帶領我們剩下的部隊投入戰鬥。最近剛從你那邊的世界執行任務回來。@

source_en: @To have tried to reach the Codex.@
@To have had victory between our claws, but to have been thwarted on the verge of success!@*
text_zh: 勝利本已掌握在爪中，卻在即將成功之際被阻擋！*

source_en: @To have encountered an impervious force field around the Codex.@*
text_zh: 曾遭遇圍繞法典的無懈可擊力場。*

source_en: @To know that such a field surrounded the Codex when my people possessed it.@*
text_zh: 當我的族人擁有法典時，知道有這樣的力場包圍著它。*

source_en: @To remember that only those on sacred quests for wisdom could pass.@*
text_zh: 記得唯有為智慧而踏上聖潔之旅者方能通過。*

source_en: @To receive a sacred quest at the Temple of Singularity.@*
text_zh: 在奇異聖殿接受聖潔之旅。*

source_en: @But to be uncertain whether a human's request would be answered there.@*
text_zh: 但不確定人類的祈求是否會在那裡得到回應。*

source_en: @To find the temple in the mountains to the north. To need to fly to get there, though!@*
text_zh: 要在北方的山中找到聖殿。不過需要飛過去才能到達！*

source_en: @Yes, to be accessible only to the superior winged gargoyles.@*
text_zh: 是的，只有 superiores 有翼石像鬼才能到達。*

source_en: @To be totally unreachable by land-bound worker gargoyles! To suppose that it is totally unreachable by land-bound humans as well.@*
text_zh: 完全無法讓陸地行走的工役石像鬼到達！推測它對陸地行走的人類也完全無法到達。*

source_en: @To honor my people with thy sacrifice!@
text_zh: 以你的犧牲來榮耀我的族人！

source_en: A strong, winged gargoyle warrior. He is sorely wounded.*
text_zh: 一名強壯的有翼石像鬼戰士。他重傷在身。*

source_en: The gargoyle struggles to sit up.
text_zh: 石像鬼掙扎著想坐起來。

source_en: Half-jokingly, Iolo says, @We'd better do as he says. After all, we don't know what kind of meat that is!@
text_zh: Iolo 開著玩笑說：“我們最好照他說的做。畢竟，我們不知道那是什麼肉！”

source_en: @The False Prophet!@ the gargoyle shouts. @Begone, begone!@
text_zh: 石像鬼喊道：“假預言者！走開，走開！”

source_en: @The False Prophet! To welcome you to my place of cooking.@
text_zh: @虛假預言者！歡迎來到我的廚房。@

source_en: @To offer you the best food in all the world!@
text_zh: @為了向你們提供全世界最美味的食物！@

source_en: @To be called Foodmaker, not having a name yet. But to be the finest cook in the land!@*
text_zh: @被稱為Foodmaker，雖然我還沒有名字。但要成為這世上最優秀的廚師！@*

source_en: @To receive a name someday soon for my skill!@*
text_zh: @因為我的技藝，很快就會有一個名字了！@*

source_en: @To cook and serve food for all the gargoyles who live in these parts!@
text_zh: @為住在這片土地上的所有石像鬼烹飪並提供食物！@

source_en: @Also to guide and instruct the wingless ones in cooking chores.@
text_zh: @還要指導和教導那些不會飛的同行進行烹飪工作。@

source_en: @To not have food on me. To have you visit my shop.@
text_zh: @身上沒有食物。請光臨我的店鋪。@

source_en: @Yes, yes! To offer you this finely roasted meat!@*
text_zh: @是的，是的！向你們提供這道精心烤製的肉類！@*

source_en: With a few strokes of his huge knife, the gargoyle cuts you a slice of meat.*
text_zh: 石像鬼幾下劃動巨大的刀，為你切下一片肉。*

source_en: the profferred food. The flavor is unlike anything you've had before.
text_zh: 遞過來的食物。味道前所未見。

source_en: Iolo speaks. @I wonder what sort of meat that is,
text_zh: Iolo 說話了。@我不知道那是什麼肉，

source_en: The gargoyle beams with pride. @To ask you: Is it not the best meat you have ever eaten?@
text_zh: 石像鬼自豪地笑著。@想問你們：這是不是你們吃過最美味的肉？@

source_en: @To not be able to carry this!@
@To be saddened by your not liking!@*
text_zh: @因為你們不喜歡而感到難過！@*

source_en: @To know of no finer cooker of horseflesh than myself!@*
text_zh: @我以為沒有比我更會烹飪馬肉的廚師了！@*

source_en: @To be famous among all gargoyles for the quality of my horseflesh!@*
text_zh: @因為我的馬肉品質，在石像鬼中聞名！@*

source_en: @I think I'm going to be sick...@
@The goodscrafter? To be pathetic!@ the huge gargoyle scowls.*
text_zh: @那個商販？真可憐！@巨大的石像鬼皺著眉頭。*

source_en: @To have self-pity, when strength and long work will give success!@*
text_zh: @自憐其境，當實力與長久努力能帶來成功時！@*

source_en: @To wish to hear no more about that creature.@*
text_zh: @不想再聽關於那個生物的事。@*

source_en: @To have to watch their every move! But to acknowledge that they are vital to our society.@*
text_zh: @必須監視他們的一舉一動！但承認他們對我們社會至關重要。@*

source_en: @Well, yes, of course to have that as well. But to be famous for my roast horseflesh!@*
text_zh: @嗯，是的，當然也要這樣做。但要因我的烤馬肉而聞名！@*

source_en: @To offer you some of this fine food!@*
text_zh: @邀請你品嚐這些精美的食物！@*

source_en: A large and boisterous gargoyle. He carries a 'knife' large enough to be a sword!
text_zh: 一隻巨大且喧鬧的石像鬼。他背著一把大到足以當作長劍的「刀」！

source_en: @An-bal-sil-fer!@ the gargoyle shouts. @Gres por! Gres por!@
text_zh: @An-bal-sil-fer!@ 石像鬼大喊。@Gres por! Gres por!@

source_en: @To suppose that you have come to kill me as well. All right.@
@To ask why you disturb me again, False Prophet.@
text_zh: @詢問你為何再次打擾我，偽先知。@

source_en: @To see the Amulet of Submission.  To suppose, then, that my world has been saved.@
text_zh: @看到順服之符。 認為，然後，我的世界獲救了。@

source_en: @But to feel that salvation has come too late.@
@To be a goodscrafter. Though to have no reason to make goods now.@
text_zh: @是一名工匠。雖然現在沒有理由製造物品了。@

source_en: @To refuse to discuss my grief with the being who caused it.@*
text_zh: @拒絕與造成此悲痛的實體討論它。@*

source_en: @Surely to know what pain you have caused by stealing the Codex?@*
text_zh: @肯定知道因為竊取法典而造成的痛苦？@*

source_en: @To not believe that you care. To believe, in fact, that you enjoy causing suffering.@*
text_zh: @不相信你在乎。事實上，認為你享受造成痛苦。@*

source_en: @To not believe that you would do anything to help.@*
text_zh: @不相信自己會做什麼來幫助。@*

source_en: @To invite you to take what you want.@*
@To have lost my entire family in the cataclysms.@*
@To wish not to speak of it.@*
@To wait here for you to return to kill me.@
The gargoyle silently awaits his fate.
text_zh: 石像鬼靜靜地等待它的命運。

source_en: @Oh, the False Prophet,@ the gargoyle says calmly.*
text_zh: @哦，偽先知，@ 石像鬼平靜地說。*

source_en: The gargoyle screams, @An-bal-sil-fer! Des-lem, klep lem!@
text_zh: 石像鬼尖叫，@An-bal-sil-fer! Des-lem, klep lem!@
一隻大型、外觀健康的有翼石像鬼。

source_en: @To note that you wear the Amulet of Submission. To admire your courage and to appreciate your sacrifice.@
text_zh: @注意到你佩戴著屈服項圈。欣賞你的勇氣並感激你的犧牲。@

source_en: @To ask your name, that I may address you in a noble manner?@
text_zh: @請問你的名字，以便我以尊貴的稱呼稱謂你？@

source_en: . To be pleased by your return!@
@To be named Krill Us-arb-vas-lem, Krill the Leader of Farmers.@*
text_zh: @被命名為克里爾 Us-arb，農民領袖克里爾。@*

source_en: @To lead the wingless ones, the worker gargoyles who tend these fields.@
text_zh: @為了領導無翼者，這些照料田地的工作石像鬼。@

source_en: @To have great fortune in my harvests!@
text_zh: @為了在我的收獲中獲得巨大的好運！@

source_en: @To be forced by necessity to give the wingless ones no room for choice or freedom.@*
text_zh: @被迫於必要性，不給無翼者任何選擇或自由的空間。@*

source_en: @Beh Lem? To be but a child. To someday grow wings just like his father, Scholar Valkadesh.@*
text_zh: @Beh Lem？不過是個孩子。終有一天長出翅膀，就像他的父親，學者 Valkadesh 一樣。@*

source_en: @To admire the wisdom of Scholar Valkadesh, but to consider his studies unseemly.@*
text_zh: @欣賞學者 Valkadesh 的智慧，但認為他的研究不合時宜。@*

source_en: @To abhor his continued study of the accursed humans!@*
text_zh: @厭惡他繼續研究那些受詛咒的人類！@*
石像鬼停下腳步，感到尷尬。*

source_en: . To acknowledge the nobility of your sacrifice.@*
@To consider you a great credit to your race!@
@To acknowledge that it may seem harsh, but to assure you that there is no other way to treat the wingless ones.@*
text_zh: @承認這可能看起來很嚴厲，但向你保證這是對待無翼者的唯一方式。@*
@An-bal-西爾-費爾！德斯-魯姆，克萊普 魯姆！@

source_en: @To consider them valuable members of society who need firm control and strong leadership. To explain that they are far less intelligent than you or I.@*
text_zh: @認為他們是社會的有價值的成員，需要嚴格的管控和強大的領導。解釋他們遠不如你我聰明。@*

source_en: @To receive bountiful harvests thanks to the efforts of my well-directed workers.@*
text_zh: @感謝我指導有方的工人們的努力，獲得豐收。@*

source_en: @To feed my workers far better than misguided Farmer Nash to the east does.@
text_zh: @比我東邊那位迷途的Farmer Nash feeding 我的工人好得多。@

source_en: @To be ashamed that Nash lacks common sense. To be appalled by his uncontrolled heart and undirected mind.@*
text_zh: @為納什缺乏常識而感到羞恥。對他那顆不受控制的心和無方向的頭腦感到震驚。@*

source_en: @To point out his unproductive fields as an example of why the wingless ones need firm guidance.@
text_zh: @指出他那低產的田地，作為無翼者需要嚴格指引的例子。@

source_en: @To have greatly enjoyed this conversation, noble

text_zh: 再次向您致意，偽預言者。

source_en: The gargoyle screams, @The False Prophet! Workers, attack!@
text_zh: 石像鬼尖叫道，偽預言者！工人們，攻擊！

source_en: The venerable gargoyle peers at you.
text_zh: 德高望重的石像鬼注視著您。

source_en: @To have been told by Naxatilor, long ago, that the you would one day come to me, wearing the Amulet of Submission.@
text_zh: 據納薩蒂爾（Naxatilor）很久以前告訴我，您終有一日會佩戴著順服項鍊來找我。

source_en: @To never have believed it would come to pass. To ask what service I can perform?@
text_zh: 我從未相信這會發生。請問我能為您服務嗎？

source_en: @To ask how again I may help you?@
text_zh: 請問我還能如何幫助您？

source_en: @To lack a name, of course. But to be called Lor-wis-lem, the scholar of light, by many learned gargoyles.@*
text_zh: 「沒有名字，當然了。但被許多博學的石像鬼稱為光之學者 Lor-wis-lem。」*

source_en: As he says this, the ancient gargoyle beams with pride.
text_zh: 當他這麼說時，古老的石像鬼臉上綻開了自豪的笑容。

source_en: @To craft the finest lenses in the land,@ the gargoyle says proudly.
text_zh: 石像鬼驕傲地說：「打造這世上最精細的透鏡，」

source_en: @Also to teach my young apprentices not to cut themselves on the glass!@
text_zh: 「還有教導我的年輕徒弟們，不要讓玻璃劃傷自己！」

source_en: @To be nearing the end of my time.@*
@To have one last sacred duty: To pass on my skill to the next generation.@*
text_zh: 「擁有一項最後的神聖職責：將我的技藝傳給下一代。」*

source_en: @To be over a thousand years old. To seem a mere youth compared to Naxatilor, however.@*
text_zh: 「已活了一千多年。然而與 Naxatilor 相比，我仍顯得像個少年。」*

source_en: @To have helped Naxatilor create the Vortex Lens, centuries ago. To have found him venerable and ancient even then!@*
text_zh: 「幾個世紀前曾協助 Naxatilor 創造了漩渦透鏡。即使在那時，便覺得他崇高而古老了！」*

source_en: @To see the shattered Vortex Lens you carry. To remember making it, so very long ago.@*
text_zh: 「看到你手中那枚破碎的漩渦透鏡。記起了那是在很久很久以前製作的。」*

source_en: Taking the shards of glass, the lensmaker turns to his grinding table. In a short while, he has crafted a new Vortex Lens!*
text_zh: 收下玻璃碎片後，磨鏡師轉向他的磨製台。不久之後，他便打造出了一面新的漩渦透鏡！*
一隻非常古老的石像鬼。*

source_en: @To have far greater skill now than when first I made this lens,@ he says smugly. @To require little time to repair it.@*
text_zh: @現在我的技藝比最初製作這枚透鏡時要高得多了，@他驕傲地說道。@修復它只需要很少的時間。@*

source_en: He hands you the restored Vortex Lens*
text_zh: 他將修復後的旋風透鏡遞給你*

source_en: @To remember little from so long ago,@ the gargoyle croaks.@*
text_zh: @對於那麼久遠的事，我記得並不多，@石像鬼啞著嗓子說。@*

source_en: @To require the pieces of the lens in order to make a new copy.@*
text_zh: @需要收集透鏡的碎片才能製造一個新的複製品。@*

source_en: @To be honored to have helped you, False Prophet.@
The gargoyle gasps in terror and wheezes, @An-bal-sil-fer!@
text_zh: 石像鬼驚恐地大喘著氣，喘息道：@An-bal-sil-fer!@

source_en: The gargoyle gasps in terror and wheezes, @False Prophet!@
text_zh: 石像鬼驚恐地大喘著氣，喘息道：@假先知!@
@An-bal-西爾-費爾！德斯-魯姆，克萊普 魯姆！@

source_en: @To ask your name, that I may address you as you deserve?@
text_zh: @請問閣下尊姓大名，以便我給予你應有的禮遇？@

source_en: @To be honored by your visit, Avatar.@
. To be honored by another visit!@
@To be named Nash Us-arb-vas-lem, Nash the Leader of Farmers.@*
text_zh: @我叫 Nash Us-arb-vas-lem，是農民的領袖 Nash。@*

source_en: @To lead the wingless ones, the worker gargoyles who tend these fields.@
text_zh: @為了領導無翼者，這些照料田地的工作石像鬼。@

source_en: @But to have little fortune in my harvests.@
text_zh: @但在我的收穫上，運氣並不太好。@

source_en: @To try to give the wingless ones free reign, but to be forced to guide them in their work.@*
text_zh: @試圖讓無翼者自由發揮，卻不得不在他們工作中加以引導。@*

source_en: @To be far kinder to the wingless ones than most of my kind.@*
text_zh: @對無翼者的態度比大多數我的同類更為仁慈。@*

source_en: @To feel that the wingless ones should not be enslaved simply because they lack our intelligence.@*
text_zh: @認為無翼者不應僅僅因為缺乏我們的智力而被奴役。@*

source_en: @To be forced, on occasion, to tend the fields myself because of the harshness of the times.@*
text_zh: @時常因為時局艱難，不得不親自下田耕作。@*

source_en: @To wish my fields were as productive as those of Farmer Krill, my neighbor to the west.@*
text_zh: @希望我的田地能像西邊鄰居 Farmer Krill的那樣豐收。@*

source_en: @To be ashamed that Farmer Krill treats his workers so harshly.@*
text_zh: @對 Farmer Krill對待工人如此嚴酷感到羞恥。@*

source_en: @To be appalled by his lack of concern for their thoughts and feelings.@*
text_zh: @對他漠視他們的想法與感受感到震驚。@*

source_en: @To have been greatly honored by this conversation , noble
text_zh: @能與尊貴的您進行此次對話，深感榮幸，尊貴的
一個面容憔悴、看起來很疲憊的有翼石像鬼。*

source_en: @To greatly admire your nobility, False Prophet. To honor my people with your sacrifice!@
text_zh: @極度敬佩您的崇高品格，偽先知。以您的犧牲來榮耀我的族人！@

source_en: @To advise you to find some way to fly if you wish to get there, though!@
text_zh: @不過，建議您若想到達那裡，還是得想辦法飛過去！@

source_en: @To be unable to reach the Temple on foot; to be forced to fly over the mountains.@
text_zh: @無法步行抵達神殿；不得不飛越羣山。@

source_en: @To express my thanks for the sacrifice you have chosen to make!@
text_zh: @為您選擇做出的犧牲表達感謝！@

source_en: @May your long work and strength lead to success!@
text_zh: @願您漫長的工作與力量帶來成功！@

source_en: Suddenly realizing that he is holding a weapon, the gargoyle attacks!
text_zh: 石像鬼突然意識到自己持有武器，隨即發動攻擊！

source_en: @The False Prophet!@ the gargoyle screams. @Guards! Guards!@
text_zh: @偽先知！@ 石像鬼尖叫道。 @衛兵！衛兵！@

source_en: @To thank you for your upcoming sacrifice. To greatly respect your nobility and courage.@
text_zh: @感謝您即將做出的犧牲。對您的崇高與勇氣深表敬意。@

source_en: @To ask how I can help you, noble one.@.
text_zh: @詢問我如何能幫助您，尊貴者。@.

source_en: @To be but a simple weaponsmith, False Prophet.@*
text_zh: “不過是一名簡單的武器鍛造師，假預言者。”*

source_en: @To lack a name, as is appropriate for my station.@*
text_zh: “因我的身份而沒有名字，這是理所當然的。”*

source_en: @To be the master weaponsmith now, although to have but recently been a simple apprentice.@
text_zh: “雖然是剛成為大師武器鍛造師，但最近才從一個簡單的學徒。”

source_en: @To regret that I have such a small supply of zu ylem dust.@
text_zh: “為我的朱勒姆塵存量如此之少而後悔。”

source_en: @To wish I had more boomerangs, that I might give you another.@
text_zh: “希望我有更多的迴力標，這樣我就能再給你一個了。”

source_en: @To greatly regret the loss of my master, killed during the disasters.@
text_zh: “對我師父在災難中遇害的事深感遺憾。”

source_en: @But to carry on in the face of adversity. And certainly not to lose all passion for life, like the worthless goodscrafter!@
text_zh: “但要在逆境中堅持下去。當然，不能像那無能的高斯克拉夫特那樣失去對生活的熱情！”

source_en: @To consider him a discredit to the race!@
@Most of all, to consider him a dishonor to my late master!@
text_zh: “最重要的是，認為他是對我已故師父的褻瀆！”

source_en: @Yes, surely to know of the disasters?@
@To have only barely survived the earthquakes after the Codex disappeared.@
text_zh: “在法典消失後的地震中僅僅倖免於難。”

source_en: @To wish I could leave on adventures...@
@But to be dedicated to my important work.@
@To create these items for the use of all.@
text_zh: “為所有人的使用而製作這些物品。”

source_en: @To give these wares to any gargoyle who has need of them.@
text_zh: “將這些貨物給任何需要的石像鬼。”

source_en: @To invite you to look around at my wares as well.@
@To ask if any of them interest you?@
text_zh: 想知道其中是否有你感興趣的？

source_en: @To ask you to see me at my shop!@
@To have but a few items available. To be far less adept than my former master.@
text_zh: 我的庫存不多。而且我的技藝遠不及我從前的主人。

source_en: @Ah, to see you admire these boomerangs, the work of my master.@*
text_zh: 啊，看到你們欣賞這些回力鏢，那是我主人的傑作。*

source_en: @To regret being unable to create boomerangs myself.@*
text_zh: 很遺憾，我自己無法製作回力鏢。*

source_en: @To have only a few left in stock, but to offer you one.@
text_zh: 庫存只剩幾個了，但我可以送你一個。

source_en: The gargoyle hands you a boomerang.
text_zh: 石像鬼遞給你一個回力鏢。

source_en: As you take the boomerang, Shamino speaks.
text_zh: 當你拿起回力鏢時，Shamino 發話了。
是的，這是一件非常有趣的武器，

source_en: . Perhaps when our quest is through I can study its use.@
text_zh: 。也許等我們的旅程結束後，我可以研究一下它的用法。

source_en: The gargoyle speaks. @To ask if anything else interests you?@
text_zh: 石像鬼發話了。 想知道是否還有其他你感興趣的東西？

source_en: @To not be able to carry it.@
The gargoyle nods. @Yes, to see that you already have enough weapons.@
text_zh: 石像鬼點了點頭。 是的，看到你已經擁有足夠的武器。

source_en: @Yes, to be a very interesting weapon. To knock out even a large animal with just a single pouch of this powder!@*
text_zh: 是的，這是一件非常有趣的武器。只需要一包這種粉末就能擊暈甚至大型動物！*

source_en: @To be used most often by hunters, to avoid harming the meat. Unfortunately, to make this powder from plants that can no longer be found.@*
text_zh: 通常獵人使用它，以免傷害肉類。不幸的是，製作這種粉末所需的植物已無從尋找。*

source_en: He hands you a small pouch. @To hope you find it useful.@
text_zh: 他遞給你一個小袋子。 希望你能覺得它有用。

source_en: The gargoyle nods. @To understand your reluctance To know the dangers of zu ylem dust to the untrained user.@*
text_zh: 石像鬼點了點頭。 理解你的猶豫。知道 Zu Ylem 粉末對未受訓練的使用者而言危險重重。*

source_en: @To create the zu ylem dust from plants that can no longer be found. But to know of far worse effects of the disasters.@
text_zh: 從已無法尋獲的植物中製作出 Zu Ylem 粉末。但知道災難帶來的效果要糟糕得多。

source_en: @To be a powerful but dangerous drug! To turn gargoyle warriors into unstoppable fighters!@
text_zh: 這是一種強大但危險的藥物！它能把石像鬼戰士變成無敵的戰鬥者！

source_en: @But to always be fatal after the battle ends.@
text_zh: 但戰鬥結束後總是會致命。

source_en: @To be created by the snake charmer, who lives to the southwest.@
text_zh: @由住在西南方的馴蛇師製作。@
一隻年輕、看起來很緊張的岩石巨魔。

source_en: @Yes, to suggest you visit him if you are interested. To find the snake-summoning horn a most impressive sight!@
text_zh: @是的，建議你有興趣的話可以去拜訪他。親眼看看那支能召喚巨蛇的號角，絕對是一幅壯觀的景象！@

source_en: @To see little of interest in that item.@
text_zh: @覺得那件物品沒什麼特別之處。@

source_en: @To ask what you want to speak of next?@
@To cheapen all our loss, all our grief, by his self-pity. To have lost my master, like a father to me.@
text_zh: @覺得他只是用自憫來貶低我們所有的損失和悲傷。我失去了我的主人，他對我來說就像父親一樣。@

source_en: @Yet to maintain control, to maintain diligence. Most of all to maintain passion for life. To feel that the goodscrafter dishonors us all by abandoning our principles.@
text_zh: @然而為了保持控制，保持勤勉。最重要的是保持對生活的熱情。覺得那工藝精湛者拋棄我們的原則，貶低了我們所有人。@

source_en: @To feel that the goodscrafter needs a trip to the catacombs.@
text_zh: @覺得那工藝精湛者該去一趟墓穴。@

source_en: @Yes, to have visited them myself once, long ago. To find there shrines to our three principles: control, passion and diligence.@
text_zh: @是的，我很久以前曾親自去過一次。在那裡發現了供奉我們三大原則的聖壇：控制、熱情和勤勉。@

source_en: @To speak with these shrines and meditate, to receive new insight. To not remember where the catacombs are.@
text_zh: @與這些聖壇對話並冥想，以獲得新的啟示。不記得墓穴在哪裡。@

source_en: @To be sent there by the Temple of Singularity.@
@To find that to the north, in the mountains.@
, let's away from here.  There's naught of use this creature can tell us. Agreed?@
text_zh: ，我們離開這裡吧。這個生物什麼有用的也說不出來。同意嗎？@
困惑的岩石巨魔揮手道別。

source_en: @Captain Johne teach I human speak,@ the gargoyle says haltingly.
text_zh: @Captain Johne教我說人話,@ 那個石像鬼結結巴巴地說。

source_en: @To ask how I can help, mighty
@To greet you, human. To recognize you as the False Prophet!@
text_zh: @向你問好，凡人。承認你是偽先知!@

source_en: @To be called Beh Lem, which means 'just one.' To have not received a true name.@
text_zh: @我的名字叫做Beh Lem，意思是『唯一』。尚未獲得真正的名字。@

source_en: @To know Captain Johne! To help him and Valkedesh in their work,@ the youngster says proudly.
text_zh: @認識Captain Johne!幫助他和Valkedesh工作,@ 年輕人自豪地說。

source_en: @To not receive a true name until I have proved myself worthy.@
text_zh: @在證明自己值得之前，不會獲得真正的名字。@

source_en: @To not deserve a name yet. But to get one someday, just like my father Valkadesh!@
text_zh: @還不夠資格擁有一個名字。但有一天會得到的，就像我父親Valkadesh一樣!@

source_en: @To be here to help you, noble
@To be here to wait for Captain Johne.@
@To be feared by everybody - everybody except me and Valkadesh, my father!@
text_zh: @被所有人懼怕 - 除了我和我父親Valkadesh!@

source_en: @To very much respect Valkadesh my father.@*
@To want to be a scholar someday just like him!@
text_zh: @希望有一天能像他一樣成為學者!@

source_en: @To go with you and guide you there!@
@To wish very much to join you. But to not have enough room in your party for another.@
text_zh: @非常希望能加入你們。但是隊伍裡沒有多餘的位置了。@

source_en: @Avatar, I'll return to the surface and let everyone know of our progress.@
text_zh: @聖者，我將返回地面，讓大家知道我們的進展。@

source_en: The little gargoyle eagerly joins your group.
text_zh: 小石像鬼熱切地加入了你們的小隊。
@哦。@ 那隻小巖魔似乎很難過。
一隻膚色淺白的小巖魔。*

source_en: @To go from the entrance to Hythloth westward, following the @mountains.@*
text_zh: @從入口出發，沿著 Hythloth 向西，順著@山脈。@*

source_en: @Then to turn north, at the Hall of Knowledge.@*
text_zh: @然後在 Hall of Knowledge 轉向北方。@*

source_en: @To walk east along the mountains until you come to a narrow pass.@*
text_zh: @沿著山脈東行，直到來到一條狹窄的隘口。*

source_en: @To find the house of Valkadesh through the pass!@*
@To see it at 42 degrees south, 88 degrees east by the sextant.@*
text_zh: @用量角器觀測，它位於南緯42度，東經88度。*

source_en: @But to take care! To avoid the lava pits and the Hall of Knowledge!@*
text_zh: @但要小心！避開熔岩坑和Hall of Knowledge！@*

source_en: @To see it at 40 degrees south, 65 degrees east by the sextant.@*
text_zh: @用量角器觀測，它位於南緯40度，東經65度。*

source_en: The gargoyle greets you enthusiastically, but you can't understand him!*
text_zh: 巖魔熱情地跟你打招呼，但你聽不懂它在說什麼。*

source_en: @To walk clockwise around the mountains from Hythloth to reach my father's house.@
text_zh: @從Hythloth順時針繞著山脈走，到達我父親的房子。@

source_en: @To avoid the Hall! To talk to Valkadesh first!@
@To find the Hall of Knowledge to the south of the city.@
@To find the house of Valkadesh my father through the pass east of the Hall.@
text_zh: @在大殿東邊的隘口找到Valkadesh，也就是我父親的家。@

source_en: @To be in danger from the lava! To stay far away!@
@To not leave until there is peace between our races!@
text_zh: @在我們種族之間實現和平之前，不離開！@

source_en: @May our persistence and precision lead to success!@
text_zh: @願我們的堅持與精準帶來成功！@

source_en: @May your persistence and precision lead to success!@
text_zh: @願你的堅韌與精準帶來成功！@

source_en: Seeing your confusion, he switches to the human language. It's obviously a strain for him.
text_zh: 看到你的困惑，他改用人類語言說話。對他來說顯然很吃力。

source_en: @To be called the Caretaker, in lieu of a name.@*
@To be honored by being allowed to perform my duties as caretaker of this Hall.@*
text_zh: @能夠在此館執行管理者的職責，是我莫大的榮幸。@*

source_en: @To care for my race's artifacts that rest here in the Hall of Knowledge.@
text_zh: @守護安放在Hall of Knowledge的我族文物。@

source_en: @To keep the treasured artifacts of our race here in this Hall, in the three chambers.@*
text_zh: @守護我族珍貴的文物，安放在此館的三個房間中。@*

source_en: @To keep artifacts from the Underworld in the Human Chamber, to the east. To keep valuable books in the Librum Chamber, to the west.@*
text_zh: @在東側的人類房間存放來自冥界（Underworld）的文物；在西側的書庫房間存放珍貴的書籍。@*

source_en: @And to keep the Cube and the Lens in the Vortex Chamber, to the south.@*
text_zh: @在南側的Vortex Chamber存放魔方和水晶球。@*

source_en: The gargoyle ignores you and continues writing.
text_zh: 滴水石無視了你，繼續寫東西。

source_en: @Yes, the Underworld. To believe you know it as 'Britannia.'@*
text_zh: @是的，冥界（Underworld）。我想你應該知道那裡被稱作「Britannia」。@*

source_en: @To regret that that item is lost, stolen by human thieves years ago.@*
text_zh: @那件物品幾年前被人類竊賊偷走，我深感遺憾。@*

source_en: @To have heard the humans mention the name Stonegate as they fled.*
text_zh: @曾聽逃竄的人類提及「Stonegate」這個名字。*

source_en: @To have heard them say they would sail through Lost Hope Bay. To know nothing more about its whereabouts.@*
text_zh: @曾聽他們說將航經「Lost Hope Bay」。對其具體下落我一無所知。@*

source_en: @To find what you seek in the Vortex Chamber.@*
@To suspect it to be someplace in the human-filled Underworld.@*
text_zh: @推測它在充滿人類的冥界（Underworld）某處。@*

source_en: @To find the Temple of Singularity in the mountains to the north - if you can fly!@*
text_zh: @在北方的羣山之中尋得奇異聖殿——如果你能飛的話！@*

source_en: @To be unable to reach the mountain-locked Temple of Singularity on foot. To only be able to reach that holy place if you are a winged gargoyle.@*
text_zh: @無法步行抵達鎖於山巒中的奇異聖殿。唯有長翼的滴水石才能抵達那座聖地。@*

source_en: @To find this most fitting and proper.@*
@To see no reason to let human riff-raff into the Temple.@*
text_zh: @看不出有什麼理由讓這些人渣進入神殿。@*

source_en: @Yes? To inquire about the reason for this interruption.@
text_zh: @是的？想詢問這次打擾的原因。@

source_en: @To admit ignorance regarding the location of the moonstones.@*
text_zh: @承認不知道月之石的所在地。@*

source_en: Without another word, the gargoyle returns to his work.
text_zh: 沒再多說一句話，石像鬼回到了他的工作崗位。

source_en: @Yes? To inquire about the reason for yet another interruption.@.
text_zh: @是的？想詢問又一次打擾的原因。@。
馴蛇者！向 Drax 臣服

source_en: The gargoyle shouts, @The False Prophet!@ and flees!
text_zh: 石像鬼大叫：「@偽先知！@」然後逃走了！

source_en: The gargoyle seems afraid of you at first. Then he notices the amulet around your neck.
text_zh: 這隻風鈴石人起初似乎害怕你。然後他注意到了你頸上的護身符。

source_en: @To--to feel honored to address you, False Prophet.@
text_zh: @能向假預言家您請安，我深感榮幸。@

source_en: @To feel honored by your visit, False Prophet.@.
text_zh: @能得到假預言家您的光臨，我深感榮幸。@.

source_en: @To ask what you wish of a simple snakecharmer?@
text_zh: @您希望一個平凡的馴蛇人做什麼？@

source_en: @To be called simply by my job, snakecharmer.@*
text_zh: @別無所求，只希望被稱為我的職業：馴蛇人。@*

source_en: @To summon the silver snake, and to direct the young warriors in defeating it.@
text_zh: @召喚銀色巨蛇，並指揮年輕的戰士們擊敗它。@

source_en: @Then to extract the venom so that I can make the battle-drug.@
text_zh: @然後提取毒液，以便我製作戰鬥藥劑。@

source_en: @To make the drug for our bravest warriors, who take it and turn into fighting daemons!@*
text_zh: @為我們最英勇的戰士製作藥物，他們服下後會轉變為戰鬥惡魔！@*

source_en: @To express sorrow that the drug is fatal, but to express awe and respect for the warriors' sacrifice.@*
text_zh: @對藥物致命性表示哀悼，但對戰士的犧牲表達敬畏與尊敬。@*

source_en: @To use the great horn to summon the silver snake.@*
@To always require many warriors to defeat the creature!@*
text_zh: @要擊敗這頭生物，必須動用許多戰士！@*

source_en: @To find the horn just north of my house. But to warn you never to blow the horn!@*
text_zh: @去我家北邊找號角。但警告你千萬不要吹號角！@*

source_en: @To be in grave peril from the snake without a squad of warriors!*
text_zh: @若沒有戰士小隊，面對那蛇將處於極大的危險中。!*

source_en: @To express my thanks for the sacrifice you have chosen to make!@
text_zh: @為您選擇做出的犧牲表達感謝！@
一隻古老的帶翼石像鬼。
石像鬼喊著 @An-bal-sil-fer！@ 然後逃跑了！

source_en: In a thick accent, the gargoyle croaks, @I bad with human language.@
text_zh: 石像鬼用濃重的口音嘎嘎說道：@我不太擅長人類的語言。@

source_en: @Must Captain Johne go. Only he speak. Must go!@
text_zh: @Captain Johne必須離開。只有他會說話。必須走！@

source_en: @Captain Johne gargoyle friend. Captain Johne speak.@
text_zh: @Captain Johne是石像鬼的朋友。Captain Johne會說話。@

source_en: @Want much to talk. Captain Johne speak, Captain Johne go!@
text_zh: @很想在這裡多聊會兒。Captain Johne會說話，Captain Johne要走了！@

source_en: @To offer greetings, False Prophet. To have waited long for you to return to this side of the world.@*
text_zh: @向偽先知致意。等待你回到這個世界已經很久了。@*

source_en: @To believe that the Book of Prophecies is wrong. To believe that I can reason with you, persuade you to spare my people.@*
text_zh: @相信《預言書》是錯誤的。相信可以說服你，讓你放過我的人民。@*

source_en: @To wish to address you honorably: To ask your name?@*
text_zh: @希望以尊稱向您致意：請問您的名號？@*

source_en: @Noble Avatar, to see that you are a being of honor and respect.@
text_zh: @高貴的聖者，見您是如此榮耀與受敬重之存在。@

source_en: , to see that you are a being of honor and respect.@
text_zh: ，見您是如此榮耀與受敬重之存在。@

source_en: @To not betray that honor - to return the Codex!@
@To save my people from the prophesy!@
@To see you have done the honorable thing. To have earned much respect from my people by doing this!@*
text_zh: @見您做了正當之事。因此事而在我族人中贏得了莫大的敬重！@*

source_en: @To hope your travels have brought you wisdom?@
text_zh: @希望您旅途中的見聞已為您帶來智慧？@

source_en: @To regret that, and to wish to aid you.@
text_zh: @對此事感到遺憾，並希望幫助您。@

source_en: @To be called Valkadesh Wis-lem, Valkadesh the Scholar@
text_zh: @名為 Valkadesh Wis-lem，學識淵博的 Valkadesh@

source_en: @To have been given a partial name. To have yet to achieve full honor.@
text_zh: @只獲得了部分名號。尚未達成完整的榮耀。@

source_en: @To be a Scholar. To be seeking a way to avert the prophecy.@
text_zh: @身為學者。正尋求避免預言發生的方法。@

source_en: @To be greatly honored by even a partial name. To be customary among my people to give names only to those most worthy.@
text_zh: @即便只是部分名號也深感榮耀。在我族人中，通常只授予最配得之人以名號。@

source_en: @To be written in the Book of Prophecies that you would destroy our world.@*
text_zh: @預言書中寫道，您將毀滅我們的世間。@*

source_en: @To also be written that only the sacrifice of the False Prophet would save us.@*
text_zh: @亦寫有，唯有獻祭偽預言者方能拯救我們。@*

source_en: @To be the only alternative to returning the Codex. Without the Codex, to have no choice but to sacrifice your life!@*
text_zh: @這是歸還法典以外的唯一選擇。若無法典，將無可避免地必須犧牲您的生命！@*

source_en: @To believe that it is not too late. To beg you to return the Codex.@
text_zh: @相信還來得及。懇請你歸還《法典》。@

source_en: @Avert the prophesy! Save your life, and my people's lives as well!@
text_zh: @阻擋預言！救救你自己，也救救我族人的性命！

source_en: @Wait! To know that sacrifice has three meanings: of self, of others and of valuables.@*
text_zh: @等等！「犧牲」有三種含義：犧牲自我、犧牲他人、犧牲珍寶。@*
一隻高瘦、長著翅膀的石像鬼。*

source_en: @Perhaps to find a better answer in one of those other meanings.@
text_zh: @或許能在其中另一種含義中找到更好的答案。@

source_en: @To suggest you seek out Naxatilor himself for further enlightenment.@
text_zh: @建議你去尋找 Naxatilor 本人，以獲得進一步的啟示。@

source_en: @To learn from Naxatilor, the wisest gargoyle. To find his chambers just to the northeast of the Hall of Knowledge.@
text_zh: @向最睿智的石像鬼 Naxatilor 學習。他的房間就在Hall of Knowledge的東北側。@

source_en: @To suggest you go there and ask him of sacrifice.@
text_zh: @建議你去那裡，向他詢問關於犧牲的問題。@

source_en: @To travel to the Inquisitor. To tell the Inquisitor that you surrender.@
text_zh: @前往審問官那裡。告訴審問官你願意投降。@

source_en: @Then to be no longer a threat, and no longer be feared.@
text_zh: @這樣就不再是威脅，也不再被害怕。@

source_en: The gargoyle smiles, but his grin is somehow disturbing.*
text_zh: 石像鬼笑了，但他的笑容顯得有些詭異。*

source_en: @To have done the honorable thing and now be respected and unfeared by my people.@
text_zh: @我做了正當之事，現在受我族人尊敬，也不再被他們害怕。@

source_en: @To go to Draxinusom, the Inquisitor and leader of my race.@*
text_zh: @前往 Draxinusom 那裡，他是審問官，也是我族的首領。@*

source_en: @To find his chambers just to the northwest of the Hall of Knowledge.@*
text_zh: @他的房間就在Hall of Knowledge的西北側。@*

source_en: @To surrender to him, that you may travel freely in our land.@*
text_zh: @向他投降，這樣你就可以自由地在我族領地通行。@*

source_en: @To know that the moons are not properly aligned yet for the ritual.@*
text_zh: @月亮尚未對準，還沒到進行儀式的時候。@*

source_en: @To assure you that you will not be sacrificed for many weeks.@*
text_zh: @保證你在數週內不會被當作祭品。@*

source_en: @To assure you further that surrender is the only way you can travel among my people.@*
text_zh: @再向你保證，投降是你能在我們族人中間通行的唯一方式。@*

source_en: As you turn to leave, the gargoyle stops you.
text_zh: 當你轉身欲走時，石像鬼擋住了你。

source_en: @Wait,@ he calls. @To be feared and hated by all gargoyles. To be unsafe for you right now, False Prophet.@
text_zh: @等等，@ 他喊道。@被所有石像鬼懼怕和憎恨。現在對你來說並不安全，虛偽的先知。@

source_en: @To surrender is only answer. To surrender to Inquisitor.@*
text_zh: @投降是唯一的答案。向審問官投降。@*

source_en: @Then to be no longer a threat, and no longer be feared by my people!@
text_zh: @這樣就不再是威脅，也不再被我族人害怕了！

source_en: @To surrender to the Inquisitor, and then to be free to look for the solution.@
text_zh: @向審問官投降，然後自由地尋找解決方案。@
@我是人類的的朋友。想和你說話。@

source_en: @May your precision and persistence lead to success!@
text_zh: @願你的精準與堅持能帶來成功！@

source_en: @What you back for? I thought you not like my inn.@
text_zh: @你怎麼又回來了？我以為你不喜歡我的旅店。@

source_en: @I am keeping the inn, here at King's Ransom.@
text_zh: @我管理著 King's Ransom 這家旅店。@

source_en: gold per person for you to stay and have meal, good?@
text_zh: 金幣每人，住宿並用餐，好嗎？@

source_en: He hands you the key. @Last door on your right, enjoy ya?@
text_zh: 他把手遞給你。@門在你右邊最後一間，玩得愉快？@

source_en: @Must pay in advance for rooms. Sorry, is policy.@
text_zh: @房間必須預先付費。抱歉，這是規定。@

source_en: @What, maybe you don't like my inn? Well, maybe I don't like you either!@
text_zh: @什麼，也許你不喜歡我的旅店？嗯，也許我也討厭你！

source_en: @You speak too quick. What was that?@
He serves you breakfast. @Good morning to you.@
@Where is key? You go find it.@
A giant of a man with a solemn stare.*
text_zh: 一個身軀魁偉、目光嚴肅的男人。*

source_en: . Come, have a seat and talk with us a while.@
@Life on the sea is the only life for me. Alas, the Hind needs serious repairs just now.@
text_zh: @海上生活是我唯一的生活方式。唉，女妖號現在急需大修。@

source_en: @Yes, I must keep myself occupied on land, meantime. Perhaps I could join thy party for a time.@
text_zh: @是的，這段時間我得找點事在陸地上做。也許我可以暫時加入你們的隊伍。@

source_en: @Ah, the sea. 'Tis as vast as a thousand dreams.@
@The Golden Hind won't be repaired for months, at the soonest. Traveling with you would likely prove interesting. Would you like me to come along?@
text_zh: @Golden Hind至少還得好幾個月才能修好。跟你們一起旅行大概會很有意思。你願意讓我同行嗎？@

source_en: @Very well. This should make a nice change from my usual routine. You might ask Leonna if she would like to join us as well.@
text_zh: @很好。這將會是我日常生活的愉快變化。你可以問問Leonna是否也想加入我們。@

source_en: @You have enough travelling with you already. But if you ask one of them to leave first, I'd be happy to join you.@
text_zh: @你們已經有足夠的旅伴了。但如果你們讓其中一人先離開，我很樂意加入你們。@

source_en: @Okay. I'll be here if you change your mind.@
text_zh: @沒問題。如果你改變主意，我就在這裡。@

source_en: @I'd be glad to join you--but I have already!@
text_zh: @我很樂意加入你們——但我已經加入了！@

source_en: @Has the time come for me to leave your crew?@
text_zh: @是我該離開你們船隊的時候了嗎？@

source_en: @Do you want me to wait here, or go home?@
@Very well, I shall wait here for you to return.@
text_zh: 好吧，我會在這裡等你回來。

source_en: @Okay. I think I'll head back to the Fallen Virgin, then. Here's all the equipment I was carrying, if you need it.@
text_zh: @好的。那我想我會回去‘落難聖女’號。這裡有我身上所有的裝備，如果你需要的話。@

source_en: She sets down everything she was carrying before walking off.
text_zh: 她放下身上所有攜帶的物品，然後離開了。

source_en: @Okay. I think I'll head back to the Fallen Virgin, then.@
text_zh: @好的。那我想我會回去‘落難聖女’號。@

source_en: @Well, I shall stay with you then.@
When you say 'Captain,' all the pirates at the table turn to you expectantly. When they realize you weren't talking to them, they return to their business.
text_zh: 當你提到‘隊長’時，桌上所有的海盜都期待地轉向了你。當他們意識到你不是在對他們說話時，他們又恢復了自己的事情。

source_en: @You wouldn't be talking about Captain Johne would you?@
@Aye, Leonna is the best first mate I've ever had.@
text_zh: 「是啊，Leonna 是我見過最棒的大副。」
「Leonna 臉紅了，別過頭去，有些害羞。」

source_en: @Comes from being a captain once herself, you know.@
text_zh: 「這可是因為她以前自己當過船長，你知道的。」

source_en: @That scallawag? He went down to the other side of the world to join up with the gargoyles, the dirty traitor...@
text_zh: 「那雜種？他跑到世界另一端去投靠石像鬼了，這個卑鄙的叛徒...」

source_en: The tea-drinker interrupts. @No, no, you've got it all wrong! I can tell you the truth about Captain Johne.@
text_zh: 喝茶的人插嘴道。「不，不，你們都搞錯了！我可以告訴你們關於 Captain Johne的真相。」

source_en: @Vile creatures, they are. One of them attacked my ship once. He flew off with a ham before anyone could stop him.@
text_zh: 「它們是可惡的生物。其中一個曾經攻擊過我的船。在任何人能阻止之前，他飛走並帶走了一塊火腿。」

source_en: @Yes, he stole my ham, and I dined on biscuits that night.@
text_zh: 「是的，他偷了我的火腿，那晚我就吃了餅乾。」

source_en: @Drop by again next time you're in town.@

text_zh: !@ 她躲開了這一拳。 @我很忙！@

source_en: A woman with a slightly seaworn look, but delicate hands.
text_zh: 一位看起來略有風霜之氣的女子，但雙手細膩。

source_en: @Uh-huh. You're not a member of the guild. I don't have to tell you anything.@
text_zh: @嗯哼。你不是公會成員。我沒必要告訴你什麼。@

source_en: @It was buried in a small cave.@
@After Captain Hawkins passed away, we tore his treasure map into nine pieces. The plan was, when nobody was looking for us any more, we'd get together and go dig it up.@*
text_zh: @Captain Hawkins過世後，我們把他的藏寶圖撕成了九片。計畫是，等到沒人再找我們時，我們就聚在一起去挖掘。@*

source_en: @Splitting up the map was my idea - that way nobody could doublecross the others. I figure after all these years the others must have given up, so its alright for me to search for the treasure by myself.@*
text_zh: @把地圖分開是我的主意——這樣就沒人能背叛其他人。我想這麼多 years 過去了，其他人一定已經放棄了，所以我獨自去找寶物也沒問題。@*

source_en: @Then hand it over and we're even.@ His eyes gleam with greedy anticipation. Do you give him the cloak?@
text_zh: @那就交出來，我們就兩清了。@ 他的眼睛閃爍著貪婪的期待。你要把斗篷給他嗎？@

source_en: @Trouble is, I've got a bit of the gout in one leg, and I can't travel much any more. Maybe we can help each other out. I know where my piece of the map is hidden, and if you bring me the other eight pieces, perhaps we could make a deal.@*
text_zh: @問題是，我一條腿有點痛風，不能再到處奔波了。也許我們可以互相幫助。我知道我那片地圖藏在哪里，如果你把另外八片帶來給我，也許我們可以做個交易。@*

source_en: @I'll tell you all I know about where the pieces might be... Ol' Hawknose set out for the Dry Land, to kill the daemon that is said to live there.@*
text_zh: @我把我知道的所有碎片可能所在的地方都告訴妳...Ol' Hawknose出發前往Dry Land，去殺死據說住在那裡的惡魔。@*

source_en: @Sandy, the ship's cook, went to Trinsic with the first mate.@*
text_zh: @Sandy，船上的廚師，和大副一起去了 Trinsic。@*

source_en: @Old Ybarra said he was headed for the dungeon Shame, looking for more treasure. I think one of the men died in a shipwreck.@*
text_zh: @老Ybarra說他去了恥辱地牢，想找更多財寶。我想其中一個人在船難中死了。@*

source_en: @Then there was one more... Can't remember his name, but I've heard tell he settled in Jhelom. He'll be easy to recognize - he has a hook in place o' one of his hands. That's all I know. Perhaps in your travels you can find out where the others have gone.@*
text_zh: @還有一個...記不起他的名字，但聽說他定居在Jhelom。很好認——他一隻手的位置裝了個鉤子。我知道的就這些了。也許妳在旅途中能查出其他人的下落。@*

source_en: @When you find the pieces, you can lay them out on the ground to see how they fit together. But remember, only I know where the ninth piece is, so come back here when you've got the other eight.@
text_zh: @找到碎片後，妳可以把它們攤在地板上看看如何拼湊。但要記住，只有我知道第九片在哪裡，所以妳拿到其他八片後要回來找我。@

source_en: @Go ask Budo. And you didn't hear that from me, understand?@
text_zh: @去找Budo問問。而且別說你聽我說的，懂嗎？@
@說真的，跟你說話真是种享受。@

source_en: Homer holds up the Storm Cloak and examines it carefully, rubbing the fabric between his fingers.*
text_zh: Homer舉起風暴斗篷，仔細地檢視著，手指摩挲著布料。*

source_en: His eyes narrow. @This... ain't the cloak from Hawkins' treasure hoard.@*
text_zh: 他的眼睛瞇了起來。 @這...不是Hawkins寶藏裡的斗篷。@*

source_en: @The one we buried was in better shape than this. I remember it well... I helped steal the blasted thing!@*
text_zh: @我們埋葬的那件比這件狀況好多了。我記得清楚...我幫手偷了那該死的東西！@*

source_en: His face twists with anger as he thrusts the cloak back toward you.
text_zh: 他的臉上扭曲著憤怒，把斗篷往你這邊一推。

source_en: @You trying to cheat me, are ye? Bringing me some dockside rag and calling it Hawkins' Storm Cloak!@*
text_zh: @你想騙我，是吧？拿塊碼頭的破布來，就說這是Hawkins的風暴斗篷！@*

source_en: @Do I look like a fool to you?@
@Don't play coy with me! I may have one bad leg, but I ain't blind!@
text_zh: @別跟我裝傻！我雖然一條腿不好使，但我沒瞎！@

source_en: @Then take that scrap and find the real one!@
text_zh: @那就拿走那塊破布，去找真正的斗篷！

source_en: @Come back when you've got the cloak from the treasure itself... or don't come back at all!@
text_zh: @等你拿到寶藏裡的斗篷再回來...或者別回來了！

source_en: He takes the cloak from you. @Thanks for keeping your word. There's not many that does, these days...@
text_zh: 他從你那裡拿過斗篷。 @謝謝你信守承諾。這年頭，肯這麼做的人不多了...@

source_en: You have no storm cloak to give him.
@Blast ye! If I still had two good legs, I'd keelhaul the lot of you!@*
text_zh: @見鬼！如果我還有兩條好腿，我就把你們這些傢伙都吊起來絞死！*

source_en: @We had a deal! Besides, I helped steal that treasure myself, fair and square.@*
text_zh: @我們有過協議！而且，我也正當合法地幫手偷了那筆寶藏。@*

source_en: @Then get off your duff and go dig it up!@
text_zh: @那就別發愣了，去把它挖出來！

source_en: @So, have ye found the eight pieces of the map yet?@
text_zh: @所以，你找到地圖的八片碎片了嗎？@

source_en: @Very well. I've been thinking about how we could work out a deal.@*
text_zh: @好吧。我一直在想我們能怎樣做個交易。@*

source_en: @You served your purpose by bringing me the cloak... Now I have no further need of you. I have big plans now, and no time to waste talking.@
text_zh: @你給我帶來斗篷已經盡了責...現在我不再需要你了。我現在有大計畫，沒時間閒聊。@

source_en: @I know you want the silver tablet. Far as I'm concerned, you can have it.@*
text_zh: @我知道你想要銀色板。就我而言，你可以拿走它。@*

source_en: @All I really want is the magical cloak that's buried with the rest of the treasure. So...@*
text_zh: @我真正想要的只是隨寶藏一起埋葬的魔法斗篷。所以...@*

source_en: @I'll tell you where the ninth piece of the map is if you promise to bring me the cloak.@*
text_zh: @如果你答應帶斗篷來給我，我就告訴你地圖第九片藏在哪裡。@*

source_en: @The rest of the treasure should be loot enough to satisfy you. Is it a deal?@*
text_zh: @剩下的寶物應該足夠讓你滿意了。成交嗎？@*

source_en: @Okay. The ninth piece of the map is hidden...Right here in my pocket!@ He grins wickedly. I had to keep it safe while you were off gathering the others, didn't I?@
text_zh: @好吧。地圖的第九片藏在...就在我口袋裡！@他露出邪惡的笑容。我不得不把它保得好好的，趁你去收集其他片的時候，是吧？@

source_en: He hands you the last piece of the map. The island in the upper left hand corner is Buccaneer's Den.@
text_zh: 他遞給你是地圖的最後一片。左上角標記的島嶼是海盜巢穴。 Buccaneer's Den

source_en: @You'll keep your word and come right back here with the magic storm cloak, won't you?@
text_zh: @你會守信用，帶著魔法風暴斗篷馬上回來，是吧？@

source_en: @Good. Then I'll tell you this: When you reach the island marked with the X, find the three stones and stand in the center.@*
text_zh: @很好。那我告訴你：當你到達標有 X 的島嶼時，找到那三塊石頭，站在中間。@*

source_en: @Then walk three paces due south, nine paces due west, and twelve more paces south. That should put you right next to an old dead tree.@*
text_zh: @然後向南走三步，向西走九步，再向南走十二步。那應該會讓你正好站在一棵枯樹旁邊。@*

source_en: @Dig in the patch of dirt just to the south of you, and you'll find the treasure!@*
text_zh: @在你南邊的一小片泥土裡挖掘，你會找到寶藏！@*

source_en: @Don't want to keep your word now that you have the map, eh? Well, then, I won't tell you where you need to dig to find the treasure!@
text_zh: @現在你有了地圖，不想守信用了，是吧？那麼，我不會告訴你需要在哪裡挖掘才能找到寶藏！@

source_en: @Suit yourself, mate, that's the only deal I'll offer.@
text_zh: @隨你便，夥計，這是我唯一能給的交易條件。@

source_en: @Best count again. You need eight pieces before I'll bargain with you.@
text_zh: @最好重新數一遍。在你給我八片之前，我不會跟你談判。@

source_en: @Then what are you wasting my time for?@
A shifty-eyed character. He carries a cane and walks with a slight limp.*
text_zh: 一個眼神閃爍的人物。他拄著柺杖，走路略有跛腳。*

source_en: He takes your measure, looking you over from head to toe. @What do you want?@
text_zh: 他打量著你，從頭到腳看了一遍。@你要幹什麼？@

source_en: @Fine, 'Avatar', if that's who you really are... You can call me Homer.@
text_zh: @很好，‘聖者’，如果你真的是那個人的話...你可以叫我Homer。@

source_en: ' - if that's what your name really is... You can call me Homer.@
text_zh: ' - 如果你真的叫那個名字...你可以叫我Homer。@

source_en: @I once sailed on the ship called 'Empire, under Captain Hawkins.@
text_zh: @我曾經在Captain Hawkins指揮的‘Empire’號船上航行。@

source_en: @It was wrecked on the cape, southwest of here. Not too far from Serpent's Hold.@
text_zh: 它在這裡西南方的海岬上失事了。距離Serpent's Hold不遠。

source_en: His eyes light up with hatred. @That heartless bastard...He was killed by his own men, and it was no worse than he deserved.@*
text_zh: 他的眼中閃爍著憎恨。那個冷血的小人...他被自己人殺死，這是他活該的。*

source_en: He hesitates, then adds quickly, @Of course, I had nothing to do with it.@
text_zh: 他猶豫了一下，然後迅速補充道：「當然，這跟我沒有關係。」

source_en: @You're looking for the silver tablet? It's part of Captain Hawkins' buried treasure.@
text_zh: 你在找銀板？那是Captain Hawkins埋藏寶物的一部分。

source_en: He regards you warily. @Who sent you?@
text_zh: 他警惕地打量著你。誰派你來的？

source_en: @I see.@ He screws his face up into an even more suspicious expression than before. @Just why do you want to know about it, anyway?@
text_zh: 我明白了。他的臉色變得比之前更加懷疑。你到底為什麼要問這個？

source_en: @Have you found the storm cloak yet?@
A smartly dressed woman. Her smile has a delightful subtlety to it.
text_zh: 一位穿著時髦的女人。她的微笑帶著迷人的含蓄。

source_en: , the famous Avatar! 'Tis an honor to meet thee.@*
text_zh: ，著名的聖者！很高榮能見到您。*

source_en: Her face lights up as she recognizes you. @Hello again,
text_zh: 當她認出你時，臉上的表情亮了起來。再次見面了，

source_en: @I used to captain my own ship. But I fell on hard times, and now I sail with Leodon on the Hind.@
text_zh: 我以前有自己的船。但後來時運不濟，現在我隨萊奧頓在“印度”號上航行。 Leodon

source_en: @A fine old vessel, the Golden Hind. Alas, I have little to do while she's being repaired.@
text_zh: “金 Hind 號真是一艘精美的老船。唉，她在修理期間，我無事可做。” Golden Hind

source_en: @Oh good! I bet we'll meet a lot of interesting men...@
text_zh: “太好了！我敢打賭我們會遇到很多有趣的人...”

source_en: @You have enough traveling with you already. But if you ask one of them to leave first, I'd be happy to join you.@
text_zh: “你已經帶了足夠的旅伴了。但如果你讓他們中的一個先離開，我很樂意加入你們。”

source_en: @Okay. I guess I'll just stay here for now.@
text_zh: “好吧。我想我就先留在這里了。”

source_en: @I'd be glad to join you--but I have already!@
text_zh: @我很樂意加入你們——但我已經加入了！@

source_en: @Has the time come for me to leave your crew?@
text_zh: @是我該離開你們船隊的時候了嗎？@

source_en: @Do you want me to wait here, or go home?@
@Very well, I shall wait here for you to return.@
text_zh: 好吧，我會在這裡等你回來。

source_en: @Okay. I think I'll head back to the Fallen Virgin, then. Here's all the equipment I was carrying, if you need it.@
text_zh: @好的。那我想我會回去‘落難聖女’號。這裡有我身上所有的裝備，如果你需要的話。@

source_en: She sets down everything she was carrying before walking off.
text_zh: 她放下身上所有攜帶的物品，然後離開了。

source_en: @Okay. I think I'll head back to the Fallen Virgin, then.@
text_zh: @好的。那我想我會回去‘落難聖女’號。@

source_en: @Well, I shall stay with you then.@
When you say 'Captain,' all the pirates at the table turn to you expectantly. When they realize you weren't talking to them, they return to their business.
text_zh: 當你提到‘隊長’時，桌上所有的海盜都期待地轉向了你。當他們意識到你不是在對他們說話時，他們又恢復了自己的事情。

source_en: @You wouldn't be talking about Captain Johne would you?@
@There's none I'd rather ship out with.@
text_zh: “我沒有更想一起出海的人了。”

source_en: @Aye, Leonna is the best first mate I've ever had.@
text_zh: 「是啊，Leonna 是我見過最棒的大副。」
「Leonna 臉紅了，別過頭去，有些害羞。」

source_en: @Comes from being a captain once herself, you know.@
text_zh: 「這可是因為她以前自己當過船長，你知道的。」

source_en: @Captain Johne is a madman! He went down in Hythloth seeking a way to the other side of the world. Said he was going to kill as many gargoyles as he could before they got him.@
text_zh: “約翰船長是個瘋子！他去了Hythloth，尋找通往世界另一邊的路。他說要在他們抓住他之前，盡可能多地殺死食尸鬼。” Captain Johne
