source_en: @That's not true!@ says Captain Fox. @I can tell you what really happened.@
text_zh: @那不對！@ Captain Fox說。@我可以告訴你到底發生了什麼事。@

source_en: You fail to get her attention in the midst of the brawl.
text_zh: 你在扭打中無法引起她的注意。

source_en: You see a handsome gentleman, immaculately dressed.*
text_zh: 你看見一位英俊的紳士，衣著一絲不苟。*

source_en: @I'm Captain Fox, of the Silken Stag.@
@I sail the wide, wide sea, to the edges of the world and back again. Of course, I'm also known for the paintings I create in my spare time.@
text_zh: @我航行於廣闊無垠的大海，直到世界的邊緣再返回。當然，我因在業餘時間創作的畫作而聞名。@

source_en: When you say 'Captain,' all the pirates at the table turn to you expectantly. When they realize you weren't talking to them, they go back to what they were doing.
text_zh: 當你說「船長」時，桌上的所有海盜都滿懷期待地轉過頭來看著你。當他們意識到你不是在跟他們說話時，他們便繼續做著原本的事。

source_en: @There are a few of them around here. Go see for yourself.@
text_zh: @這附近有一些。去親自看看吧。@

source_en: @We just stopped off here for some supplies and a drink or two.@
text_zh: @我們只是停靠在這裡補充給養，再喝上兩杯。@

source_en: @Captain Johne, that lunatic? I hear he went underground seeking the gargoyles, but he fled from the first one he encountered. Nobody knows where he is now.@
text_zh: @Captain Johne，那個瘋子？我聽說他下地底去找石像鬼了，結果碰到第一隻就嚇跑了。現在沒人知道他人在哪裡。@
像個男人一樣戰鬥吧，你這膽小鬼！

source_en: @Well, that's not what I heard.@ says Leodon.
text_zh: 「@這跟我聽到的不一樣。@」 Leodon 說道。

source_en: @Under the earth is no place for a seafaring man to be.@
@Tough creatures. My crew and I steer well clear.@
text_zh: @兇猛的生物。我和我的船員都避而遠之。@

source_en: @Don't go too far, matey--ye'll fall off!@ He laughs a hearty laugh and takes a swig of ale.
text_zh: @別走太遠，伙計——你會掉下去的！@ 他爽朗地大笑，並喝了一大口麥酒。

source_en: Your question makes him laugh suddenly. His ale spills across the table. He continues laughing as he pours himself another ale.
text_zh: 你的問題讓他突然大笑起來。他的麥酒灑了一桌。他邊笑邊又為自己倒了一杯麥酒。

source_en: .@ He pauses to punch another pirate in the belly. @Come back later when I've less on my mind!@
text_zh: .@ 他停下動作，又給另一個海盜腹部一拳。@等我不那麼忙碌時再來吧！@

source_en: @Fine!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the
text_zh: @好！@ 在收下你的金子後，他交出了

source_en: A charismatic man with an engaging smile.*
text_zh: 一位魅力非凡、笑容迷人的男子。*

source_en: @Welcome.@ He makes a sweeping gesture with his hat.@
text_zh: 歡迎。他用帽子做了一個大幅度的揮手動作。

source_en: @Welcome back, stranger.@ He winks at you.
text_zh: 歡迎回來，陌生人。他向你眨了眨眼。

source_en: @I sell ham, ale, mead, wine, and rations.@
text_zh: 我賣火腿、啤酒、麥酒、葡萄酒和乾糧。
明天我們開門時再來吧。

source_en: He shrugs @I'm sorry. Perhaps you could ask someone else.@
text_zh: 他聳了聳肩，抱歉。也許你可以問問別人。

source_en: @I'm glad you stopped by.@ He gives you a firm handshake.
text_zh: 很高興你來光顧。他和你用力握手。

source_en: @Which- ham, ale, mead, wine, or rations?@
text_zh: 要哪樣——火腿、啤酒、麥酒、葡萄酒還是乾糧？

source_en: An uncomfortable looking man sitting behind a cup of tea.
text_zh: 一個神態不安的男子，坐在一杯茶後方。

source_en: @Hello.@ His gaze darts from side to side, lingering longingly on the mugs of ale his fellow patrons are gulping down heartily.@
text_zh: 「你好。」他左右張望，目光充滿渴望地停留在其他顧客大口暢飲的麥酒杯上。

source_en: He looks at you uneasily. @I'm Captain Elad. Not that it's any business of yours...@
text_zh: 他不安地看著你。「我是Captain Elad。這雖然不關你的事...」

source_en: @I was Captain of the Theodosia Marie--until she sank@
text_zh: 我曾是Theodosia·Marie號的隊長——直到她沉沒

source_en: When you say 'Captain,' all the pirates at the table turn to you expectantly. When they realize you weren't talking to them, they go back to what they were doing.
text_zh: 當你說「船長」時，桌上的所有海盜都滿懷期待地轉過頭來看著你。當他們意識到你不是在跟他們說話時，他們便繼續做著原本的事。

source_en: @Captain Johne, that fool... He was captured by gargoyles. I hear they dragged him down into Hythloth, and nobody's seen hide nor hair of him since.@
text_zh: @Captain Johne，那個笨蛋...他被石像鬼抓走了。我聽說他們把他拖到了 Hythloth，從此以後就再沒有人見過他的蹤影。@

source_en: Leonna raises an eyebrow. @Is that so? I could tell a different tale...@
text_zh: Leonna 揚起眉毛。@是嗎？我可以講一個不同的故事...@

source_en: @Aye, 'twas a terrible ordeal. We were sailing just off Bordermarch when the whole island started shaking. Must have been one of those earthquakes we've been having.@
text_zh: @是的，那是一場可怕的災難。我們剛駛離 Bordermarch，整座島就開始震動。一定是我們最近經歷的那些地震之一。@

source_en: @The whole island sank beneath the waves. We were caught in the huge whirlpool left in its wake. I was one of the lucky few to swim clear. But my ship's on the bottom of the ocean now, and that's the honest truth.@
text_zh: @整座島都沉入了海裡。我們被它留下的一個巨大漩渦捲入其中。我是少數幾個游出來的人之一。但我的船現在在海底，這是事實。@

source_en: He shudders, then takes a sip of his tea. @I don't like to think about it.@
text_zh: 他顫抖了一下，然後喝了一口茶。@我不喜歡去想那件事。@

source_en: @Might we speak for a moment, milord?@
@A fair sized island, and now she's gone! Some o' them earthquakes have been mighty fierce.@
text_zh: @一座相當大的島，現在它不見了！那些地震有些非常猛烈。@

source_en: @Yes, they started soon after Lord British was rescued from the underworld. I lost my ship to the last one.@
text_zh: @是的，它們在 Lord British從地獄被救出來後不久就開始了。我在最後一次地震中失去了我的船。@

source_en: @I'd toast him with you, but this,@ he gestures disparagingly at his cup, @is hardly fitting for such an honor.@
text_zh: @我很想跟你敬他一杯，但這個，@ 他鄙夷地指了指自己的杯子，@實在不配這份榮耀。@

source_en: @Surely you've heard tales of the Avatar's bold exploits? It was all anyone was talking about roundhere for weeks.@
text_zh: @你肯定聽說過聖者的英勇事蹟吧？這裡幾週來大家都在談論這個。@

source_en: @I wish I had one of them... I bet I could sell it for a pretty penny!@
text_zh: @我真希望我有一個...我猜我能賣不少錢！@

source_en: @You don't hear much about the virtues in a pirate town...@
text_zh: @在海盜城裡，你很少會聽到關於美德的事...@

source_en: @I could use more virtue in me life. I've just given up drinking, to start with.@
text_zh: @我的生活中需要更多美德。首先，我剛剛戒了酒。@

source_en: @Indeed.@ He takes another big gulp of tea.
@Wait, before you go...I was wondering--do you know the mantra of Honesty?@
text_zh: 等一下，在你走之前...我在想——你知道誠實的口訣嗎？

source_en: @I've been trying to find out what it is, so that I can better myself. I'll give you five gold if you tell me. Is it a deal?@
text_zh: 我一直試著找出它是什麼，這樣我才能提升自己。如果你告訴我，我給你五個金幣。成交嗎？

source_en: @Thank you! Now my meditations will succeed at last!@
text_zh: 謝謝！現在我的冥想終於會成功了！

source_en: As you turn to leave, you think you might have caught a glimpse of Captain Elad stealing a swig from someone else's mug... But you can't be sure.
text_zh: 當你轉身離開時，你似乎瞥見 Captain Elad正趁人不注意從別人的杯子裡偷喝一口...但你不能確定。

source_en: You decide to make up a random word. The pirate frowns.
text_zh: 你決定胡編一個詞。海盜皺起了眉頭。

source_en: You tell him the mantra is '
@I'll be here with the money if you change your mind.@
text_zh: 如果你改變主意，我帶著錢在這裡等你。

source_en: @Oh. Well, let me know if you find out later.@
text_zh: 哦。好，如果你之後找到了，告訴我。

source_en: The pirate smiles and waves goodbye, then scowls as he turns back to his mug of tea.
text_zh: 海盜笑著揮手道別，然後轉回他那杯茶，臉色又臭了。

source_en: @Can't talk now. I'm--ungh!@ He reels from a punch to his belly. @I'm in the middle of something,
@They're fine, hearty fellows, one and all.@
text_zh: 他們都還不錯，是一羣豪爽的人。

source_en: @I'd better not... I've still got bruises from the last time I tried yodeling around here.@
text_zh: 我最好別...上次我試著在這裡唱搖音唱法時，身上還有瘀傷呢。

source_en: @Not that there are pirates around here or anything...The salty air just doesn't agree with me.@
text_zh: 不是說這裡有海盜之類的...只是海風讓我覺得不舒服。

source_en: @Did I say pirates? I didn't say that.@ He looks around nervously.*
text_zh: 我說海盜了？我才沒那樣說。* 他緊張地環顧四周。

source_en: @Nobody but fine honest sailors around here.@ He lowers his voice. @By the way... If you should happen to run across Bonn, or Ybarra, or Hawkins, don't tell them I'm here.@
text_zh: 這裡除了正派誠實的水手沒別人。 他壓低了聲音。 對了...如果你剛好碰到 Bonn、Ybarra 或 Hawkins，別告訴他們我來過。
@他是誰？我從來沒聽過這名字。@

source_en: @I don't think it would be a good idea to talk about that...@
text_zh: @我想，討論這件事可能不是個好主意...@

source_en: @Oh, a loon with a spoon, Sang a song of ballooning. And the man in the moon Said it was quite a tune.@*
text_zh: @噢，拿湯匙的瘋子，唱著氣球的歌。月亮上的男人說，這調子真不錯。@*

source_en: @Now one fine day in June A young man went ballooning. Did he rise up to glory, Or fall to his doom?@*
text_zh: @某天六月的一個好日子，一個年輕人去駕駛氣球。他飛向榮耀的高處，還是墜向毀滅的深淵？@*

source_en: @Just one thing will I say, Of the sport of ballooning: On the ground will I stay, While the ground still has room!@
text_zh: @關於駕駛氣球這門運動，我只說一句話：地面還有空間時，我就留在地面！@

source_en: @Oh, that's just some nonsense that gave me an idea for a song...I read about it in a book at the Lycaeum.@
text_zh: @噢，那只是無稽之談，不過它給了我一首歌的靈感...我在Lycaeum書院的一本書裡讀到的。@
一位神情不安的吟遊詩人。*
@去問那邊的圖書管理員尋求幫助吧。@

source_en: He spits on the ground and then says, @What?@
text_zh: 他朝地上吐了一口痰，然後說：@什麼？@

source_en: @Oh, hello. Can I help you with something?@*
@I sing songs for the pira - for the sailors here. But I'm looking for a chance to move to another town.@
text_zh: @我為船員——這裡的航海者們——唱歌。但我正在尋找機會搬去另一個城鎮。@

source_en: @I'm out of work after selling you all my ships and skiffs.@
text_zh: @賣完給妳所有的大船和小艇後，我就失業了。@

source_en: @A strong name, as strong as the sea. She looks into the distance.@
text_zh: @強壯的名字，就像大海一樣強壯。她望向遠方。@

source_en: @Beautiful thing, but a jealous man he is.@
text_zh: @美麗的事物，但他是個嫉妒的人。@

source_en: @Many call her a female. If ya ask me, men are much more unpredictable.@
text_zh: @很多人說她像個女人。如果要我說，男人更難以捉摸。@

source_en: @It'll cost you 350 gold for the deed. Interested?@
@Excellent!@ After accepting your gold, Fentrissa hands over the deed.@
text_zh: @太好了！@ 收下妳的黃金後，Fentrissa 把地契交給了妳。
你找不到比這更好的船了。

source_en: @Have a good one.@ She bows, hands on her hips.
text_zh: @祝你過得好。@ 她行了個禮，雙手叉腰。

source_en: A strong, sinewy woman with a hard look about her.
text_zh: 一位強壯、肌肉結實的女人，眼神堅定。

source_en: @Smell that salt air, friend. Brings a tear to me eye...@
text_zh: @聞聞那鹹腥的海風吧，朋友。讓我的眼睛都濕潤了...@

source_en: @Welcome, welcome!@ She slaps you heartily on the back.
text_zh: @歡迎，歡迎！@ 她重重地拍了一下妳的背。

source_en: Budo frowns at you. @That was a good price.@
text_zh: Budo 對妳皺起眉頭。@那是個好價格。@

source_en: @There you go.@ Budo hands you the

text_zh: 交給你。我很感謝你的顧睏。”

source_en: @I bet you've come back to pick up that orrery you ordered.@
text_zh: “我猜你是回來領取你訂購的天體運行儀了。”

source_en: @Don't be ridiculous! This is the first time we've ever been in your shop!@ says Dupre.
text_zh: “別開玩笑了！這是我們第一次來你的店裡！”Dupre 說道。

source_en: @Oh, I'm sorry. I must have thought you were somebody you aren't.@
text_zh: “哦，對不起。我一定是把你當成不是你的人了。”

source_en: @Do you need to buy some supplies?@
@Why, it's Budo, I believe. That's what it was last week. Some call me 'the Den', but I don't think that's my name.@
text_zh: “咦，我想你是 Budo。上週也是這麼叫的。有人叫我‘The Den’，但我覺得那不是我真正的名字。”

source_en: @Which, torches, oil, lockpicks, gems, backpacks, bags, shovels, or powder kegs?@
text_zh: “你要買哪樣，火把、油、開鎖工具、寶石、背包、袋子、鏟子，還是火藥桶？”

source_en: @Oh, I sell this and that. I'm not sure what 'this' and 'that' are, but I sell a lot of them! People give me money for them, that is.@
text_zh: “哦，我賣東買西。我不確定‘東’和‘西’是什麼，但我賣了很多！那是說，人們給我錢買它們。”

source_en: @I think someone told me that was Nick's name.@
text_zh: @我想有人跟我說那是 Nick 的名字。@

source_en: @I don't know what it is, but I've got one on order.@
text_zh: @我不知道那是什麼，但我訂購了一個。@

source_en: @It's not as sweet as honey, but you can trade one for the other.@
text_zh: @它不像蜂蜜那樣甜，但你可以用它交換蜂蜜。@

source_en: He glances about quickly, to make sure nobody else is listening. In a low voice he says, @Congratulations, and welcome to the guild. I can offer you the standard member's discount on all supplies now. Just remember, whatever you do, don't tell anyone about our guild!@
text_zh: 他迅速環顧四周，確保沒有其他人聽得到。他低聲說道，@恭喜你，歡迎加入公會。現在你可以享受所有物資的標準會員折扣了。記住，無論如何，不要告訴任何人關於我們公會的事！@

source_en: A startling change comes over his features. Suddenly the good-natured bumbler that stood before you has been transformed into a shrewd, sharp, dangerous looking man. He leans forward staring straight into your eyes as he asks @Who sent you?@
text_zh: 他的神情突然變了。剛才站在你面前的那個和藹可親的笨手笨腳之人的形象瞬間消失，取而代之的是一個精明、銳利、看起來危險的男人。他身體前傾，直直地盯著你的眼睛問，@誰派你來的？@

source_en: @Uh-huh. Well... Were you hoping to join?@
@All right, maybe you've got what it takes. We'll see. To be a member of the thieves' guild, you have to get your own belt.@*
text_zh: @好吧，也許你具備了條件。我們再看著辦。要成為小偷公會的成員，你得自己弄到一條腰帶。@*

source_en: @Now we have a limited membership, so there's only so many belts in the world. If you want one of them, you have to 'retire' a member of the guild. Lucky for you, it just happens there's a member we'd like to see 'retired' soon.@*
text_zh: @現在我們的會員人數有限，所以世間只有這麼多條腰帶。如果你想要其中一條，你就必須讓公會的一名成員「退休」。幸運的是，剛好有一位成員我們希望他盡快「退休」。@*

source_en: @Her hideout is deep below Britain, in the sewers. You'd best watch out for the rats down there!@*
text_zh: @她的巢穴深藏在 Britain 下方的下水道裡。你最好小心那裡的老鼠！@*

source_en: @One last thing... It would be an embarassment for the guild to have bodies turning up inconveniently. So don't get too violent unless you have to. I'll talk to you when you get back.@
text_zh: @最後一件事...對公會來說，如果不恰當地發現屍體會很丟臉。所以除非必要，否則別太暴力。等你回來我們再談。@

source_en: He leans even closer, transfixing you with his gaze.*
text_zh: 他靠得更近了，用目光牢牢釘住你。*

source_en: @Then just remember this. I don't take kindly to anyone spreading secrets around. If you were to tell anyone I'm involved with the guild, well...Let's just say accidents can happen to anyone--even the Avatar...@
text_zh: @那麼就記住這點。我不喜歡任何人傳播祕密。如果你告訴任何人我與公會有關聯，好吧...讓我們假設任何人——甚至聖者——都可能發生意外...@

source_en: @To keep the guild safe, each member only knows the names of two others. You're safer not knowing more about the guild than you have to, believe me...@
text_zh: @為了確保公會的安全，每位成員只知道另外兩人的名字。相信我，你最好不要知道太多關於公會的事，這樣才安全...@

source_en: He winks at you. @The guild is behind you, as long as you keep our secret.@
text_zh: 他向你眨了眨眼。@只要你能守住我們的祕密，公會就在你身後支持你。@

source_en: @I think you have less gold than you thought.@
text_zh: @我想你身上的黃金沒有你以為的那麼多。@

source_en: @You haven't any room in your pack.@
@Good!@ After accepting your gold, Enrik hands over the
A scarred man with a gap-toothed grin and large, calloused hands.*
text_zh: 一個滿臉疤痕、露出豁口牙笑容、雙手粗糙多繭的男人。*

source_en: @Right. You been here before.@ He studies you carefully.
text_zh: @嗯。你以前來過。@ 他仔細地打量著你。

source_en: @Enrik. Enrik the Hammer's what I'm known as 'round here.@
@And my mutter said I was thick. You can buy's arms from me or sell me yer used stuff. Or mebbe you need cannon balls fer yer ship?@
text_zh: 「我媽說我笨。你可以在我這裡買武器，或者把舊東西賣給我。也許你的船需要砲彈？」

source_en: @They call me that 'cause I's got a good left.@
text_zh: 「他們這樣叫我是因為我左拳很厲害。」

source_en: @Keep it up and I'll show ya,@ he growls.
text_zh: 「你再這樣，我就讓你好看，」他低吼道。

source_en: @Come by my shop when I'm open!@
@It'll cost you 35 gold per cannon ball. Interested?@
text_zh: 「每顆砲彈 35 金幣。你有興趣嗎？」

source_en: @How many cannonballs do you want to buy?@
@Good!@ After accepting your gold, Enrik hands over the cannonballs.@
text_zh: 「好！」收下你的金幣後，Enrik把砲彈交給你。

source_en: @Hey, what's it look like, I'm a mind reader? Do ya want arms, armor, or cannon balls?@
text_zh: 「喂，我長了天眼還是會讀心術？你是要武器、鎧甲還是砲彈？」
「嗯，你那裡可能有我感興趣的東西...」

source_en: He gives you a blank stare.
text_zh: 他給你一個空洞的眼神。

source_en: @Seggallion of...well now that won't mean anything to you.@
He looks at you puzzled. @The same as yours now.@
text_zh: 他困惑地看著你。@現在和你的一樣。@

source_en: @If you mean my profession, I would have to say a knight of Ashtalarea.@
text_zh: @如果你是指我的職業，我會說我是 Ashtalarea 的騎士。@

source_en: @Ask me again sometime. It is quite a story.@
@A land unfamiliar to you, I'm sure. Just as unfamiliar as yours is to me.@
text_zh: @那是一片你不熟悉的地域，我敢打賭。就像你的那片地域對我不一樣不熟悉一樣。@

source_en: @Yes, I was walking in the mountains of Tyme when suddenly I heard a noise. It was dark and I heard this low growling. Having just been released from Pildar's clutches, I was tired and hungry.@
text_zh: @是的，我正在Tyme的山脈中行走，突然聽見一陣聲響。天色昏暗，我聽見這低沉的咆哮聲。剛從Pildar的魔爪中獲釋，我疲憊且飢餓。@

source_en: @That is a great range of mountains in my land. Wherever that is now.@
text_zh: @那是我故鄉中一片廣大的山脈。現在它在哪裡呢。@

source_en: @Am I standing in your light? Sorry.@
@From what I hear, he is not unlike your Mondain. Anyway, I peered into the darkness but could see nothing. Suddenly a huge wall of blue flame appeared behind me.@
text_zh: @據我所聞，他與你們的Mondain沒什麼兩樣。總之，我往黑暗中窺視，卻什麼也看不見。突然，一堵巨大的藍色火焰牆出現在我身後。@

source_en: @Yes, blue like nothing I had seen in any spell. Anyway, just as I turned, the creature leapt from the woods. It hit me with such force, we both entered the blue flame together.@
text_zh: @是的，藍得像我在任何咒語中都沒見過的顏色。總之，就在我轉身時，那生物從樹林中躍出。它以巨大的力量撞向我的，我們倆一起進入了那藍色火焰中。@

source_en: @Well, it didn't burn us, we just fell through to the ground beyond it. After struggling for a while, I finally managed to kill it. That's when I wandered into this community.@
text_zh: @嗯，它沒有燒灼我們，我們只是穿過它跌落在另一邊的地面上。掙扎了一陣子後，我終於成功殺死了它。就在那時，我 wandered 進入了這個社區。@

source_en: @The people of this land are brave and honorable. They fed and clothed me when I discovered that my gold was not the same as yours. I know it is a queer story, but true none the less.@
text_zh: @這片土地的人們勇敢而正直。當我發現我的黃金與你們的不同時，他們給我食物並為我提供衣物。我知道這是一個奇怪的故事，但它確實是真的。@

source_en: You see a huge, muscled warrior with a sad look in his eyes.*
text_zh: 你看到一位龐大、肌肉發達的戰士，眼神中帶著憂傷。*

source_en: @Yes it is. Still, if I could I would like to join you on your quest. Perhaps one of the people in your land will know how to get me back to mine. If not, at least I can thank your people by assisting you.@
text_zh: @是的，確實如此。不過，如果可能的話，我很想加入你們的旅程。也許你們那裡的人知道如何送我回去。如果不行的話，至少我可以幫助你們，以感謝你們的善意。@

source_en: He bows low. @Seggallion at your service.@
text_zh: 他深深鞠躬。@Seggallion 為您服務。@

source_en: You can see by his broad smile and large physique, he would be a worthy opponent. @Shall we be off then?@
text_zh: 從他寬闊的笑容和魁梧的身軀可以看出，他將是一位強大的對手。@那麼，我們出發吧？@

source_en: @I wish I could, however, you seem to have enough strong arms already. If any should leave though, seek me out.@
text_zh: @我很想加入，不過你們似乎已經有很多強壯的手腳了。如果有人離開的話，儘管來找我。@

source_en: @You don't look seperated to me.@ He laughs heartily.
text_zh: @在我看來，你們並沒有分離。@ 他哈哈大笑。

source_en: @Do you want me to wait here, or go home?@
@Very well, I shall wait here for you to return.@
text_zh: 好吧，我會在這裡等你回來。

source_en: I shall wait here for thee.
@I'll leave all these things with you.*@
He leaves everything he was carrying in a pile on the ground.
text_zh: 他將身上攜帶的所有物品都堆在地上。

source_en: @It is hard to say goodbye, but I see your path leads elsewhere, so...@
text_zh: @說再見很難，但我看見你的道路指向別處，所以...@

source_en: He looks at you imploringly. @What is it?@
text_zh: 他懇求地看著你。@怎麼了？@

source_en: @I'm Tessa. We met during thy last quest, Avatar! Strange that thou didst not recognize me. I would have hoped that the past years had not taken that much toll on me!@
text_zh: @我是Tessa。我們在聖者你上次的任務中見過面！奇怪你竟然不認得我。我還以為過去幾年不會對我造成那麼大的影響呢！@

source_en: @I'm the keeper of the Flame of Courage. I also help my husband Simon run this town. How fortunate we were to come here after the earthquake!@
text_zh: @我是勇氣之火的守護者。我也幫我的丈夫Simon管理這個鎮子。地震後能來到這裡，我們真是不幸中的大幸！@

source_en: @He is the lord of this hold.@

text_zh: @你會在這裡見到許多勇敢的戰士！@

source_en: @After thy last quest, there were many great earthquakes. The island of Bordermarch sank into the sea, along with our keep! Only through great fortune did Simon and I make it off the island alive!@
text_zh: @在你上次任務之後，發生了許多大地震。Bordermarch島連同我們的城堡一起沉入海中！幸好Simon和我僥倖逃離了那個島，保住了性命。@

source_en: @Farewell, Avatar! Be brave in thy quest!@
text_zh: @告別了，聖者！願你在任務中保持勇氣！@

source_en: ! A sailor from Britain said thou had returned to the land! How glad I am to see that it is true!@
text_zh: ！一位來自 Britain 的水手說你已經回到陸地了！看到這是真的，我真的高興極了！@

source_en: @I am the lord of Serpent's Hold.@
@I personally favor the mantra of Valour. I taught it to the bard Culham in a song.@
text_zh: @我個人推崇勇氣的真言。我以一首歌的形式教給了吟遊詩人 Culham。@

source_en: @He spends much time in Jhelom, though he be a traveling bard.@
text_zh: @他雖然是一位流浪吟遊詩人，但大部分時間都待在Jhelom。@

source_en: @Yes, there's no telling where one might find him. As I said, though, Jhelom is a good guess.@
text_zh: @是，無人能預料他會在哪裡出現。不過正如我所說，Jhelom 是一個合理的猜測。@

source_en: @If I had a rune, I'd wear it proudly. But others fear for the safety of such important talismans, hiding them in some peculiar places. I wonder if 'tis considered theft to seize a rune laid out for all to see...@
text_zh: @若我擁有一枚符文，我會驕傲地佩戴它。但其他人擔心如此重要的護符的安全，將它們藏在一些奇異的地方。我想知道，拿走一枚隨意放置、對所有人開放的符文，是否算作偷竊...@

source_en: @Goodbye. I hope thou wilt visit me again when thou hast time, friend.@
text_zh: @再見。我希望你有時間時再來探望我，朋友。@

source_en: A muscular knight. He speaks in a raspy voice.*
text_zh: 一名肌肉發達的騎士。他說話聲音沙啞。*

source_en: Avatar! Thou art most welcome in my castle, Avatar.@ He bows deeply to you.
text_zh: 聖者！你在我城堡裡是最受歡迎的客人，聖者。@ 他向你深深地鞠躬。

source_en: ! As guildmaster, I welcome thee in the name of the Order of the Silver Serpent.@
text_zh: ！作為公會大師，我謹代表 Order of the Silver Serpent 歡迎你的到來。@

source_en: @It is good to see thee again,
@I am Koranada, son of Kulebra. My father was a brave lighthouse keeper.@
text_zh: @我是柯拉納達（Koranada），庫拉貝拉（Kulebra）之子。我的父親曾是一位勇敢的燈塔看守。@

source_en: @An earthquake destroyed the lighthouse, else I would have inherited the position of keeper in Greyhaven. I traveled to Serpent's Hold to join the Order instead.@
text_zh: @一場地震摧毀了燈塔，否則我本可繼承格雷海文（Greyhaven）的看守職位。我改到巨蛇堡（Serpent's Hold）加入了教團。@

source_en: @We stand for the principle of Courage.@
@Dost thou wish to join the Order of the Silver Serpent?@
text_zh: @你願意加入銀蛇教團（Order of the Silver Serpent）嗎？@

source_en: @We would be greatly honored if thou wouldst join us, Avatar.@*
text_zh: @若你能加入我們，將是我們莫大的榮耀，聖者。@*
@你的行為充分證明了你的價值，

source_en: . I shall waive the usual requirements since thy adventures are more than sufficient proof of thy courage.@*
text_zh: . 既然你的冒險經歷足以證明你的勇氣，我將豁免通常的入團要求。@*

source_en: @However, thou must still create thine own shield.@
text_zh: @不過，你必須自己打造一副盾牌。@

source_en: @There will always be a place here for thee,
@Acquire a Silver Serpent shield and thou wilt be admitted to the order,
text_zh: @獲得一面 Silver Serpent shield，你便能加入教團，

source_en: @We are honored by thy membership, worthy Avatar!@
text_zh: @我們很榮耀能有你這位值得尊敬的成員，聖者！@

source_en: Koranada glances at your shield. @Avatar, thou must aquire thine own Serpent shield from Gherick. Someone else's won't suffice...@
text_zh: 柯拉納達（Koranada）瞥了一眼你的盾牌。@聖者，你必須向格裡克（Gherick）購買並打造屬於你自己的巨蛇盾。別人的盾牌是不夠的...@

source_en: @Go and speak to de Hugh. Observe what he believes to be courage. Though he is a fine fighter, he has yet to prove himself worthy of our order.@
text_zh: @去找德休（de Hugh）談談。觀察他認為什麼是勇氣。雖然他是一位出色的戰士，但他尚未證明自己有資格加入我們的教團。@

source_en: @The Serpent Shield of our order is a sacred symbol of our brotherhood of bravery.@
text_zh: @我們教團的巨蛇盾（Serpent Shield）是勇敢兄弟會的神聖象徵。@

source_en: @Its making is a magical process. Gherick the Smithy will help thee make one.@
text_zh: @它的製作過程帶有魔法成分。鐵匠格裡克（Gherick the Smithy）會幫助你打造。@

source_en: @As guildmaster, I welcome thee in the name of the Order of the Silver Serpent.@
text_zh: @作為公會會長，我謹代表 Order of the Silver Serpent 歡迎你的到來。@

source_en: @You will most likely find him at Siege Crafters.@
text_zh: @你很可能會在圍城工匠（Siege Crafters）那裡找到他。@

source_en: . But I am honored by the offer.@
text_zh: . 但對於這個邀約，我感到十分榮耀。@

source_en: @However...Dost thou wish to join the Order of the Silver Serpent?@
text_zh: @不過...你願意加入 Order of the Silver Serpent 嗎？@

source_en: @Without the meaning, such a symbol is just a meaningless scratching. We meditate on Valor here.@
text_zh: @沒有含義，這樣的符號只是無意義的塗鴉。我們在這裡冥想「英勇」。@

source_en: @A mantra is a concept, a special word to be turned over and over in the mind. When we meditate on a mantra, we do so in order to find the meaning of that virtue.@
text_zh: @真言是一個概念，是一個需要在腦海中反復運轉的特殊詞語。當我們冥想真言時，目的是為了找到該德性的含義。@

source_en: @It is not enough just to know a mantra or possess a rune. In order to be virtuous, one must act virtuously.@
text_zh: @僅僅知道真言或擁有符號是不夠的。要變得富有德性，必須行動富有德性。@

source_en: @Sometimes one virtue conflicts with another, though both be numbered amongst the Virtues of the Avatar. The hero seeks to act with an awareness of these conflicts instead of merely following instinct. My teacher Conor taught me this.@
text_zh: @有時一種德性與另一種德性相互衝突，儘管兩者都被列為聖者的德性之中。英雄尋求在行動時意識到這些衝突，而不是單純地跟隨本能。我的老師 Conor 教會了我這一點。@

source_en: @A dear friend. He was guildmaster here when I was in training. He lives humbly in New Magincia now.@
text_zh: @一位親密的朋友。我受訓時，他是這裡的公會會長。現在他簡樸地居住在New Magincia。@

source_en: A dignified man wearing a loose jacket decorated with a serpent.*
text_zh: 一位衣著體面的男子，穿著一件繡有蛇紋的寬鬆外套。*

source_en: @Touche!@ He wields his foil casually, lunging at an imaginary target.
text_zh: @見識了！@ 他隨意地揮舞著花劍，向一個假想的目標刺去。

source_en: @But you already know who I am, silly person!@
text_zh: @但你已經知道我是誰了，傻丫頭！@

source_en: @Oui, I teach ze fencing here in my salle, my school@
text_zh: @是的，我在這裡我的道場，我的學校教導擊劍@

source_en: @Is very difficult sometimes. Most fighters, zey have no subtlety, no finesse.
text_zh: @有時這非常困難。大多數戰士，他們沒有細膩，沒有精湛。

source_en: @But you, you look much better than that, my friend.@
text_zh: @不過你，我的朋友，你看起來比那個好得多。@

source_en: @He turns up his nose and sniffs aristocraticlly. Zey are not like you, mah friend! You are most talented!@
text_zh: @他高擰著鼻子，傲慢地嗅了嗅。他們跟你不一樣，我的朋友！你是最有才華的！@
@練習？在這裡？你一定是在開玩笑！@*

source_en: @No, come to ma salle sometime, zen we will spar, yes?@
text_zh: @不，有空來我的教室吧，到時我們切磋一下，好嗎？@

source_en: @I charge 70 gold for a session, but thou wilt benefit greatly. Is this agreeable,
text_zh: @我收一節課 70 黃金，但你會獲益良多。這樣沒問題，

source_en: @No? When you're ready, you 'ave but to ask, mah friend.@
text_zh: @不？等你準備好了，只要開口就好，我的朋友。@

source_en: @Zat simply means 'touch.' In fencing we score by touching ze opponent with ze foil tip.@
text_zh: @這只是意味著『觸及』。在擊劍中，我們用劍尖觸及對手來得分。@

source_en: @Zey are blunt on ze end, see? Ze first third of ze blade -near ze 'andle- is 'forte'--strong. It is good to parry with zis part of ze sword.@*
text_zh: @你看，它們末端是鈍的。劍葉的前三分之一——靠近劍柄的部分——是『 forte 』——強勁。用這部分劍來格擋是很好的。@*

source_en: @Ze rest of ze blade is 'foible'--weak and flexible. Ze foil, she is a very delicate thing. There must be much skill, yes?@*
text_zh: @劍葉的其餘部分是『 foible 』——柔弱且有彈性。花劍，它是一件非常精緻的東西。需要很高的技巧，對吧？@*

source_en: @You must 'old ze sword like a living bird: Too loose and she flies away. Too tight and she smothers. Just right, and...She sings very sweet!@*
text_zh: @你必須像握住一隻活鳥一樣握劍：太鬆了，它就飛走了。太緊了，它就窒息了。恰到好處，而...它會發出甜美的歌聲！@*

source_en: He strikes metal and the foil makes a pleasant ringing noise.
text_zh: 他擊打金屬，花劍發出悅耳的鳴響。

source_en: He greets you with an elaborate bow and flourish. @Good
text_zh: 他向你鞠躬致意，動作優雅華麗。@早安，

source_en: @Ave you come to moi for instruction? You 'ave but to ask, mah friend.@
text_zh: @你是來找我學藝嗎？只要開口就好，我的朋友。@

source_en: @Well, Avatar, I am Baron de Hugh.@
@I plan to build my reputation as a great fighter. My army and I will kill the mighty daemon Sin'Vraal!@
text_zh: @我打算建立我作為great fighter的聲譽。我和我的軍隊將擊敗強大的惡魔 Sin'Vraal！@

source_en: @He is a malevolent creature, lord over numerous servants who crawl about the desert.@
text_zh: @他是一個邪惡的生物，統治著無數在沙漠中爬行的僕從。@

source_en: @It is on the north-eastern tip of Britannia. Look it up on a map.@
text_zh: @它在Britannia的東北角。去地圖上找找看。@

source_en: @It is foolish to be courageous unless one is backed by a well-trained force of fighters. Or unless one happens to be the Avatar, I imagine.@
text_zh: @如果沒有訓練有素的戰鬥力量支援，勇敢是愚蠢的。或者，我想，除非你恰好是聖者。@

source_en: @I heard at the guild that the Avatar was in town!@
@Koronada says I will be considered for membership when I have done something noteworthy. Have ye ever done aught worthy of note?@
text_zh: @Koronada 說，當我做出值得注意的事情時，就會考慮讓我加入。你有過值得稱讚的舉動嗎？@

source_en: A commanding presence: a tall warrior in black armor.*
text_zh: 威嚴的存在：一位身穿黑色鎧甲的高大戰士。*

source_en: @Then surely Koronada has heard of ye.  Tell him your name and he may invite ye to join the Silver Serpent guild.@
text_zh: @那麼 Koronada 一定聽過你的名字。告訴他你的名字，他可能會邀請你加入 Silver Serpent 公會。@

source_en: @He is firm but fair.  He does not wish to see any unworthy person bear the Silver Serpent blazon.@
text_zh: @他嚴格但公正。他不想讓任何不配的人佩戴 Silver Serpent 的紋章。@

source_en: @I believe the silver serpent is a quick and highly venomous creature.@
text_zh: @我認為銀蛇是一種行動敏捷且毒性極強的生物。@

source_en: @A blazon is a shield marking, such as a Serpent.@
He stands and bows to you. @
@Good! I seek courageous warriors to accompany me.@
text_zh: 很好！我正在尋找勇敢的戰士陪我同行。

source_en: @Then why hast thou come to Serpent's Hold?@
@Well!@ She turns up her nose and leaves.
text_zh: 真是無聊！她撇了撇嘴，走了。

source_en: @I know nothing about that!@ She walks off in a huff.
text_zh: 我對那事一竅不通！她氣沖沖地走開了。

source_en: @That's right, me bucko. Why, I've sailed with Lord British and Captain Johne.@
text_zh: 說得對，老兄。說起來，我曾與英國大人和約翰船長一起航行過。 Captain Johne Lord British

source_en: @He walks with a limp, ye know. 'Fraid of mice, too, he is.@
text_zh: 你知道的，他走路一瘸一拐的。他還很怕老鼠呢。

source_en: Sherry turns to you, giving you a look of amused bewilderment only a talking mouse could.
text_zh: 雪莉轉過頭來看著你，露出一種只有會說話的老鼠才會露出的、充滿趣味與困惑的神情。 Sherry

source_en: @He offered to marry me but of course I refused. Didn't want to be tied down.@
text_zh: 他向我求婚了，但我當然拒絕了。我不願被束縛住。

source_en: Dupre leans towards Shamino and whispers, @That's an image no amount of ale could cleanse from the mind...@
text_zh: Dupre湊近Shamino耳語道：「那種景象，再多的麥酒也無法從腦海中洗去...」

source_en: Shamino shudders and nods in agreement
text_zh: Shamino顫抖著點了點頭表示贊同。

source_en: She looks around furtively first. @Well, now, I might have seen the likes of that in me travels...Tell ye what, matey: If ye give me a shield of the Order of the Serpent, I'll tell ye where that map be at.@
text_zh: 她先警惕地四下張望。「嗯，我或許曾在旅途中見過類似的地方...這樣吧，老兄：如果你給我一面蛇之秩序盾，我就告訴你地圖在哪裡。」

source_en: @I might even ask 'im to marry me.@ She winks slyly at you.
text_zh: 我甚至可能會求他向我求婚。她俏皮地向你眨了眨眼。

source_en: @If I had a Silver Serpent shield, I'd give it to Caradon.@
text_zh: 如果我有一面 Silver Serpent shield，我會把它給 Caradon。

source_en: @He's a fine, brave lad, he is.@
@That be quite a prize there, matey. Will ye trade it to me for a bit o' map?@
text_zh: @那可是件大獎品啊，夥計。願意拿它跟我換一小塊地圖嗎？@

source_en: From a little box Morchella hands over a piece of paper. It is a piece of the pirate map. @I was going to give this magic shield to Caradon but methinks I'll keep it for meself instead! Good
text_zh: Morchella 從一個小盒子裡拿出一張紙。那是海盜地圖的一部分。@我本來想把這面魔法盾牌給 Caradon 的，但我想還是留給我自己吧！好

source_en: @Then leave me be!@ She turns her back angrily on you and walks off.@
text_zh: @別管我了！@ 她氣憤地背過身去，走了。@

source_en: A tough-looking woman with a walk like a troll.*
text_zh: 一個長相兇悍的女人，走路像巨魔一樣。*

source_en: @Now all I need is a magic sword; then methinks I'll be a knight. @
text_zh: @現在我只需要一把魔法劍；這樣我想我就成為騎士了。 @

source_en: @I be a retired sailor, that I am.@
@I am a knight. Currently, though, I am recovering from a battle.@
text_zh: @我是一名騎士。不過目前，我正在從戰鬥中恢復。@

source_en: @I've just come home from fighting in Yew. I fought gargoyles near the shrine.@
text_zh: @我剛從 Yew 的戰鬥中回來。我在聖殿附近戰鬥了石像鬼。@

source_en: @There I was, with ten companions. Outside the Shrine of Justice stood two gargoyles. I saw them drink from little vials right before they charged us. Large, clumsy brutes they were. They should have been easy to dispatch...But they fought like cyclones!@*
text_zh: @當時，我有十個同伴。Shrine of Justice外有兩隻石像鬼。我看到它們在衝向我們之前喝了一些小瓶子裡的東西。它們是巨大、笨拙的兇獸。它們本該很容易擊殺...但它們像颶風一樣戰鬥！@*

source_en: @My captain ordered me to go to town for help when only we two and the gargoyles were left standing. Just as I was returning with some guards, I saw the monsters throwing my friends' dead bodies onto a fire. Then the gargoyles looked up at us and fell over, both dead.@
text_zh: @我的船長命令我去城裡尋求幫助，當時只剩我們兩個和石像鬼站著。就在我要帶著一些衛兵回來時，我看到怪物們把我朋友們的屍體扔進火裡。然後石像鬼看向我們，倒下死亡。@

source_en: @Yes, just like that: all of a sudden! I only wish I could have killed them myself, for vengeance!@
text_zh: @是的，就是那樣：突然之間！我真希望我能親手殺了他們，為他報仇！@

source_en: @If they had not burned his body, my captain might have been resurrected. For a moment, Caradon looks ready to weep. The beasts!@
text_zh: @如果他們沒有燒毀他的屍體，我的隊長也許能被復活。片刻間，Caradon 看起來快要流淚了。那些野獸！@

source_en: @Monsters with eyes like coals and skin like rock.@
text_zh: @眼睛像煤塊、皮膚像岩石的怪物。@

source_en: A paladin with a longsword on his back.*
text_zh: 一位背著長劍的聖武士。*

source_en: @I am pleased to hear that thou art well. I wish I were healthy again.@
text_zh: @很高興聽到你恢復了健康。我真希望我也能再健康起來。@

source_en: @Sir Caradon of Trinsic, at thy service.@
A large black woman with a loud laugh.*
text_zh: 一位大笑聲響亮的高個黑皮膚女子。*

source_en: @Hello, hello!@ she cries, clapping her hands together.*
@You're here again! Good.@ She smiles widely.
text_zh: 「你又來了！真好。」她露出燦爛的笑容。

source_en: @I sell ale, mead, wine, mutton and Waybread.@
text_zh: 「我賣啤酒、麥酒、葡萄酒、羊肉和旅行麵包。」

source_en: @Amanda, but you can call me 'Miss Mandy'.@
@Come to my tavern during business hours and I'll be glad to serve you.@
text_zh: 「營業時間來我的旅館，我很樂意為你服務。」

source_en: @He's been in here a few times. He has a homesick look, he does.@
text_zh: 「他來這裡幾次了。他看起來很思鄉。」

source_en: @Remember to tell your friends 'bout Miss Mandy!@
text_zh: 「記得跟你的朋友提一下Miss Mandy！」

source_en: @Come back when you have some gold.@
@You don't have room to carry it.@
text_zh: 你的隨身空間不夠，無法攜帶它。

text_zh: 你的朋友 Iolo 翻了個白眼。「 @這種智慧我們完全可以不要！@”

source_en: He ask anxiously @Do you like it,
@Such a picky eater. No wonder you're so skinny,
text_zh: @真是個挑食的人。怪不得你這麼瘦，

source_en: @Being a cook is like being an adventurer,
. I must gather up all my ingredients with care.@
text_zh: 。我必須小心地收集所有食材。@

source_en: @So that I have the right ingredients,
@Adventurers are always searching for this or that,
text_zh: @冒險者總是在尋找這個或那個，

source_en: . So are cooks. Do you know of Magincian Pastry?@
text_zh: 。廚師也是。你知道 Magincian Pastry 嗎？@

source_en: . My friend Sandy gave me the recipe...I'm only missing one ingredient...@
text_zh: . 我的朋友桑迪（Sandy）給了我這個食譜...我只缺少一種材料...@

source_en: , but I cannot get one of the ingredients...@
text_zh: , 但我找不到其中一種材料...@

source_en: @I sure would appreciate it if you brought it back for me if you came across one in your travels,
text_zh: @如果你在外旅行時碰巧找到一個，帶回來給我，我將非常感激，

source_en: ...If you could find time for old Shubin, that is...@*
text_zh: ...如果你願意為老舒賓（Shubin）抽出時間的話...@*

source_en: @Would it be too much trouble to bring me back a dragon's egg,
text_zh: @帶一顆龍蛋回來給我會太麻煩嗎，

A man with a wide bottom. His voice is almost like a woman's*
text_zh: 一個身材矮胖的男人。他的聲音幾乎像女人的聲音*

source_en: @Ooh, you look so thin! Here, have a bite of bread.@ He gives you a roll; it is still warm from the oven.*
text_zh: @噢，你看起來好瘦！給，吃一口面包。@他給了你一個麵包；它還是從烤箱裡拿出來時溫熱的。*

source_en: @Good!@ After accepting your gold, he hands over the
text_zh: 很好！ 接受你的金子後，他交出

source_en: A tall man, covered with scars and drooling uncontrollably.*
text_zh: 一個滿身傷疤、口水直流的高大男人。*

source_en: @Are ya learnin' how ta speak or do ya need somethin'?@
text_zh: @你是在學說話，還是需要什麼？@

source_en: @Come to my shop when I'm open!@
text_zh: @我營業時間時歡迎來到我的商店！@

source_en: @I's a great craftsman, I is. Me shop is 'uge! You'll hafta be more specific: weapons or armor?@
text_zh: @我是個偉大的工匠，我是。我的店很大！你得說得更具體點：武器還是防具？@

source_en: @Come to me shop when it's open!@
@Huh? Oh, yeah, da serpent shield.@ He looks around and then at the ceiling. @I needs a snake shield, a chunk o' gold, and a magic gem. Have ya got dese tings?@
text_zh: @什麼？哦，對，蛇盾。@ 他環顧四周，然後看向天花板。 @我需要一個蛇盾、一大塊金子，還有一顆魔法寶石。你有這些東西嗎？@

source_en: Gherick takes the items and goes to work in his forge. After a while, he returns.*
text_zh: Gherick 拿走物品，並前往他的鍛爐開始工作。過了一會兒，他回來了。*

source_en: He holds up a beautiful golden shield that glows softly. @Here ya go. Just as promised.@
text_zh: 他舉起一面美麗的金盾，散發著柔和的光芒。 @給你了。就像承諾的那樣。@

source_en: @You ain't got all that I asked for.@
@What, you gone daft? I already made ya one!@
text_zh: @什麼，你瘋了嗎？我已經幫你做了一個了！@

source_en: @You ain't the sort what'd be interested.@
text_zh: @你不像是那種會有興趣的人。@

source_en: @I ain't gonna tell you, you'd steal me brilliant ideas!@
text_zh: @我不會告訴你的，你會偷走我 brilliant 的主意！

source_en: @I got some other stuff you could buy, though.@
text_zh: @不過，我有一些其他你可以購買的東西。@

source_en: @She's got the best food in the land. Go see for yerself.@
text_zh: @她這裡有全國最好的食物。自己去看看就知道。@

source_en: @A fine warrior. New to this area.@
text_zh: @一位優秀的戰士。剛到這片地區。@

source_en: @Shut the door on yer way out,@ he snarls.
text_zh: @出去的時候把門關好，@ 他怒吼道。

source_en: Le'nard takes your gold and hands over the
text_zh: Le'nard 收下你的金幣，並交給你

source_en: You see a short, fat, rosy-cheeked man with long hair covering his eyes.
text_zh: 你看到一個矮小、胖乎、面紅耳赤的男人，長髮遮住了他的眼睛。

source_en: The man seems afraid of you. @Wh-what do you want?@
text_zh: 那個男人似乎很害怕你。@你…你想要什麼？@

source_en: As faint as a whisper comes the word @Le'nard.@
text_zh: 一陣輕如耳語的聲音傳來了名字@Le'nard。@
@我縫製長褲、束腰外衣和連衣裙，

@Please come back when my shop is open.@
text_zh: 請等我店鋪開門時再來。

source_en: gold pieces and takes the thread.
@But - but none of you has any thread to sell.@
text_zh: 但是——但是你們誰都沒有線團可以賣。

source_en: @I'm terribly sorry, but I can't sell it for less!@
text_zh: 非常抱歉，但我不能以更低的价格出售！

source_en: @I wouldn't know where to begin. Ask Marissa in Paws.@
text_zh: 我不知道該從哪裡開始。去問問爪印店（Paws）的瑪麗莎（Marissa）吧。

source_en: He looks around, then waves goodbye.
text_zh: 他環顧四周，然後揮手告別。

source_en: @I'm sorry, but I really don't think you can carry that.@
text_zh: 抱歉，但我真的不認為你能帶著那個東西。

source_en: @Oh, sorry. I thought thou wanted to buy something.@
text_zh: 噢，抱歉。我還以為你想買點什麼。

source_en: gold. Do you still want it?@
@...ambush... too many to fight... all dead..@
@I got away... but one followed. I...@
text_zh: 我逃出來了...但有個人跟蹤了我。我...

source_en: As his voice trails off, his eyes roll into the back of his head.
text_zh: 他的聲音逐漸微弱，眼珠翻向後方。

source_en: A mortally wounded guard. He looks up at you.
text_zh: 一名重傷垂死的衛兵。他抬頭看著你。

source_en: His eyes roll into the back of his head and he says nothing more.
text_zh: 他的眼珠翻向後方，再沒有說任何話。

source_en: @Ugghngn... too much.. @ He breaks out into a coughing fit.
text_zh: 嗯...太多了..”他開始劇烈咳嗽。

source_en: He doesn't respond to your question. He is slipping in and out of consciousness.
text_zh: 他沒有回應你的問題。他在意識清醒與昏迷之間搖擺不定。

source_en: Approaching from seemingly out of nowhere, an unsavoury-looking guard stands before you. You then realize you are surrounded by his henchmen.
text_zh: 一個看似從無聲無息中逼近的邋遢衛兵擋在你面前。隨後你意識到自己被他的手下團團圍住。

source_en: He notices you clutching the Rune of Honesty.
text_zh: 他注意到你緊握著誠實符文。

source_en: @Say.. that be quite a trinket thou'rt carrying. T'would fetch us fair price on the antiquities market. Much too expensive for the likes of ye...@
text_zh: 看你手上帶著的這件小飾品，相當不錯。在古董市場上能賣個好價錢。對你們這種人來說..實在是太貴了...

source_en: Noticing the rogue guard's henchmen slowly closing in, Shamino leans towards you and whispers. @Careful
text_zh: 注意到那名不法衛兵的手下正在緩緩包圍過來，Shamino湊近你低聲說道。@小心

source_en: Shamino clutches his weapon, never once keeping his eyes off the graverobbers.
text_zh: Shamino緊握武器，目光始終沒有離開那些盜墓賊。

source_en: , it is thy lucky day. Hand over that artifact and we won't kill ye.@
text_zh: ，算你僥倖。把那件神器交出來，否則我們就殺了你。@

source_en: @Knave, the Avatar will not give in to such a request from a petty criminal such as thyself!@
text_zh: @無恥之徒，聖者不會向像你這樣的卑鄙罪犯屈服！@

source_en: @Very well. Prepare to join these unfortunate souls in the abyss...@
text_zh: @很好。準備加入這些不幸靈魂的行列，一同墜入深淵...@

source_en: You put the rune into your pack and draw your weapon, declining the rogue's request.
text_zh: 你把符文放進背包，拔出武器，拒絕了那名不法之徒的要求。

source_en: @We been waitin' to break into that vault for a while now. As luck would have it, thou foundest the key and the prizes within.@
text_zh: @我們早就想撬開那個金庫了。運氣真好，你找到了鑰匙，還有裡面的寶物。@

source_en: The bearer of this letter is granted permission to visit the solitary confinement cells in the Yew city jail. This permission is given by my hand this day.  -- Lenora.
text_zh: 持有此信者獲准進入 Yew 市監獄的單人牢房。此許可由我於今日親自簽署。 -- Lenora。

source_en: Yorl will be asleep by then and I can leave him a letter that he will find on the docks once we have left. Until next we meet, I shall be thinking of thee.
text_zh: 到那時 Yorl 應該已經睡著了，我可以在我們離開後，留下一封信給他，讓他能在碼頭找到。期待下次再會，我將會時刻想著你。

source_en: If you're looking for the clue, there's something for you under a plant in Serpent's Hold.
text_zh: 如果你在找線索，Serpent's Hold 有一株植物下面藏著給你的東西。

source_en: This scroll is filled with Lord British's notes on his astronomical observations.
text_zh: 這份卷軸裡寫滿了 Lord British 關於天文觀測的筆記。

source_en: Ship deed to the Majestic Seahorse, commissioned by Peer of Jhelom.
text_zh: Majestic Seahorse 的船籍證書，由 Jhelom 的貴族訂購。 Peer

source_en: Ship deed to the Beckoning Siren, commissioned by Trebor of Minoc.
text_zh: Beckoning Siren 的船籍證書，由 Minoc 的 Trebor 訂購。

source_en: Your next hint is under a beehive in Minoc.
text_zh: 你的下一個線索在 Minoc 的蜂巢下面。

source_en: You're doing well! Next you should search the harpsichord in the Blue Bottle Tavern.
text_zh: 你做得很好！接下來你應該去 Blue Bottle Tavern 搜尋那架大鍵琴。

source_en: Well done! Now go search the beds in the jail in Yew.
text_zh: 做得好！現在去 Yew 的監獄搜尋牀鋪。

source_en: Most people would have given up by now... But since you haven't, you can find the next hint under a cauldron in New Magincia.
text_zh: 大多數人此時已經放棄了...但既然你沒有，你可以在 New Magincia 的鍋下面找到下一個線索。

source_en: You're almost there! Search the stone lions in Lord British's castle.
text_zh: 你快到了！去 Lord British 的城堡搜尋石獅子。

source_en: Ho eyo he hum! You've won, you've won! Go to Iolo's hut and ask Smith the horse to tell you the clue!
text_zh: 哈艾優赫姆！你贏了，你贏了！去Iolo's hut，問問馬兒Smith，讓他告訴你線索！

source_en: I look to the moon and stars,
Somewhere underneath of them she's there..
text_zh: 某處在她們之下，她就在那裡..

source_en: Let it be known throughout Britannia that Myron, once of the Royal Guard, is hereby pardoned of the charge of desertion. Though his courage faltered in battle, the Avatar hath spoken on his behalf, and I, Sir Geoffrey, Captain of the Guard, honor that judgment.
text_zh: 茲布告於Britannia全境：前衛隊隊員 Myron，特此赦免其逃兵指控。雖然他在戰事中膽怯，但聖者已為他說情，而我，衛隊長 Sir Geoffrey，尊重此判決。

source_en: By my hand and seal, let no man pursue him further, nor levy punishment upon him. Instead, may he find the strength to serve Britannia in peace, and by Compassion redeem himself.
text_zh: 以我之手與印記為證，任何人均不得繼續追捕他，亦不得對其施加懲罰。願他能找回力量，以和平方式效忠Britannia，並以慈悲贖回自身。

source_en: This is not a valid scroll QUAL attribute!  Stop cheating!
text_zh: 這不是有效的卷軸 QUAL 屬性！停止作弊！

source_en: This scroll contains Captain Johne's notes on the gargoyle language. After studying it for a while, you are now able to understand them!
text_zh: 這張卷軸包含 Captain Johne 關於石像鬼語言的筆記。研究一番後，你現在能理解它們了！

source_en:
I beseech thee.. give me more time to repay my debt to you. Our nets have been empty as of late, so income is sparse. I promise that the money will come up, I just need more time. Marney
				means everything to me and she's all I have left. If not for me, grant the time for Marney's sake. Please consider mine request, and I will give thee the money owed.
text_zh: 我懇求你..再給我一些時間，讓我償還欠你的債。我們最近一直沒有捕到魚，因此收入很少。我保證錢一定會湊齊，只是需要多一點時間。Marney 對我而言就是一切，她是我僅剩的家人。即使不是為了我，也請看在 Marney 的份上寬限一些時間。請考慮我的請求，我會把欠你的錢還上。
帶上愛意，來自表兄 Manrel。

source_en: Ship deed to the Lady o' the Sea, commissioned by Fentrissa of Bucaneer's Den.
text_zh: Lady o' the Sea 號船隻產權證，由 Bucaneer's Den 的 Fentrissa 委託。

source_en: I have received word from Sir Geoffrey that the Shrine of Honor hath also fallen prey to the gargoyles. Since thou'rt already in Trinsic on thy last assignment, I need thine assistance. Thy new assignment is to scout out the Shrine of Honor and gauge the size of the occupying force. Reinforcements are scarce and must be routed to areas where there are the most gargoyle activity. Respond quickly, and may the virtues be with thee. In honor
text_zh: 我已從 Sir Geoffrey 處獲悉，Shrine of Honor也遭石像鬼侵佔。既然你上次任務就在特蘭西克，我需要你的協助。你的新任務是偵察Shrine of Honor，並評估駐守部隊的規模。補兵資源匱乏，必須調派至石像鬼活動最頻繁的地區。請迅速回覆，願美德與你同在。以榮譽之名 Trinsic

source_en: Plans for the construction of a hot air balloon

First you must have a wicker balloon basket made, large enough to carry several passengers. Then you'll need a big iron cauldron, to hold a fire to generate the hot air. Next you must have a huge bag sewn out of silk, to hold the hot air in. Lastly, get enough rope to tie the balloon securely to the basket. Once you've gathered all of these together, use these plans to assemble them. When flying your balloon, you'll find that a ship's anchor makes the best ballast, and is also useful for stopping the balloon where and when you wish.
text_zh: 首先，你必須製作一個柳條籃子，要足夠大以容納多名乘客。然後，你需要一個大鐵鍋，用來生火產生熱氣。接下來，你必須用絲綢縫製一個巨大的袋子來盛裝熱氣。最後，準備足夠的繩子，將氣球牢固地綁在籃子上。當你把這些材料湊齊後，使用這些計劃組裝它們。駕駛氣球時，你會發現船錨是最好的壓艙物，對於讓氣球停在想要的時間和地點也非常有用。

source_en: From the desk of Lord British
text_zh: 來自 Lord British 書桌的信

source_en: As decreed by Lord British, the completion of the sewer systems beneath the city will proceed. Construction of the sewers will require demolition of the Royal Prison. Upon our liege's orders I have arranged for the transport of the remaining prisoners, Drudgeworth and Saduj, to the prison in Yew. Pridgarm, jailer of Yew, hath been instructed to put these dangerous criminals in solitary confinement. The transport carriage will be waiting outside the castle gates at midnight in two days, as to not disturb the townsfolk with their mad ravings. Thou wilt accompany the prisoner transport to Yew, and a hefty purse of gold and a promotion is waiting for thee once the transport hath been completed. Contact me personally if thou hast any questions, our liege is much too busy as of late.
text_zh: 遵從 Lord British 的旨意，城市下水道的建設將繼續進行。下水道工程需要拆除皇家監獄。遵從我們主君的命令，我已安排將剩餘的囚犯 Drudgeworth and Saduj 護送至 Yew 的監獄。Yew 的典獄長 Pridgarm 已受命將這些危險罪犯關入單獨監禁。護送車將在兩天後午夜等待於城堡大門外，以免他們的瘋言瘋語擾民。你將護送囚犯前往 Yew，護送完成後，一大袋金幣和晉升將等著你。如有任何疑問，請親自聯繫我，我們的主君最近非常繁忙。

source_en: Chuckles, on behalf of Lord British
By proclamation of Lord British this is an official document denoting ownership of the heretofore mentioned sailing vessel. Forgery of this title is prohibited under law no. 1989832.A5, section 809.
text_zh: 經 Lord British 公告，這是正式文件，標註前述帆船的所有權。根據法律編號 1989832.A5 第 809 條，偽造此產權證屬違法行為。

source_en: @Strange.. this letter is stained with blood..@
My patience with you has run out after our last meeting, as I have come back empty without payment. I don't run a charity, and you've had plenty of time to repay thy loan.
text_zh: 上次見面後，我已對你失去耐心，因為我空手而回，分文未獲。我這裡不是慈善機構，你已有了足夠的時間來償還貸款。

source_en: The next time I come into town, you better have my money ready. If you have nothing but more excuses for me, I might be inclined to take some collateral...
text_zh: 下次我進城時，你最好把錢準備好。如果你除了更多藉口之外一無所有，我可能會傾向於收取一些抵押品...

source_en: You have until tomorrow eve. I'll return in the night, at our pre-arranged meeting place. Don't be late, and don't come empty handed.
text_zh: 你在明天日落前都有時間。我會趁夜裡回到我們預先約定的會合地點。別遲到，也別空手而來。

source_en: I count down the hours until we meet again. You are a lone beacon of light in my darkness since my father was killed by the gargoyles. I have decided to come with you on the voyage you mentioned to me in your last visit to town.
text_zh: 我分秒計算著再次與你相見的日子。自從父親被石像鬼殺害以來，你便成為我黑暗中唯一的光明。我已決定加入你上次來鎮上時提到的那趟航行之旅。

source_en: I look forward to the voyage with you and seeing the world, since I've never seen much beyond mine home. Yorl has forbidden me from seeing you, so we will need to meet up in secret. I will be waiting for you at the docks before midnight in three days.
text_zh: 我期待與你同行，看見這世界，因為我從來沒有見過我家以外的風景。Yorl 禁止我見你，所以我們需要祕密會合。三天後午夜前，我會在碼頭等你。

source_en: @May thy diligence maintain thee on thy quest.@
text_zh: @願你的勤勉能在你的征程中助你一臂之力。@

source_en: @Thou wilt need control of others to succede in thy quest, Avatar.@*
text_zh: @在妳的征程中，聖者，妳將需要掌控他人以獲得成功。@*

source_en: @But thou wilt most of all need control of thyself to be worthy.@*
text_zh: @但最重要的是，妳需要掌控自己才能配得上。@*

source_en: @I admire thy deeds and thy control.@
text_zh: @我欽佩妳的作為和妳的自我克制。@
@你的行為展現了對控制的瞭解。@

source_en: @Thy deeds show a need for more Control.@
text_zh: @你的行為顯示你更需要控制。@

source_en: @Thy deeds show a lack of Control.@
@May thy control help you succeed in thy quest.@
text_zh: @願你的控制幫助你在任務中取得成功。@

source_en: @Thou wilt need passion to succeed in thy quest, Avatar.@*
text_zh: @你需要受難劇才能在任務中取得成功，聖者。@*

source_en: @But thou must limit thy passion, lest balance and order be lost.@*
text_zh: @但你必須限制你的受難劇，以免失去平衡和秩序。@*

source_en: @I admire thy deeds and thy Passion.@
text_zh: @我欽佩你的行為和你的受難劇。@

source_en: @Thy deeds the merits of thy passion.@
text_zh: @你的行為體現了你的受難劇的美德。@

source_en: @Thy deeds show misguided but strong passion.@
text_zh: @你的行為顯示了錯誤但強烈的受難劇。@

source_en: @Thy deeds show nought but unlimited passion.@
text_zh: @你的行為只顯示無限的受難劇。@

source_en: @May thy passion help you succeed in thy quest.@
text_zh: @願你的受難劇幫助你在任務中取得成功。@

source_en: @Thou wilt need Diligence to succeed in thy quest, Avatar.@*
text_zh: @要在你的征途上成功，你需要勤奮，聖者。@*

source_en: @But thou wilt most of all need a clear vision of thy goal to be worthy.@*
text_zh: @但你需要對目標有清晰的視野，才值得擁有它。@*

source_en: @I admire thy deeds and thy Diligence.@
text_zh: @我欽佩你的舉止和你的勤奮。@

source_en: @Thy deeds show the value of thy Diligence.@
text_zh: @你的舉止展現了你勤奮的價值。@
@你的舉止展現了誤導的勤奮。@

source_en: @Thy deeds show a lack of Diligence.@
text_zh: @你的舉止展現了勤奮的缺乏。@

source_en: Which spell do you want to enchant it with?
text_zh: 你想用哪個法術來附魔它？

source_en: @Marney, I have uncovered evidence proving Michael was responsible for your father's murder. It was not the gargoyles.@
text_zh: @Marney，我發現了證據，證明 Michael 是你父親謀殺案的兇手。並不是石像鬼。@

source_en: Before you could protest, Chuckles responds for you.
text_zh: 在你來得及抗議之前，Chuckles 已經代你回答了。

source_en: You pick up the concave lens and pass it to the King.
text_zh: 你拿起凹透鏡並遞給國王。

source_en: @Was the book ever truly ours, Your Majesty? Was it written for Britannia alone?@
text_zh: @陛下，這本書曾經真正屬於我們嗎？它是只為Britannia而寫下的嗎？@

source_en: @Thou dost no longer hold the Codex, but is its wisdom indeed lost? Look into the Vortex, and let the Codex answer for itself!@
text_zh: @你不再持有法典，但它的智慧真的失落了嗎？望入渦流，讓法典自行昭示吧！@

source_en: As Lord British holds the glass before the wall, the Codex of Ultimate Wisdom wavers against a myriad of swimming stars!*
text_zh: 當Lord British將玻璃置於牆前，最終智慧法典在無數流轉的星光中搖曳。*

source_en: And waves of heat shimmer in the air, heralding the birth of another red gate!
text_zh: 熱浪在空氣中閃爍，預示著另一道紅色門的誕生！

source_en: Quickly you reach down to seize the convex lens...*
text_zh: 你迅速彎腰抓取凸透鏡...*

source_en: ...and you press it into the hand of the towering Gargoyle king, meeting his sunken eyes.
text_zh: ...並將其放入高聳的石像鬼國王手中，與他凹陷的雙目相對視。

source_en: @Join my Lord in his search for peace, I beg thee.@
text_zh: @我懇求你，加入吾主尋找和平的行列。@

source_en: At your urging, King Draxinusom reluctantly raises his lens to catch the light. As Lord British holds up his own lens, every eye in the room, human and Gargoyle alike, fixes upon the image of the Codex which shines upon the wall.
text_zh: 在你的勸說下，Draxinusom 國王不情願地舉起他的透鏡捕捉光線。當 Lord British 也舉起他的透鏡時，房間裡的每一雙眼睛，無論是人類還是鷹身人，都盯著牆壁上閃耀的《法典》影像。

source_en: The ancient book opens. Both kings gaze upon its pages in spellbound silence, as the eloquence of Ultimate Wisdom is revealed in the toungues of each lord's domain. You, too, can read the answers the Codex gives...
text_zh: 古老的書冊打開了。兩位國王注視著它的頁面，陷入出神的沉默，至高的智慧在各自領主的領域語言中展現其雄辯。你也能閱讀《法典》給出的答案...

source_en: ...and when it's wisdom is gleaned, when Lord British and King Draxinusom turn to each other as friends, hating no longer, fearing no more, you know that your mission in Britannia has ended at last.
text_zh: ...當智慧被汲取，當 Lord British 和 Draxinusom 國王彼此轉向，成為朋友，不再仇恨，不再恐懼，你知道你在Britannia的任務終於結束了。

source_en: A glowing portal springs from the floor!
text_zh: 一道發光的光門從地面躍出！

source_en: @That's it, you win. Games over. Back to earth I go. Thanks for playing. See you in 200 years! Avatar, out!@
text_zh: @就是這樣，你贏了。遊戲結束。我回地球去了。感謝遊玩。200年後見！聖者，退場！@

source_en: From it's crimson depths Lord British emerges, trialed by the mage Nystul.
text_zh: Lord British 從深紅色的深處走出，受到了法師 Nystul 的審判。

source_en: Anguish and disbelief prevail on the royal seer's face, but Lord British directs his stony gaze at you and speaks as if to a wayward child.
text_zh: 痛苦和不信佔據了皇家預言者的臉龐，但 Lord British 用堅毅的目光看著你，說話時彷彿在對一個調皮的孩子。

source_en: @Tender-handed stroke a nettle, and it stings you for your pains.@*
text_zh: @輕輕撫摸荊棘，它會因妳的痛楚而刺傷妳。@*

source_en: @Grasp it as a man of mettle, and it soft as silk remains.@
text_zh: @以堅強者的姿態握住它，它便如絲綢般柔軟。@

source_en: @If there be any virtue and if there be any praise, think on these things.@*
text_zh: @若有德行，若可稱讚，思想這一切。@*

source_en: @The universe is so vast and so ageless..@*
text_zh: @宇宙如此浩瀚，如此亙古無涯..@*

source_en: @..that the life of one man can only be justified@*
@Honor may be assailed, but can never be hurt.@*
text_zh: @榮譽雖可遭攻擊，卻永不受傷。@*

source_en: @Surprised by unjust force, but not enthralled.@*
text_zh: @雖驚於不義之力，卻不受其束縛。@*

source_en: @Throughout this varied and eternal world, soul is the only element.@*
text_zh: @在這豐富而永恆的世界裡，靈魂是唯一要素。@*

source_en: @The wealth of the spirit is the only true wealth..@*
text_zh: @靈性的財富，是唯一真正的財富..@*

source_en: @No beast so fierce but shows some touch of pity. Sweet mercy is nobility's true badge.@
text_zh: @縱有兇猛之獸，亦顯慈悲之心。仁慈乃尊貴的真正徽章。@

source_en: @The humblest citizen of all the land, when clad in the armor of a righteous cause,@*
text_zh: @最卑微的公民，身披正義之因的盔甲，*@

source_en: @is stronger than all the hosts of error.@*
@There is naught else for you to learn here and now. Return when thy journey has progressed further.@
text_zh: @你在此處已無可學習之事。待你的旅程進展更多時再回來吧。@

source_en: The gate wanes rapidly as you and Dupre charge through...*
text_zh: 當你與 Dupre 衝過大門時，它迅速消散了...*

source_en: From the mob's vanguard, three of the abominations scramble towards the gate.  Driven by fury, the creatures hurl their bodies into the portal's last handspan of light!
text_zh: 從人羣的先鋒中，三個醜怪之物向大門爬去。被狂怒驅使，這些生物將自己投身進光門最後殘存的光輝中！

source_en: Snatching the fallen priest's book, Iolo dives into the redness with Shamino at his heels.  The howling throng surges forward, all of one terrible mind.
text_zh: Iolo 抓起跌倒神父的書，跟著 Shamino 跳入紅光中。嚎叫的人羣湧向前方，彷彿只有一個可怕的心智在支配著所有人。

source_en: Silent red light fills the darkness. There is the wooden clack of a crossbow, and a violet fletched rose blooms in the priest's barren forehead.*
text_zh: 靜謐的紅光填滿了黑暗。聽見弩機發出的木製咔噠聲，一朵帶有紫色尾羽的玫瑰綻放在神父光禿的額頭上。*

source_en: Friendly faces vault from a newborn moongate, while a rain of quarrels holds the furious mob at bay. The knight Dupre's sword flashes twice in the darkness, slicing away your bonds!*
text_zh: 友善的面孔從新生成的月門中躍出，而如雨般的箭矢將狂怒的人羣擋在遠處。騎士 Dupre 的劍在黑暗中閃爍了兩次，斬斷了你的束縛！*

source_en: Catcalls, the dagger, a scream, Death....
text_zh: 嘲罵聲、匕首、尖嘯聲、死亡....

source_en: Pandemonium. Shrieks of rage, of terror.
text_zh: 混沌一片。憤怒的尖叫，恐懼的哀嚎。

source_en: From the inevitable, an impossibility emerges.*
text_zh: 從必然之中，出現了一個不可能。*

source_en: Shouts and jeers explode from the masses as the priest slams shut the book. In his hand a malignant dagger drips with moonlight.*
text_zh: 人羣發出歡呼與嘲弄聲，神父用力合上了書。他手中握著一把散發著邪惡氣息的匕首，滴落著月光。*

source_en: You close your eyes. A dying scream, certainly your own, curdles the air.**
text_zh: 你閉上了眼睛。一聲垂死的尖叫，確定是你自己的聲音，在空氣中凝固。**

source_en: ...but you have no place to go.
The leader unwraps a velvet covered, brass-bound book and recites from it in a formal, stilted tounge.*
text_zh: 領袖人物展開一本覆有絨布、包著黃銅邊框的書，並以正式而僵硬的語調誦讀。*

source_en: Before you can offer a protest to the creatures who surround you, scaly claws grasp your body.
text_zh: 在你來得及向環繞著你的生物提出異議之前，鱗片狀的爪子就抓住了你的身體。

source_en: With unearthly strength, the monsters bind you to the altar stone!
text_zh: 憑藉非人的力量，這些怪物將你綁在了祭壇石上！

source_en: Kneeling, the hordes sway and chant as a stately winged nightmare steps forward.*
text_zh: 跪著的人羣搖曳並吟唱，一個高大的有翼噩夢向前邁步。*

source_en: Dazed, you emerge from the portal to find yourself standing on a desolate plain. Nearby, rests a massive rune-struck altar, shrouded in moonlit fog.
text_zh: 你茫然若失地從傳送門走出，發現自己站在一片荒涼的平原上。附近，一座刻滿符文的大型祭壇靜置其中，被月光下的霧氣籠罩。

source_en: At first the plain is still.  Then a hundred voices raise a slow, deathlike song, drawing closer and closer with each passing moment. You are seized by an urge to run...
text_zh: 起初平原是寂靜的。然後，一百個聲音唱起一首緩慢、似死一般的歌聲，隨著時間流逝越來越近。你心裡湧起一股逃跑的衝動...

source_en: Exultant memories wash over you as you clutch the stone. When you last saw an orb such as this, it was cast down by Lord British to banish the tyrant Blackthorn!*
text_zh: 當你緊握住石頭時，喜悅的記憶湧上心頭。上次看到這種球體時，是 Lord British 將它擊落，以驅逐暴君 Blackthorn！*

source_en: Abruptly, the portal quivers and begins to sink into the ground. Its crimson light wanes! Desperation makes the decision an easy one.
text_zh: 突然間，傳送門開始顫抖並沉入地面。它的深紅色光線變弱了！絕望讓這個決定變得容易。

source_en: But your joy soon gives way to apprehension. The gate to Britannia has always been blue... as blue as the morning sky.
text_zh: 但你的喜悅很快轉為擔憂。通往 Britannia 的大門一直是藍色的...藍得像清晨的天空。

source_en: Near the stones, the smell of damp, blasted earth hangs in the air. In a frozen moment of lightning struck daylight, you glimpse a tiny obsidian stone in the midst of the circle!
text_zh: 在石頭附近，潮濕而破碎的泥土氣味瀰漫在空中。在閃電劃過的凝固瞬間，你瞥見圓環中央有一顆小小的黑曜石！
好奇的你把它撿了起來...

source_en: Lightning among the stones! Is this a sign from distant Britannia?
text_zh: 巨石之間閃過雷霆！這是來自遠方Britannia的預兆嗎？

source_en: You bolt from your house, stumbling, running blind in the storm. Into the forest, down the path, through the rain... to the stones.
text_zh: 你從家中衝出，腳步踉蹌，在風暴中盲目奔跑。穿過森林，沿著小徑，衝入雨幕...來到巨石旁。

source_en: Upon your world, five seasons have passed since your triumphant homecoming from Britannia.*
text_zh: 在你離開Britannia凱旋歸鄉以來，你的世界已歷過五個季節。*

source_en: ...and within moments, the storm is upon you.
text_zh: ...片刻之後，風暴便撲向了你的面門。

source_en: You have traded the Avatar's life of peril and adventure for the lonely serenity of a world at peace.*
text_zh: 你捨棄了聖者那充滿危險與冒險的生活，換取了在這個太平世界中的孤寂與寧靜。*

source_en: But television supermen cannot take the place of friends who died at your side!*
text_zh: 但電視裡的超級英雄，無法取代那些曾與你並肩戰死的朋友！*

source_en: After a time, you return to your comrades.
text_zh: 過了許久，你回到了同伴們身邊。

source_en: You try to ignore the nagging voice in the back of your mind that keeps saying, @You shouldn't have wasted time like that.@
text_zh: 你試圖忽視腦海深處那個不斷吶喊的的聲音，它一直在說：@你本不該在那裡浪費時間。@

source_en: After a while, you and he wander back to the rest of the caravan, weary but satisfied.
text_zh: 過了一陣子，你和他在滿足而疲憊中，漫步回到商隊其餘人員身邊。

source_en: You try to ignore the nagging voice in the back of your head that says you shouldn't have wasted time like that.
text_zh: 你試圖忽視腦海深處那個聲音，它說你不該在那裡浪費時間。

source_en: You put the rune into your pack and draw your weapon, declining the rogue's request.
text_zh: 你把符文放進背包，拔出武器，拒絕了那名不法之徒的要求。

source_en: You sleep in a comfortable bed...You wake rested and eat a large breakfast.
text_zh: 你睡在舒適的牀上...你睡足了覺，吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。

source_en: You sleep in a comfortable bed...You wake rested and eat a large breakfast.
text_zh: 你睡在舒適的牀上...你睡足了覺，吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。
